name: Polynomial.eval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime
statement:
theorem eval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] {a b : R[X]}
    (h : IsCoprime a b) {x : R} (hb : b.eval x = 0) : a.eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h' := Polynomial.aeval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime (S := R) h x
  simpa [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, hb] using h'

name: WeierstrassCurve.Φ_two_eq
statement: lemma Φ_two_eq : W.Φ 2 = X * W.Ψ₂Sq - W.Ψ₃
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ_two, Ψ₂Sq, Ψ₃]
  simp only [map_ofNat, C_mul]
  ring1

name: WeierstrassCurve.bezout_Φ_two_Ψ₂Sq
statement:
theorem bezout_Φ_two_Ψ₂Sq :
    W.bezoutΦTwo * W.Φ 2 + W.bezoutΨ₂Sq * W.Ψ₂Sq = C (W.Δ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (4 : R[X]) * C W.b₈ = C W.b₂ * C W.b₆ - C W.b₄ ^ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg (C : R →+* R[X]) W.b_relation
    simp only [map_ofNat, C_sub, C_mul, C_pow] at h
    exact h
  rw [bezoutΦTwo, bezoutΨ₂Sq, Φ_two, Ψ₂Sq, Δ]
  C_simp
  linear_combination (norm := ring1)
    (-64 * C W.b₄ ^ 4 + 80 * C W.b₂ * C W.b₄ ^ 2 * C W.b₆ - 4 * C W.b₂ ^ 2 * C W.b₆ ^ 2
     - 12 * C W.b₂ ^ 2 * C W.b₄ * C W.b₈ - 324 * C W.b₄ * C W.b₆ ^ 2 + 112 * C W.b₄ ^ 2 * C W.b₈
     + 32 * C W.b₂ * C W.b₆ * C W.b₈ - 64 * C W.b₈ ^ 2)
      * hb

name: WeierstrassCurve.bezout_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq
statement:
theorem bezout_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq :
    (-W.bezoutΦTwo) * W.Ψ₃ + (W.bezoutΦTwo * X + W.bezoutΨ₂Sq) * W.Ψ₂Sq = C (W.Δ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := W.bezout_Φ_two_Ψ₂Sq
  rw [W.Φ_two_eq] at h
  linear_combination h

name: WeierstrassCurve.preΨ₄_sq_eq_Ψ₂Sq_pow_add_Ψ₃_mul
statement:
theorem preΨ₄_sq_eq_Ψ₂Sq_pow_add_Ψ₃_mul :
    W.preΨ₄ ^ 2 = W.Ψ₂Sq ^ 4 + W.Ψ₃ *
      ((12 * X + C W.b₂) * W.Ψ₂Sq * W.Ψ₃ - 4 * W.Ψ₃ ^ 2
        - (12 * X ^ 2 + C (2 * W.b₂) * X + C (2 * W.b₄)) * W.Ψ₂Sq ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (4 : R[X]) * C W.b₈ = C W.b₂ * C W.b₆ - C W.b₄ ^ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg (C : R →+* R[X]) W.b_relation
    simp only [map_ofNat, C_sub, C_mul, C_pow] at h
    exact h
  rw [preΨ₄, Ψ₂Sq, Ψ₃]
  C_simp
  linear_combination (norm := ring1)
    (13 * X ^ 8 + 8 * C W.b₂ * X ^ 7 + 28 * C W.b₄ * X ^ 6 + C W.b₂ ^ 2 * X ^ 6
      + 38 * C W.b₆ * X ^ 5 + 6 * C W.b₂ * C W.b₄ * X ^ 5 + 22 * C W.b₈ * X ^ 4
      + 8 * C W.b₄ ^ 2 * X ^ 4 + 7 * C W.b₂ * C W.b₆ * X ^ 4 + 16 * C W.b₄ * C W.b₆ * X ^ 3
      + 4 * C W.b₂ * C W.b₈ * X ^ 3 + 7 * C W.b₆ ^ 2 * X ^ 2 + 8 * C W.b₄ * C W.b₈ * X ^ 2
      + 6 * C W.b₆ * C W.b₈ * X + C W.b₈ ^ 2) * hb

name: WeierstrassCurve.Φ_eq_neg_adjacent_add
statement:
theorem Φ_eq_neg_adjacent_add (n : ℤ) :
    W.Φ n = -(W.preΨ (n + 1) * W.preΨ (n - 1) * (if Even n then 1 else W.Ψ₂Sq))
      + W.ΨSq n * X
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.Φ]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_succ_mul_ΨSq_pred
statement:
theorem ΨSq_succ_mul_ΨSq_pred (n : ℤ) :
    W.ΨSq (n + 1) * W.ΨSq (n - 1)
      = (W.preΨ (n + 1) * W.preΨ (n - 1) * (if Even n then 1 else W.Ψ₂Sq)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ¬Even (n + 1) ↔ Even n := by simp
  have hp : ¬Even (n - 1) ↔ Even n := by simp
  simp only [ΨSq]
  by_cases hn : Even n
  · rw [if_neg (by simpa [hs] using hn), if_neg (by simpa [hp] using hn), if_pos hn]
    ring
  · rw [if_pos (by simpa [hs] using hn), if_pos (by simpa [hp] using hn), if_neg hn]
    ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.isCoprime_Φ_ΨSq_of_isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.ΨSq_succ_mul_ΨSq_pred n] at h
  rw [W.Φ_eq_neg_adjacent_add n]
  exact (h.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left (dvd_pow_self _ two_ne_zero)).neg_left.add_mul_left_left X

name: WeierstrassCurve.isCoprime_Φ_ΨSq_of_isCoprime_ΨSq
statement:
theorem isCoprime_Φ_ΨSq_of_isCoprime_ΨSq {n : ℤ} (hs : IsCoprime (W.ΨSq (n + 1)) (W.ΨSq n))
    (hp : IsCoprime (W.ΨSq (n - 1)) (W.ΨSq n)) : IsCoprime (W.Φ n) (W.ΨSq n)
proof:
:=
  isCoprime_Φ_ΨSq_of_isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent (hs.mul_left hp)

name: WeierstrassCurve.eval_Φ_sq_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_Φ_sq_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero {n : ℤ} {x : R} (hx : (W.ΨSq n).eval x = 0) :
    (W.Φ n).eval x ^ 2 = (W.ΨSq (n + 1)).eval x * (W.ΨSq (n - 1)).eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eval_mul, W.ΨSq_succ_mul_ΨSq_pred n, W.Φ_eq_neg_adjacent_add n]
  simp only [eval_pow, eval_add, eval_neg, eval_mul, hx, zero_mul, add_zero]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.eval_Φ_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_adjacent_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eval_Φ_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_adjacent_ne_zero {n : ℤ} {x : R} (hx : (W.ΨSq n).eval x = 0)
    (h : (W.ΨSq (n + 1)).eval x * (W.ΨSq (n - 1)).eval x ≠ 0) : (W.Φ n).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  refine h ?_
  rw [← eval_Φ_sq_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero hx, h0]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.eval_Φ_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eval_Φ_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_ne_zero {n : ℤ} {x : R} (hx : (W.ΨSq n).eval x = 0)
    (hs : (W.ΨSq (n + 1)).eval x ≠ 0) (hp : (W.ΨSq (n - 1)).eval x ≠ 0) :
    (W.Φ n).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  eval_Φ_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_adjacent_ne_zero hx (mul_ne_zero hs hp)

name: WeierstrassCurve.eval_Φ_ne_zero_iff_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_Φ_ne_zero_iff_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero {n : ℤ} {x : R} (hx : (W.ΨSq n).eval x = 0) :
    (W.Φ n).eval x ≠ 0 ↔ (W.ΨSq (n + 1)).eval x * (W.ΨSq (n - 1)).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eval_Φ_sq_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero hx, ne_eq, ne_eq, pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.forall_eval_Φ_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem forall_eval_Φ_ne_zero_iff {n : ℤ} :
    (∀ x : R, (W.ΨSq n).eval x = 0 → (W.Φ n).eval x ≠ 0) ↔
      ∀ x : R, (W.ΨSq n).eval x = 0 →
        (W.ΨSq (n + 1)).eval x * (W.ΨSq (n - 1)).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h x hx => (eval_Φ_ne_zero_iff_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero hx).mp (h x hx),
    fun h x hx => (eval_Φ_ne_zero_iff_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero hx).mpr (h x hx)⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.isCoprime_of_eq_C_Δ_sq
statement:
private theorem isCoprime_of_eq_C_Δ_sq {a b p q : R[X]}
    (h : a * p + b * q = C (W.Δ ^ 2)) : IsCoprime p q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (W.isUnit_Δ.pow 2).map (C : R →+* R[X])
  refine ⟨(↑w⁻¹ : R[X]) * a, (↑w⁻¹ : R[X]) * b, ?_⟩
  have hring : (↑w⁻¹ : R[X]) * a * p + (↑w⁻¹ : R[X]) * b * q
      = (↑w⁻¹ : R[X]) * (a * p + b * q) := by ring
  rw [hring, h, ← hw, ← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.isCoprime_Φ_two_Ψ₂Sq
statement: theorem isCoprime_Φ_two_Ψ₂Sq : IsCoprime (W.Φ 2) W.Ψ₂Sq
proof:
:=
  W.isCoprime_of_eq_C_Δ_sq W.bezout_Φ_two_Ψ₂Sq

name: WeierstrassCurve.isCoprime_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq
statement: theorem isCoprime_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq : IsCoprime W.Ψ₃ W.Ψ₂Sq
proof:
:=
  W.isCoprime_of_eq_C_Δ_sq W.bezout_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq

name: WeierstrassCurve.isCoprime_preΨ₄_Ψ₃
statement: theorem isCoprime_preΨ₄_Ψ₃ : IsCoprime W.preΨ₄ W.Ψ₃
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsCoprime (W.preΨ₄ ^ 2) W.Ψ₃ := by
    rw [W.preΨ₄_sq_eq_Ψ₂Sq_pow_add_Ψ₃_mul]
    exact (W.isCoprime_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq.symm.pow_left).add_mul_left_left _
  exact h.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left (dvd_pow_self _ two_ne_zero)

name: WeierstrassCurve.isCoprime_Φ_three_ΨSq_three
statement: theorem isCoprime_Φ_three_ΨSq_three : IsCoprime (W.Φ 3) (W.ΨSq 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hΦ : W.Φ 3 = -(W.preΨ₄ * W.Ψ₂Sq) + W.Ψ₃ * (X * W.Ψ₃) := by
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.Φ_three]; ring1
  have h : IsCoprime (W.Φ 3) W.Ψ₃ := by
    rw [hΦ]
    exact ((W.isCoprime_preΨ₄_Ψ₃.mul_left W.isCoprime_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq.symm).neg_left).add_mul_left_left _
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_three]
  exact h.pow_right

name: EllipticCurves.Fixture.three_ne_zero_of_charZero
statement: lemma three_ne_zero_of_charZero : (3 : F) ≠ 0
proof: := by norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.formalLambda_mul_biX_sub
statement:
theorem formalLambda_mul_biX_sub :
    W.formalLambda * (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) = W.biY₂ - W.biY₁
proof:
:= by
  unfold formalLambda
  rw [mul_assoc, Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ W.isUnit_biX₂_sub_biX₁, mul_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.biY₁_eq
statement: theorem biY₁_eq : W.biY₁ = W.formalLambda * W.biX₁ + W.formalNu
proof:
:= by
  unfold formalNu; ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.biY₂_eq
statement: theorem biY₂_eq : W.biY₂ = W.formalLambda * W.biX₂ + W.formalNu
proof:
:= by
  unfold formalNu
  linear_combination -W.formalLambda_mul_biX_sub

name: WeierstrassCurve.weierstrass_thirdInt
statement:
theorem weierstrass_thirdInt :
    (W.formalLambda * W.formalXThree + W.formalNu) ^ 2
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * W.formalXThree
          * (W.formalLambda * W.formalXThree + W.formalNu)
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₃) * (W.formalLambda * W.formalXThree + W.formalNu)
      = W.formalXThree ^ 3 + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₂) * W.formalXThree ^ 2
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₄) * W.formalXThree
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₆)
proof:
:= by
  
  have q1 := W.biX₁_biY₁_weierstrass
  rw [W.biY₁_eq] at q1
  have q2 := W.biX₂_biY₂_weierstrass
  rw [W.biY₂_eq] at q2
  
  set K : (R⸨X⸩)⸨X⸩ :=
    -(W.biX₁ ^ 2 + W.biX₁ * W.biX₂ + W.biX₂ ^ 2)
      + (W.formalLambda ^ 2 + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * W.formalLambda
          - HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₂)) * (W.biX₁ + W.biX₂)
      + (2 * W.formalLambda * W.formalNu + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * W.formalNu
          + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₃) * W.formalLambda
          - HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₄)) with hKdef
  
  have hK : K = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := W.isUnit_biX₂_sub_biX₁
    have hmul : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) * K = 0 := by rw [hKdef]; linear_combination q2 - q1
    have hu' : (u : (R⸨X⸩)⸨X⸩) * K = 0 := by rw [hu]; exact hmul
    exact (Units.mul_right_eq_zero u).mp hu'
  
  unfold formalXThree
  linear_combination q1
    + (W.formalLambda ^ 2 + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * W.formalLambda
        - HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₂) - W.biX₁ - W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) * hK

name: WeierstrassCurve.formalXThree_formalYThree_weierstrass
statement:
theorem formalXThree_formalYThree_weierstrass :
    W.formalYThree ^ 2 + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * W.formalXThree * W.formalYThree
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₃) * W.formalYThree
      = W.formalXThree ^ 3 + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₂) * W.formalXThree ^ 2
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₄) * W.formalXThree
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₆)
proof:
:= by
  unfold formalYThree
  linear_combination W.weierstrass_thirdInt

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_formalY
statement: theorem isUnit_formalY : IsUnit W.formalY
proof:
:=
  IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one _ (by rw [mul_neg, W.formalY_mul_coe_formalW, neg_neg])

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_biX₁_zero
statement: theorem coeff_biX₁_zero : W.biX₁.coeff 0 = W.formalX
proof:
:= by
  rw [biX₁, cConstRingHom, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_single_same]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_biY₁_zero
statement: theorem coeff_biY₁_zero : W.biY₁.coeff 0 = W.formalY
proof:
:= by
  rw [biY₁, cConstRingHom, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_single_same]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_biY₁_of_ne
statement: theorem coeff_biY₁_of_ne {g : ℤ} (h : g ≠ 0) : W.biY₁.coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [biY₁, cConstRingHom, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_single_of_ne h]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_biY₂
statement: theorem coeff_biY₂ (g : ℤ) : W.biY₂.coeff g = HahnSeries.C (W.formalY.coeff g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [biY₂, cLaurentRingHom, HahnSeries.mapRingHom_apply, HahnSeries.map_coeff]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_d_neg_one
statement: private lemma coeff_d_neg_one : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff (-1) = -HahnSeries.C W.a₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biX₂, coeff_formalX_neg_one, W.coeff_biX₁_of_ne (by norm_num),
    sub_zero, map_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_d_zero
statement:
private lemma coeff_d_zero :
    (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff 0 = -HahnSeries.C W.a₂ - W.formalX
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biX₂, coeff_formalX_zero, W.coeff_biX₁_zero, map_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_d_one
statement: private lemma coeff_d_one : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff 1 = -HahnSeries.C W.a₃
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biX₂, coeff_formalX_one, W.coeff_biX₁_of_ne (by norm_num),
    sub_zero, map_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_n_neg_three
statement: private lemma coeff_n_neg_three : (W.biY₂ - W.biY₁).coeff (-3) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biY₂, coeff_formalY_neg_three, W.coeff_biY₁_of_ne (by norm_num),
    sub_zero, map_neg, map_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_n_neg_two
statement: private lemma coeff_n_neg_two : (W.biY₂ - W.biY₁).coeff (-2) = HahnSeries.C W.a₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biY₂, coeff_formalY_neg_two, W.coeff_biY₁_of_ne (by norm_num),
    sub_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_n_neg_one
statement: private lemma coeff_n_neg_one : (W.biY₂ - W.biY₁).coeff (-1) = HahnSeries.C W.a₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biY₂, coeff_formalY_neg_one, W.coeff_biY₁_of_ne (by norm_num),
    sub_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_n_zero
statement:
private lemma coeff_n_zero :
    (W.biY₂ - W.biY₁).coeff 0 = HahnSeries.C W.a₃ - W.formalY
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biY₂, coeff_formalY_zero, W.coeff_biY₁_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_n_of_lt
statement: private lemma coeff_n_of_lt {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -3) : (W.biY₂ - W.biY₁).coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biY₂, W.coeff_formalY_of_lt hg, map_zero,
    W.coeff_biY₁_of_ne (by omega), sub_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.orderTop_d
statement:
private lemma orderTop_d [Nontrivial R] :
    (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).orderTop = ((-2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (HahnSeries.orderTop_le_of_coeff_ne_zero ?_) ?_
  · rw [W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_neg_two]; exact one_ne_zero
  · rw [HahnSeries.le_orderTop_iff_forall]
    intro j hj
    exact W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt (by exact_mod_cast hj)

name: WeierstrassCurve.d_ne_zero
statement: private lemma d_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  W.isUnit_biX₂_sub_biX₁.ne_zero

name: WeierstrassCurve.order_d
statement: private lemma order_d [Nontrivial R] : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).order = -2
proof:
:= by
  have : ((W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).order : WithTop ℤ) = ((-2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) := by
    rw [HahnSeries.order_eq_orderTop_of_ne_zero W.d_ne_zero, W.orderTop_d]
  exact_mod_cast this

name: WeierstrassCurve.leadingCoeff_d
statement: private lemma leadingCoeff_d [Nontrivial R] : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).leadingCoeff = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_eq, W.order_d, W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_neg_two]

name: WeierstrassCurve.orderTop_inv_d
statement:
private lemma orderTop_inv_d [Nontrivial R] :
    (Ring.inverse (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁)).orderTop = ((2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) * Ring.inverse (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) = 1 :=
    Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ W.isUnit_biX₂_sub_biX₁
  have hinv0 : Ring.inverse (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := W.isUnit_biX₂_sub_biX₁
    rw [← hu, Ring.inverse_unit]; exact u⁻¹.ne_zero
  have hlc : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).leadingCoeff *
      (Ring.inverse (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁)).leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := by
    rw [W.leadingCoeff_d, one_mul]; exact HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hinv0
  have h := HahnSeries.orderTop_mul_of_ne_zero hlc
  rw [hmul, HahnSeries.orderTop_one, W.orderTop_d] at h
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp
    (HahnSeries.orderTop_ne_top.mpr hinv0)
  rw [← hk] at h ⊢
  rw [← WithTop.coe_add, ← WithTop.coe_zero, WithTop.coe_eq_coe] at h
  rw [WithTop.coe_eq_coe]
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_lambdaPrincipal_mul
statement:
private lemma coeff_lambdaPrincipal_mul (y : (R⸨X⸩)⸨X⸩) (g : ℤ) :
    (W.lambdaPrincipal * y).coeff g
      = (-1) * y.coeff (g + 1)
        + (-W.formalX) * y.coeff (g - 1)
        + (-W.formalY - HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * W.formalX) * y.coeff (g - 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lambdaPrincipal, add_mul, add_mul, HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.coeff_add,
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul,
    sub_neg_eq_add]

name: WeierstrassCurve.orderTop_n_sub_lambdaPrincipal_mul_d
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.le_orderTop_iff_forall]
  intro g hg
  have hg1 : g < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hg
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, W.coeff_lambdaPrincipal_mul]
  rcases lt_or_ge g (-3 : ℤ) with hlt | hge
  · rw [W.coeff_n_of_lt hlt, W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt (show g + 1 < -2 by omega),
      W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt (show g - 1 < -2 by omega),
      W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt (show g - 2 < -2 by omega)]
    ring
  · have hz3 : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff (-3) = 0 := W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt (by norm_num)
    have hz4 : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff (-4) = 0 := W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt (by norm_num)
    have hz5 : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff (-5) = 0 := W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt (by norm_num)
    interval_cases g <;>
      simp only [W.coeff_n_neg_three, W.coeff_n_neg_two, W.coeff_n_neg_one, W.coeff_n_zero,
        W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_neg_two, W.coeff_d_neg_one, W.coeff_d_zero, W.coeff_d_one,
        hz3, hz4, hz5, show (-3 : ℤ) + 1 = -2 by norm_num,
        show (-3 : ℤ) - 1 = -4 by norm_num, show (-3 : ℤ) - 2 = -5 by norm_num,
        show (-2 : ℤ) + 1 = -1 by norm_num, show (-2 : ℤ) - 1 = -3 by norm_num,
        show (-2 : ℤ) - 2 = -4 by norm_num, show (-1 : ℤ) + 1 = 0 by norm_num,
        show (-1 : ℤ) - 1 = -2 by norm_num, show (-1 : ℤ) - 2 = -3 by norm_num,
        show (0 : ℤ) + 1 = 1 by norm_num, show (0 : ℤ) - 1 = -1 by norm_num,
        show (0 : ℤ) - 2 = -2 by norm_num] <;> ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.orderTop_lambda_sub_principal
statement:
private lemma orderTop_lambda_sub_principal [Nontrivial R] :
    ((3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ (W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) * Ring.inverse (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) = 1 :=
    Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ W.isUnit_biX₂_sub_biX₁
  have hfac : ((W.biY₂ - W.biY₁) - W.lambdaPrincipal * (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁))
      * Ring.inverse (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) = W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal := by
    rw [formalLambda, sub_mul, mul_assoc, hmul, mul_one]
  calc ((3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = ((1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) + ((2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) := by
        rw [← WithTop.coe_add]; norm_num
    _ ≤ ((W.biY₂ - W.biY₁) - W.lambdaPrincipal * (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁)).orderTop
          + (Ring.inverse (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁)).orderTop :=
        add_le_add W.orderTop_n_sub_lambdaPrincipal_mul_d (le_of_eq W.orderTop_inv_d.symm)
    _ ≤ _ := by rw [← hfac]; exact HahnSeries.orderTop_add_le_mul

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_CC_mul

name: WeierstrassCurve.orderTop_lamP_sq

name: WeierstrassCurve.le_orderTop_CC_mul

proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ HahnSeries.orderTop_add_le_mul

name: WeierstrassCurve.le_orderTop_add'

name: WeierstrassCurve.le_orderTop_sub'

proof:

  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.formalYThree_sub_biY₁_eq
proof:
:= by
  unfold formalYThree formalXThree formalNu zpureY qY
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.orderTop_zpureY_ge
statement:
private lemma orderTop_zpureY_ge [Nontrivial R] :
    ((-3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ W.zpureY.orderTop
proof:
:= by
  have hCCL2 : ((-3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
      ≤ (HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * W.lambdaPrincipal ^ 2).orderTop :=
    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (-3 : ℤ) ≤ -2))
      (le_trans W.orderTop_lamP_sq (le_orderTop_CC_mul _ _))
  have hCC2L : ((-3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
      ≤ (HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₂) * W.lambdaPrincipal).orderTop :=
    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (-3 : ℤ) ≤ -1))
      (le_trans W.orderTop_lamP (le_orderTop_CC_mul _ _))
  have hCC1CC1L : ((-3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
      ≤ (HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) *
          (HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * W.lambdaPrincipal)).orderTop :=
    le_trans (le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (-3 : ℤ) ≤ -1))
      (le_trans W.orderTop_lamP (le_orderTop_CC_mul _ _))) (le_orderTop_CC_mul _ _)
  have hLbiX1 : ((-3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ (W.lambdaPrincipal * W.biX₁).orderTop := by
    refine le_trans ?_ (W.le_orderTop_lamP_mul W.biX₁)
    rw [show ((-3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = ((-1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) + ((-2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by
      rw [← WithTop.coe_add]; norm_num]
    exact add_le_add (le_refl _)
      (le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (-2 : ℤ) ≤ 0)) W.orderTop_biX₁)
  have hLbiX2 : ((-3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ (W.lambdaPrincipal * W.biX₂).orderTop := by

    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (-3 : ℤ) ≤ 0))

  have hCC1CC1 : ((-2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
      ≤ (HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁)
          : (R⸨X⸩)⸨X⸩).orderTop :=
    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (-2 : ℤ) ≤ 0))
      (le_trans (orderTop_CC _) (le_orderTop_CC_mul _ _))
  have hbiX1 : ((-2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ W.biX₁.orderTop :=
    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (-2 : ℤ) ≤ 0)) W.orderTop_biX₁
  have hbiX2 : ((-2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ W.biX₂.orderTop := W.orderTop_biX₂
  unfold qY
  refine le_orderTop_add' (le_orderTop_add' (le_orderTop_add' (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_add'
    (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_sub'
    (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_sub'
    (le_orderTop_sub' (le_orderTop_sub' ?_ hL2) hL2) hLh) hLh) hLh) hhh) hCCL) hCCL) hCCL) hCCL)
    hCCh) hCCh) hCC2) hCC1CC1) hbiX1) hbiX1) hbiX2

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_zpureY_of_lt

        coeff_CC_of_ne W.a₃ (show (-1 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num),
        W.coeff_lamP_mul_biX₁, W.coeff_lamP_cube_neg_three, W.coeff_lamP_cube_neg_two,

        W.coeff_lamP_sq_neg_one, W.coeff_lamP_sq_zero, W.coeff_lamP_neg_one, W.coeff_lamP_zero,
        W.coeff_lamP_mul_biX₂_neg_three, W.coeff_lamP_mul_biX₂_neg_two,

        W.coeff_biX₂_neg_two, W.coeff_biX₂_neg_one, W.coeff_biX₂_zero, W.coeff_biY₁_zero,

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_formalYThree

    refine HahnSeries.isUnit_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_AddUnitOrder ?_ (AddGroup.isAddUnit _)
    have hlc : W.formalYThree.leadingCoeff = W.formalY := by
      rw [show W.formalYThree = W.biY₁ + (W.formalYThree - W.biY₁) by ring,

    rw [HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_eq, W.order_formalX, W.coeff_formalX_neg_two]
  have h := HahnSeries.coeff_mul_order_add_order W.formalX W.formalX
  rw [W.order_formalX, hlc, mul_one, show (-2 : ℤ) + (-2) = -4 by norm_num, ← sq] at h
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalX_sq_of_lt
statement:
private lemma coeff_formalX_sq_of_lt [Nontrivial R] {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -4) :
    (W.formalX ^ 2).coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
  refine lt_of_lt_of_le
    (show ((g : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) < ((-4 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by exact_mod_cast hg) ?_
  rw [sq]
  refine le_trans ?_ HahnSeries.orderTop_add_le_mul
  rw [show ((-4 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = ((-2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) + ((-2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by
    rw [← WithTop.coe_add]; norm_num]
  exact add_le_add (le_of_eq W.orderTop_formalX.symm) (le_of_eq W.orderTop_formalX.symm)

name: WeierstrassCurve.orderTop_lam_sub_prin_mul_qX
statement:
private lemma orderTop_lam_sub_prin_mul_qX [Nontrivial R] :
    ((2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ ((W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal) * W.qX).orderTop
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ HahnSeries.orderTop_add_le_mul
  rw [show ((2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = ((3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) + ((-1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by
    rw [← WithTop.coe_add]; norm_num]
  exact add_le_add W.orderTop_lambda_sub_principal W.orderTop_qX_ge

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalXThree_one
statement:
theorem coeff_formalXThree_one [Nontrivial R] :
    W.formalXThree.coeff 1
      = W.formalY + W.formalY + HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * W.formalX + HahnSeries.C W.a₃
proof:
:= by
  have hdecomp : W.formalXThree
      = W.biX₁ + W.zpureX + (W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal) * W.qX := by
    linear_combination W.formalXThree_sub_biX₁_eq
  rw [hdecomp, HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.coeff_add,
    HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (show ((1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) < ((2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by
        exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) < 2)) W.orderTop_lam_sub_prin_mul_qX),
    W.coeff_biX₁_of_ne (show (1 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num), add_zero, zero_add, zpureX]
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_add, coeff_CC_mul, W.coeff_lamP_sq_one,
    W.coeff_lamP_one, coeff_CC_of_ne W.a₂ (show (1 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num),
    W.coeff_biX₁_of_ne (show (1 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num), W.coeff_biX₂_one]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalXThree_one_inner_neg_three
statement:
theorem coeff_formalXThree_one_inner_neg_three [Nontrivial R] :
    (W.formalXThree.coeff 1).coeff (-3) = -2
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.coeff_formalXThree_one]
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, sub_zero,
    W.coeff_formalY_neg_three, W.coeff_formalX_of_lt (show (-3 : ℤ) < -2 by norm_num),
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_of_ne (show (-3 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalXThree_one_inner_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_formalXThree_one_inner_of_lt [Nontrivial R] {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -3) :
    (W.formalXThree.coeff 1).coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.coeff_formalXThree_one]
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, sub_zero,
    W.coeff_formalY_of_lt hg, W.coeff_formalX_of_lt (show g < -2 by omega),
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_of_ne (show g ≠ 0 by omega)]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.lam_sub_prin_mul_d
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_mul, W.formalLambda_mul_biX_sub]

name: WeierstrassCurve.orderTop_d_sub_single
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.le_orderTop_iff_forall]
  intro g hg
  have hg2 : g < -1 := by exact_mod_cast hg
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_single]
  by_cases hgeq : g = -2
  · rw [hgeq, W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_neg_two, if_pos rfl, sub_self]
  · rw [W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt (by omega), if_neg hgeq, sub_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_lam_sub_prin_mul_d_one
proof:
:= by
  set h := W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal with hh
  have hvanish :
      (h * ((W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) - HahnSeries.single (-2) 1)).coeff 1 = 0 := by
    apply HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (show ((1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) < ((2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by
      exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) < 2)) ?_
    refine le_trans ?_ HahnSeries.orderTop_add_le_mul
    rw [show ((2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = ((3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) + ((-1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by
      rw [← WithTop.coe_add]; norm_num]
    exact add_le_add W.orderTop_lambda_sub_principal W.orderTop_d_sub_single
  have hsplit : W.biX₂ - W.biX₁
      = HahnSeries.single (-2) 1 + ((W.biX₂ - W.biX₁) - HahnSeries.single (-2) 1) := by ring
  rw [hsplit, mul_add, HahnSeries.coeff_add, hvanish, add_zero, HahnSeries.coeff_mul_single,
    show (1 : ℤ) - (-2) = 3 by norm_num, mul_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_lamP_mul_d_one
statement:
private lemma coeff_lamP_mul_d_one :
    (W.lambdaPrincipal * (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁)).coeff 1
      = -(W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff 2 - W.formalX * (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff 0
        + (-W.formalY - HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * W.formalX) * (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff (-1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.coeff_lambdaPrincipal_mul, show (1 : ℤ) + 1 = 2 by norm_num,
    show (1 : ℤ) - 1 = 0 by norm_num, show (1 : ℤ) - 2 = -1 by norm_num]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_eq
statement:
private lemma coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_eq [Nontrivial R] :
    (W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).coeff 3
      = HahnSeries.C (W.formalY.coeff 1) + HahnSeries.C (W.formalX.coeff 2)
        - HahnSeries.C W.a₂ * W.formalX - W.formalX ^ 2
        - HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * W.formalY
        - HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * (HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * W.formalX)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← W.coeff_lam_sub_prin_mul_d_one, W.lam_sub_prin_mul_d, HahnSeries.coeff_sub,
    W.coeff_lamP_mul_d_one, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, W.coeff_biY₂,
    W.coeff_biY₁_of_ne (show (1 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num), sub_zero,
    show (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff 2 = HahnSeries.C (W.formalX.coeff 2) by
      rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, W.coeff_biX₂, W.coeff_biX₁_of_ne (show (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num),
        sub_zero],
    W.coeff_d_zero, W.coeff_d_neg_one]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_inner
statement:
private lemma coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_inner [Nontrivial R] :
    ((W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).coeff 3).coeff (-4) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_eq]
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.C_apply,
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, sub_zero, W.coeff_formalX_sq_neg_four,
    W.coeff_formalX_of_lt (show (-4 : ℤ) < -2 by norm_num),
    W.coeff_formalY_of_lt (show (-4 : ℤ) < -3 by norm_num),
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_of_ne (show (-4 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_inner_of_lt
statement:
private lemma coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_inner_of_lt [Nontrivial R] {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -4) :
    ((W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).coeff 3).coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_eq]
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.C_apply,
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, sub_zero, W.coeff_formalX_sq_of_lt hg,
    W.coeff_formalX_of_lt (show g < -2 by omega), W.coeff_formalY_of_lt (show g < -3 by omega),
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_of_ne (show g ≠ 0 by omega)]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_lambda_sq_two
statement:
private lemma coeff_lambda_sq_two [Nontrivial R] :
    (W.formalLambda ^ 2).coeff 2
      = W.formalX ^ 2
        - ((W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).coeff 3
            + (W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).coeff 3)
proof:
:= by
  set h := W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal with hh
  have hlam : W.formalLambda = W.lambdaPrincipal + h := by rw [hh]; ring
  have hh2 : (h ^ 2).coeff 2 = 0 := by
    apply HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (show ((2 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) < ((6 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by
      exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (2 : ℤ) < 6)) ?_
    rw [sq]
    refine le_trans ?_ HahnSeries.orderTop_add_le_mul
    rw [show ((6 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) = ((3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) + ((3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by
      rw [← WithTop.coe_add]; norm_num]
    exact add_le_add W.orderTop_lambda_sub_principal W.orderTop_lambda_sub_principal
  have hLh : (W.lambdaPrincipal * h).coeff 2 = -h.coeff 3 := by
    rw [W.coeff_lambdaPrincipal_mul, show (2 : ℤ) + 1 = 3 by norm_num,
      show (2 : ℤ) - 1 = 1 by norm_num, show (2 : ℤ) - 2 = 0 by norm_num,
      HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
        (lt_of_lt_of_le (show ((1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) < h.orderTop from
          lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) < 3))
            W.orderTop_lambda_sub_principal) (le_refl _)),
      HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
        (lt_of_lt_of_le (show ((0 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) < h.orderTop from
          lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (0 : ℤ) < 3))
            W.orderTop_lambda_sub_principal) (le_refl _))]
    ring
  calc (W.formalLambda ^ 2).coeff 2
      = (W.lambdaPrincipal ^ 2 + (W.lambdaPrincipal * h + W.lambdaPrincipal * h)
          + h ^ 2).coeff 2 := by rw [hlam]; congr 1; ring
    _ = (W.lambdaPrincipal ^ 2).coeff 2
          + ((W.lambdaPrincipal * h).coeff 2 + (W.lambdaPrincipal * h).coeff 2)
          + (h ^ 2).coeff 2 := by
        rw [HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.coeff_add]
    _ = W.formalX ^ 2 - (h.coeff 3 + h.coeff 3) := by rw [W.coeff_lamP_sq_two, hLh, hh2]; ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.order_formalXThree_zero
statement: private lemma order_formalXThree_zero [Nontrivial R] : W.formalXThree.order = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hne : W.formalXThree ≠ 0 :=
    HahnSeries.orderTop_ne_top.mp (by rw [W.orderTop_formalXThree]; exact WithTop.zero_ne_top)
  have h : (W.formalXThree.order : WithTop ℤ) = (0 : WithTop ℤ) := by
    rw [HahnSeries.order_eq_orderTop_of_ne_zero hne, W.orderTop_formalXThree]
  exact_mod_cast h

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalXThree_zero
statement: private lemma coeff_formalXThree_zero [Nontrivial R] : W.formalXThree.coeff 0 = W.formalX
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (0 : ℤ) = W.formalXThree.order from W.order_formalXThree_zero.symm,
    ← HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_eq, W.leadingCoeff_formalXThree]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalXThree_two_eq
statement:
private lemma coeff_formalXThree_two_eq [Nontrivial R] :
    W.formalXThree.coeff 2
      = W.formalX ^ 2
        - ((W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).coeff 3
            + (W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).coeff 3)
        + HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * (-W.formalY - HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * W.formalX)
        - HahnSeries.C (W.formalX.coeff 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [formalXThree, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_sub,
    HahnSeries.coeff_add, W.coeff_lambda_sq_two, coeff_CC_mul,
    W.coeff_lambda_eq_principal (show (2 : ℤ) < 3 by norm_num), W.coeff_lamP_two,
    coeff_CC_of_ne W.a₂ (show (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num),
    W.coeff_biX₁_of_ne (show (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num), W.coeff_biX₂]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalXThree_two_inner_neg_four
statement:
theorem coeff_formalXThree_two_inner_neg_four [Nontrivial R] :
    (W.formalXThree.coeff 2).coeff (-4) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have key := W.coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_inner
  rw [W.coeff_formalXThree_two_eq]
  set c := (W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).coeff 3 with hc
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.coeff_neg, HahnSeries.C_apply,
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, sub_zero, W.coeff_formalX_sq_neg_four, key,
    W.coeff_formalX_of_lt (show (-4 : ℤ) < -2 by norm_num),
    W.coeff_formalY_of_lt (show (-4 : ℤ) < -3 by norm_num),
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_of_ne (show (-4 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalXThree_two_inner_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_formalXThree_two_inner_of_lt [Nontrivial R] {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -4) :
    (W.formalXThree.coeff 2).coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key := W.coeff_lam_sub_prin_three_inner_of_lt hg
  rw [W.coeff_formalXThree_two_eq]
  set c := (W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal).coeff 3 with hc
  simp only [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_add, HahnSeries.coeff_neg, HahnSeries.C_apply,
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, sub_zero, W.coeff_formalX_sq_of_lt hg, key,
    W.coeff_formalX_of_lt (show g < -2 by omega),
    W.coeff_formalY_of_lt (show g < -3 by omega),
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_of_ne (show g ≠ 0 by omega)]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_lambda_mul_formalXThree_one
proof:
:= by
  set h := W.formalLambda - W.lambdaPrincipal with hh
  have hlam : W.formalLambda = W.lambdaPrincipal + h := by rw [hh]; ring
  have hhx : (h * W.formalXThree).coeff 1 = 0 := by
    apply HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (show ((1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) < ((3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) by
      exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (1 : ℤ) < 3)) ?_
    have hb : ((3 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ) ≤ h.orderTop + W.formalXThree.orderTop := by
      rw [W.orderTop_formalXThree, add_zero]; exact W.orderTop_lambda_sub_principal
    exact le_trans hb HahnSeries.orderTop_add_le_mul
  have hxm1 : W.formalXThree.coeff (-1) = 0 :=
    HahnSeries.coeff_eq_zero_of_lt_orderTop
      (by rw [W.orderTop_formalXThree]; exact_mod_cast (by norm_num : (-1 : ℤ) < 0))
  rw [hlam, add_mul, HahnSeries.coeff_add, hhx, add_zero, W.coeff_lambdaPrincipal_mul,
    show (1 : ℤ) + 1 = 2 by norm_num, show (1 : ℤ) - 1 = 0 by norm_num,
    show (1 : ℤ) - 2 = -1 by norm_num, W.coeff_formalXThree_zero, hxm1]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalNu_one
statement: private lemma coeff_formalNu_one [Nontrivial R] : W.formalNu.coeff 1 = W.formalX ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [formalNu, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, W.coeff_biY₁_of_ne (show (1 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num),
    show (W.formalLambda * W.biX₁).coeff 1 = W.formalLambda.coeff 1 * W.formalX by
      rw [biX₁, cConstRingHom, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_mul_single_zero],
    W.coeff_lambda_eq_principal (show (1 : ℤ) < 3 by norm_num), W.coeff_lamP_one]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalYThree_one_eq
statement:
theorem coeff_formalYThree_one_eq [Nontrivial R] :
    W.formalYThree.coeff 1
      = W.formalXThree.coeff 2 - HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * W.formalXThree.coeff 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [formalYThree, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.coeff_neg,
    HahnSeries.coeff_add, W.coeff_lambda_mul_formalXThree_one, W.coeff_formalNu_one, coeff_CC_mul,
    coeff_CC_of_ne W.a₃ (show (1 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalYThree_one_inner_neg_four
statement:
theorem coeff_formalYThree_one_inner_neg_four [Nontrivial R] :
    (W.formalYThree.coeff 1).coeff (-4) = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.coeff_formalYThree_one_eq, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, W.coeff_formalXThree_two_inner_neg_four,
    HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, sub_zero,
    W.coeff_formalXThree_one_inner_of_lt (show (-4 : ℤ) < -3 by norm_num)]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalYThree_one_inner_of_lt
statement:
theorem coeff_formalYThree_one_inner_of_lt [Nontrivial R] {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -4) :
    (W.formalYThree.coeff 1).coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.coeff_formalYThree_one_eq, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, HahnSeries.C_apply,
    HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, sub_zero,
    W.coeff_formalXThree_one_inner_of_lt (show g < -3 by omega),
    W.coeff_formalXThree_two_inner_of_lt hg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_formalX
statement: theorem isUnit_formalX : IsUnit W.formalX
proof:
:=
  IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one ((W.formalW : R⸨X⸩) * HahnSeries.single (-1 : ℤ) 1) (by
    rw [← mul_assoc, W.formalX_mul_coe_formalW, HahnSeries.single_mul_single,
      show (1 : ℤ) + (-1) = 0 by norm_num, mul_one, HahnSeries.single_zero_one])

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalNu_neg_one
statement: private lemma coeff_formalNu_neg_one [Nontrivial R] : W.formalNu.coeff (-1) = W.formalX
proof:
:= by
  rw [formalNu, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, W.coeff_biY₁_of_ne (show (-1 : ℤ) ≠ 0 by norm_num),
    show (W.formalLambda * W.biX₁).coeff (-1) = W.formalLambda.coeff (-1) * W.formalX by
      rw [biX₁, cConstRingHom, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_mul_single_zero],
    W.coeff_lambda_eq_principal (show (-1 : ℤ) < 3 by norm_num), W.coeff_lamP_neg_one]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalNu_of_lt
statement:
private lemma coeff_formalNu_of_lt [Nontrivial R] {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -1) :
    W.formalNu.coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [formalNu, HahnSeries.coeff_sub, W.coeff_biY₁_of_ne (show g ≠ 0 by omega),
    show (W.formalLambda * W.biX₁).coeff g = W.formalLambda.coeff g * W.formalX by
      rw [biX₁, cConstRingHom, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_mul_single_zero],
    W.coeff_lambda_eq_principal (show g < 3 by omega), W.coeff_lamP_of_lt hg]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_formalNu
statement: theorem isUnit_formalNu : IsUnit W.formalNu
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ := subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
  · have hlead : W.formalNu.coeff (-1) = W.formalX := W.coeff_formalNu_neg_one
    have hle : W.formalNu.order ≤ -1 :=
      HahnSeries.order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (by rw [hlead]; exact W.isUnit_formalX.ne_zero)
    have hne : W.formalNu ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h, HahnSeries.coeff_zero] at hlead
      exact W.isUnit_formalX.ne_zero hlead.symm
    have hge : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ W.formalNu.order := by
      by_contra hlt
      exact HahnSeries.coeff_order_eq_zero.not.2 hne (W.coeff_formalNu_of_lt (not_le.mp hlt))
    have horder : W.formalNu.order = -1 := le_antisymm hle hge
    refine HahnSeries.isUnit_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_AddUnitOrder ?_ ?_
    · rw [HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_eq, horder, hlead]; exact W.isUnit_formalX
    · rw [horder]; exact AddGroup.isAddUnit _

name: WeierstrassCurve.biZ₂_sub_biZ₁_mul_biY₂_mul_biY₁
statement:
theorem biZ₂_sub_biZ₁_mul_biY₂_mul_biY₁ :
    (W.biZ₂ - W.biZ₁) * (W.biY₂ * W.biY₁) = -W.formalNu * (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination W.biY₁ * W.biZ₂_mul_biY₂ - W.biY₂ * W.biZ₁_mul_biY₁
    - W.biX₂ * W.biY₁_eq + W.biX₁ * W.biY₂_eq

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_biZ₂_sub_biZ₁
statement: theorem isUnit_biZ₂_sub_biZ₁ : IsUnit (W.biZ₂ - W.biZ₁)
proof:
:= by
  refine isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left (y := W.biY₂ * W.biY₁) ?_
  rw [W.biZ₂_sub_biZ₁_mul_biY₂_mul_biY₁]
  exact W.isUnit_formalNu.neg.mul W.isUnit_biX₂_sub_biX₁

name: PowerSeries.coe_adicEval
statement:
theorem coe_adicEval {x : A} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    letI : WithIdeal A
proof:
:= ⟨I⟩
    ⇑(adicEval I hx) = eval₂ (RingHom.id A) x := by
  letI : WithIdeal A := ⟨I⟩
  haveI : CompleteSpace A := ((IsAdic.isAdicComplete_iff (I := I) rfl).mp ‹_›).1
  haveI : T2Space A := ((IsAdic.isAdicComplete_iff (I := I) rfl).mp ‹_›).2
  exact coe_eval₂Hom continuous_id (WithIdeal.isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_mem hx)

name: PowerSeries.adicEval_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adicEval_X {x : A} (hx : x ∈ I) : adicEval I hx (X : PowerSeries A) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_adicEval hx, eval₂_X]

name: PowerSeries.adicEval_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adicEval_C {x : A} (hx : x ∈ I) (a : A) : adicEval I hx (C a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_adicEval hx, eval₂_C, RingHom.id_apply]

name: PowerSeries.adicEval_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adicEval_one {x : A} (hx : x ∈ I) : adicEval I hx (1 : PowerSeries A) = 1
proof:
:=
  map_one _

name: PowerSeries.adicEval_eq_tsum
statement:
theorem adicEval_eq_tsum {x : A} (hx : x ∈ I) (f : PowerSeries A) :
    letI : WithIdeal A
proof:
:= ⟨I⟩
    adicEval I hx f = ∑' n : ℕ, coeff n f * x ^ n := by
  letI : WithIdeal A := ⟨I⟩
  haveI : CompleteSpace A := ((IsAdic.isAdicComplete_iff (I := I) rfl).mp ‹_›).1
  haveI : T2Space A := ((IsAdic.isAdicComplete_iff (I := I) rfl).mp ‹_›).2
  have := eval₂_eq_tsum (φ := RingHom.id A) (a := x) continuous_id
    (WithIdeal.isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_mem hx) f
  simpa only [coe_adicEval hx, RingHom.id_apply] using this

name: PowerSeries.adicEval_mem
statement:
theorem adicEval_mem {x : A} (hx : x ∈ I) {f : PowerSeries A}
    (hf : constantCoeff f = 0) : adicEval I hx f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := X_dvd_iff.mpr hf
  rw [map_mul, adicEval_X]
  exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hx

name: PowerSeries.coe_adicEvalMv
statement:
theorem coe_adicEvalMv (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A] {a : σ → A} (ha : ∀ s, a s ∈ I) :
    letI : WithIdeal A
proof:
:= ⟨I⟩
    ⇑(adicEvalMv I ha) = MvPowerSeries.eval₂ (RingHom.id A) a := by
  letI : WithIdeal A := ⟨I⟩
  haveI : CompleteSpace A := ((IsAdic.isAdicComplete_iff (I := I) rfl).mp ‹_›).1
  haveI : T2Space A := ((IsAdic.isAdicComplete_iff (I := I) rfl).mp ‹_›).2
  exact MvPowerSeries.coe_eval₂Hom continuous_id
    ⟨fun s ↦ WithIdeal.isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_mem (ha s), by
      rw [Filter.cofinite_eq_bot]; exact Filter.tendsto_bot⟩

name: PowerSeries.adicEvalMv_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adicEvalMv_X (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A] {a : σ → A} (ha : ∀ s, a s ∈ I) (s : σ) :
    adicEvalMv I ha (MvPowerSeries.X s) = a s
proof:
:= by
  letI : WithIdeal A := ⟨I⟩
  rw [coe_adicEvalMv I ha, MvPowerSeries.eval₂_X]

name: PowerSeries.adicEvalMv_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adicEvalMv_C (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A] {a : σ → A} (ha : ∀ s, a s ∈ I) (r : A) :
    adicEvalMv I ha (MvPowerSeries.C r : MvPowerSeries σ A) = r
proof:
:= by
  letI : WithIdeal A := ⟨I⟩
  rw [coe_adicEvalMv I ha, MvPowerSeries.eval₂_C, RingHom.id_apply]

name: PowerSeries.adicEvalMv_mem
statement:
theorem adicEvalMv_mem (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A] {a : σ → A} (ha : ∀ s, a s ∈ I)
    {f : MvPowerSeries σ A} (hf : MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff f = 0) :
    adicEvalMv I ha f ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  letI : WithIdeal A := ⟨I⟩
  haveI : CompleteSpace A := ((IsAdic.isAdicComplete_iff (I := I) rfl).mp ‹_›).1
  haveI : T2Space A := ((IsAdic.isAdicComplete_iff (I := I) rfl).mp ‹_›).2
  have hev : MvPowerSeries.HasEval a :=
    ⟨fun s ↦ WithIdeal.isTopologicallyNilpotent_of_mem (ha s), by
      rw [Filter.cofinite_eq_bot]; exact Filter.tendsto_bot⟩
  
  have hIclosed : IsClosed (I : Set A) := by
    have hopen : IsOpen (((I ^ 1).toAddSubgroup) : Set A) := (I.openAddSubgroup 1).isOpen'
    have := AddSubgroup.isClosed_of_isOpen ((I ^ 1).toAddSubgroup) hopen
    simpa [pow_one] using this
  
  have pow_mem : ∀ (b : A) (k : ℕ), b ∈ I → 0 < k → b ^ k ∈ I := by
    intro b k hb hk
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hk.ne'
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact I.mul_mem_left _ hb
  
  have term_mem : ∀ d : σ →₀ ℕ,
      (RingHom.id A) (MvPowerSeries.coeff d f) * (d.prod fun s e ↦ a s ^ e) ∈ I := by
    intro d
    by_cases hd : d = 0
    · subst hd
      rw [MvPowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, hf, map_zero, zero_mul]
      exact I.zero_mem
    · have hprod : (d.prod fun s e ↦ a s ^ e) ∈ I := by
        obtain ⟨s0, hs0⟩ := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.mpr hd
        rw [← Finsupp.mul_prod_erase d s0 (fun s e ↦ a s ^ e) hs0]
        exact I.mul_mem_right _
          (pow_mem (a s0) (d s0) (ha s0) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hs0)))
      exact I.mul_mem_left _ hprod
  
  have hsum := MvPowerSeries.hasSum_eval₂ (φ := RingHom.id A) (a := a) continuous_id hev f
  have key : MvPowerSeries.eval₂ (RingHom.id A) a f ∈ (I : Set A) := by
    refine hIclosed.mem_of_tendsto hsum (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s ↦ ?_)
    simpa only [SetLike.mem_coe] using Ideal.sum_mem I fun d _ ↦ term_mem d
  have hcoe : adicEvalMv I ha f = MvPowerSeries.eval₂ (RingHom.id A) a f :=
    congrFun (coe_adicEvalMv I ha) f
  rw [hcoe]
  exact key

name: HahnSeries.mapRingHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapRingHom_apply (f : R →+* S) (x : HahnSeries Γ R) : mapRingHom f x = x.map f
proof: := rfl

name: HahnSeries.mapRingHom_C
statement:
theorem mapRingHom_C (f : R →+* S) (r : R) :
    mapRingHom f (C r) = (C (f r) : HahnSeries Γ S)
proof:
:=
  map_C r f

name: HahnSeries.mapRingHom_single
statement:
theorem mapRingHom_single (f : R →+* S) (a : Γ) (r : R) :
    mapRingHom f (single a r) = single a (f r)
proof:
:=
  HahnSeries.map_single f.toAddMonoidHom.toZeroHom

name: WeierstrassCurve.cLaurentRingHom_single_one
statement:
theorem cLaurentRingHom_single_one :
    cLaurentRingHom R (HahnSeries.single (1 : ℤ) 1) = W.biZ₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [cLaurentRingHom, HahnSeries.mapRingHom_single, map_one, biZ₂]

name: WeierstrassCurve.cLaurentRingHom_C
statement:
theorem cLaurentRingHom_C (a : R) :
    cLaurentRingHom R (HahnSeries.C a) = HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C a : R⸨X⸩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cLaurentRingHom, HahnSeries.mapRingHom_C]

name: WeierstrassCurve.biX₁_mul_biW₁
statement: theorem biX₁_mul_biW₁ : W.biX₁ * W.biW₁ = W.biZ₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [biX₁, biW₁, biZ₁, ← map_mul, W.formalX_mul_coe_formalW]

name: WeierstrassCurve.biX₂_mul_biW₂
statement: theorem biX₂_mul_biW₂ : W.biX₂ * W.biW₂ = W.biZ₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [biX₂, biW₂, ← map_mul, W.formalX_mul_coe_formalW, W.cLaurentRingHom_single_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.biY₁_mul_biW₁
statement: theorem biY₁_mul_biW₁ : W.biY₁ * W.biW₁ = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [biY₁, biW₁, ← map_mul, W.formalY_mul_coe_formalW, map_neg, map_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.biY₂_mul_biW₂
statement: theorem biY₂_mul_biW₂ : W.biY₂ * W.biW₂ = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [biY₂, biW₂, ← map_mul, W.formalY_mul_coe_formalW, map_neg, map_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.biZ₁_mul_biY₁
statement: theorem biZ₁_mul_biY₁ : W.biZ₁ * W.biY₁ = -W.biX₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [biZ₁, biY₁, biX₁, ← map_mul, W.single_one_mul_formalY, map_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.biZ₂_mul_biY₂
statement: theorem biZ₂_mul_biY₂ : W.biZ₂ * W.biY₂ = -W.biX₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [biY₂, biX₂, ← W.cLaurentRingHom_single_one, ← map_mul, W.single_one_mul_formalY, map_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.biX₁_biY₁_weierstrass
statement:
theorem biX₁_biY₁_weierstrass :
    W.biY₁ ^ 2 + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * W.biX₁ * W.biY₁
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₃) * W.biY₁
      = W.biX₁ ^ 3 + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₂) * W.biX₁ ^ 2
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₄) * W.biX₁ + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₆)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (cConstRingHom R) W.formalX_formalY_weierstrass
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow] at h
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.biX₂_biY₂_weierstrass
statement:
theorem biX₂_biY₂_weierstrass :
    W.biY₂ ^ 2 + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₁) * W.biX₂ * W.biY₂
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₃) * W.biY₂
      = W.biX₂ ^ 3 + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₂) * W.biX₂ ^ 2
        + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₄) * W.biX₂ + HahnSeries.C (HahnSeries.C W.a₆)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (cLaurentRingHom R) W.formalX_formalY_weierstrass
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow, cLaurentRingHom_C] at h
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_biW₁
statement: theorem isUnit_biW₁ : IsUnit W.biW₁
proof: := W.isUnit_coe_formalW.map (cConstRingHom R)

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_biW₂
statement: theorem isUnit_biW₂ : IsUnit W.biW₂
proof: := W.isUnit_coe_formalW.map (cLaurentRingHom R)

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_biX₂
statement: theorem coeff_biX₂ (g : ℤ) : W.biX₂.coeff g = HahnSeries.C (W.formalX.coeff g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [biX₂, cLaurentRingHom, HahnSeries.mapRingHom_apply, HahnSeries.map_coeff]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_biX₁_of_ne
statement: theorem coeff_biX₁_of_ne {g : ℤ} (h : g ≠ 0) : W.biX₁.coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [biX₁, cConstRingHom, HahnSeries.C_apply, HahnSeries.coeff_single_of_ne h]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_neg_two
statement: theorem coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_neg_two : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff (-2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biX₂, coeff_formalX_neg_two, W.coeff_biX₁_of_ne (by norm_num),
    sub_zero, map_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt
statement: theorem coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -2) : (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁).coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.coeff_sub, coeff_biX₂, W.coeff_formalX_of_lt hg, map_zero,
    W.coeff_biX₁_of_ne (by omega), sub_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_biX₂_sub_biX₁
statement: theorem isUnit_biX₂_sub_biX₁ : IsUnit (W.biX₂ - W.biX₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | _ := subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · exact isUnit_of_subsingleton _
  · set d := W.biX₂ - W.biX₁ with hd
    have hlead : d.coeff (-2) = 1 := W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_neg_two
    have hne : d ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; rw [h, HahnSeries.coeff_zero] at hlead; exact one_ne_zero hlead.symm
    have hle : d.order ≤ -2 :=
      HahnSeries.order_le_of_coeff_ne_zero (by rw [hlead]; exact one_ne_zero)
    have hge : (-2 : ℤ) ≤ d.order := by
      by_contra hlt
      exact HahnSeries.coeff_order_eq_zero.not.2 hne (W.coeff_biX₂_sub_biX₁_of_lt (not_le.mp hlt))
    have horder : d.order = -2 := le_antisymm hle hge
    refine HahnSeries.isUnit_of_isUnit_leadingCoeff_AddUnitOrder ?_ ?_
    · rw [HahnSeries.leadingCoeff_eq, horder, hlead]; exact isUnit_one
    · rw [horder]; exact AddGroup.isAddUnit _

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_wCofactor
statement: lemma coeff_wCofactor (n : ℕ) : coeff n W.wCofactor = coeff (n + 3) W.formalW
proof:
:= by
  rw [wCofactor, coeff_mk]

name: WeierstrassCurve.formalW_eq_X_pow_mul_wCofactor
statement: theorem formalW_eq_X_pow_mul_wCofactor : W.formalW = X ^ 3 * W.wCofactor
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [coeff_X_pow_mul']
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [coeff_wCofactor, Nat.sub_add_cancel h]
  · exact coeff_of_lt_order m
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact_mod_cast Nat.not_le.mp h) W.order_formalW)

name: WeierstrassCurve.constantCoeff_wCofactor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constantCoeff_wCofactor : constantCoeff W.wCofactor = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff_apply, coeff_wCofactor, zero_add, coeff_formalW_three]

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_wCofactor
statement: theorem isUnit_wCofactor : IsUnit W.wCofactor
proof:
:=
  isUnit_iff_constantCoeff.mpr (by simp)

name: WeierstrassCurve.wCofactor_mul_invOfUnit
statement: theorem wCofactor_mul_invOfUnit : W.wCofactor * invOfUnit W.wCofactor 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  mul_invOfUnit W.wCofactor 1 (by rw [constantCoeff_wCofactor, Units.val_one])

name: WeierstrassCurve.order_formalW_eq
statement: theorem order_formalW_eq [Nontrivial R] : W.formalW.order = 3
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (order_le 3 (by rw [coeff_formalW_three]; exact one_ne_zero)) W.order_formalW

name: WeierstrassCurve.coe_formalW_eq
statement:
theorem coe_formalW_eq :
    (W.formalW : R⸨X⸩) = HahnSeries.single (3 : ℤ) 1 * (W.wCofactor : R⸨X⸩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [W.formalW_eq_X_pow_mul_wCofactor, coe_mul, coe_pow, HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries_X,
    HahnSeries.single_pow]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.isUnit_coe_formalW
statement: theorem isUnit_coe_formalW : IsUnit (W.formalW : R⸨X⸩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_formalW_eq]
  refine IsUnit.mul ?_ (W.isUnit_wCofactor.map (HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries ℤ R))
  refine ⟨⟨HahnSeries.single (3 : ℤ) 1, HahnSeries.single (-3 : ℤ) 1, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  · simp [HahnSeries.single_mul_single]
  · simp [HahnSeries.single_mul_single]

name: WeierstrassCurve.formalX_mul_coe_formalW
statement:
theorem formalX_mul_coe_formalW :
    W.formalX * (W.formalW : R⸨X⸩) = HahnSeries.single (1 : ℤ) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [formalX, coe_formalW_eq, mul_mul_mul_comm, HahnSeries.single_mul_single,
    ← coe_mul, mul_comm (invOfUnit W.wCofactor 1) W.wCofactor,
    W.wCofactor_mul_invOfUnit, coe_one, mul_one]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.formalY_mul_coe_formalW
statement:
theorem formalY_mul_coe_formalW :
    W.formalY * (W.formalW : R⸨X⸩) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ((-3 : ℤ) + 3) = 0 := by norm_num
  have hr : ((-1 : R) * 1) = -(1 : R) := by ring
  rw [formalY, coe_formalW_eq, mul_mul_mul_comm, HahnSeries.single_mul_single,
    ← coe_mul, mul_comm (invOfUnit W.wCofactor 1) W.wCofactor,
    W.wCofactor_mul_invOfUnit, coe_one, mul_one, hg, hr,
    HahnSeries.single_neg, HahnSeries.single_zero_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.single_one_mul_formalY
statement:
theorem single_one_mul_formalY :
    HahnSeries.single (1 : ℤ) 1 * W.formalY = -W.formalX
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ((1 : ℤ) + -3) = -2 := by norm_num
  have hr : ((1 : R) * -1) = -(1 : R) := by ring
  rw [formalY, formalX, ← mul_assoc, HahnSeries.single_mul_single, hg, hr,
    HahnSeries.single_neg, neg_mul]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coe_powerSeries_coeff_of_neg
statement:
theorem coe_powerSeries_coeff_of_neg (p : R⟦X⟧) {g : ℤ} (hg : g < 0) :
    (p : R⸨X⸩).coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [HahnSeries.ofPowerSeries_apply, HahnSeries.embDomain_notin_range]
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  simp only [Nat.castOrderEmbedding, OrderEmbedding.coe_ofStrictMono] at hn
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalX_neg_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_formalX_neg_two : W.formalX.coeff (-2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ((-2 : ℤ) - (-2)) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by norm_num
  rw [formalX, HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, h0, LaurentSeries.coeff_coe_powerSeries]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalY_neg_three
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_formalY_neg_three : W.formalY.coeff (-3) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ((-3 : ℤ) - (-3)) = ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by norm_num
  rw [formalY, HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, h0, LaurentSeries.coeff_coe_powerSeries]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalX_of_lt
statement: theorem coeff_formalX_of_lt {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -2) : W.formalX.coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [formalX, HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, one_mul]
  exact coe_powerSeries_coeff_of_neg _ (by omega)

name: WeierstrassCurve.coeff_formalY_of_lt
statement: theorem coeff_formalY_of_lt {g : ℤ} (hg : g < -3) : W.formalY.coeff g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [formalY, HahnSeries.coeff_single_mul, coe_powerSeries_coeff_of_neg _ (by omega), mul_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.coe_formalW_functional_eq
statement:
theorem coe_formalW_functional_eq :
    (W.formalW : R⸨X⸩)
      = HahnSeries.single (1 : ℤ) 1 ^ 3
        + (HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * HahnSeries.single 1 1
            + HahnSeries.C W.a₂ * HahnSeries.single 1 1 ^ 2) * (W.formalW : R⸨X⸩)
        + (HahnSeries.C W.a₃ + HahnSeries.C W.a₄ * HahnSeries.single 1 1)
            * (W.formalW : R⸨X⸩) ^ 2
        + HahnSeries.C W.a₆ * (W.formalW : R⸨X⸩) ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [W.formalW_eq, wOp]
  simp only [PowerSeries.coe_add, PowerSeries.coe_mul, PowerSeries.coe_pow, PowerSeries.coe_C,
    PowerSeries.coe_X]

name: WeierstrassCurve.formalX_formalY_weierstrass
statement:
theorem formalX_formalY_weierstrass :
    W.formalY ^ 2 + HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * W.formalX * W.formalY + HahnSeries.C W.a₃ * W.formalY
      = W.formalX ^ 3 + HahnSeries.C W.a₂ * W.formalX ^ 2 + HahnSeries.C W.a₄ * W.formalX
        + HahnSeries.C W.a₆
proof:
:= by
  set w : R⸨X⸩ := (W.formalW : R⸨X⸩) with hw
  set z : R⸨X⸩ := HahnSeries.single (1 : ℤ) 1 with hz
  have hx : W.formalX * w = z := W.formalX_mul_coe_formalW
  have hy : W.formalY * w = -1 := W.formalY_mul_coe_formalW
  have hFE : w = z ^ 3
      + (HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * z + HahnSeries.C W.a₂ * z ^ 2) * w
      + (HahnSeries.C W.a₃ + HahnSeries.C W.a₄ * z) * w ^ 2
      + HahnSeries.C W.a₆ * w ^ 3 := W.coe_formalW_functional_eq
  
  refine (((W.isUnit_coe_formalW.pow 3)).mul_left_inj).mp ?_
  
  have e1 : W.formalY ^ 2 * w ^ 3 = w := by
    linear_combination (w * (W.formalY * w - 1)) * hy
  have e2 : W.formalX * W.formalY * w ^ 3 = -(z * w) := by
    linear_combination (W.formalY * w ^ 2) * hx + (z * w) * hy
  have e3 : W.formalY * w ^ 3 = -w ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination (w ^ 2) * hy
  have e4 : W.formalX ^ 3 * w ^ 3 = z ^ 3 := by
    linear_combination ((W.formalX * w) ^ 2 + (W.formalX * w) * z + z ^ 2) * hx
  have e5 : W.formalX ^ 2 * w ^ 3 = z ^ 2 * w := by
    linear_combination (w * (W.formalX * w + z)) * hx
  have e6 : W.formalX * w ^ 3 = z * w ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination (w ^ 2) * hx
  linear_combination e1 + HahnSeries.C W.a₁ * e2 + HahnSeries.C W.a₃ * e3 - e4
    - HahnSeries.C W.a₂ * e5 - HahnSeries.C W.a₄ * e6 + hFE

name: vieta_root_of_regular
statement:
theorem vieta_root_of_regular {T : Type*} [CommRing T] (F : T → T) (A B Cc x y z a : T)
    (hdiff : ∀ u v : T, F u - F v = (u - v) * (A * (u ^ 2 + u * v + v ^ 2) + B * (u + v) + Cc))
    (hFx : F x = 0) (hFy : F y = 0) (hA : A * a = 1) (hz : z = -(B * a) - x - y)
    (hreg : ∀ c : T, (x - y) * c = 0 → c = 0) : F z = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hGxy : A * (x ^ 2 + x * y + y ^ 2) + B * (x + y) + Cc = 0 := by
    refine hreg _ ?_
    have h := hdiff x y
    rw [hFx, hFy] at h
    linear_combination -h
  
  have hFz : F z = (z - x) * (A * (z ^ 2 + z * x + x ^ 2) + B * (z + x) + Cc) := by
    have h := hdiff z x
    rw [hFx] at h
    linear_combination h
  
  have hfactor : A * (z ^ 2 + z * x + x ^ 2) + B * (z + x) + Cc
      = (z - y) * (A * (z + x + y) + B) := by
    have h2 : A * (z ^ 2 + z * x + x ^ 2) + B * (z + x) + Cc
        = (z - y) * (A * (z + x + y) + B) + (A * (x ^ 2 + x * y + y ^ 2) + B * (x + y) + Cc) := by
      ring
    rw [h2, hGxy, add_zero]
  
  have hlin : A * (z + x + y) + B = 0 := by
    rw [hz]; linear_combination -B * hA
  rw [hFz, hfactor, hlin, mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_mul_X_shift
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPowerSeries.X_def, MvPowerSeries.coeff_add_mul_monomial, mul_one]

name: MvPowerSeries.eq_zero_of_mul_X_one_sub_X_zero_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mul_X_one_sub_X_zero_eq_zero (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin 2) R)
    (h : (X 1 - X 0) * c = 0) : c = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : c * X 1 = c * X 0 := by linear_combination h
  refine MvPowerSeries.ext fun d => ?_
  rw [map_zero]
  
  suffices H : ∀ n (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), d 0 = n → MvPowerSeries.coeff d c = 0 by
    exact H (d 0) d rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro d hd
    by_cases hd0 : d 0 = 0
    · 
      have hk := congrArg (MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 1 1)) hcomm
      rw [coeff_mul_X_shift] at hk
      have hrhs : MvPowerSeries.coeff (d + Finsupp.single 1 1) (c * X 0) = 0 := by
        refine MvPowerSeries.X_dvd_iff.mp ⟨c, by ring⟩ _ ?_
        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, hd0, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1), zero_add]
      exact hk.trans hrhs
    · 
      have hpos : 1 ≤ d 0 := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hd0
      have hle : Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 ≤ d := Finsupp.single_le_iff.mpr hpos
      set m := d - Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 with hm
      have hdeq : m + Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 = d := tsub_add_cancel_of_le hle
      have hk := congrArg
        (MvPowerSeries.coeff (m + Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1)) hcomm
      rw [coeff_mul_X_shift, show
          m + Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1
            = m + Finsupp.single 1 1 + Finsupp.single 0 1 from add_right_comm _ _ _,
        coeff_mul_X_shift] at hk
      rw [hdeq] at hk
      have hd0m : d 0 = m 0 + 1 := by
        rw [← hdeq, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
      have hmc : MvPowerSeries.coeff (m + Finsupp.single 1 1) c = 0 := by
        refine ih (m 0) (by omega) (m + Finsupp.single 1 1) ?_
        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1), add_zero]
      exact hk.trans hmc
