name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_eq_neg_log_valuation
statement:
theorem ord_eq_neg_log_valuation {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ord v f = - WithZero.log (v.valuation W.FunctionField f)
proof:
:=
  count_eq_neg_log_valuation v hf

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.count_spanSingleton_algebraMap_liesOver
statement:
theorem count_spanSingleton_algebraMap_liesOver {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    count L w (spanSingleton B⁰ (algebraMap K L x))
      = (v.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.asIdeal : ℤ) * count K v (spanSingleton A⁰ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : algebraMap K L x ≠ 0 := by simpa using (algebraMap K L).injective.ne hx
  rw [count_eq_neg_log_valuation w hx', ← valuation_liesOver L v w x,
    valuation_eq_exp_neg_count v hx, ← exp_nsmul, log_exp]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ord_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem ord_functionFieldMap (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing)
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing)
    [w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal] {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ord w (functionFieldMap W K f)
      = (v.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.asIdeal : ℤ) * ord v f
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isScalarTower_coordinateRing_baseChange W K
  haveI := isScalarTower_functionFieldMap W K rfl
  rw [ord, ord]
  exact count_spanSingleton_algebraMap_liesOver
    (A := W.CoordinateRing) (K := W.FunctionField)
    ((W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField) v w hf

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem divisor_functionFieldMap (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing)
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing)
    [w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal] {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    divisor (W.map (algebraMap F K)) (functionFieldMap W K f) w
      = (v.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.asIdeal : ℤ) * divisor W f v
proof:
:= by

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ord_functionFieldMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem ord_functionFieldMap_eq_zero_iff (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing)
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing)
    [w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal] {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ord w (functionFieldMap W K f) = 0 ↔ ord v f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_functionFieldMap W K v w hf, mul_eq_zero]
  simp [ramificationIdx'_functionFieldMap_ne_zero v w]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.dvd_ord_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem dvd_ord_functionFieldMap {n : ℤ} (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing)

    [w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal] {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hd : n ∣ ord v f) :
    n ∣ ord w (functionFieldMap W K f)
proof:

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ord_functionFieldMap_under
statement:
theorem ord_functionFieldMap_under [Module.Finite F K]
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing)
    {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ord w (functionFieldMap W K f)
      = ((HeightOneSpectrum.under W.CoordinateRing w).asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.asIdeal : ℤ)
          * ord (HeightOneSpectrum.under W.CoordinateRing w) f
proof:
:= by
  haveI : w.asIdeal.LiesOver (HeightOneSpectrum.under W.CoordinateRing w).asIdeal := by
    rw [HeightOneSpectrum.under_asIdeal]; infer_instance
  exact ord_functionFieldMap W K _ w hf

statement:
theorem divisor_functionFieldMap_under [Module.Finite F K]
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing)

      = ((HeightOneSpectrum.under W.CoordinateRing w).asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.asIdeal : ℤ)

proof:

  exact divisor_functionFieldMap _ w hf

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ord_functionFieldMap_under_eq_zero_iff

theorem ord_functionFieldMap_under_eq_zero_iff [Module.Finite F K]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.dvd_ord_functionFieldMap_under
statement:
theorem dvd_ord_functionFieldMap_under [Module.Finite F K] {n : ℤ}
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_liesOver
statement:
theorem exists_liesOver [Module.Finite F K] (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    ∃ w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing,
      w.asIdeal.LiesOver v.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQmax, hQ⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal_ideal_liesOver_of_isIntegral
    (R := W.CoordinateRing) (S := (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing) v.asIdeal
  refine ⟨⟨Q, hQmax.isPrime, ?_⟩, hQ⟩
  rintro rfl
  refine v.ne_bot (hQ.over.trans ?_)
  rw [Ideal.under, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
  exact (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp
    (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective W.CoordinateRing _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_under_eq
statement:
theorem exists_under_eq [Module.Finite F K] (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    ∃ w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing,
      HeightOneSpectrum.under W.CoordinateRing w = v
proof:
:=
  let ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_liesOver W K v
  ⟨w, HeightOneSpectrum.ext hw.over.symm⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ord_eq_of_forall_ord_functionFieldMap_eq
statement:
theorem ord_eq_of_forall_ord_functionFieldMap_eq [Module.Finite F K] {n : ℤ}
    {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing,
      n * ord w (functionFieldMap W K g) = ord w (functionFieldMap W K f))
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    n * ord v g = ord v f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_liesOver W K v
  haveI := hw
  have hwv := h w
  rw [ord_functionFieldMap W K v w hf, ord_functionFieldMap W K v w hg] at hwv
  refine mul_left_cancel₀ (a := (v.asIdeal.ramificationIdx' w.asIdeal : ℤ)) ?_ ?_
  · exact_mod_cast ramificationIdx'_functionFieldMap_ne_zero v w
  · rw [← hwv]; ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_eq_of_divisor_functionFieldMap_eq
statement:
theorem divisor_eq_of_divisor_functionFieldMap_eq [Module.Finite F K] {n : ℤ}
    {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : n • divisor (W.map (algebraMap F K)) (functionFieldMap W K g)
      = divisor (W.map (algebraMap F K)) (functionFieldMap W K f)) :
    n • divisor W g = divisor W f
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simpa using ord_eq_of_forall_ord_functionFieldMap_eq W K hf hg
    (fun w => by simpa using congrArg (fun D => D w) h) v

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_functionFieldMap_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext v
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_liesOver W K v
    haveI := hw
    have hw0 := congrArg (fun D => D w) h
    simp only [divisor_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hw0 ⊢
    exact (ord_functionFieldMap_eq_zero_iff v w hf).mp hw0
  · intro h
    ext w
    have hv0 := congrArg (fun D => D (HeightOneSpectrum.under W.CoordinateRing w)) h
    simp only [divisor_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hv0 ⊢
    exact (ord_functionFieldMap_under_eq_zero_iff W K w hf).mpr hv0

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.certRoot_not_mem_range
statement:
private theorem certRoot_not_mem_range :
    certRoot ∉ Set.range (algebraMap ℚ (X ^ 2 + 1 : ℚ[X]).SplittingField)
proof:

  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have h := certRoot_eval
  rw [← hq, eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_hom] at h
  have hq0 : (q : ℚ) ^ 2 + 1 = 0 := by
    have := (map_eq_zero (algebraMap ℚ (X ^ 2 + 1 : ℚ[X]).SplittingField)).mp h
    simpa using this

          certPoint.asIdeal : ℤ)
        * ord (HeightOneSpectrum.under (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).CoordinateRing certPoint)
            (genPsi (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) (XClass (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) 0))

    Ideal.map (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing)
        (pointClosedPoint h).asIdeal
      = (pointClosedPointBaseChange K h).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [pointClosedPoint_asIdeal, pointClosedPointBaseChange_asIdeal]
  change Ideal.map (CoordinateRing.map W (algebraMap F K)) _ = _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ramificationIdx'_pointClosedPointBaseChange
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_pointClosedPointBaseChange (h : W.Equation x y) :
    (pointClosedPoint h).asIdeal.ramificationIdx'
        (pointClosedPointBaseChange K h).asIdeal = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_asIdeal_pointClosedPoint K h]
  refine Ideal.ramificationIdx'_map_self_eq_one ?_ ?_ <;>
    rw [map_asIdeal_pointClosedPoint K h]
  · exact (isMaximal_asIdeal_pointClosedPointBaseChange K h).ne_top
  · exact (pointClosedPointBaseChange K h).ne_bot

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.eq_pointClosedPointBaseChange_of_liesOver
statement:
theorem eq_pointClosedPointBaseChange_of_liesOver (h : W.Equation x y)
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing)
    [w.asIdeal.LiesOver (pointClosedPoint h).asIdeal] :
    w = pointClosedPointBaseChange K h
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (pointClosedPointBaseChange K h).asIdeal ≤ w.asIdeal := by
    rw [← map_asIdeal_pointClosedPoint K h, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, ← Ideal.under_def]
    exact le_of_eq (Ideal.LiesOver.over ..)
  exact HeightOneSpectrum.ext
    ((isMaximal_asIdeal_pointClosedPointBaseChange K h).eq_of_le w.isPrime.ne_top hle).symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ord_functionFieldMap_pointClosedPointBaseChange
statement:
theorem ord_functionFieldMap_pointClosedPointBaseChange (h : W.Equation x y)
    {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ord (pointClosedPointBaseChange K h) (functionFieldMap W K f) = ord (pointClosedPoint h) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord_functionFieldMap W K (pointClosedPoint h) _ hf,
    ramificationIdx'_pointClosedPointBaseChange K h]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_functionFieldMap_pointClosedPointBaseChange
statement:
theorem divisor_functionFieldMap_pointClosedPointBaseChange (h : W.Equation x y)
    {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    divisor (W.map (algebraMap F K)) (functionFieldMap W K f) (pointClosedPointBaseChange K h)
      = divisor W f (pointClosedPoint h)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [divisor_apply] using ord_functionFieldMap_pointClosedPointBaseChange K h hf

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.under_pointClosedPointBaseChange
statement:
theorem under_pointClosedPointBaseChange [Module.Finite F K] (h : W.Equation x y) :
    HeightOneSpectrum.under W.CoordinateRing (pointClosedPointBaseChange K h)
      = pointClosedPoint h
proof:
:= by
  refine HeightOneSpectrum.ext ?_
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.under_asIdeal]
  exact (Ideal.LiesOver.over ..).symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.under_eq_iff_liesOver
statement:
theorem under_eq_iff_liesOver [Module.Finite F K] (h : W.Equation x y)
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (W.map (algebraMap F K)).CoordinateRing) :
    HeightOneSpectrum.under W.CoordinateRing w = pointClosedPoint h ↔
      w.asIdeal.LiesOver (pointClosedPoint h).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hu
    rw [← hu, HeightOneSpectrum.under_asIdeal]
    infer_instance
  · intro hlo
    exact HeightOneSpectrum.ext ((HeightOneSpectrum.under_asIdeal ..).trans hlo.over.symm)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_functionFieldMap_eq_single
statement:
theorem divisor_functionFieldMap_eq_single [Module.Finite F K] (h : W.Equation x y)
    {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) {n : ℤ}
    (hfdiv : divisor W f = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h) n) :
    divisor (W.map (algebraMap F K)) (functionFieldMap W K f)
      = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPointBaseChange K h) n
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  rw [divisor_functionFieldMap_under W K w hf, hfdiv]
  by_cases hw : HeightOneSpectrum.under W.CoordinateRing w = pointClosedPoint h
  · haveI : w.asIdeal.LiesOver (pointClosedPoint h).asIdeal := (under_eq_iff_liesOver K h w).mp hw
    have hweq : w = pointClosedPointBaseChange K h :=
      eq_pointClosedPointBaseChange_of_liesOver K h w
    subst hweq
    rw [hw, Finsupp.single_eq_same, ramificationIdx'_pointClosedPointBaseChange K h,
      Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    simp
  · have hne : pointClosedPointBaseChange K h ≠ w := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hw (under_pointClosedPointBaseChange K h)
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hw, mul_zero, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hne)]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ramificationIdx'_cert
statement:
private theorem ramificationIdx'_cert :
    (pointClosedPoint equation_zero_zero_base).asIdeal.ramificationIdx'
        (pointClosedPointBaseChange (X ^ 2 + 1 : ℚ[X]).SplittingField
          equation_zero_zero_base).asIdeal = 1
proof:
:=
  ramificationIdx'_pointClosedPointBaseChange _ _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ord_functionFieldMap_cert
statement:
private theorem ord_functionFieldMap_cert :
    ord (pointClosedPointBaseChange (X ^ 2 + 1 : ℚ[X]).SplittingField equation_zero_zero_base)
        (functionFieldMap (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) (X ^ 2 + 1 : ℚ[X]).SplittingField
          (genPsi (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) (XClass (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) 0)))
      = ord (pointClosedPoint equation_zero_zero_base)
          (genPsi (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) (XClass (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) 0))
proof:
:=
  ord_functionFieldMap_pointClosedPointBaseChange _ _ genPsi_XClass_ne_zero

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_coe_units
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ord_coe_units (u : W.CoordinateRingˣ) (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    ord v (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField (u : W.CoordinateRing)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰
      (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField (u : W.CoordinateRing)) = 1 := by
    rw [← coeIdeal_span_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.mpr u.isUnit, coeIdeal_top]
  rw [ord, h1, count_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_coe_units
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisor_coe_units (u : W.CoordinateRingˣ) :
    divisor W (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField (u : W.CoordinateRing)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisorHom_apply (f : W.FunctionFieldˣ) :
    divisorHom W f = Multiplicative.ofAdd (divisor W (f : W.FunctionField))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.classGroup_mk_toPrincipalIdeal
statement:
lemma classGroup_mk_toPrincipalIdeal (x : W.FunctionFieldˣ) :
    ClassGroup.mk W.FunctionField
      (toPrincipalIdeal W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ClassGroup.mk_def]
  refine (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr ?_
  rw [canonicalEquiv_self, RingEquiv.coe_monoidHom_refl, Units.map_id, MonoidHom.id_apply]
  exact MonoidHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_algebraMap_base
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ord_algebraMap_base {c : F} (hc : c ≠ 0) (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    ord v (algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := ord_coe_units (W := W) ((Ne.isUnit hc).map (algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing)).unit v
  rwa [IsUnit.unit_spec, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_algebraMap_base
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisor_algebraMap_base {c : F} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    divisor W (algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp [hc]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (h : divisor W f = 0) : ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ f = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_unit_of_divisor_eq hf one_ne_zero (by rw [h, divisor_one])
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := CoordinateRing.exists_eq_algebraMap_of_isUnit u.isUnit
  rw [hc, Algebra.smul_def,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField] at hu
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, zero_mul] at hu
    exact zero_ne_one hu
  refine ⟨c⁻¹, inv_ne_zero hc0, ?_⟩
  rw [map_inv₀]
  exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by rwa [mul_comm] at hu)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem divisor_eq_zero_iff {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    divisor W f = 0 ↔ ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ f = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero hf, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
  exact divisor_algebraMap_base hc

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_ne_zero_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem divisor_ne_zero_of_forall_ne {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ c : F, f ≠ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) : divisor W f ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun hd => by
  obtain ⟨c, -, hfc⟩ := exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero hf hd
  exact h c hfc

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_scalar_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_of_ord_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing, ord v f = ord v g) :
    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c * f = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_unit_of_ord_eq hf hg h
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := CoordinateRing.exists_eq_algebraMap_of_isUnit u.isUnit
  rw [hc, Algebra.smul_def,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField] at hu
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hu⟩
  rintro rfl
  rw [map_zero, zero_mul] at hu
  exact hg hu.symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_scalar_of_divisor_eq
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_of_divisor_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : divisor W f = divisor W g) :
    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c * f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_scalar_of_ord_eq hf hg fun v => ?_
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun h v
  rwa [divisor_apply, divisor_apply] at this

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_eq_iff_exists_scalar
statement:
theorem divisor_eq_iff_exists_scalar {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    divisor W f = divisor W g ↔
      ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c * f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_scalar_of_divisor_eq hf hg, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
  rw [divisor_mul ((map_ne_zero_iff _ (algebraMap F W.FunctionField).injective).mpr hc) hf,
    divisor_algebraMap_base hc, zero_add]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_genX_ne_zero
statement: theorem divisor_genX_ne_zero : divisor W (CoordinateRing.genX W) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  divisor_ne_zero_of_forall_ne
    (fun h => CoordinateRing.genX_ne (W := W) 0 (by rw [h, map_zero]))
    (fun c => CoordinateRing.genX_ne c)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero

theorem exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)

proof:

  WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero hf h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.divisor_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem divisor_eq_zero_iff {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :

:=

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.divisor_ne_zero_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem divisor_ne_zero_of_forall_ne {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ c : F, f ≠ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) : divisor W f ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_ne_zero_of_forall_ne hf h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.exists_scalar_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_of_ord_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing, ord v f = ord v g) :
    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c * f = g

:=

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.exists_scalar_of_divisor_eq
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_of_divisor_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)

    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c * f = g
proof:
:=

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.divisor_eq_iff_exists_scalar
statement:
theorem divisor_eq_iff_exists_scalar {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.divisor_genX_ne_zero

name: Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_span
statement:
@[simp]
lemma natDegreeGenerator_span (p : F[X]) : natDegreeGenerator (Ideal.span {p}) = p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  unfold natDegreeGenerator
  have h : Associated (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (Ideal.span {p})) p := by
    rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton (α := F[X])]
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_generator _
  exact natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq (degree_eq_degree_of_associated h)

name: Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma natDegreeGenerator_top : natDegreeGenerator (⊤ : Ideal F[X]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_one, natDegreeGenerator_span, natDegree_one]

name: Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_mul
statement:
lemma natDegreeGenerator_mul {I J : Ideal F[X]} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    natDegreeGenerator (I * J) = natDegreeGenerator I + natDegreeGenerator J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : ∃ p, I = Ideal.span {p} := ⟨_, (Ideal.span_singleton_generator I).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ : ∃ q, J = Ideal.span {q} := ⟨_, (Ideal.span_singleton_generator J).symm⟩
  rw [Ideal.span_singleton_mul_span_singleton, natDegreeGenerator_span, natDegreeGenerator_span,
    natDegreeGenerator_span]
  refine natDegree_mul ?_ ?_
  · simpa [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hI
  · simpa [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using hJ

name: Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_pow
statement:
lemma natDegreeGenerator_pow {I : Ideal F[X]} (hI : I ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    natDegreeGenerator (I ^ n) = n * natDegreeGenerator I
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, natDegreeGenerator_mul (pow_ne_zero n hI) hI, ih]; ring

name: Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_eq_finrank_quotient
statement:
lemma natDegreeGenerator_eq_finrank_quotient (I : Ideal F[X]) :
    natDegreeGenerator I = Module.finrank F (F[X] ⧸ I)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_generator I]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_generator I]
  rw [natDegreeGenerator_span, finrank_quotient_span_eq_natDegree]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorIdeal_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisorIdeal_apply (I : Ideal W.CoordinateRing) (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    divisorIdeal W I v = ordIdeal v I
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorIdeal_span
statement:
lemma divisorIdeal_span (a : W.CoordinateRing) :
    divisorIdeal W (Ideal.span {a})
      = divisor W (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [divisorIdeal_apply, ordIdeal, divisor_apply, ord, coeIdeal_span_singleton]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorIdeal_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisorIdeal_top : divisorIdeal W (⊤ : Ideal W.CoordinateRing) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [divisorIdeal_apply, ordIdeal, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, Ideal.one_eq_top, coeIdeal_top, count_one]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorIdeal_mul
statement:
lemma divisorIdeal_mul {I J : Ideal W.CoordinateRing} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    divisorIdeal W (I * J) = divisorIdeal W I + divisorIdeal W J
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [divisorIdeal_apply, ordIdeal, Finsupp.add_apply, divisorIdeal_apply, divisorIdeal_apply,
    ordIdeal, ordIdeal, coeIdeal_mul, count_mul _ v (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hI)
      (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr hJ)]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorIdeal_prime
statement:
lemma divisorIdeal_prime (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    divisorIdeal W v.asIdeal = Finsupp.single v 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext w
  rw [divisorIdeal_apply, ordIdeal, count_maximal, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degDiv_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degDiv_zero : degDiv W (0 : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing →₀ ℤ) = 0
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_zero_index

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degDiv_add
statement:
lemma degDiv_add (D E : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing →₀ ℤ) :
    degDiv W (D + E) = degDiv W D + degDiv W E
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ => zero_mul _) (fun _ _ _ => add_mul _ _ _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degDiv_sub
statement:
lemma degDiv_sub (D E : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing →₀ ℤ) :
    degDiv W (D - E) = degDiv W D - degDiv W E
proof:
:= by
  have h := degDiv_add (W := W) (D - E) E
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degDiv_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degDiv_single (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) (n : ℤ) :
    degDiv W (Finsupp.single v n) = n * degPt v
proof:
:= by
  rw [degDiv, Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_mul _)]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.natDegreeGenerator_relNorm
statement:
theorem natDegreeGenerator_relNorm (I : Ideal W.CoordinateRing) (hI : I ≠ 0) :
    (Ideal.natDegreeGenerator (Ideal.relNorm F[X] I) : ℤ) = degDiv W (divisorIdeal W I)
proof:
:= by
  induction I using UniqueFactorizationMonoid.induction_on_prime with
  | h₁ => exact absurd rfl hI
  | h₂ x hx =>
      rw [Ideal.isUnit_iff.mp hx, Ideal.relNorm_top, divisorIdeal_top, degDiv_zero,
        Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_top]
      rfl
  | h₃ a p ha hp ih =>
      have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := hp.ne_zero
      have hvp : p.IsPrime := (Ideal.prime_iff_isPrime hp0).mp hp
      set v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing := ⟨p, hvp, hp0⟩ with hv
      have hprime : (Ideal.natDegreeGenerator (Ideal.relNorm F[X] p) : ℤ)
          = degDiv W (divisorIdeal W p) := by
        rw [divisorIdeal_prime v, degDiv_single, one_mul, degPt]
      rw [map_mul, Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_mul
          (by simpa using (Ideal.relNorm_eq_bot_iff (R := F[X])).not.mpr hp0)
          (by simpa using (Ideal.relNorm_eq_bot_iff (R := F[X])).not.mpr ha),
        divisorIdeal_mul hp0 ha, degDiv_add, Nat.cast_add, hprime, ih ha]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.deg_eq_degDiv
statement:
theorem deg_eq_degDiv {a : W.CoordinateRing} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (deg W a : ℤ) = degDiv W (divisor W (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a))
proof:
:= by
  have h := natDegreeGenerator_relNorm (W := W) (Ideal.span {a})
    (by simpa [Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot] using ha)
  rw [divisorIdeal_span] at h
  rw [← h, Ideal.relNorm_singleton, Algebra.intNorm_eq_norm, Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_span]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degDiv_divisor_add_ordInfty
statement:
theorem degDiv_divisor_add_ordInfty {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    degDiv W (divisor W f) + ordInfty W f = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := W.CoordinateRing) f
  set A := algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a with hA
  set B := algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField b with hB
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb
  have hB0 : B ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hB]
    exact fun h => hb0 ((IsFractionRing.injective W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField)
      (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_div] at hf
    exact hf rfl
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := fun h => hA0 (by rw [hA, h, map_zero])
  rw [divisor_div hA0 hB0, degDiv_sub, ← deg_eq_degDiv ha0, ← deg_eq_degDiv hb0,
    ordInfty_div hA0 hB0, ordInfty_algebraMap ha0, ordInfty_algebraMap hb0]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degDiv_divisor
statement:
theorem degDiv_divisor {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    degDiv W (divisor W f) = -ordInfty W f
proof:
:= by
  have := degDiv_divisor_add_ordInfty hf
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degPt_pos
statement: lemma degPt_pos (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) : 0 < degPt v
proof:
:= by
  rw [degPt, Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
  intro h
  have hne : Ideal.relNorm F[X] v.asIdeal ≠ ⊥ := by
    simpa using (Ideal.relNorm_eq_bot_iff (R := F[X])).not.mpr v.ne_bot
  have hgen : Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (Ideal.relNorm F[X] v.asIdeal) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hg
    exact hne (by rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_generator (Ideal.relNorm F[X] v.asIdeal), hg,
      Ideal.span_singleton_zero])
  have hunit : IsUnit (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (Ideal.relNorm F[X] v.asIdeal)) := by
    rw [Polynomial.isUnit_iff_degree_eq_zero, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hgen]
    exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → WithBot ℕ) h
  have htop : Ideal.relNorm F[X] v.asIdeal = ⊤ := by
    rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_generator (Ideal.relNorm F[X] v.asIdeal),
      Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
    exact hunit
  have h1 : (1 : F[X]) ∈ v.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap F[X] W.CoordinateRing) :=
    Ideal.relNorm_le_comap F[X] v.asIdeal (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, map_one] at h1
  exact v.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ h1 isUnit_one)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degDiv_nonneg
statement:
lemma degDiv_nonneg {D : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing →₀ ℤ} (hD : ∀ v, 0 ≤ D v) :
    0 ≤ degDiv W D
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun v _ => mul_nonneg (hD v) (Int.natCast_nonneg _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eq_zero_of_degDiv_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_degDiv_eq_zero {D : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing →₀ ℤ}
    (hD : ∀ v, 0 ≤ D v) (h : degDiv W D = 0) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  by_cases hv : v ∈ D.support
  · have hterm := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun w _ => mul_nonneg (hD w) (Int.natCast_nonneg (degPt w)))).mp h v hv
    have hpos : (0 : ℤ) < degPt v := by exact_mod_cast degPt_pos v
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hterm with h0 | h0
    · simpa using h0
    · omega
  · simpa using Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hv

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_eq_zero_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem divisor_eq_zero_of_nonneg {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hD : ∀ v, 0 ≤ divisor W f v) (hinf : 0 ≤ ordInfty W f) :
    divisor W f = 0 ∧ ordInfty W f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := degDiv_divisor_add_ordInfty hf
  have hnn := degDiv_nonneg (W := W) hD
  have hz : degDiv W (divisor W f) = 0 := by omega
  exact ⟨eq_zero_of_degDiv_eq_zero hD hz, by omega⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_eq_algebraMap_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem exists_eq_algebraMap_of_nonneg {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hD : ∀ v, 0 ≤ divisor W f v) (hinf : 0 ≤ ordInfty W f) :
    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ f = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c
proof:
:=
  exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero hf (divisor_eq_zero_of_nonneg hf hD hinf).1

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_galoisFunctionField_eq_of_nsmul_divisor_eq
statement:
theorem divisor_galoisFunctionField_eq_of_nsmul_divisor_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    {z : W.FunctionField} {g : (W⁄K).FunctionField}
    (h : n • divisor (W⁄K) g = divisor (W⁄K) (functionFieldMap W K z))
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[F] K) :
    divisor (W⁄K) (galoisFunctionField σ g) = divisor (W⁄K) g
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  have hz : ord ((mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ)).symm w) (functionFieldMap W K z)
      = ord w (functionFieldMap W K z) := by
    rw [← ord_galoisFunctionField_apply σ w, galoisFunctionField_functionFieldMap]
  have hw := congrArg (fun D => D w) h
  have hw' := congrArg (fun D => D ((mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ)).symm w)) h
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, divisor_apply, nsmul_eq_mul] at hw hw'
  rw [divisor_apply, divisor_apply, ord_galoisFunctionField_apply]
  have : (n : ℤ) * ord ((mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ)).symm w) g = (n : ℤ) * ord w g := by
    rw [hw', hz, hw]
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hn) this

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_nsmul_divisor_eq_of_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_divisor_eq_of_functionFieldMap [FiniteDimensional F K] [IsGalois F K]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {z : W.FunctionField} (hz : z ≠ 0)
    {g : (W⁄K).FunctionField} (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : n • divisor (W⁄K) g = divisor (W⁄K) (functionFieldMap W K z)) :
    ∃ g₂ : W.FunctionField, g₂ ≠ 0 ∧ n • divisor W g₂ = divisor W z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hgσ : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[F] K, galoisFunctionField σ g ≠ 0 := fun σ =>
    fun hzero => hg (by simpa using (galoisFunctionField (W := W) σ).injective (hzero.trans
      (map_zero (galoisFunctionField (W := W) σ)).symm))
  
  have hc : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[F] K, ∃ c : Kˣ,
      galoisFunctionField σ g = algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField (c : K) * g := by
    intro σ
    have h0 : divisor (W⁄K) (galoisFunctionField σ g / g) = 0 := by
      rw [divisor_div (hgσ σ) hg, divisor_galoisFunctionField_eq_of_nsmul_divisor_eq K hn h σ,
        sub_self]
    obtain ⟨c, hc0, hceq⟩ :=
      exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero (div_ne_zero (hgσ σ) hg) h0
    exact ⟨Units.mk0 c hc0, by rw [Units.val_mk0, ← hceq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hg]⟩
  choose cc hcc using hc
  
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField) :=
    (algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField).injective
  have hcocycle : groupCohomology.IsMulCocycle₁ cc := by
    intro σ τ
    have key : algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField ((cc (σ * τ) : K))
        = algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField ((σ (cc τ : K)) * (cc σ : K)) := by
      have h1 : galoisFunctionField (σ * τ) g
          = algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField ((σ (cc τ : K)) * (cc σ : K)) * g := by
        rw [galoisFunctionField_mul_apply, hcc τ, map_mul, galoisFunctionField_algebraMap,
          hcc σ, map_mul]
        ring
      have h2 := (hcc (σ * τ)).symm.trans h1
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ hg h2
    exact Units.ext (by simpa using hinj key)
  
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ :=
    groupCohomology.isMulCoboundary₁_of_isMulCocycle₁_of_aut_to_units cc hcocycle
  
  set g₁ : (W⁄K).FunctionField := g / algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField (β : K) with hg₁def
  have hβ0 : algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField (β : K) ≠ 0 := fun hzero =>
    β.ne_zero (hinj (hzero.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have hg₁0 : g₁ ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hg hβ0
  have hg₁inv : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[F] K, galoisFunctionField σ g₁ = g₁ := by
    intro σ
    have hcσ : (σ (β : K)) = (cc σ : K) * (β : K) := by
      have h' : σ • β = cc σ * β := div_eq_iff_eq_mul.mp (hβ σ)
      simpa [AlgEquiv.smul_units_def] using congrArg (fun u : Kˣ => (u : K)) h'
    rw [hg₁def, map_div₀, hcc σ, galoisFunctionField_algebraMap, hcσ, map_mul]
    rw [mul_comm (algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField (cc σ : K))
      (algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField (β : K))]
    rw [mul_comm (algebraMap K (W⁄K).FunctionField (cc σ : K)) g]
    rw [mul_div_mul_right _ _ (fun hzero =>
      (cc σ).ne_zero (hinj (hzero.trans (map_zero _).symm)))]
  have hdivg₁ : divisor (W⁄K) g₁ = divisor (W⁄K) g := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc0, hceq⟩ : ∃ c : K, c ≠ 0 ∧ (β : K) = c := ⟨(β : K), β.ne_zero, rfl⟩
    rw [hg₁def, divisor_div hg hβ0, hceq, divisor_algebraMap_base hc0, sub_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂0, hg₂⟩ :=
    exists_ne_zero_functionFieldMap_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq (W := W) hg₁0 hg₁inv
  refine ⟨g₂, hg₂0, ?_⟩
  have hup : ((n : ℤ)) • divisor (W⁄K) (functionFieldMap W K g₂)
      = divisor (W⁄K) (functionFieldMap W K z) := by
    rw [hg₂, hdivg₁, ← h, natCast_zsmul]
  have := divisor_eq_of_divisor_functionFieldMap_eq (W := W) (K := K) hz hg₂0 hup
  rwa [natCast_zsmul] at this

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.eq_of_count_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_count_eq {I J : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ v : HeightOneSpectrum R, count K v I = count K v J) : I = J
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finprod_heightOneSpectrum_factorization' K hI,
      ← finprod_heightOneSpectrum_factorization' K hJ]
  exact finprod_congr fun v => by rw [h v]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.spanSingleton_eq_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem spanSingleton_eq_of_ord_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ v, ord v f = ord v g) :
    spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ f = spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ g
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ f ≠ 0 := by rwa [ne_eq, spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff]
  have hg' : spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ g ≠ 0 := by rwa [ne_eq, spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff]
  exact eq_of_count_eq hf' hg' h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_unit_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unit_of_ord_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ v, ord v f = ord v g) :
    ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • f = g
proof:
:=
  (spanSingleton_eq_spanSingleton (S := W.CoordinateRing⁰) (P := W.FunctionField)).mp
    (spanSingleton_eq_of_ord_eq hf hg h)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_unit_of_divisor_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unit_of_divisor_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : divisor W f = divisor W g) :
    ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_unit_of_ord_eq hf hg fun v => ?_
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun h v
  rwa [divisor_apply, divisor_apply] at this

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.count_idealOfDivisor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_idealOfDivisor (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (D : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) :
    count K v (idealOfDivisor K D) = D v
proof:
:=
  count_finsuppProd K v D

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.idealOfDivisor_ne_zero
statement: theorem idealOfDivisor_ne_zero (D : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) : idealOfDivisor K D ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun v _ => zpow_ne_zero _ (coeIdeal_ne_zero.mpr v.ne_bot)

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.idealOfDivisor_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealOfDivisor_zero : idealOfDivisor K (0 : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) = 1
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.prod_zero_index

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.idealOfDivisor_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealOfDivisor_single (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (n : ℤ) :
    idealOfDivisor K (Finsupp.single v n) = (v.asIdeal : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) ^ n
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.prod_single_index (zpow_zero _)

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.idealOfDivisor_add
statement:
theorem idealOfDivisor_add (D₁ D₂ : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) :
    idealOfDivisor K (D₁ + D₂) = idealOfDivisor K D₁ * idealOfDivisor K D₂
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_count_eq (idealOfDivisor_ne_zero K _)
    (mul_ne_zero (idealOfDivisor_ne_zero K D₁) (idealOfDivisor_ne_zero K D₂)) fun v => ?_
  rw [count_idealOfDivisor, count_mul K v (idealOfDivisor_ne_zero K D₁)
    (idealOfDivisor_ne_zero K D₂), count_idealOfDivisor, count_idealOfDivisor, Finsupp.add_apply]

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.coe_unitOfDivisor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_unitOfDivisor (D : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) :
    (unitOfDivisor K D : FractionalIdeal R⁰ K) = idealOfDivisor K D
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.unitOfDivisorHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unitOfDivisorHom_apply (D : Multiplicative (HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ)) :
    unitOfDivisorHom K D = unitOfDivisor K (Multiplicative.toAdd D)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.classOfDivisorHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem classOfDivisorHom_apply (D : Multiplicative (HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ)) :
    classOfDivisorHom K D = classOfDivisor K (Multiplicative.toAdd D)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.classOfDivisor_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem classOfDivisor_zero : classOfDivisor K (0 : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) = 1
proof:
:=
  map_one (classOfDivisorHom K)

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.classOfDivisor_add
statement:
theorem classOfDivisor_add (D₁ D₂ : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) :
    classOfDivisor K (D₁ + D₂) = classOfDivisor K D₁ * classOfDivisor K D₂
proof:
:=
  map_mul (classOfDivisorHom K) (Multiplicative.ofAdd D₁) (Multiplicative.ofAdd D₂)

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.classOfDivisor_nsmul
statement:
theorem classOfDivisor_nsmul (D : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    classOfDivisor K (n • D) = classOfDivisor K D ^ n
proof:
:=
  map_pow (classOfDivisorHom K) (Multiplicative.ofAdd D) n

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.exists_spanSingleton_eq_iff_classOfDivisor_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_spanSingleton_eq_iff_classOfDivisor_eq_one (D : HeightOneSpectrum R →₀ ℤ) :
    (∃ x : K, x ≠ 0 ∧ spanSingleton R⁰ x = idealOfDivisor K D) ↔ classOfDivisor K D = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [classOfDivisor, ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, -, hx⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, by rw [coe_unitOfDivisor, ← hx, coe_spanSingleton]⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hspan : idealOfDivisor K D = spanSingleton R⁰ x :=
      coeToSubmodule_injective (by simpa [coe_spanSingleton] using hx)
    refine ⟨x, ?_, hspan.symm⟩
    rintro rfl
    exact idealOfDivisor_ne_zero K D (by rwa [spanSingleton_zero] at hspan)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.idealOfDivisor_divisor
statement:
theorem idealOfDivisor_divisor {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    idealOfDivisor W.FunctionField (divisor W f) = spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ f
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ f ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [ne_eq, spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff]
  refine eq_of_count_eq (idealOfDivisor_ne_zero W.FunctionField _) hspan fun v => ?_
  rw [count_idealOfDivisor, divisor_apply, ord]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_divisor_eq_iff_classOfDivisor_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_divisor_eq_iff_classOfDivisor_eq_one
    (D : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing →₀ ℤ) :
    (∃ g : W.FunctionField, g ≠ 0 ∧ divisor W g = D) ↔
      classOfDivisor W.FunctionField D = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← exists_spanSingleton_eq_iff_classOfDivisor_eq_one]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g, hg, (idealOfDivisor_divisor hg).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, hspan⟩
    refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
    ext v
    rw [divisor_apply, ord, hspan, count_idealOfDivisor]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.classOfDivisor_single_pointClosedPoint
statement:
theorem classOfDivisor_single_pointClosedPoint (h : W.Nonsingular x y) :
    classOfDivisor W.FunctionField (Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h.left) (1 : ℤ)) =
      Additive.toMul (Point.toClass (Point.some x y h))
proof:
:= by
  refine congrArg (ClassGroup.mk W.FunctionField) (Units.ext ?_)
  rw [coe_unitOfDivisor, idealOfDivisor_single, zpow_one, pointClosedPoint_asIdeal,
    ← XYIdeal'_eq (W := W) h]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.classOfDivisor_single_pointClosedPoint_natCast
statement:
theorem classOfDivisor_single_pointClosedPoint_natCast (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (n : ℕ) :
    classOfDivisor W.FunctionField (Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h.left) (n : ℤ)) =
      Additive.toMul (Point.toClass (Point.some x y h)) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← classOfDivisor_single_pointClosedPoint h, ← classOfDivisor_nsmul,
    Finsupp.smul_single, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_divisor_eq_single_iff_mem_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_divisor_eq_single_iff_mem_torsion (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (n : ℕ) :
    (∃ g : W.FunctionField, g ≠ 0 ∧
        divisor W g = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h.left) (n : ℤ)) ↔
      Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n
proof:
:= by
  rw [exists_divisor_eq_iff_classOfDivisor_eq_one,
    classOfDivisor_single_pointClosedPoint_natCast h n, mem_torsion_iff,
    ← Point.toClass_eq_zero, map_nsmul]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.not_exists_divisor_eq_single_pointClosedPoint
statement:
theorem not_exists_divisor_eq_single_pointClosedPoint (h : W.Nonsingular x y) :
    ¬ ∃ g : W.FunctionField, g ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W g = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h.left) (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hex
  have h1 : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 1 := by
    rw [← exists_divisor_eq_single_iff_mem_torsion h 1]
    simpa using hex
  exact Point.some_ne_zero h (by simpa using mem_torsion_iff.mp h1)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_prod
statement:
lemma ord_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → W.FunctionField)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) :
    ord v (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, ord v (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ih =>
    have hfa : f a ≠ 0 := hf a (Finset.mem_cons_self a s)
    have hmem : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 := fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_cons_of_mem hi)
    have hprod : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 hmem
    rw [Finset.prod_cons, Finset.sum_cons, ord_mul v hfa hprod, ih hmem]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_prod
statement:
lemma divisor_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → W.FunctionField)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) :
    divisor W (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, divisor W (f i)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [divisor_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  exact ord_prod v s f hf

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.exists_unit_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unit_of_ord_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ v, ord v f = ord v g) :
    ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • f = g
proof:
:=
  WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_unit_of_ord_eq hf hg h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.exists_unit_of_divisor_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unit_of_divisor_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : divisor W f = divisor W g) :
    ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • f = g
proof:
:=
  WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_unit_of_divisor_eq hf hg h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.classGroup_mk_toPrincipalIdeal
statement:
theorem classGroup_mk_toPrincipalIdeal (x : W.FunctionFieldˣ) :
    ClassGroup.mk W.FunctionField
      (toPrincipalIdeal W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField x) = 1

:=

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion [DecidableEq F] {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y)
    {n : ℕ} (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ)

:=
  WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion h hP

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_mapEquiv
statement:
theorem valuation_mapEquiv (e : R ≃+* S) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (x : K) :
    (mapEquiv e v).valuation L (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv (K := K) (L := L) e x)
      = v.valuation K x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, s, -, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := R) x
  rw [map_div₀, IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap,
    IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap, map_div₀, map_div₀, valuation_of_algebraMap,
    valuation_of_algebraMap, valuation_of_algebraMap, valuation_of_algebraMap,
    intValuation_mapEquiv, intValuation_mapEquiv]

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.count_mapEquiv
statement:
theorem count_mapEquiv (e : R ≃+* S) (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) (x : K) :
    count L (mapEquiv e v)
        (spanSingleton S⁰ (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv (K := K) (L := L) e x))
      = count K v (spanSingleton R⁰ x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · simp only [map_zero, spanSingleton_zero, count_zero]
  · rw [count_eq_neg_log_valuation _ (by simpa using hx), count_eq_neg_log_valuation _ hx,
      valuation_mapEquiv]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_ringEquivOfRingEquiv
statement:
theorem ord_ringEquivOfRingEquiv (e : W.CoordinateRing ≃+* W.CoordinateRing)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) (f : W.FunctionField) :
    ord (mapEquiv e v)
      (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv (K := W.FunctionField) (L := W.FunctionField) e f)
      = ord v f
proof:
:=
  count_mapEquiv e v f

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_ringEquivOfRingEquiv
statement:
theorem divisor_ringEquivOfRingEquiv (e : W.CoordinateRing ≃+* W.CoordinateRing)
    (f : W.FunctionField) :
    divisor W
        (IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv (K := W.FunctionField) (L := W.FunctionField) e f)
      = (divisor W f).equivMapDomain (mapEquiv e)
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  rw [Finsupp.equivMapDomain_apply, divisor_apply, divisor_apply,
    ← ord_ringEquivOfRingEquiv e ((mapEquiv e).symm w) f, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ord_galoisFunctionField
statement:
theorem ord_galoisFunctionField (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (W⁄F).CoordinateRing) (f : (W⁄F).FunctionField) :
    ord (mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ) v) (galoisFunctionField σ f) = ord v f
proof:
:=
  ord_ringEquivOfRingEquiv _ v f

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_galoisFunctionField
statement:
theorem divisor_galoisFunctionField (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (f : (W⁄F).FunctionField) :
    divisor (W⁄F) (galoisFunctionField σ f)
      = (divisor (W⁄F) f).equivMapDomain (mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ))
proof:
:=
  divisor_ringEquivOfRingEquiv _ f

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ord_galoisFunctionField_apply
statement:
theorem ord_galoisFunctionField_apply (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)
    (w : HeightOneSpectrum (W⁄F).CoordinateRing) (f : (W⁄F).FunctionField) :
    ord w (galoisFunctionField σ f) = ord ((mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ)).symm w) f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ord_galoisFunctionField σ ((mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ)).symm w) f,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_galoisFunctionField_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem divisor_galoisFunctionField_eq_zero_iff (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (f : (W⁄F).FunctionField) :
    divisor (W⁄F) (galoisFunctionField σ f) = 0 ↔ divisor (W⁄F) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h <;> ext v
  · rw [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, divisor_apply, ← ord_galoisFunctionField σ v f,
      ← divisor_apply, h, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  · rw [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, divisor_apply, ord_galoisFunctionField_apply,
      ← divisor_apply, h, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ord_zero : ord v (0 : W.FunctionField) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord, spanSingleton_zero, count_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_one
statement:

lemma ord_one : ord v (1 : W.FunctionField) = 0
proof:
:= by

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_mul
statement:
lemma ord_mul {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ord v (f * g) = ord v f + ord v g
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ f ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [ne_eq, spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff]
  have hg' : spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ g ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [ne_eq, spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff]
  rw [ord, ord, ord, ← spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton, count_mul _ _ hf' hg']

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ord_inv (f : W.FunctionField) : ord v f⁻¹ = -ord v f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord, ord, ← spanSingleton_inv, count_inv]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_div
statement:
lemma ord_div {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ord v (f / g) = ord v f - ord v g
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ord_mul v hf (inv_ne_zero hg), ord_inv, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_pow
statement: lemma ord_pow (f : W.FunctionField) (n : ℕ) : ord v (f ^ n) = n * ord v f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord, ord, ← spanSingleton_pow, count_pow]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_zpow
statement: lemma ord_zpow (f : W.FunctionField) (n : ℤ) : ord v (f ^ n) = n * ord v f
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat k =>
    simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast, ord_pow]
  | negSucc k =>
    rw [zpow_negSucc, ord_inv, ord_pow, Int.negSucc_eq]
    push_cast; ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_finite
statement:
lemma ord_finite (f : W.FunctionField) :
    (Function.support fun v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing => ord v f).Finite
proof:
:=
  Filter.eventually_cofinite.mp (finite_factors (spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ f))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisor_apply (f : W.FunctionField) (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_inv

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_div

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero

theorem functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base (c : F) :
    functionFieldMap W K (algebraMap F W.FunctionField c)

proof:
:= by
  rw [← genPsi_mk_CC, functionFieldMap_algebraMap, CoordinateRing.map_mk]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.map_map_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem map_map_functionFieldMap :
    (W.map (algebraMap F W.FunctionField)).map (functionFieldMap W K)
      = (W.map (algebraMap F K)).map
          (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (functionFieldMap W K).comp (algebraMap F W.FunctionField)
      = (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField).comp (algebraMap F K) :=
    RingHom.ext fun c => functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base W K c
  exact congrArg W.map h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_eval_genX
proof:
:= by

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_evalEval_gen
statement:
private lemma functionFieldMap_evalEval_gen (q : W.FunctionField[X][Y]) :

      = (q.map (mapRingHom (functionFieldMap W K))).evalEval
          (genX (W.map (algebraMap F K))) (genY (W.map (algebraMap F K)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← functionFieldMap_genX W K, ← functionFieldMap_genY W K]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_map_a₁

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_mulByTwoCoordHom
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_mulByTwoCoordHom (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h2' : (2 : K) ≠ 0)
    (a : W.CoordinateRing) :
    functionFieldMap W K (mulByTwoCoordHom h2 a)
      = mulByTwoCoordHom (W := W.map (algebraMap F K)) h2'
          (CoordinateRing.map W (algebraMap F K) a)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (functionFieldMap W K).comp (mulByTwoCoordHom h2)
      = (mulByTwoCoordHom (W := W.map (algebraMap F K)) h2').comp
          (CoordinateRing.map W (algebraMap F K)) := by
    refine AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext (Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun c => ?_) ?_) ?_
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mulByTwoCoordHom, CoordinateRing.map, AdjoinRoot.lift_of,
        coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C, eval₂_C,
        functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mulByTwoCoordHom, CoordinateRing.map, AdjoinRoot.lift_of,
        coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, eval₂_X, map_div₀,
        functionFieldMap_Φ_eval, functionFieldMap_Ψ₂Sq_eval]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mulByTwoCoordHom, CoordinateRing.map, AdjoinRoot.lift_root,
        map_div₀, map_sub, map_mul, map_add, map_pow, map_ofNat, functionFieldMap_map_a₁,
        functionFieldMap_map_a₃, functionFieldMap_Φ_eval, functionFieldMap_Ψ₂Sq_eval,
        functionFieldMap_preΨ₄_eval, functionFieldMap_ψ_evalEval]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun key a

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_mulByTwoEndo
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_mulByTwoEndo (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h2' : (2 : K) ≠ 0)

proof:

      = (mulByTwoEndo (W := W.map (algebraMap F K)) h2').comp (functionFieldMap W K) := by
    refine IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := W.CoordinateRing) fun a => ?_
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, mulByTwoEndo_algebraMap,
      functionFieldMap_algebraMap, mulByTwoEndo_algebraMap,
      functionFieldMap_mulByTwoCoordHom h2 h2']
  exact RingHom.congr_fun key z

theorem functionFieldMap_mulByThreeCoordHom (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)

    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mulByThreeCoordHom, CoordinateRing.map, AdjoinRoot.lift_of,
        coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C, eval₂_C,
        functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mulByThreeCoordHom, CoordinateRing.map, AdjoinRoot.lift_of,
        coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, eval₂_X, map_div₀,
        functionFieldMap_Φ_eval, functionFieldMap_ΨSq_eval]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mulByThreeCoordHom, CoordinateRing.map, AdjoinRoot.lift_root,

        functionFieldMap_map_a₃, functionFieldMap_genX, functionFieldMap_genY,
        functionFieldMap_Φ_eval, functionFieldMap_preΨ_eval, functionFieldMap_preΨ₄_eval,

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_mulByThreeEndo
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_mulByThreeEndo (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_slope_gen
statement:
private lemma functionFieldMap_slope_gen (x₂ y₂ : F) :
    functionFieldMap W K ((W.map (algebraMap F W.FunctionField)).slope (genX W)
        (algebraMap F W.FunctionField x₂) (genY W) (algebraMap F W.FunctionField y₂))
      = ((W.map (algebraMap F K)).map
            (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField)).slope (genX _)
          (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField (algebraMap F K x₂)) (genY _)
          (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField (algebraMap F K y₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_slope (functionFieldMap W K), map_map_functionFieldMap, functionFieldMap_genX,
    functionFieldMap_genY, functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base,
    functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_addX_gen
statement:
private lemma functionFieldMap_addX_gen (x₂ y₂ : F) :
    functionFieldMap W K ((W.map (algebraMap F W.FunctionField)).addX (genX W)
        (algebraMap F W.FunctionField x₂)
        ((W.map (algebraMap F W.FunctionField)).slope (genX W)
          (algebraMap F W.FunctionField x₂) (genY W) (algebraMap F W.FunctionField y₂)))
      = ((W.map (algebraMap F K)).map
            (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField)).addX (genX _)
          (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField (algebraMap F K x₂))
          (((W.map (algebraMap F K)).map
            (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField)).slope (genX _)
            (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField (algebraMap F K x₂)) (genY _)
            (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField (algebraMap F K y₂)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_addX (functionFieldMap W K), map_map_functionFieldMap, functionFieldMap_genX,
    functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base, functionFieldMap_slope_gen]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_addY_gen
statement:
private lemma functionFieldMap_addY_gen (x₂ y₂ : F) :
    functionFieldMap W K ((W.map (algebraMap F W.FunctionField)).addY (genX W)
        (algebraMap F W.FunctionField x₂) (genY W)
        ((W.map (algebraMap F W.FunctionField)).slope (genX W)
          (algebraMap F W.FunctionField x₂) (genY W) (algebraMap F W.FunctionField y₂)))
      = ((W.map (algebraMap F K)).map
            (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField)).addY (genX _)
          (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField (algebraMap F K x₂)) (genY _)
          (((W.map (algebraMap F K)).map
            (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField)).slope (genX _)
            (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField (algebraMap F K x₂)) (genY _)
            (algebraMap K (W.map (algebraMap F K)).FunctionField (algebraMap F K y₂)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_addY (functionFieldMap W K), map_map_functionFieldMap, functionFieldMap_genX,
    functionFieldMap_genY, functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base, functionFieldMap_slope_gen]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_translateCoordHom
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_translateCoordHom (h₂ : W.Equation x₂ y₂) (a : W.CoordinateRing) :
    functionFieldMap W K (translateCoordHom h₂ a)
      = translateCoordHom (h₂.map (algebraMap F K))
          (CoordinateRing.map W (algebraMap F K) a)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (functionFieldMap W K).comp (translateCoordHom h₂)
      = (translateCoordHom (h₂.map (algebraMap F K))).comp
          (CoordinateRing.map W (algebraMap F K)) := by
    refine AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext (Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun c => ?_) ?_) ?_
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, translateCoordHom, CoordinateRing.map, AdjoinRoot.lift_of,
        coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_C, eval₂_C,
        functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, translateCoordHom, CoordinateRing.map, AdjoinRoot.lift_of,
        coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom, Polynomial.map_X, eval₂_X]
      exact functionFieldMap_addX_gen x₂ y₂
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, translateCoordHom, CoordinateRing.map, AdjoinRoot.lift_root]
      exact functionFieldMap_addY_gen x₂ y₂
  exact RingHom.congr_fun key a

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_translateEndo
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_translateEndo (h₂ : W.Equation x₂ y₂) (z : W.FunctionField) :
    functionFieldMap W K (translateEndo h₂ z)
      = translateEndo (h₂.map (algebraMap F K)) (functionFieldMap W K z)

      = (translateEndo (h₂.map (algebraMap F K))).comp (functionFieldMap W K) := by
    refine IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := W.CoordinateRing) fun a => ?_
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.comp_apply, translateEndo_algebraMap,
      functionFieldMap_algebraMap, translateEndo_algebraMap, functionFieldMap_translateCoordHom]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun key z

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.nonsingular_functionFieldMap

  cases hc : (n • genericPoint (W := W)) with
  | zero =>
      have h0 : (n • genericPoint (W := W.map (algebraMap F K))) = 0 := by

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.functionFieldMap_mulByNEndo
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_mulByNEndo {n : ℕ}
    (hn : Transcendental F (n • genericPoint (W := W)).xCoord)
    (hn' : Transcendental K (n • genericPoint (W := W.map (algebraMap F K))).xCoord)
    (z : W.FunctionField) :
    functionFieldMap W K (mulByNEndo n hn z)
      = mulByNEndo n hn' (functionFieldMap W K z)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (functionFieldMap W K).comp (mulByNEndo n hn)
      = (mulByNEndo n hn').comp (functionFieldMap W K) := by
    refine functionField_ringHom_ext (W := W) (fun c => ?_) ?_ ?_
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mulByNEndo_algebraMap_base, functionFieldMap_algebraMap_base]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mulByNEndo_genX, functionFieldMap_genX,
        functionFieldMap_xCoord_nsmul]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mulByNEndo_genY, functionFieldMap_genY,
        functionFieldMap_yCoord_nsmul]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun key z

proof:

  | zero =>
      rw [show (Point.zero : W.Point) = 0 from rfl, map_zero, translatePointEndo_zero,
        translatePointEndo_zero, RingHom.id_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
  | some x y h =>
      rw [basePointMap_some, translatePointEndo_some, translatePointEndo_some]
      exact functionFieldMap_translateEndo h.left z

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisCoordEndo_bcCoord
statement:
private lemma galoisCoordEndo_bcCoord (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (a : W.CoordinateRing) :
    galoisCoordEndo σ (bcCoord W F a) = bcCoord W F a
proof:
:= by
  have key : (galoisCoordEndo (W := W) σ).comp (bcCoord W F) = bcCoord W F := by
    refine AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext (Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun c => ?_) ?_) ?_
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, bcCoord_of, Polynomial.map_C,
        ← algebraMap_coordinateRing_eq_of, galoisCoordEndo_algebraMap, AlgEquiv.commutes]
    · have hX : AdjoinRoot.of (W⁄F).polynomial X = mk (W⁄F) (C X) := rfl
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, bcCoord_of, Polynomial.map_X, hX, galoisCoordEndo_mk_C_X]
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, bcCoord_root, galoisCoordEndo_root]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisFunctionField_bcField
statement:
private lemma galoisFunctionField_bcField (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (z : W.FunctionField) :
    galoisFunctionField σ (bcField W F z) = bcField W F z
proof:
:= by
  have key : ((galoisFunctionField (W := W) σ :
      (W⁄F).FunctionField →+* (W⁄F).FunctionField)).comp (bcField W F) = bcField W F := by
    refine functionField_ringHom_ext (fun c => ?_) ?_ ?_
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, bcField_algebraMap_base]
      exact (galoisFunctionField_algebraMap σ _).trans (congrArg _ (σ.commutes c))
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, bcField_genX]
      exact galoisFunctionField_genX σ
    · rw [RingHom.comp_apply, bcField_genY]
      exact galoisFunctionField_genY σ
  exact RingHom.congr_fun key z

statement:
private lemma galoisCoordEndo_smul (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (p : F[X]) (a : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing) :
    galoisCoordEndo σ (p • a) = p.map (σ : F →+* F) • galoisCoordEndo σ a
proof:
:= by

    galoisCoordEndo_of]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisCoordEndo_smul_basis
statement:
private lemma galoisCoordEndo_smul_basis (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (p q : F[X]) :
    galoisCoordEndo σ (p • (1 : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing) + q • mk (W⁄F) Y)
      = p.map (σ : F →+* F) • (1 : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing)
        + q.map (σ : F →+* F) • mk (W⁄F) Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, galoisCoordEndo_smul, galoisCoordEndo_smul, map_one, AdjoinRoot.mk_X,
    galoisCoordEndo_root]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_map_eq_of_forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq
statement:
theorem exists_map_eq_of_forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq [IsGalois S F]
    {a : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing} (ha : ∀ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, galoisCoordEndo σ a = a) :
    ∃ b : W.CoordinateRing, CoordinateRing.map W (algebraMap S F) b = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_basis_eq a
  have hfix : ∀ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, p.map (σ : F →+* F) = p ∧ q.map (σ : F →+* F) = q := fun σ => by
    have hσ := ha σ
    rw [galoisCoordEndo_smul_basis] at hσ
    have h0 : (p.map (σ : F →+* F) - p) • (1 : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing)
        + (q.map (σ : F →+* F) - q) • mk (W⁄F) Y = 0 := by
      rw [sub_smul, sub_smul, sub_add_sub_comm, hσ, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := smul_basis_eq_zero h0
    exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp h1, sub_eq_zero.mp h2⟩
  have hlift : ∀ r : F[X], (∀ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, r.map (σ : F →+* F) = r) →
      ∃ r₀ : S[X], r₀.map (algebraMap S F) = r := fun r hr => by
    have hc : ∀ n, r.coeff n ∈ Set.range (algebraMap S F) := fun n => by
      refine (InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed (r.coeff n)).mpr fun σ => ?_
      have h : (σ : F →+* F) (r.coeff n) = r.coeff n := by
        conv_rhs => rw [← hr σ]
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
      exact h
    exact Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts (f := algebraMap S F) (p := r) |>.mpr hc
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ := hlift p fun σ => (hfix σ).1
  obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ := hlift q fun σ => (hfix σ).2
  refine ⟨p₀ • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + q₀ • mk W Y, ?_⟩
  change bcCoord W F _ = _
  rw [map_add, bcCoord_smul, bcCoord_smul, map_one, bcCoord_mk_Y, hp₀, hq₀]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mem_range_map_iff_forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq
statement:
theorem mem_range_map_iff_forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq [IsGalois S F] (a : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing) :
    a ∈ Set.range (CoordinateRing.map W (algebraMap S F))
      ↔ ∀ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, galoisCoordEndo σ a = a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨b, hb⟩ σ => hb ▸ galoisCoordEndo_map σ b, exists_map_eq_of_forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisCoordEndo_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma galoisCoordEndo_ne_zero (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) {b : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing} (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    galoisCoordEndo σ b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← galoisCoordRing_apply]
  exact fun h => hb ((galoisCoordRing σ).injective (by rwa [map_zero]))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq
statement:
private lemma forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq
    {a : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing} (ha : ∀ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, galoisFunctionField σ (genPsi (W⁄F) a)
      = genPsi (W⁄F) a) (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) : galoisCoordEndo σ a = a
proof:
:= by
  refine IsFractionRing.injective (W⁄F).CoordinateRing (W⁄F).FunctionField ?_
  rw [← galoisFunctionField_algebraMap_coordRing]
  exact ha σ

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_functionFieldMap_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq
statement:
theorem exists_functionFieldMap_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq
    [FiniteDimensional S F] [IsGalois S F] {z : (W⁄F).FunctionField}
    (hz : ∀ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, galoisFunctionField σ z = z) :
    ∃ w : W.FunctionField, functionFieldMap W F w = z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := (W⁄F).CoordinateRing) z
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb
  set c : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing := ∏ σ ∈ Finset.univ.erase (1 : F ≃ₐ[S] F),
    galoisCoordEndo σ b with hc
  set N : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing := ∏ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, galoisCoordEndo σ b with hN
  have hNbc : N = b * c := by
    rw [hN, hc, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ (1 : F ≃ₐ[S] F)),
      galoisCoordEndo_one, RingHom.id_apply]
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun σ _ => galoisCoordEndo_ne_zero σ hb0
  have hN0 : N ≠ 0 := by rw [hNbc]; exact mul_ne_zero hb0 hc0
  have hNfix : ∀ τ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, galoisCoordEndo τ N = N := by
    intro τ
    rw [hN, map_prod]
    refine Fintype.prod_equiv (Equiv.mulLeft τ) _ _ fun σ => ?_
    change galoisCoordEndo τ (galoisCoordEndo σ b) = galoisCoordEndo (τ * σ) b
    rw [galoisCoordEndo_mul, RingHom.comp_apply]
  have hgen : ∀ {x : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing}, x ≠ 0 → genPsi (W⁄F) x ≠ 0 := fun {x} hx h =>
    hx (IsFractionRing.injective (W⁄F).CoordinateRing (W⁄F).FunctionField (by rwa [map_zero]))
  set A : (W⁄F).CoordinateRing := a * c with hA
  have hz' : genPsi (W⁄F) A / genPsi (W⁄F) N = z := by
    rw [hA, hNbc, map_mul, map_mul, mul_div_mul_right _ _ (hgen hc0), hab]
  have hAN : genPsi (W⁄F) A = z * genPsi (W⁄F) N := by
    rw [← hz', div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hgen hN0)]
  have hAfix : ∀ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, galoisCoordEndo σ A = A := by
    refine forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq fun σ => ?_
    rw [hAN, map_mul, hz σ, galoisFunctionField_algebraMap_coordRing, hNfix σ]
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := exists_map_eq_of_forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq hAfix
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := exists_map_eq_of_forall_galoisCoordEndo_eq hNfix
  have hA₀' : bcCoord W F A₀ = A := hA₀
  have hN₀' : bcCoord W F N₀ = N := hN₀
  refine ⟨genPsi W A₀ / genPsi W N₀, ?_⟩
  change bcField W F _ = z
  rw [map_div₀, bcField_genPsi, bcField_genPsi, hA₀', hN₀', hz']

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mem_range_functionFieldMap_iff_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq
statement:
theorem mem_range_functionFieldMap_iff_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq
    [FiniteDimensional S F] [IsGalois S F] (z : (W⁄F).FunctionField) :
    z ∈ Set.range (functionFieldMap W F)
      ↔ ∀ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, galoisFunctionField σ z = z
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨w, hw⟩ σ => hw ▸ galoisFunctionField_functionFieldMap σ w,
    exists_functionFieldMap_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.range_functionFieldMap_eq
proof:

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_ne_zero_functionFieldMap_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_functionFieldMap_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq
    [FiniteDimensional S F] [IsGalois S F] {z : (W⁄F).FunctionField} (hz0 : z ≠ 0)
    (hz : ∀ σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F, galoisFunctionField σ z = z) :
    ∃ w : W.FunctionField, w ≠ 0 ∧ functionFieldMap W F w = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_functionFieldMap_eq_of_forall_galoisFunctionField_eq hz
  exact ⟨w, fun h => hz0 (by rw [← hw, h]; exact map_zero _), hw⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisCoordEndo_XClass
statement:
@[simp] lemma galoisCoordEndo_XClass (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (x : F) :
    galoisCoordEndo σ (XClass (W⁄F) x) = XClass (W⁄F) (σ x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : XClass (W⁄F) x = AdjoinRoot.of (W⁄F).polynomial (X - C x) := rfl
  have h' : XClass (W⁄F) (σ x) = AdjoinRoot.of (W⁄F).polynomial (X - C (σ x)) := rfl
  rw [h, h', galoisCoordEndo_of, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisCoordEndo_YClass
statement:
@[simp] lemma galoisCoordEndo_YClass (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (y : F) :
    galoisCoordEndo σ (YClass (W⁄F) (C y)) = YClass (W⁄F) (C (σ y))
proof:
:= by
  have h : YClass (W⁄F) (C y)
      = AdjoinRoot.root (W⁄F).polynomial - AdjoinRoot.of (W⁄F).polynomial (C y) := by
    rw [YClass, map_sub, AdjoinRoot.mk_X]
    rfl
  have h' : YClass (W⁄F) (C (σ y))
      = AdjoinRoot.root (W⁄F).polynomial - AdjoinRoot.of (W⁄F).polynomial (C (σ y)) := by
    rw [YClass, map_sub, AdjoinRoot.mk_X]
    rfl
  rw [h, h', map_sub, galoisCoordEndo_root, galoisCoordEndo_of, Polynomial.map_C]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.map_XYIdeal_galoisCoordRing
statement:
lemma map_XYIdeal_galoisCoordRing (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (x y : F) :
    (XYIdeal (W⁄F) x (C y)).map (galoisCoordRing σ) = XYIdeal (W⁄F) (σ x) (C (σ y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [XYIdeal, XYIdeal, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
  simp [galoisCoordRing_apply]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mapEquiv_galoisCoordRing_pointClosedPoint
statement:
theorem mapEquiv_galoisCoordRing_pointClosedPoint (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)
    (h₂ : (W⁄F).Equation x₂ y₂) :
    mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ) (pointClosedPoint h₂)
      = pointClosedPoint (equation_algEquiv σ h₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply HeightOneSpectrum.ext
  rw [mapEquiv_asIdeal, pointClosedPoint_asIdeal, pointClosedPoint_asIdeal,
    map_XYIdeal_galoisCoordRing]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint_congr
statement:
lemma pointClosedPoint_congr {x y x' y' : F} (h : (W⁄F).Equation x y)
    (h' : (W⁄F).Equation x' y') (hx : x = x') (hy : y = y') :
    pointClosedPoint h = pointClosedPoint h'
proof:
:= by
  subst hx; subst hy; rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint_inj
statement:
theorem pointClosedPoint_inj {x y x' y' : F} (h : (W⁄F).Equation x y)
    (h' : (W⁄F).Equation x' y') (he : pointClosedPoint h = pointClosedPoint h') :
    x = x' ∧ y = y'
proof:
:= by
  have hI : XYIdeal (W⁄F) x (C y) = XYIdeal (W⁄F) x' (C y') := congrArg HeightOneSpectrum.asIdeal he
  have hx : evalEvalHom h' (XClass (W⁄F) x) = 0 := by
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, ker_evalEvalHom, ← hI]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hy : evalEvalHom h' (YClass (W⁄F) (C y)) = 0 := by
    rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, ker_evalEvalHom, ← hI]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
  rw [show XClass (W⁄F) x = mk (W⁄F) (C (X - C x)) from rfl, evalEvalHom_mk, evalEval_C] at hx
  rw [show YClass (W⁄F) (C y) = mk (W⁄F) (Y - C (C y)) from rfl, evalEvalHom_mk] at hy
  simp only [Polynomial.evalEval, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C] at hx hy
  exact ⟨(sub_eq_zero.mp hx).symm, (sub_eq_zero.mp hy).symm⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mapEquiv_galoisCoordRing_pointClosedPoint_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem mapEquiv_galoisCoordRing_pointClosedPoint_eq_self_iff (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)
    (h₂ : (W⁄F).Equation x₂ y₂) :
    mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ) (pointClosedPoint h₂) = pointClosedPoint h₂
      ↔ σ x₂ = x₂ ∧ σ y₂ = y₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapEquiv_galoisCoordRing_pointClosedPoint]
  exact ⟨fun h => pointClosedPoint_inj _ _ h, fun ⟨hx, hy⟩ => pointClosedPoint_congr _ _ hx hy⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.equivMapDomain_galoisCoordRing_single
statement:
theorem equivMapDomain_galoisCoordRing_single (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)
    (h₂ : (W⁄F).Equation x₂ y₂) (n : ℤ) :
    (Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h₂) n).equivMapDomain (mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ))
      = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint (equation_algEquiv σ h₂)) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.equivMapDomain_single, mapEquiv_galoisCoordRing_pointClosedPoint]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.equivMapDomain_galoisCoordRing_sum_single
statement:
theorem equivMapDomain_galoisCoordRing_sum_single {ι : Type*} (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)
    (s : Finset ι) {x y : ι → F} (h : ∀ i, (W⁄F).Equation (x i) (y i)) (n : ι → ℤ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint (h i)) (n i)).equivMapDomain
        (mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ))
      = ∑ i ∈ s, Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint (equation_algEquiv σ (h i))) (n i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finsupp.domCongr_apply, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by
    rw [Finsupp.domCongr_apply, equivMapDomain_galoisCoordRing_single]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_galoisFunctionField_of_eq_single
statement:
theorem divisor_galoisFunctionField_of_eq_single [W.IsElliptic] (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)
    (h₂ : (W⁄F).Equation x₂ y₂) {f : (W⁄F).FunctionField} {n : ℤ}
    (hf : divisor (W⁄F) f = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h₂) n) :
    divisor (W⁄F) (galoisFunctionField σ f)
      = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint (equation_algEquiv σ h₂)) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisor_galoisFunctionField, hf, equivMapDomain_galoisCoordRing_single]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisor_eq_equivMapDomain_of_eq_single
statement:
theorem divisor_eq_equivMapDomain_of_eq_single [W.IsElliptic] (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)
    (h₂ : (W⁄F).Equation x₂ y₂) {g g' : (W⁄F).FunctionField} {n : ℤ}
    (hg : divisor (W⁄F) g = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h₂) n)
    (hg' : divisor (W⁄F) g' = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint (equation_algEquiv σ h₂)) n) :
    divisor (W⁄F) g' = (divisor (W⁄F) g).equivMapDomain (mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hg, hg', equivMapDomain_galoisCoordRing_single]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_generator_divisor_galois
statement:
theorem exists_generator_divisor_galois [W.IsElliptic] [DecidableEq F] (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)
    {x y : F} (h : (W⁄F).Nonsingular x y) {n : ℕ} (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ (W⁄F).torsion n) :
    ∃ f g : (W⁄F).FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧ g ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor (W⁄F) f = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ) ∧
      divisor (W⁄F) g = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint (equation_algEquiv σ h.1)) (n : ℤ) ∧
      divisor (W⁄F) g = (divisor (W⁄F) f).equivMapDomain (mapEquiv (galoisCoordRing σ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hdiv⟩ := exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion h hP
  refine ⟨f, galoisFunctionField σ f, hf, ?_, hdiv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using (map_ne_zero_iff _ (galoisFunctionField σ).injective).mpr hf
  · exact divisor_galoisFunctionField_of_eq_single σ h.1 hdiv
  · exact divisor_eq_equivMapDomain_of_eq_single σ h.1 hdiv
      (divisor_galoisFunctionField_of_eq_single σ h.1 hdiv)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisPoint_pointClosedPoint
statement:
theorem galoisPoint_pointClosedPoint (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisDivisor_single_pointClosedPoint

theorem galoisDivisor_single_pointClosedPoint (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.algebraMap_coordinateRing_eq_of
statement:
lemma algebraMap_coordinateRing_eq_of (c : F) :
    algebraMap F (W⁄F).CoordinateRing c = AdjoinRoot.of (W⁄F).polynomial (C c)
proof:
:= by

    ← Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.baseChange_map_algEquiv
statement: lemma baseChange_map_algEquiv (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) : (W⁄F).map (σ : F →+* F) = W⁄F
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (σ : F →+* F).comp (algebraMap S F) = algebraMap S F :=
    RingHom.ext fun s => σ.commutes s
  change (W.map (algebraMap S F)).map (σ : F →+* F) = W.map (algebraMap S F)
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.map_map, hcomp]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.polynomial_map_algEquiv
statement:
lemma polynomial_map_algEquiv (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) :
    (W⁄F).polynomial.map (mapRingHom (σ : F →+* F)) = (W⁄F).polynomial
proof:
:= by

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisCoordEndo_of
statement:
lemma galoisCoordEndo_of (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) (p : F[X]) :
    galoisCoordEndo σ (AdjoinRoot.of (W⁄F).polynomial p)
      = AdjoinRoot.of (W⁄F).polynomial (p.map (σ : F →+* F))
proof:
:= by
  rw [galoisCoordEndo, AdjoinRoot.lift_of, RingHom.comp_apply, coe_mapRingHom]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.galoisCoordEndo_root
statement:
@[simp] lemma galoisCoordEndo_root (σ : F ≃ₐ[S] F) :
    galoisCoordEndo σ (AdjoinRoot.root (W⁄F).polynomial) = AdjoinRoot.root (W⁄F).polynomial
proof:
:= by
