name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYCoordHom_root
statement:
@[simp] lemma negYCoordHom_root :
    negYCoordHom W' (AdjoinRoot.root W'.polynomial) = mk W' W'.negPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AdjoinRoot.mk_X, negYCoordHom_mk, X_comp]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYCoordHom_comp_negYCoordHom
statement:
lemma negYCoordHom_comp_negYCoordHom :
    (negYCoordHom W').comp (negYCoordHom W') = AlgHom.id R[X] W'.CoordinateRing
proof:
:=
  AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext <| by
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, negYCoordHom_root, negYCoordHom_mk,
      negPolynomial_comp_negPolynomial, AdjoinRoot.mk_X, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYCoordHom_negYCoordHom
statement:
@[simp] lemma negYCoordHom_negYCoordHom (g : W'.CoordinateRing) :
    negYCoordHom W' (negYCoordHom W' g) = g
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (negYCoordHom_comp_negYCoordHom W') g

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYCoordEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma negYCoordEquiv_apply (g : W'.CoordinateRing) :
    negYCoordEquiv W' g = negYCoordHom W' g
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
lemma negYEquiv_algebraMap (g : W.CoordinateRing) :
    negYEquiv W (genPsi W g) = genPsi W (negYCoordHom W g)
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap _ g

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYAlgEquiv_genPsi
statement:
@[simp] lemma negYAlgEquiv_genPsi (g : W.CoordinateRing) :
    negYAlgEquiv W (genPsi W g) = genPsi W (negYCoordHom W g)
proof:
:=
  negYEquiv_algebraMap W g

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYAlgEquiv_genX
statement: @[simp] lemma negYAlgEquiv_genX : negYAlgEquiv W (genX W) = genX W
proof:
:= by
  rw [genX, negYAlgEquiv_genPsi, negYCoordHom_mk, C_comp]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYAlgEquiv_genY
statement:
@[simp] lemma negYAlgEquiv_genY :
    negYAlgEquiv W (genY W) =
      -genY W - algebraMap F W.FunctionField W.a₁ * genX W
        - algebraMap F W.FunctionField W.a₃
proof:
:= by
  have hC : (C (C W.a₁ * X + C W.a₃) : F[X][Y]) = C (C W.a₁) * C X + C (C W.a₃) := by
    rw [map_add, map_mul]
  rw [genY, negYAlgEquiv_genPsi, negYCoordHom_root, negPolynomial, hC]
  simp only [map_sub, map_neg, map_add, map_mul, genPsi_mk_CC]
  rw [← genX, AdjoinRoot.mk_X]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYAlgEquiv_genY'
statement:
lemma negYAlgEquiv_genY' :
    negYAlgEquiv W (genY W) =
      (W.map (algebraMap F W.FunctionField)).negY (genX W) (genY W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [negYAlgEquiv_genY, negY, map_a₁, map_a₃]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYAlgEquiv_negYAlgEquiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma negYAlgEquiv_negYAlgEquiv (f : W.FunctionField) :
    negYAlgEquiv W (negYAlgEquiv W f) = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, d, -, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := W.CoordinateRing) f
  simp only [map_div₀, negYAlgEquiv_genPsi, negYCoordHom_negYCoordHom]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYAlgEquiv_trans_negYAlgEquiv
statement:
lemma negYAlgEquiv_trans_negYAlgEquiv :
    (negYAlgEquiv W).trans (negYAlgEquiv W) = AlgEquiv.refl
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.ext (negYAlgEquiv_negYAlgEquiv W)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mk_polynomialY_ne_zero
statement: theorem mk_polynomialY_ne_zero [W.IsElliptic] : mk W W.polynomialY ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  AdjoinRoot.mk_ne_zero_of_natDegree_lt monic_polynomial polynomialY_ne_zero
    (by rw [natDegree_polynomial]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (natDegree_polynomialY_le W) one_lt_two)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.genPsi_mk_polynomialY
statement:
lemma genPsi_mk_polynomialY :
    genPsi W (mk W W.polynomialY) = genY W - negYAlgEquiv W (genY W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Y_sub_negPolynomial, map_sub, map_sub, AdjoinRoot.mk_X, ← genY, genY,
    negYAlgEquiv_genPsi, negYCoordHom_root]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.negYAlgEquiv_ne_one
statement: theorem negYAlgEquiv_ne_one [W.IsElliptic] : negYAlgEquiv W ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine mk_polynomialY_ne_zero W ?_
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mp
    (IsFractionRing.injective W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField) _ ?_
  rw [genPsi_mk_polynomialY, h, AlgEquiv.one_apply, sub_self]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.nontrivial_algEquiv
statement:
theorem nontrivial_algEquiv [W.IsElliptic] :
    Nontrivial (W.FunctionField ≃ₐ[F] W.FunctionField)
proof:
:=
  ⟨negYAlgEquiv W, 1, negYAlgEquiv_ne_one W⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisor_pow
statement:
lemma divisor_pow (f : W.FunctionField) (m : ℕ) :
    divisor W (f ^ m) = m • divisor W f
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [divisor_apply, ord_pow, Finsupp.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_smul_pow_eq_of_nsmul_divisor
statement:
theorem exists_smul_pow_eq_of_nsmul_divisor {h : W.FunctionField} (hh : h ≠ 0)
    {m : ℕ} {g₀ : W.FunctionField} (hg₀ : g₀ ≠ 0)
    (hdiv : m • divisor W g₀ = divisor W h) :
    ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • g₀ ^ m = h
proof:
:=
  exists_unit_of_divisor_eq (pow_ne_zero m hg₀) hh (by rw [divisor_pow, hdiv])

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_unit_of_nsmul_divisor_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unit_of_nsmul_divisor_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0)
    {g₁ g₂ : W.FunctionField} (hg₁ : g₁ ≠ 0) (hg₂ : g₂ ≠ 0)
    (h : m • divisor W g₁ = m • divisor W g₂) :
    ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • g₁ = g₂
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_unit_of_divisor_eq hg₁ hg₂ ?_
  ext v
  have hv := DFunLike.congr_fun h v
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul] at hv
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast hm) hv

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_two
statement:
theorem exists_gS_two [DecidableEq F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y)
    (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 2)
    (hprin : ∀ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 →
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (2 : ℤ) →
      ∃ g₀ : W.FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        2 • divisor W g₀ = divisor W (mulByTwoEndo h2 f)) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (2 : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : W.FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • gS ^ 2 = mulByTwoEndo h2 f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfdiv⟩ := exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion h hP
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀, hdiv⟩ := hprin f hf hfdiv
  have hne : mulByTwoEndo h2 f ≠ 0 := fun hz =>
    hf ((mulByTwoEndo h2).injective (by rw [hz, map_zero]))
  exact ⟨f, hf, hfdiv, g₀, hg₀, exists_smul_pow_eq_of_nsmul_divisor hne hg₀ hdiv⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_three
statement:
theorem exists_gS_three [DecidableEq F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {x y : F}
    (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 3)
    (hprin : ∀ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 →
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (3 : ℤ) →
      ∃ g₀ : W.FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        3 • divisor W g₀ = divisor W (mulByThreeEndo h2 h3 f)) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (3 : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : W.FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • gS ^ 3 = mulByThreeEndo h2 h3 f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfdiv⟩ := exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion h hP
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀, hdiv⟩ := hprin f hf hfdiv
  have hne : mulByThreeEndo h2 h3 f ≠ 0 := fun hz =>
    hf ((mulByThreeEndo h2 h3).injective (by rw [hz, map_zero]))
  exact ⟨f, hf, hfdiv, g₀, hg₀, exists_smul_pow_eq_of_nsmul_divisor hne hg₀ hdiv⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_n
statement:
theorem exists_gS_n [DecidableEq F] {n : ℕ}
    (hn : Transcendental F ((n • genericPoint (W := W)).xCoord))
    {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (hS : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n)
    (hprin : ∀ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 →
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ) →
      ∃ g₀ : W.FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        n • divisor W g₀ = divisor W (mulByNEndo n hn f)) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : W.FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • gS ^ n = mulByNEndo n hn f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfdiv⟩ := exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion h hS
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀, hdiv⟩ := hprin f hf hfdiv
  have hne : mulByNEndo n hn f ≠ 0 := fun hz =>
    hf (mulByNEndo_injective n hn (by rw [hz, map_zero]))
  exact ⟨f, hf, hfdiv, g₀, hg₀, exists_smul_pow_eq_of_nsmul_divisor hne hg₀ hdiv⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_of_smooth
statement:
theorem exists_gS_of_smooth [DecidableEq F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ≠ 0) (hfac : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3)
    {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (hS : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n)
    (hprin : ∀ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 →
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ) →
      ∃ g₀ : W.FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        n • divisor W g₀ =
          divisor W (mulByNEndo n (transcendental_xCoord_nsmul_of_smooth h2 h3 hn hfac) f)) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : W.FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • gS ^ n
          = mulByNEndo n (transcendental_xCoord_nsmul_of_smooth h2 h3 hn hfac) f
proof:
:=
  exists_gS_n _ h hS hprin

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_gS_of_ne_zero [DecidableEq F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : ((n : ℤ) : F) ≠ 0)
    {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (hS : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n)
    (hprin : ∀ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 →
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ) →
      ∃ g₀ : W.FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        n • divisor W g₀ =
          divisor W (mulByNEndo n
            (transcendental_xCoord_nsmul_genericPoint_of_intCast_ne_zero h2 hn) f)) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : W.FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • gS ^ n
          = mulByNEndo n (transcendental_xCoord_nsmul_genericPoint_of_intCast_ne_zero h2 hn) f
proof:
:=
  exists_gS_n _ h hS hprin

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_two_of_general
statement:
private theorem exists_gS_two_of_general [DecidableEq F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x y : F}
    (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 2)
    (hprin : ∀ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 →
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (2 : ℤ) →
      ∃ g₀ : W.FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        2 • divisor W g₀ = divisor W (mulByTwoEndo h2 f)) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (2 : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : W.FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • gS ^ 2 = mulByTwoEndo h2 f
proof:
:= by
  have key := exists_gS_n (transcendental_xCoord_two_nsmul (W := W) h2) h hP
    (by simpa only [mulByNEndo_two h2, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hprin)
  simpa only [mulByNEndo_two h2, Nat.cast_ofNat] using key

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_three_of_general
statement:
private theorem exists_gS_three_of_general [DecidableEq F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 3)
    (hprin : ∀ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 →
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (3 : ℤ) →
      ∃ g₀ : W.FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        3 • divisor W g₀ = divisor W (mulByThreeEndo h2 h3 f)) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (3 : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : W.FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • gS ^ 3 = mulByThreeEndo h2 h3 f
proof:
:= by
  have key := exists_gS_n (transcendental_xCoord_three_nsmul (W := W) h2 h3) h hP
    (by simpa only [mulByNEndo_three h2 h3, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hprin)
  simpa only [mulByNEndo_three h2 h3, Nat.cast_ofNat] using key

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.primeFactors_four
statement: private lemma primeFactors_four : ∀ p ∈ (4 : ℕ).primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨hpp, hdvd, -⟩ := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp
  rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 from rfl] at hdvd
  exact Or.inl ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpp Nat.prime_two).mp (hpp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hdvd))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleNsP
statement: private lemma exampleNsP : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Nonsingular 0 0
proof:
:=
  (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).equation_iff_nonsingular.mp (by
    norm_num [y2EqX3SubX, WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff])

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleTorTwo
statement: private lemma exampleTorTwo : Point.some (0 : ℚ) 0 exampleNsP ∈ (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).torsion 2
proof:
:=
  (mem_torsion_two_some_iff exampleNsP).mpr (by norm_num [y2EqX3SubX])

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleTorFour
statement: private lemma exampleTorFour : Point.some (0 : ℚ) 0 exampleNsP ∈ (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).torsion 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_torsion_iff, show (4 : ℕ) = 2 * 2 from rfl, mul_nsmul,
    mem_torsion_iff.mp exampleTorTwo, smul_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleGSFour
statement:
private theorem exampleGSFour
    (hprin : ∀ f : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).FunctionField, f ≠ 0 →
      divisor (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) f
          = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint exampleNsP.1) (4 : ℤ) →
      ∃ g₀ : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        4 • divisor (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) g₀ = divisor (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) (mulByNEndo 4
          (transcendental_xCoord_nsmul_of_smooth exampleTwo exampleThree
            (by norm_num) primeFactors_four) f)) :
    ∃ f : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) f
          = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint exampleNsP.1) (4 : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).CoordinateRingˣ, (u : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).CoordinateRing) • gS ^ 4
          = mulByNEndo 4 (transcendental_xCoord_nsmul_of_smooth exampleTwo exampleThree
              (by norm_num) primeFactors_four) f
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    exists_gS_of_smooth exampleTwo exampleThree (n := 4) (by norm_num) primeFactors_four
      exampleNsP exampleTorFour (by simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat] using hprin)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleTorTen
statement: private lemma exampleTorTen : Point.some (0 : ℚ) 0 exampleNsP ∈ (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).torsion 10
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_torsion_iff, show (10 : ℕ) = 2 * 5 from rfl, mul_nsmul,
    mem_torsion_iff.mp exampleTorTwo, smul_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleGSTen
statement:
private theorem exampleGSTen
    (hprin : ∀ f : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).FunctionField, f ≠ 0 →
      divisor (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) f
          = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint exampleNsP.1) (10 : ℤ) →
      ∃ g₀ : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        10 • divisor (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) g₀ = divisor (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) (mulByNEndo 10
          (transcendental_xCoord_nsmul_genericPoint_of_intCast_ne_zero exampleTwo
            (by norm_num)) f)) :
    ∃ f : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor (y2EqX3SubX ℚ) f
          = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint exampleNsP.1) (10 : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).CoordinateRingˣ, (u : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).CoordinateRing) • gS ^ 10
          = mulByNEndo 10 (transcendental_xCoord_nsmul_genericPoint_of_intCast_ne_zero exampleTwo
              (by norm_num)) f
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    exists_gS_of_ne_zero exampleTwo (n := 10) (by norm_num) exampleNsP exampleTorTen
      (by simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat] using hprin)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.norm_ne_zero
statement: lemma norm_ne_zero {a : W.CoordinateRing} (ha : a ≠ 0) : Algebra.norm F[X] a ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff_of_basis (CoordinateRing.basis W)).mpr ha

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.degree_norm_eq_deg
statement:
lemma degree_norm_eq_deg {a : W.CoordinateRing} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (Algebra.norm F[X] a).degree = (deg W a : ℕ)
proof:
:=
  degree_eq_natDegree (norm_ne_zero ha)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma deg_zero : deg W (0 : W.CoordinateRing) = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Free F[X] W.CoordinateRing := Module.Free.of_basis (CoordinateRing.basis W)
  haveI : Module.Finite F[X] W.CoordinateRing := Module.Finite.of_basis (CoordinateRing.basis W)
  simp [deg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma deg_one : deg W (1 : W.CoordinateRing) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [deg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_mul
statement:
lemma deg_mul {a b : W.CoordinateRing} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    deg W (a * b) = deg W a + deg W b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deg, map_mul]
  exact natDegree_mul (norm_ne_zero ha) (norm_ne_zero hb)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mk_C_ne_zero
statement: lemma mk_C_ne_zero {p : F[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) : (mk W (C p) : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine hp (smul_basis_eq_zero (W' := W) (p := p) (q := 0) ?_).1
  rw [zero_smul, add_zero, smul, mul_one]
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mk_Y_ne_zero
statement: lemma mk_Y_ne_zero : (mk W Y : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : (0 : F[X]) • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + (1 : F[X]) • mk W Y = 0 := by
    rw [zero_smul, zero_add, one_smul]; exact h
  exact one_ne_zero (smul_basis_eq_zero h1).2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.two_nsmul_mono
statement: private lemma two_nsmul_mono {u v : WithBot ℕ} (h : u ≤ v) : (2 : ℕ) • u ≤ (2 : ℕ) • v
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_nsmul, two_nsmul]; exact add_le_add h h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.two_nsmul_max
statement:
private lemma two_nsmul_max (u v : WithBot ℕ) :
    (2 : ℕ) • max u v = max ((2 : ℕ) • u) ((2 : ℕ) • v)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total u v with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_right (two_nsmul_mono h)]
  · rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_left (two_nsmul_mono h)]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.max_add_right
statement: private lemma max_add_right (u v c : WithBot ℕ) : max u v + c = max (u + c) (v + c)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total u v with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_right (add_le_add h (le_refl c))]
  · rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_left (add_le_add h (le_refl c))]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.degree_norm_add_le
statement:
lemma degree_norm_add_le (a b : W.CoordinateRing) :
    (Algebra.norm F[X] (a + b)).degree ≤
      max (Algebra.norm F[X] a).degree (Algebra.norm F[X] b).degree
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_basis_eq a
  obtain ⟨p', q', rfl⟩ := exists_smul_basis_eq b
  have hadd : (p • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + q • mk W Y)
      + (p' • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + q' • mk W Y)
      = (p + p') • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + (q + q') • mk W Y := by
    rw [add_smul, add_smul]; ring
  rw [hadd, degree_norm_smul_basis, degree_norm_smul_basis, degree_norm_smul_basis]
  refine max_le ?_ ?_
  · have h1 : (2 : ℕ) • (p + p').degree ≤ max ((2 : ℕ) • p.degree) ((2 : ℕ) • p'.degree) :=
      (two_nsmul_mono (degree_add_le p p')).trans_eq (two_nsmul_max _ _)
    exact h1.trans (max_le_max (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _))
  · have h2 : (2 : ℕ) • (q + q').degree + 3
        ≤ max ((2 : ℕ) • q.degree + 3) ((2 : ℕ) • q'.degree + 3) := by
      refine le_trans (add_le_add ?_ (le_refl 3)) (max_add_right _ _ 3).le
      exact (two_nsmul_mono (degree_add_le q q')).trans_eq (two_nsmul_max _ _)
    exact h2.trans (max_le_max (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_add_le
statement: lemma deg_add_le (a b : W.CoordinateRing) : deg W (a + b) ≤ max (deg W a) (deg W b)
proof:
:= by
  refine natDegree_le_iff_degree_le.mpr ((degree_norm_add_le a b).trans (max_le ?_ ?_))
  · exact degree_le_natDegree.trans (by exact_mod_cast le_max_left (deg W a) (deg W b))
  · exact degree_le_natDegree.trans (by exact_mod_cast le_max_right (deg W a) (deg W b))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.eq_smul_basis_algebraMap
statement:
lemma eq_smul_basis_algebraMap (c : F) :
    algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c = C c • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + (0 : F[X]) • mk W Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_smul, add_zero, ← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F F[X] W.CoordinateRing, ← Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma deg_algebraMap (c : F) : deg W (algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg, eq_smul_basis_algebraMap, norm_smul_basis]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_mk_C
statement: lemma deg_mk_C (p : F[X]) : deg W (mk W (C p)) = 2 * p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have h : mk W (C p) = p • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + (0 : F[X]) • mk W Y := by
    rw [zero_smul, add_zero, smul, mul_one]
  rw [deg, h, norm_smul_basis]
  simp [natDegree_pow]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_mk_Y
statement: lemma deg_mk_Y : deg W (mk W Y) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have h : mk W Y = (0 : F[X]) • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + (1 : F[X]) • mk W Y := by
    rw [zero_smul, zero_add, one_smul]
  refine natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some ?_
  rw [h, degree_norm_smul_basis]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_ne_one
statement: lemma deg_ne_one (a : W.CoordinateRing) : deg W a ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  natDegree_norm_ne_one a

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_eq_algebraMap_of_deg_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_eq_algebraMap_of_deg_eq_zero {a : W.CoordinateRing} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : deg W a = 0) : ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ a = algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg0 : (Algebra.norm F[X] a).degree = 0 := by
    rw [degree_norm_eq_deg ha, h]; rfl
  obtain ⟨p, q, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_basis_eq a
  rw [degree_norm_smul_basis] at hdeg0
  have hq3 : 2 • q.degree + 3 ≤ (0 : WithBot ℕ) := (le_max_right _ _).trans hdeg0.le
  have hq0 : q = 0 := by
    by_contra hq
    have hqd : (0 : WithBot ℕ) ≤ q.degree := zero_le_degree_iff.mpr hq
    have h2q : (0 : WithBot ℕ) ≤ 2 • q.degree := by
      rw [two_nsmul]; exact add_nonneg hqd hqd
    have h3 : (3 : WithBot ℕ) ≤ 2 • q.degree + 3 := le_add_of_nonneg_left h2q
    exact absurd (h3.trans hq3) (by decide)
  subst hq0
  simp only [degree_zero, two_nsmul, WithBot.bot_add, max_bot_right] at hdeg0
  have hp0 : p.degree = 0 := (Nat.WithBot.add_eq_zero_iff.mp hdeg0).1
  have hp : p = C (p.coeff 0) := eq_C_of_degree_eq_zero hp0
  have hc : p.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hc0
    rw [hc0, map_zero] at hp
    rw [hp, degree_zero] at hp0
    exact absurd hp0 (by simp)
  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, hc, ?_⟩
  rw [zero_smul, add_zero, ← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F F[X] W.CoordinateRing, ← Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, ← hp]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_eq_zero_iff_isUnit
statement:
theorem deg_eq_zero_iff_isUnit {a : W.CoordinateRing} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    deg W a = 0 ↔ IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_algebraMap_of_deg_eq_zero ha h
    exact (isUnit_iff_exists_eq_algebraMap).mpr ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := (isUnit_iff_exists_eq_algebraMap).mp h
    exact deg_algebraMap c

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_deg_eq
statement: theorem exists_deg_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 1) : ∃ a : W.CoordinateRing, a ≠ 0 ∧ deg W a = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with he | ho
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := he
    refine ⟨mk W (C (X ^ k)), mk_C_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero), ?_⟩
    rw [deg_mk_C, natDegree_X_pow]
    omega
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ho
    have hk1 : k ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hn (by omega)
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    have hX : (mk W (C (X ^ j)) : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0 :=
      mk_C_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero)
    refine ⟨mk W (C (X ^ j)) * mk W Y, mul_ne_zero hX mk_Y_ne_zero, ?_⟩
    rw [deg_mul hX mk_Y_ne_zero, deg_mk_C, deg_mk_Y, natDegree_X_pow]
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.two_nsmul_degree_add_eq_iff
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp
  · simp only [degree_zero, two_nsmul, WithBot.bot_add, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, false_and,
      iff_false]
    exact WithBot.bot_ne_natCast n
  · rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp, two_nsmul]
    simp only [hp, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, true_and]
    rw [← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_inj]
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.two_nsmul_degree_add_lt_iff
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp
  · simp only [degree_zero, two_nsmul, WithBot.bot_add, true_or, iff_true]
    exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _
  · rw [degree_eq_natDegree hp, two_nsmul]
    simp only [hp, false_or]
    rw [← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_lt]
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.two_nsmul_degree_eq_iff
statement:
private lemma two_nsmul_degree_eq_iff {p : F[X]} {n : ℕ} :
    (2 : ℕ) • p.degree = (n : WithBot ℕ) ↔ (p ≠ 0 ∧ 2 * p.natDegree = n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using two_nsmul_degree_add_eq_iff (p := p) (k := 0) (n := n)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.two_nsmul_degree_lt_iff
statement:
private lemma two_nsmul_degree_lt_iff {p : F[X]} {n : ℕ} :
    (2 : ℕ) • p.degree < (n : WithBot ℕ) ↔ (p = 0 ∨ 2 * p.natDegree < n)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using two_nsmul_degree_add_lt_iff (p := p) (k := 0) (n := n)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.max_two_nsmul_degree_cases
statement:
private lemma max_two_nsmul_degree_cases {p q : F[X]} {n : ℕ}
    (h : max ((2 : ℕ) • p.degree) ((2 : ℕ) • q.degree + 3) = (n : WithBot ℕ)) :
    (p ≠ 0 ∧ 2 * p.natDegree = n ∧ (q = 0 ∨ 2 * q.natDegree + 3 < n)) ∨
      (q ≠ 0 ∧ 2 * q.natDegree + 3 = n ∧ (p = 0 ∨ 2 * p.natDegree < n))
proof:
:= by
  have hthree : ((3 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) = (3 : WithBot ℕ) := by norm_num
  have hp := le_max_left ((2 : ℕ) • p.degree) ((2 : ℕ) • q.degree + 3)
  have hq := le_max_right ((2 : ℕ) • p.degree) ((2 : ℕ) • q.degree + 3)
  rw [h] at hp hq
  rcases max_choice ((2 : ℕ) • p.degree) ((2 : ℕ) • q.degree + 3) with hm | hm
  · rw [hm] at h
    obtain ⟨hp0, hpn⟩ := two_nsmul_degree_eq_iff.1 h
    refine Or.inl ⟨hp0, hpn, ?_⟩
    refine two_nsmul_degree_add_lt_iff.1 (hthree ▸ lt_of_le_of_ne (hthree ▸ hq) fun hcon => ?_)
    obtain ⟨-, hqn⟩ := two_nsmul_degree_add_eq_iff.1 (hthree ▸ hcon)
    omega
  · rw [hm] at h
    obtain ⟨hq0, hqn⟩ := two_nsmul_degree_add_eq_iff.1 (hthree ▸ h)
    refine Or.inr ⟨hq0, hqn, ?_⟩
    refine two_nsmul_degree_lt_iff.1 (lt_of_le_of_ne hp fun hcon => ?_)
    obtain ⟨-, hpn⟩ := two_nsmul_degree_eq_iff.1 hcon
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_leadingCoeff_ratio
statement:
private lemma exists_leadingCoeff_ratio {u₁ u₂ w₁ w₂ : F[X]} {n k l : ℕ}
    (hu₁ : u₁ ≠ 0) (hu₂ : u₂ ≠ 0)
    (hnu₁ : 2 * u₁.natDegree + k = n) (hnu₂ : 2 * u₂.natDegree + k = n)
    (hw₁ : w₁ = 0 ∨ 2 * w₁.natDegree + l < n) (hw₂ : w₂ = 0 ∨ 2 * w₂.natDegree + l < n) :
    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧
      (u₁ - C c * u₂ = 0 ∨ 2 * (u₁ - C c * u₂).natDegree + k < n) ∧
      (w₁ - C c * w₂ = 0 ∨ 2 * (w₁ - C c * w₂).natDegree + l < n)
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : u₁.natDegree = u₂.natDegree := by omega
  set c : F := u₁.leadingCoeff / u₂.leadingCoeff with hc
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hu₁) (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hu₂)
  refine ⟨c, hc0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases eq_or_ne (u₁ - C c * u₂) 0 with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    refine Or.inr ?_
    have hlc : u₁.leadingCoeff = (C c * u₂).leadingCoeff := by
      rw [leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C, hc, div_mul_cancel₀]
      exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hu₂
    have hdd : u₁.degree = (C c * u₂).degree := by
      rw [degree_C_mul hc0, degree_eq_natDegree hu₁, degree_eq_natDegree hu₂, hdeg]
    have hlt : (u₁ - C c * u₂).degree < u₁.degree := degree_sub_lt hdd hu₁ hlc
    have : (u₁ - C c * u₂).natDegree < u₁.natDegree :=
      natDegree_lt_natDegree h (by rwa [degree_eq_natDegree hu₁] at hlt ⊢)
    omega
  · rcases eq_or_ne (w₁ - C c * w₂) 0 with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    refine Or.inr ?_
    have hle : (w₁ - C c * w₂).natDegree ≤ max w₁.natDegree w₂.natDegree :=
      (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le_max (le_refl _) (natDegree_C_mul_le c w₂))
    have h₁ : w₁ ≠ 0 ∨ w₂ ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      exact h (by rw [hcon.1, hcon.2, mul_zero, sub_zero])
    rcases hw₁ with rfl | hb₁ <;> rcases hw₂ with rfl | hb₂ <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.deg_smul_basis_cast
statement:
private lemma deg_smul_basis_cast {p q : F[X]}
    (h : p • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + q • mk W Y ≠ 0) :
    ((deg W (p • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + q • mk W Y) : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ)
      = max ((2 : ℕ) • p.degree) ((2 : ℕ) • q.degree + 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← degree_norm_eq_deg h, degree_norm_smul_basis]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.exists_deg_sub_lt
statement:
theorem exists_deg_sub_lt {a b : W.CoordinateRing} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : deg W a = deg W b) :
    ∃ c : F, a - algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c * b = 0 ∨
      deg W (a - algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c * b) < deg W b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₁, q₁, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_basis_eq a
  obtain ⟨p₂, q₂, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_basis_eq b
  set n := deg W (p₂ • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + q₂ • mk W Y) with hn
  have h₁ : max ((2 : ℕ) • p₁.degree) ((2 : ℕ) • q₁.degree + 3) = (n : WithBot ℕ) := by
    rw [← deg_smul_basis_cast ha, h]
  have h₂ : max ((2 : ℕ) • p₂.degree) ((2 : ℕ) • q₂.degree + 3) = (n : WithBot ℕ) :=
    (deg_smul_basis_cast hb).symm
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hu, hw⟩ :
      ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ (p₁ - C c * p₂ = 0 ∨ 2 * (p₁ - C c * p₂).natDegree < n) ∧
        (q₁ - C c * q₂ = 0 ∨ 2 * (q₁ - C c * q₂).natDegree + 3 < n) := by
    rcases max_two_nsmul_degree_cases h₁ with ⟨hp₁, hn₁, hq₁⟩ | ⟨hq₁, hn₁, hp₁⟩
    · rcases max_two_nsmul_degree_cases h₂ with ⟨hp₂, hn₂, hq₂⟩ | ⟨hq₂, hn₂, -⟩
      · obtain ⟨c, hc0, hu, hw⟩ :=
          exists_leadingCoeff_ratio (k := 0) (l := 3) hp₁ hp₂ (by omega) (by omega) hq₁ hq₂
        exact ⟨c, hc0, by simpa using hu, hw⟩
      · omega
    · rcases max_two_nsmul_degree_cases h₂ with ⟨hp₂, hn₂, -⟩ | ⟨hq₂, hn₂, hp₂⟩
      · omega
      · obtain ⟨c, hc0, hu, hw⟩ :=
          exists_leadingCoeff_ratio (k := 3) (l := 0) hq₁ hq₂ hn₁ hn₂
            (by simpa using hp₁) (by simpa using hp₂)
        exact ⟨c, hc0, by simpa using hw, hu⟩
  
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  have hsub : (p₁ • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + q₁ • mk W Y)
      - algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c * (p₂ • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + q₂ • mk W Y)
      = (p₁ - C c * p₂) • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + (q₁ - C c * q₂) • mk W Y := by
    rw [eq_smul_basis_algebraMap, zero_smul, add_zero, smul_mul_assoc, one_mul, smul_add,
      smul_smul, smul_smul, sub_smul, sub_smul]
    ring
  rw [hsub]
  rcases eq_or_ne ((p₁ - C c * p₂) • (1 : W.CoordinateRing) + (q₁ - C c * q₂) • mk W Y) 0
    with hz | hz
  · exact Or.inl hz
  refine Or.inr ?_
  rw [← Nat.cast_lt (α := WithBot ℕ), deg_smul_basis_cast hz]
  exact max_lt (two_nsmul_degree_lt_iff.2 hu)
    (by simpa using two_nsmul_degree_add_lt_iff.2 hw)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ordInfty_zero : ordInfty W (0 : W.FunctionField) = 0
proof: := if_pos rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_eq_sub
statement:
theorem ordInfty_eq_sub {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) {a b : W.CoordinateRing} (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : f * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField b
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a) :
    ordInfty W f = (deg W b : ℤ) - deg W a
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField) :=
    IsFractionRing.injective W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField
  set n := (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).1 with hn
  set s := (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).2 with hs
  have hspec : f * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField (s : W.CoordinateRing)
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField n := IsLocalization.sec_spec _ f
  have hs0 : (s : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero s
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro hazero
    rw [hazero, map_zero, mul_eq_zero] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact hf h
    · exact hb (hinj (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
    intro hnzero
    rw [hnzero, map_zero, mul_eq_zero] at hspec
    rcases hspec with h' | h'
    · exact hf h'
    · exact hs0 (hinj (by rw [h', map_zero]))
  have hcross : n * b = a * (s : W.CoordinateRing) := by
    refine hinj ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← hspec, ← h]
    ring
  have hdeg : deg W n + deg W b = deg W a + deg W (s : W.CoordinateRing) := by
    rw [← deg_mul hn0 hb, ← deg_mul ha0 hs0, hcross]
  rw [ordInfty, if_neg hf, ← hn, ← hs]
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ordInfty_algebraMap {a : W.CoordinateRing} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ordInfty W (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a) = -(deg W a : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfa : algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    ha ((IsFractionRing.injective W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField) (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  rw [ordInfty_eq_sub (a := a) (b := 1) hfa one_ne_zero (by rw [map_one, mul_one]), deg_one]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ordInfty_one : ordInfty W (1 : W.FunctionField) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := ordInfty_algebraMap (W := W) (a := 1) one_ne_zero
  rwa [map_one, deg_one, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma ordInfty_of_ne_zero {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ordInfty W f = (deg W (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).2 : ℤ)
      - deg W (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).1
proof: := if_neg hf

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.sec_fst_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma sec_fst_ne_zero {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hspec := IsLocalization.sec_spec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f
  rw [h, map_zero, mul_eq_zero] at hspec
  rcases hspec with h' | h'
  · exact hf h'
  · exact nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero _
      ((IsFractionRing.injective W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField) (by rw [h', map_zero]))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_mul
statement:
theorem ordInfty_mul {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ordInfty W (f * g) = ordInfty W f + ordInfty W g
proof:
:= by
  have hf' := IsLocalization.sec_spec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f
  have hg' := IsLocalization.sec_spec W.CoordinateRing⁰ g
  have hsf : ((IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).2 : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0 :=
    nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero _
  have hsg : ((IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ g).2 : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0 :=
    nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero _
  have hprod : (f * g) * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField
        (((IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).2 : W.CoordinateRing) *
          ((IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ g).2 : W.CoordinateRing))
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField
        ((IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).1 *
          (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ g).1) := by
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← hf', ← hg']
    ring
  rw [ordInfty_eq_sub (mul_ne_zero hf hg) (mul_ne_zero hsf hsg) hprod,
    deg_mul hsf hsg, deg_mul (sec_fst_ne_zero hf) (sec_fst_ne_zero hg),
    ordInfty_of_ne_zero hf, ordInfty_of_ne_zero hg]
  push_cast
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_inv
statement: theorem ordInfty_inv (f : W.FunctionField) : ordInfty W f⁻¹ = -ordInfty W f
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · simp
  have hf' := IsLocalization.sec_spec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f
  have hsf : ((IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).2 : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0 :=
    nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero _
  have hinv : f⁻¹ * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField
        (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).1
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField
        ((IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).2 : W.CoordinateRing) := by
    rw [← hf', ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hf, one_mul]
  rw [ordInfty_eq_sub (inv_ne_zero hf) (sec_fst_ne_zero hf) hinv, ordInfty_of_ne_zero hf]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_div
statement:
theorem ordInfty_div {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ordInfty W (f / g) = ordInfty W f - ordInfty W g
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ordInfty_mul hf (inv_ne_zero hg), ordInfty_inv]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_pow
statement:
theorem ordInfty_pow (f : W.FunctionField) (n : ℕ) :
    ordInfty W (f ^ n) = n * ordInfty W f
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp
    · rw [zero_pow hn.ne']; simp
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ, ordInfty_mul (pow_ne_zero k hf) hf, ih]; push_cast; ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_zpow
statement:
theorem ordInfty_zpow (f : W.FunctionField) (n : ℤ) :
    ordInfty W (f ^ n) = n * ordInfty W f
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · simp
    · rw [zero_zpow n hn]; simp
  obtain ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩ := n.eq_nat_or_neg
  · rw [zpow_natCast, ordInfty_pow]
  · rw [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ordInfty_inv, ordInfty_pow]; ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_prod
statement:
theorem ordInfty_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → W.FunctionField)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) :
    ordInfty W (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, ordInfty W (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ih =>
    have hfa : f a ≠ 0 := hf a (Finset.mem_cons_self a s)
    have hmem : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 := fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_cons_of_mem hi)
    have hprod : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 hmem
    rw [Finset.prod_cons, Finset.sum_cons, ordInfty_mul hfa hprod, ih hmem]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.le_ordInfty_add
statement:
theorem le_ordInfty_add {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hfg : f + g ≠ 0) :
    min (ordInfty W f) (ordInfty W g) ≤ ordInfty W (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  set a := (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).1 with ha
  set s := ((IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).2 : W.CoordinateRing) with hs
  set b := (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ g).1 with hb
  set t := ((IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ g).2 : W.CoordinateRing) with ht
  have hf' : f * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField s
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a := IsLocalization.sec_spec _ f
  have hg' : g * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField t
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField b := IsLocalization.sec_spec _ g
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero _
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero _
  have hsum : (f + g) * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField (s * t)
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField (a * t + b * s) := by
    rw [map_mul, map_add, map_mul, map_mul, ← hf', ← hg']
    ring
  have hfeq : ordInfty W f = (deg W (s * t) : ℤ) - deg W (a * t) := by
    refine ordInfty_eq_sub hf (mul_ne_zero hs0 ht0) ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← mul_assoc, hf']
  have hgeq : ordInfty W g = (deg W (s * t) : ℤ) - deg W (b * s) := by
    refine ordInfty_eq_sub hg (mul_ne_zero hs0 ht0) ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, show g * (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField s
      * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField t)
      = g * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField t
        * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField s from by ring, hg']
  rw [ordInfty_eq_sub hfg (mul_ne_zero hs0 ht0) hsum, hfeq, hgeq]
  have hle : deg W (a * t + b * s) ≤ max (deg W (a * t)) (deg W (b * s)) :=
    deg_add_le _ _
  rcases le_total (deg W (a * t)) (deg W (b * s)) with h | h
  · rw [max_eq_right h] at hle
    simp only [min_le_iff]
    omega
  · rw [max_eq_left h] at hle
    simp only [min_le_iff]
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_algebraMap_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ordInfty_algebraMap_base {c : F} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ordInfty W (algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : algebraMap F W.FunctionField c
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField (algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c) :=
    (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField c)
  have hne : algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using (algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing).injective.ne hc
  rw [h, ordInfty_algebraMap hne, deg_algebraMap]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_genX
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ordInfty_genX : ordInfty W (CoordinateRing.genX W) = -2
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (CoordinateRing.mk W (C X) : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0 :=
    CoordinateRing.mk_C_ne_zero Polynomial.X_ne_zero
  rw [CoordinateRing.genX, CoordinateRing.genPsi, ordInfty_algebraMap hne, deg_mk_C]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_genY
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ordInfty_genY : ordInfty W (CoordinateRing.genY W) = -3
proof:
:= by
  have hroot : AdjoinRoot.root W.polynomial = CoordinateRing.mk W Y := rfl
  have hne : (CoordinateRing.mk W Y : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0 := CoordinateRing.mk_Y_ne_zero
  rw [CoordinateRing.genY, CoordinateRing.genPsi, hroot, ordInfty_algebraMap hne, deg_mk_Y]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.genX_ne_zero
statement: lemma genX_ne_zero : CoordinateRing.genX W ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h =>
  CoordinateRing.genX_ne (W := W) 0 (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.genY_ne_zero
statement: lemma genY_ne_zero : CoordinateRing.genY W ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := ordInfty_genY (W := W)
  rw [h, ordInfty_zero] at this
  exact absurd this (by norm_num)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_genX_div_genY
statement:
theorem ordInfty_genX_div_genY :
    ordInfty W (CoordinateRing.genX W / CoordinateRing.genY W) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordInfty_div genX_ne_zero genY_ne_zero, ordInfty_genX, ordInfty_genY]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_surjective
statement:
theorem ordInfty_surjective (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧ ordInfty W f = n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(CoordinateRing.genX W / CoordinateRing.genY W) ^ n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact zpow_ne_zero _ (div_ne_zero genX_ne_zero genY_ne_zero)
  · rw [ordInfty_zpow, ordInfty_genX_div_genY, mul_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_eq_algebraMap_of_ordInfty_nonneg
statement:
theorem exists_eq_algebraMap_of_ordInfty_nonneg {a : W.CoordinateRing} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : 0 ≤ ordInfty W (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a)) :
    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ a = algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordInfty_algebraMap ha, neg_nonneg] at h
  exact exists_eq_algebraMap_of_deg_eq_zero ha (by omega)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_const_ordInfty_sub_pos
statement:
theorem exists_const_ordInfty_sub_pos {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : 0 ≤ ordInfty W f) :
    ∃ c : F, f = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c ∨
      0 < ordInfty W (f - algebraMap F W.FunctionField c)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf0
  · exact ⟨0, Or.inl (map_zero _).symm⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField) :=
    IsFractionRing.injective W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField
  set a := (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).1 with ha
  set s := (IsLocalization.sec W.CoordinateRing⁰ f).2 with hs
  have hspec : f * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField (s : W.CoordinateRing)
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a := IsLocalization.sec_spec _ f
  have hs0 : (s : W.CoordinateRing) ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero s
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, map_zero, mul_eq_zero] at hspec
    rcases hspec with h' | h'
    · exact hf0 h'
    · exact hs0 (hinj (by rw [h', map_zero]))
  have hord : ordInfty W f = (deg W (s : W.CoordinateRing) : ℤ) - deg W a :=
    ordInfty_eq_sub hf0 hs0 hspec
  have hle : deg W a ≤ deg W (s : W.CoordinateRing) := by omega
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hlt | heq
  · exact ⟨0, Or.inr (by rw [map_zero, sub_zero]; omega)⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_deg_sub_lt ha0 hs0 heq
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  have hpush : (f - algebraMap F W.FunctionField c)
      * algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField (s : W.CoordinateRing)
      = algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField
        (a - algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c * (s : W.CoordinateRing)) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, sub_mul, hspec,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField]
  rcases eq_or_ne (a - algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c * (s : W.CoordinateRing)) 0 with hz | hz
  · refine Or.inl ?_
    rw [hz, map_zero] at hpush
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hpush with h' | h'
    · exact sub_eq_zero.1 h'
    · exact absurd (hinj (by rw [h', map_zero])) hs0
  · refine Or.inr ?_
    have hdlt : deg W (a - algebraMap F W.CoordinateRing c * (s : W.CoordinateRing))
        < deg W (s : W.CoordinateRing) := hc.resolve_left hz
    have hgne : f - algebraMap F W.FunctionField c ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, zero_mul] at hpush
      exact hz (hinj (by rw [← hpush, map_zero]))
    rw [ordInfty_eq_sub hgne hs0 hpush]
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_algebraMap_nonneg
statement:
lemma ord_algebraMap_nonneg (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) (a : W.CoordinateRing) :
    0 ≤ ord v (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ord, ← coeIdeal_span_singleton]
  exact count_coe_nonneg W.FunctionField v _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_genX_ne_ordInfty_genX
statement:
theorem ord_genX_ne_ordInfty_genX (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    ord v (CoordinateRing.genX W) ≠ ordInfty W (CoordinateRing.genX W)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ord_algebraMap_nonneg v (CoordinateRing.mk W (C X))
  rw [ordInfty_genX]
  rw [CoordinateRing.genX, CoordinateRing.genPsi] at *
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_placeBelow_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_placeBelow_iff {q : ProjPoint W} {y : ↥φ.fieldRange} :
    y ∈ placeBelow φ q ↔ φ.rangeRestrictFieldEquiv.symm y ∈ placeOf W q
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coe_placeBelowEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_placeBelowEquiv (q : ProjPoint W) (x : placeOf W q) :
    ((placeBelowEquiv φ q x : placeBelow φ q) : ↥φ.fieldRange)
      = φ.rangeRestrictFieldEquiv (x : W.FunctionField)
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isNoetherianRing_placeBelow
statement:
theorem isNoetherianRing_placeBelow (q : ProjPoint W) :
    IsNoetherianRing ↥(placeBelow φ q)
proof: := inferInstance

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isFractionRing_placeBelow
statement:
theorem isFractionRing_placeBelow (q : ProjPoint W) :
    IsFractionRing ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥φ.fieldRange
proof: := inferInstance

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isIntegrallyClosed_placeBelow
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_placeBelow (q : ProjPoint W) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed ↥(placeBelow φ q)
proof: := inferInstance

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeBelow_comapProjPoint
statement:
theorem placeBelow_comapProjPoint (p : ProjPoint W) :
    placeBelow φ (comapProjPoint hφF hφint p)
      = (placeOf W p).comap (φ.fieldRange.subtype : ↥φ.fieldRange →+* W.FunctionField)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [mem_placeBelow_iff, mem_placeOf_comapProjPoint, ValuationSubring.mem_comap]
  exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (· ∈ placeOf W p)
    (congrArg Subtype.val (φ.rangeRestrictFieldEquiv.apply_symm_apply y)))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.module_flat_integralClosure_placeBelow
statement:
theorem module_flat_integralClosure_placeBelow (q : ProjPoint W) :
    Module.Flat ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.IsTorsionFree ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isTorsionFree ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField
  exact Module.Flat.flat_iff_torsion_eq_bot_of_isBezout.2
    (Submodule.isTorsionFree_iff_torsion_eq_bot.1 inferInstance)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelow
statement:
theorem module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelow (q : ProjPoint W)
    [Module.Finite ↥φ.fieldRange W.FunctionField]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable ↥φ.fieldRange W.FunctionField] :
    Module.Finite ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)
proof:
:=
  IsIntegralClosure.finite ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥φ.fieldRange W.FunctionField _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finrank_integralClosure_placeBelow
statement:
theorem finrank_integralClosure_placeBelow (q : ProjPoint W)
    [Module.Finite ↥φ.fieldRange W.FunctionField]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable ↥φ.fieldRange W.FunctionField] :
    finrank ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)
      = finrank ↥φ.fieldRange W.FunctionField
proof:
:=
  IsIntegralClosure.rank ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥φ.fieldRange W.FunctionField _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.finrank_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange
statement:
theorem finrank_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    finrank ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange W.FunctionField = 4
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).range W.FunctionField :=
    ((mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).range.subtype).toAlgebra
  rw [← Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (rangeEquivFieldRangeTwo h2)
    (RingEquiv.refl W.FunctionField) (by ext a; rfl)]
  exact finrank_mulByTwoRange_functionField h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.module_finite_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange
statement:
theorem module_finite_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Module.Finite ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange W.FunctionField
proof:
:=
  Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (by rw [finrank_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange h2]; norm_num)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.isSeparable_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange
statement:
theorem isSeparable_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange [W.IsElliptic] [CharZero F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Algebra.IsSeparable ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange W.FunctionField
proof:
:= by
  haveI : CharZero W.FunctionField :=
    charZero_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap F W.FunctionField).injective
  haveI : CharZero ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange :=
    ((mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange.subtype).charZero
  haveI := module_finite_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange (W := W) h2
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange W.FunctionField :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite _ _
  infer_instance

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.placeBelowTwo_comapProjPointTwo
statement:
theorem placeBelowTwo_comapProjPointTwo (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (p : ProjPoint W) :
    placeBelowTwo W h2 (comapProjPointTwo h2 p)
      = (placeOf W p).comap ((mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange.subtype)
proof:
:=
  placeBelow_comapProjPoint _ _ p

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.module_flat_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo
statement:
theorem module_flat_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (q : ProjPoint W) :
    Module.Flat ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q) W.FunctionField)
proof:
:=
  module_flat_integralClosure_placeBelow q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo
statement:
theorem module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange W.FunctionField)
    (q : ProjPoint W) :
    Module.Finite ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q) W.FunctionField)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := module_finite_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange (W := W) h2
  haveI := hsep
  exact module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelow q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo_of_charZero
statement:
theorem module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo_of_charZero [W.IsElliptic] [CharZero F]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (q : ProjPoint W) :
    Module.Finite ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q) W.FunctionField)
proof:
:=
  module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo h2 (isSeparable_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange h2) q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo
statement:
theorem finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange W.FunctionField)
    (q : ProjPoint W) :
    finrank ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q) W.FunctionField) = 4
proof:
:= by
  haveI := module_finite_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange (W := W) h2
  haveI := hsep
  exact (finrank_integralClosure_placeBelow (φ := mulByTwoEndo h2) q).trans
    (finrank_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange h2)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo_of_charZero
statement:
theorem finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo_of_charZero [W.IsElliptic] [CharZero F]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (q : ProjPoint W) :
    finrank ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q) W.FunctionField) = 4
proof:
:=
  finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo h2 (isSeparable_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange h2) q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degPt_eq_residueDegreeProj
statement:
theorem degPt_eq_residueDegreeProj (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    degPt v = residueDegreeProj W (some v)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : v.asIdeal.IsMaximal := v.isMaximal
  haveI hpmax : (v.asIdeal.under F[X]).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_comap_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal v.asIdeal
  haveI : v.asIdeal.LiesOver (v.asIdeal.under F[X]) := ⟨rfl⟩
  haveI : IsGalois (FractionRing F[X]) W.FunctionField := isGalois_fractionRing_polynomial
  have hp0 : v.asIdeal.under F[X] ≠ 0 :=
    Ring.ne_bot_of_isMaximal_of_not_isField hpmax (Polynomial.not_isField F)
  rw [degPt, Ideal.relNorm_eq_pow_of_isPrime_isGalois v.asIdeal (v.asIdeal.under F[X]),
    Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_pow hp0, Ideal.natDegreeGenerator_eq_finrank_quotient,
    Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq_of_isMaximal (v.asIdeal.under F[X]) v.asIdeal, residueDegreeProj,
    (residueFieldProjSomeEquiv v).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq, mul_comm]
  letI : Field (F[X] ⧸ v.asIdeal.under F[X]) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  exact Module.finrank_mul_finrank F (F[X] ⧸ v.asIdeal.under F[X]) (W.CoordinateRing ⧸ v.asIdeal)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProjPt_eq_residueDegreeProj
statement:
theorem degProjPt_eq_residueDegreeProj (p : ProjPoint W) :

proof:
:= by

  | none => rw [degProjPt_none, residueDegreeProj_none_eq_one]
  | some v => exact degPt_eq_residueDegreeProj v

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degPt_eq_one
statement: theorem degPt_eq_one (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) : degPt v = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : v.asIdeal.IsMaximal := v.isMaximal
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hv⟩ :=
    CoordinateRing.exists_equation_and_eq_XYIdeal_of_isMaximal (W := W) v.asIdeal
  have hns : W.Nonsingular a b := equation_iff_nonsingular.mp hab
  have hveq : v = CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint hns.left :=
    HeightOneSpectrum.ext (by simpa using hv)
  rw [hveq]
  exact degPt_pointClosedPoint hns

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProjPt_eq_one
statement: theorem degProjPt_eq_one (p : ProjPoint W) : degProjPt W p = 1

  | some v => exact degPt_eq_one v

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_degProjPt
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_degProjPt :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 q).toFinset,

proof:

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.sum_ramificationIdxThree_mul_degProjPt

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.not_isAlgClosed_rat
statement: private theorem not_isAlgClosed_rat : ¬ IsAlgClosed ℚ
proof:
:= fun h => by

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_placeOf_nonneg
statement:
theorem divisorProj_placeOf_nonneg {p : ProjPoint W} (x : placeOf W p) :
    0 ≤ divisorProj W (x : W.FunctionField) p
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (x : W.FunctionField) 0 with h | h
  · rw [h, divisorProj_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  · exact (mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p h).1 x.2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_span_singleton_of_divisorProj_le
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (x : W.FunctionField) 0 with hx | hx
  · have hx0 : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (by simpa using hx)
    simp [hx0]
  · have hq : (x : W.FunctionField) / (a : W.FunctionField) ∈ placeOf W p := by
      rw [mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p (div_ne_zero hx ha), divisorProj_div hx ha,
        Finsupp.sub_apply]
      omega
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.2
      ⟨⟨_, hq⟩, Subtype.ext (by simpa using div_mul_cancel₀ (x : W.FunctionField) ha)⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isPrincipalIdealRing_placeOf
statement: theorem isPrincipalIdealRing_placeOf (p : ProjPoint W) : IsPrincipalIdealRing (placeOf W p)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun I => ?_⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne I ⊥ with rfl | hI
  · exact bot_isPrincipal
  obtain ⟨b, hbI, hb0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hI
  have hb0' : (b : W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 := fun h => hb0 (Subtype.ext (by simpa using h))
  have hne : {n : ℕ | ∃ x ∈ I, (x : W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 ∧
      (divisorProj W (x : W.FunctionField) p).toNat = n}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨_, b, hbI, hb0', rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, haI, ha0, han⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hne
  refine ⟨⟨a, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [Ideal.submodule_span_eq]
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 haI)
  rcases eq_or_ne (x : W.FunctionField) 0 with hx0 | hx0
  · have : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (by simpa using hx0)
    simp [this]
  · refine mem_span_singleton_of_divisorProj_le ha0 ?_
    have hmem : (divisorProj W (x : W.FunctionField) p).toNat ∈
        {n : ℕ | ∃ x ∈ I, (x : W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 ∧
          (divisorProj W (x : W.FunctionField) p).toNat = n} := ⟨x, hx, hx0, rfl⟩
    have hle := Nat.sInf_le hmem
    have hpa := divisorProj_placeOf_nonneg a
    have hpx := divisorProj_placeOf_nonneg x
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.maximalIdeal_placeOf_ne_bot
statement:
theorem maximalIdeal_placeOf_ne_bot (p : ProjPoint W) :
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (placeOf W p) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ0, hπ⟩ := exists_divisorProj_eq_one p
  have hmem : π ∈ placeOf W p :=
    (mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p hπ0).2 (by rw [hπ]; norm_num)
  rw [maximalIdeal_placeOf_eq_span (⟨π, hmem⟩ : placeOf W p) hπ, Ne,
    Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
  exact fun h => hπ0 (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isDomain_placeOf
statement: theorem isDomain_placeOf (p : ProjPoint W) : IsDomain (placeOf W p)
proof: := inferInstance

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isNoetherianRing_placeOf
statement: theorem isNoetherianRing_placeOf (p : ProjPoint W) : IsNoetherianRing (placeOf W p)
proof: := inferInstance

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.irreducible_placeOf_iff
statement:
theorem irreducible_placeOf_iff {p : ProjPoint W} (π : placeOf W p) :
    Irreducible π ↔ divisorProj W (π : W.FunctionField) p = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => maximalIdeal_placeOf_eq_span π h⟩
  have hπ0 : (π : W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    refine maximalIdeal_placeOf_ne_bot p ?_
    rw [h, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    exact Subtype.ext (by simpa using h0)
  have hpos : 0 < divisorProj W (π : W.FunctionField) p :=
    (mem_maximalIdeal_placeOf_iff hπ0).1 (h ▸ Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self π)
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ0, hρ⟩ := exists_divisorProj_eq_one p
  have hmem : ρ ∈ placeOf W p :=
    (mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p hρ0).2 (by rw [hρ]; norm_num)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1
    (h ▸ (mem_maximalIdeal_placeOf_iff (p := p) (x := ⟨ρ, hmem⟩) hρ0).2 (by rw [hρ]; norm_num))
  have hc0 : (c : W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    refine hρ0 ?_
    have := congrArg (Subtype.val (p := fun z => z ∈ placeOf W p)) hc
    simpa [h0] using this.symm
  have hsplit : divisorProj W ((c : W.FunctionField) * (π : W.FunctionField)) p = 1 := by
    rw [← hρ]
    exact congrArg (fun z => divisorProj W z p) (congrArg Subtype.val hc)
  rw [divisorProj_mul hc0 hπ0, Finsupp.add_apply] at hsplit
  have := divisorProj_placeOf_nonneg c
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ideal_inertiaDeg_eq_residueDegreeComap
statement:
theorem ideal_inertiaDeg_eq_residueDegreeComap
    [hlies : v.asIdeal.LiesOver (maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q))] :
    v.asIdeal.inertiaDeg ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      = residueDegreeComap hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : v.asIdeal.IsMaximal := v.isMaximal
  haveI : (maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)).IsMaximal := maximalIdeal.isMaximal _
  rw [Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq_of_isMaximal (maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)) v.asIdeal,
    residueDegreeComap]
  refine Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv
    (ResidueField.mapEquiv (placeComapEquivPlaceBelow hφF hφint v)).symm
    ((IsLocalization.AtPrime.equivQuotMaximalIdeal v.asIdeal
        ↥(HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime W.FunctionField v)).trans
      (ResidueField.mapEquiv (valuationSubringAtPrimeEquivPlace hφF v))) ?_
  refine Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext (RingHom.ext fun a => ?_)
  change residue _ _ = residue _ _
  refine congrArg (residue _) (Subtype.ext ?_)
  rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, coe_placeHomComap]
  have key : φ (((placeComapEquivPlaceBelow hφF hφint v).symm a :
      ↥(placeOf W (comapProjPoint hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v))))
      : W.FunctionField) = ((a : ↥φ.fieldRange) : W.FunctionField) := by
    change φ (φ.rangeRestrictFieldEquiv.symm (a : ↥φ.fieldRange)) = _
    rw [← RingHom.rangeRestrictFieldEquiv_apply_coe, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact key.trans rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.sum_toNat_ramificationIdx_mul_residueDegreeComap_fibre
statement:
theorem sum_toNat_ramificationIdx_mul_residueDegreeComap_fibre :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPoint_preimage_singleton hφF hφint q).toFinset,
        (ramificationIdx hφF hφint p).toNat * residueDegreeComap hφF hφint p
      = finrank ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite ↥((maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)).primesOver
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)) :=
    finite_primesOver_maximalIdeal_placeBelow hφF hφint
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite ↥((maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)).primesOver
    ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField))
  rw [← sum_ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg_placeBelow (φ := φ) (q := q), ← Finset.sum_coe_sort]
  refine Eq.symm (Fintype.sum_equiv ((primesOverEquivFibre hφF hφint).trans
    (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun x => (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).symm)) _ _ fun P => ?_)
  haveI : (heightOneOfPrimesOver P).asIdeal.LiesOver (maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)) := P.2.2
  change (heightOneOfPrimesOver P).asIdeal.ramificationIdx ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      * (heightOneOfPrimesOver P).asIdeal.inertiaDeg ↥(placeBelow φ q) = _
  rw [ideal_inertiaDeg_eq_residueDegreeComap hφF hφint (heightOneOfPrimesOver P),
    ideal_ramificationIdx_eq_toNat hφF hφint (heightOneOfPrimesOver P)]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.residueDegreeProj_projPointOfPoint
statement:
theorem CoordinateRing.residueDegreeProj_projPointOfPoint (S : W.Point) :
    residueDegreeProj W (projPointOfPoint W S) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← degProjPt_eq_residueDegreeProj]
  cases S with
  | zero => exact degProjPt_none
  | some x y h => exact degPt_pointClosedPoint h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.residueDegreeTwo_projPointOfPoint
statement:
theorem residueDegreeTwo_projPointOfPoint (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (S : W.Point) :
    residueDegreeTwo h2 (projPointOfPoint W S) = 1
proof:
:=
  residueDegreeTwo_eq_one_of_residueDegreeProj_eq_one h2 (residueDegreeProj_projPointOfPoint S)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_residueDegreeTwo_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_residueDegreeTwo_of_isSeparable (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).fieldRange W.FunctionField)
    (q : ProjPoint W) :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 q).toFinset,
      (ramificationIdxTwo h2 p).toNat * residueDegreeTwo h2 p = 4
proof:
:= by
  haveI := module_finite_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange (W := W) h2
  haveI := hsep
  rw [show (4 : ℕ) = finrank ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q) W.FunctionField) from
    (finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo h2 hsep q).symm]
  exact sum_toNat_ramificationIdx_mul_residueDegreeComap_fibre
    (mulByTwoEndo_algebraMap_base h2) (mulByTwoEndo_isIntegralElem h2)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_residueDegreeTwo_of_charZero
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_residueDegreeTwo_of_charZero [CharZero F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (q : ProjPoint W) :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 q).toFinset,
      (ramificationIdxTwo h2 p).toNat * residueDegreeTwo h2 p = 4
proof:
:=
  sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_residueDegreeTwo_of_isSeparable h2
    (isSeparable_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange h2) q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_residueDegreeTwo_eq_sum_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_residueDegreeTwo_eq_sum_of_isAlgClosed [IsAlgClosed F]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (q : ProjPoint W) :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 q).toFinset,
        (ramificationIdxTwo h2 p).toNat * residueDegreeTwo h2 p
      = ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 q).toFinset,
        (ramificationIdxTwo h2 p).toNat
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  rw [residueDegreeTwo_eq_one_of_residueDegreeProj_eq_one h2 (residueDegreeProj_eq_one p), mul_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.sum_ramificationIdxThree_mul_residueDegreeThree_of_isSeparable
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdxThree_mul_residueDegreeThree_of_isSeparable (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable ↥(mulByThreeEndo (W := W) h2 h3).fieldRange W.FunctionField)
    (q : ProjPoint W) :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointThree_preimage_singleton h2 h3 q).toFinset,
      (ramificationIdxThree h2 h3 p).toNat * residueDegreeThree h2 h3 p = 9
proof:
:= by
  haveI := module_finite_mulByThreeEndoFieldRange (W := W) h2 h3
  haveI := hsep
  rw [show (9 : ℕ) = finrank ↥(placeBelowThree W h2 h3 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowThree W h2 h3 q) W.FunctionField) from
    (finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowThree h2 h3 hsep q).symm]
  exact sum_toNat_ramificationIdx_mul_residueDegreeComap_fibre
    (mulByThreeEndo_algebraMap_base h2 h3) (mulByThreeEndo_isIntegralElem h2 h3)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_one_of_mul
statement:
private lemma map_one_of_mul (hφ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → φ (x * y) = φ x + φ y) :
    φ 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hφ 1 1 one_ne_zero one_ne_zero
  rw [one_mul] at h
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_inv_of_mul
statement:
private lemma map_inv_of_mul (hφ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → φ (x * y) = φ x + φ y)
    {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) : φ x⁻¹ = -φ x
proof:
:= by
  have h := hφ x x⁻¹ hx (inv_ne_zero hx)
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hx, map_one_of_mul hφ] at h
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_zpow_of_mul
statement:
private lemma map_zpow_of_mul (hφ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → φ (x * y) = φ x + φ y)
    {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) : φ (x ^ n) = n * φ x
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using map_one_of_mul hφ
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [zpow_add_one₀ hx, hφ _ _ (zpow_ne_zero _ hx) hx, ih]
      ring
  | pred k ih =>
      rw [zpow_sub_one₀ hx, hφ _ _ (zpow_ne_zero _ hx) (inv_ne_zero hx),
        map_inv_of_mul hφ hx, ih]
      ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eq_mul_of_zero_imp_zero
statement:
private lemma eq_mul_of_zero_imp_zero
    (hφ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → φ (x * y) = φ x + φ y)
    (hψ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → ψ (x * y) = ψ x + ψ y)
    (hzero : ∀ y : K, y ≠ 0 → φ y = 0 → ψ y = 0)
    {π : K} (hπ0 : π ≠ 0) (hπ : φ π = 1) {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) : ψ x = ψ π * φ x
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : π ^ (-φ x) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0
  have h0 : φ (x * π ^ (-φ x)) = 0 := by
    rw [hφ _ _ hx hz0, map_zpow_of_mul hφ hπ0, hπ]
    ring
  have h := hzero _ (mul_ne_zero hx hz0) h0
  rw [hψ _ _ hx hz0, map_zpow_of_mul hψ hπ0] at h
  linear_combination h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eq_of_nonneg_iff_of_exists_eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_of_nonneg_iff_of_exists_eq_one
    (hφ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → φ (x * y) = φ x + φ y)
    (hψ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → ψ (x * y) = ψ x + ψ y)
    (hiff : ∀ x : K, x ≠ 0 → (0 ≤ φ x ↔ 0 ≤ ψ x))
    (hφ1 : ∃ x : K, x ≠ 0 ∧ φ x = 1) (hψ1 : ∃ x : K, x ≠ 0 ∧ ψ x = 1)
    {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) : φ x = ψ x
proof:
:= by
  
  have hzero : ∀ y : K, y ≠ 0 → φ y = 0 → ψ y = 0 := by
    intro y hy h
    have h1 : 0 ≤ ψ y := (hiff y hy).1 h.ge
    have h2 : 0 ≤ ψ y⁻¹ := (hiff y⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hy)).1 (by rw [map_inv_of_mul hφ hy, h, neg_zero])
    rw [map_inv_of_mul hψ hy] at h2
    omega
  obtain ⟨πφ, hπφ0, hπφ⟩ := hφ1
  obtain ⟨πψ, hπψ0, hπψ⟩ := hψ1
  
  
  have hc : ∀ y : K, y ≠ 0 → ψ y = ψ πφ * φ y :=
    fun y hy => eq_mul_of_zero_imp_zero hφ hψ hzero hπφ0 hπφ hy
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ ψ πφ := (hiff πφ hπφ0).1 (by rw [hπφ]; norm_num)
  have hunit : ψ πφ * φ πψ = 1 := by
    have := hc πψ hπψ0
    rw [hπψ] at this
    omega
  have hc1 : ψ πφ = 1 := by
    have hdvd : ψ πφ ∣ 1 := ⟨φ πψ, hunit.symm⟩
    have hle := Int.le_of_dvd one_pos hdvd
    have hne : ψ πφ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, zero_mul] at hunit
      exact absurd hunit (by norm_num)
    omega
  rw [hc x hx, hc1, one_mul]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_valuationSubringAtPrime_iff_ord_nonneg
statement:
theorem mem_valuationSubringAtPrime_iff_ord_nonneg
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    f ∈ HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime W.FunctionField v ↔ 0 ≤ ord v f
proof:
:= by
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring,
    Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff, valuation_eq_exp_neg_ord v hf, ← WithZero.exp_zero,
    WithZero.exp_le_exp, neg_nonpos]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg
statement:
theorem mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg (p : ProjPoint W) {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    f ∈ placeOf W p ↔ 0 ≤ divisorProj W f p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | none => rw [placeOf_none, mem_ordInftyValuationSubring, divisorProj_apply_none]
  | some v => rw [placeOf_some, divisorProj_apply_some,
      mem_valuationSubringAtPrime_iff_ord_nonneg v hf]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_divisorProj_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_divisorProj_eq_one (p : ProjPoint W) :
    ∃ π : W.FunctionField, π ≠ 0 ∧ divisorProj W π p = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | none =>
      obtain ⟨π, hπ0, hπ⟩ := ordInfty_surjective (W := W) 1
      exact ⟨π, hπ0, by rw [divisorProj_apply_none, hπ]⟩
  | some v =>
      obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := v.valuation_exists_uniformizer W.FunctionField
      have hπ0 : π ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        rw [h, map_zero] at hπ
        exact WithZero.exp_ne_zero hπ.symm
      refine ⟨π, hπ0, ?_⟩
      rw [divisorProj_apply_some, ord_eq_neg_log_valuation v hπ0, hπ, WithZero.log_exp, neg_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algEquiv_ne_zero
statement: private lemma algEquiv_ne_zero {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) : σ f ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (map_ne_zero_iff σ σ.injective).2 hf

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_algEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem divisorProj_algEquiv_apply {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (p : ProjPoint W) :
    divisorProj W (σ f) (mapProjPoint W σ p) = divisorProj W f p
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_nonneg_iff_of_exists_eq_one
    (φ := fun g => divisorProj W (σ g) (mapProjPoint W σ p)) (ψ := fun g => divisorProj W g p)
    (fun x y hx hy => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_) (fun x hx => ?_) ?_ ?_ hf
  · rw [map_mul, divisorProj_mul (algEquiv_ne_zero σ hx) (algEquiv_ne_zero σ hy), Finsupp.add_apply]
  · rw [divisorProj_mul hx hy, Finsupp.add_apply]
  · rw [← mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg _ (algEquiv_ne_zero σ hx),
      ← mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg _ hx, mem_placeOf_mapProjPoint,
      AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  · obtain ⟨π, hπ0, hπ⟩ := exists_divisorProj_eq_one (mapProjPoint W σ p)
    exact ⟨σ.symm π, (map_ne_zero_iff σ.symm σ.symm.injective).2 hπ0, by
      rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hπ]⟩
  · exact exists_divisorProj_eq_one p

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_algEquiv
statement:
theorem divisorProj_algEquiv {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W (σ f) = (divisorProj W f).mapDomain (mapProjPoint W σ)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := (mapProjPoint W σ).surjective q
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_apply (mapProjPoint W σ).injective, divisorProj_algEquiv_apply σ hf p]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_translateEndo
statement:
theorem divisorProj_translateEndo (h₂ : W.Equation x₂ y₂) {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W (CoordinateRing.translateEndo h₂ f)
      = (divisorProj W f).mapDomain (mapProjPoint W (CoordinateRing.translateAlgEquiv h₂))
proof:
:= by
  have h := divisorProj_algEquiv (CoordinateRing.translateAlgEquiv h₂) hf
  rwa [CoordinateRing.translateAlgEquiv_apply] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeBelow_injective
statement: theorem placeBelow_injective : Function.Injective (placeBelow (W := W) φ)
proof:

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.comapProjPoint_eq_iff_placeBelow_eq

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_placeBelow_of_coe_eq_algebraMap

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeBelow_le_comap_valuationSubringAtPrime
statement:
theorem placeBelow_le_comap_valuationSubringAtPrime :
    placeBelow φ q ≤ (HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime W.FunctionField v).comap
      (φ.fieldRange.subtype : ↥φ.fieldRange →+* W.FunctionField)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_comap]
  have h := HeightOneSpectrum.algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime (K := W.FunctionField) v
    (algebraMap ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) ⟨y, hy⟩)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_mem_asIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_asIdeal_iff (a : ↥(placeBelow φ q)) :
    algebraMap ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) a
        ∈ v.asIdeal
      ↔ ((a : ↥φ.fieldRange) : W.FunctionField)
          ∈ (HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime W.FunctionField v).nonunits
proof:
:= by
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.mem_asIdeal_iff_mem_nonunits (K := W.FunctionField),
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.under_asIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem under_asIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal_iff :
    Ideal.under ↥(placeBelow φ q) v.asIdeal = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      ↔ (HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime W.FunctionField v).comap
          (φ.fieldRange.subtype : ↥φ.fieldRange →+* W.FunctionField) = placeBelow φ q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hlies
    refine le_antisymm (fun y hy => ?_) (placeBelow_le_comap_valuationSubringAtPrime v)
    rw [ValuationSubring.mem_comap] at hy
    by_contra hyA
    have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := fun h => hyA (h ▸ zero_mem _)
    obtain hinv | hinv := (placeBelow φ q).mem_or_inv_mem y
    · exact hyA hinv
    · have hmax : (⟨y⁻¹, hinv⟩ : ↥(placeBelow φ q)) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := by
        rw [← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff, ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or]
        exact Or.inr (by rwa [inv_inv])
      rw [← hlies, Ideal.mem_under, algebraMap_mem_asIdeal_iff,
        ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or] at hmax
      rcases hmax with h | h
      · exact hy0 (by simpa using h)
      · exact h (by rwa [Subfield.coe_inv, inv_inv])
  · intro hcomp
    have hmem : ∀ z : ↥φ.fieldRange, z ∈ placeBelow φ q
        ↔ (z : W.FunctionField)
          ∈ HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime W.FunctionField v :=
      fun z => (SetLike.ext_iff.1 hcomp z).symm
    refine Ideal.ext fun a => ?_
    rw [Ideal.mem_under, algebraMap_mem_asIdeal_iff, ← ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff,
      ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or, ValuationSubring.mem_nonunits_iff_or]
    have hz : ((a : ↥φ.fieldRange) : W.FunctionField) = 0 ↔ (a : ↥φ.fieldRange) = 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl
    have hi : ((a : ↥φ.fieldRange) : W.FunctionField)⁻¹
        ∈ HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime W.FunctionField v
        ↔ (a : ↥φ.fieldRange)⁻¹ ∈ placeBelow φ q := by
      rw [hmem, Subfield.coe_inv]
    rw [hz, hi]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.comapProjPoint_projPointOfHeightOne_eq_iff
statement:
theorem comapProjPoint_projPointOfHeightOne_eq_iff :
    comapProjPoint hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v) = q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_projPointOfHeightOne_eq
statement:
theorem exists_projPointOfHeightOne_eq {p : ProjPoint W} (hp : comapProjPoint hφF hφint p = q) :
    ∃ v, projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := IsDedekindDomain.exists_valuationSubringAtPrime_eq (placeOf W p)
    (fun b : ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) =>
      mem_placeOf_of_mem_integralClosure hφF hφint hp b.2) (placeOf_ne_top p)
  exact ⟨v, placeOf_injective (by rw [placeOf_projPointOfHeightOne hφF v, hv])⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_fibre_comapProjPoint
statement:
theorem nonempty_fibre_comapProjPoint :
    (comapProjPoint hφF hφint ⁻¹' {q}).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isIntegral_algebra ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField
  haveI : FaithfulSMul ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).2 fun x y h => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (by
      have hx := IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ↥(placeBelow φ q)
        ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) W.FunctionField x
      have hy := IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ↥(placeBelow φ q)
        ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) W.FunctionField y
      change algebraMap ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField x
        = algebraMap ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField y
      rw [hx, hy, h]))
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty ↥((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)).primesOver
    ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)))
  exact ⟨_, (primesOverEquivFibre hφF hφint P).2⟩

    (finite_comapProjPoint_preimage_singleton hφF hφint q).to_subtype
