name: ValuationSubring.mem_of_isIntegralElem
statement:
theorem mem_of_isIntegralElem {K R : Type*} [Field K] [CommRing R] (A : ValuationSubring K)
    (f : R →+* K) (hf : ∀ r, f r ∈ A) {x : K} (hx : f.IsIntegralElem x) : x ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : A.subtype.comp (f.codRestrict A.toSubring hf) = f := rfl
  obtain ⟨p, hpm, hpe⟩ := hx
  have hint : IsIntegral A x := by
    refine ⟨p.map (f.codRestrict A.toSubring hf), hpm.map _, ?_⟩
    rw [eval₂_map]
    change eval₂ (A.subtype.comp (f.codRestrict A.toSubring hf)) x p = 0
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hpe
  have hI : Valuation.Integers A.valuation A := by
    have h := Valuation.valuationSubring.integers A.valuation
    rwa [A.valuationSubring_valuation] at h
  have h := hI.mem_of_integral hint
  rwa [A.integer_valuation] at h

name: RingHom.isIntegralElem_of_isIntegral_range
statement:
theorem isIntegralElem_of_isIntegral_range {K : Type*} [Field K] (f : K →+* K) {z : K}
    (hz : _root_.IsIntegral ↥f.range z) : f.IsIntegralElem z
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective f.rangeRestrict :=
    fun _ _ hab => f.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
  let e : K ≃+* ↥f.range :=
    RingEquiv.ofBijective f.rangeRestrict ⟨hinj, f.rangeRestrict_surjective⟩
  have hce : f.comp (e.symm : ↥f.range →+* K) = f.range.subtype :=
    RingHom.ext fun a => congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply a)
  obtain ⟨p, hpm, hpe⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨p.map (e.symm : ↥f.range →+* K), hpm.map _, ?_⟩
  rw [eval₂_map, hce]
  exact hpe

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_one_of_mul'
statement:
private lemma map_one_of_mul' (hφ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → φ (x * y) = φ x + φ y) :
    φ 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hφ 1 1 one_ne_zero one_ne_zero
  rw [one_mul] at h
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_inv_of_mul'
statement:
private lemma map_inv_of_mul' (hφ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → φ (x * y) = φ x + φ y)
    {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) : φ x⁻¹ = -φ x
proof:
:= by
  have h := hφ x x⁻¹ hx (inv_ne_zero hx)
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hx, map_one_of_mul' hφ] at h
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_zpow_of_mul'
statement:
private lemma map_zpow_of_mul' (hφ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → φ (x * y) = φ x + φ y)
    {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) : φ (x ^ n) = n * φ x
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simpa using map_one_of_mul' hφ
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [zpow_add_one₀ hx, hφ _ _ (zpow_ne_zero _ hx) hx, ih]
      ring
  | pred k ih =>
      rw [zpow_sub_one₀ hx, hφ _ _ (zpow_ne_zero _ hx) (inv_ne_zero hx),
        map_inv_of_mul' hφ hx, ih]
      ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_pos_forall_eq_mul_of_nonneg_iff
statement:
theorem exists_pos_forall_eq_mul_of_nonneg_iff
    (hφ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → φ (x * y) = φ x + φ y)
    (hψ : ∀ x y : K, x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 → ψ (x * y) = ψ x + ψ y)
    (hiff : ∀ x : K, x ≠ 0 → (0 ≤ φ x ↔ 0 ≤ ψ x))
    (hψ1 : ∃ x : K, x ≠ 0 ∧ ψ x = 1) (hφ0 : ∃ x : K, x ≠ 0 ∧ φ x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ e : ℤ, 0 < e ∧ ∀ x : K, x ≠ 0 → φ x = e * ψ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ0, hπ⟩ := hψ1
  
  have hzero : ∀ y : K, y ≠ 0 → ψ y = 0 → φ y = 0 := by
    intro y hy h
    have h1 : 0 ≤ φ y := (hiff y hy).2 h.ge
    have h2 : 0 ≤ φ y⁻¹ :=
      (hiff y⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hy)).2 (by rw [map_inv_of_mul' hψ hy, h, neg_zero])
    rw [map_inv_of_mul' hφ hy] at h2
    omega
  
  have key : ∀ x : K, x ≠ 0 → φ x = φ π * ψ x := by
    intro x hx
    have hz0 : π ^ (-ψ x) ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero _ hπ0
    have h0 : ψ (x * π ^ (-ψ x)) = 0 := by
      rw [hψ _ _ hx hz0, map_zpow_of_mul' hψ hπ0, hπ]
      ring
    have h := hzero _ (mul_ne_zero hx hz0) h0
    rw [hφ _ _ hx hz0, map_zpow_of_mul' hφ hπ0] at h
    linear_combination h
  refine ⟨φ π, ?_, key⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxne⟩ := hφ0
  rcases ((hiff π hπ0).2 (by rw [hπ]; norm_num)).lt_or_eq with h | h
  · exact h
  · exact absurd (by rw [key x hx, ← h, zero_mul]) hxne

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_mem_comap_of_algebraMap_eq
statement:

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.comap_ne_top_of_isIntegralElem
statement:

    (placeOf W p).comap φ ≠ ⊤
proof:

  intro h
  refine placeOf_ne_top p (SetLike.ext fun z => iff_of_true ?_ (ValuationSubring.mem_top z))
  exact (placeOf W p).mem_of_isIntegralElem φ
    (fun r => (h ▸ ValuationSubring.mem_top r : r ∈ (placeOf W p).comap φ)) (hφint z)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOf_comapProjPoint
statement:
@[simp] lemma placeOf_comapProjPoint (p : ProjPoint W) :
    placeOf W (comapProjPoint hφF hφint p) = (placeOf W p).comap φ
proof:
:=
  (exists_placeOf_eq ((placeOf W p).comap φ) (algebraMap_mem_comap_of_algebraMap_eq hφF p)
    (comap_ne_top_of_isIntegralElem hφint p)).choose_spec

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_placeOf_comapProjPoint

lemma mem_placeOf_comapProjPoint (p : ProjPoint W) (g : W.FunctionField) :

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.comapProjPoint_eq_iff
statement:
theorem comapProjPoint_eq_iff {p q : ProjPoint W} :
    comapProjPoint hφF hφint p = q ↔ placeOf W q = (placeOf W p).comap φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ placeOf_comapProjPoint hφF hφint p,
    fun h => placeOf_injective ((placeOf_comapProjPoint hφF hφint p).trans h.symm)⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.comapProjPoint_comp
statement:
theorem comapProjPoint_comp {ψ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField}
    (hψF : ∀ c : F, ψ (algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c)
    (hψint : ∀ z : W.FunctionField, ψ.IsIntegralElem z)
    (hcF : ∀ c : F, (φ.comp ψ) (algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c)
    (hcint : ∀ z : W.FunctionField, (φ.comp ψ).IsIntegralElem z) (p : ProjPoint W) :
    comapProjPoint hcF hcint p = comapProjPoint hψF hψint (comapProjPoint hφF hφint p)
proof:
:= by
  refine placeOf_injective ?_
  rw [placeOf_comapProjPoint, placeOf_comapProjPoint, placeOf_comapProjPoint,
    ValuationSubring.comap_comap]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ringHom_ne_zero
statement: private lemma ringHom_ne_zero {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) : φ f ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h => hf (φ.injective (by rw [h, map_zero]))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_ramificationIdx
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_pos_forall_eq_mul_of_nonneg_iff
    (φ := fun g => divisorProj W (φ g) p)
    (ψ := fun g => divisorProj W g (comapProjPoint hφF hφint p))
    (fun x y hx hy => ?_) (fun x y hx hy => ?_) (fun x hx => ?_) ?_ ?_
  · rw [map_mul, divisorProj_mul (ringHom_ne_zero hx) (ringHom_ne_zero hy), Finsupp.add_apply]
  · rw [divisorProj_mul hx hy, Finsupp.add_apply]
  · rw [← mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg _ (ringHom_ne_zero hx),
      ← mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg _ hx, mem_placeOf_comapProjPoint]
  · exact exists_divisorProj_eq_one (comapProjPoint hφF hφint p)
  · 
    have hex : ∃ z : W.FunctionField, φ z ∉ placeOf W p := by
      by_contra h
      exact comap_ne_top_of_isIntegralElem hφint p
        (SetLike.ext fun z => iff_of_true (not_not.mp fun hz => h ⟨z, hz⟩)
          (ValuationSubring.mem_top z))
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hex
    have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := fun h => hz (by rw [h, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _)
    refine ⟨z, hz0, fun h => hz ?_⟩
    rw [mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg _ (ringHom_ne_zero hz0), h]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ramificationIdx_pos
statement: theorem ramificationIdx_pos (p : ProjPoint W) : 0 < ramificationIdx hφF hφint p
proof:
:=
  (exists_ramificationIdx hφF hφint p).choose_spec.1

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_comp_apply
statement:
theorem divisorProj_comp_apply {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (p : ProjPoint W) :
    divisorProj W (φ f) p
      = ramificationIdx hφF hφint p * divisorProj W f (comapProjPoint hφF hφint p)
proof:
:=
  (exists_ramificationIdx hφF hφint p).choose_spec.2 f hf

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.dvd_divisorProj_comp
statement:
theorem dvd_divisorProj_comp {n : ℤ} {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hn : ∀ q : ProjPoint W, n ∣ divisorProj W f q) (p : ProjPoint W) :
    n ∣ divisorProj W (φ f) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisorProj_comp_apply hφF hφint hf p]
  exact Dvd.dvd.mul_left (hn _) _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isIntegralElem_algEquiv
statement:
lemma isIntegralElem_algEquiv (z : W.FunctionField) :
    (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField).IsIntegralElem z
proof:
:=
  ⟨X - C (σ.symm z), monic_X_sub_C _, by simp⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.comapProjPoint_algEquiv
statement:
theorem comapProjPoint_algEquiv (p : ProjPoint W) :
    comapProjPoint (φ := (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)) σ.commutes
        (isIntegralElem_algEquiv σ) p = (mapProjPoint W σ).symm p
proof:
:= by
  refine placeOf_injective ?_
  rw [placeOf_comapProjPoint]
  have h : placeOf W (mapProjPoint W σ.symm p)
      = (placeOf W p).comap ((σ.symm.symm : W.FunctionField ≃ₐ[F] W.FunctionField) :
        W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField) := placeOf_mapProjPoint σ.symm p
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_symm] at h
  exact h.symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ramificationIdx_algEquiv
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx_algEquiv (p : ProjPoint W) :
    ramificationIdx (φ := (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)) σ.commutes
      (isIntegralElem_algEquiv σ) p = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ0, hπ⟩ := exists_divisorProj_eq_one ((mapProjPoint W σ).symm p)
  have h1 := divisorProj_comp_apply (φ := (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)) σ.commutes
    (isIntegralElem_algEquiv σ) hπ0 p
  rw [comapProjPoint_algEquiv σ p, hπ, mul_one] at h1
  have h2 := divisorProj_algEquiv_apply σ hπ0 ((mapProjPoint W σ).symm p)
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, hπ] at h2
  exact h1.symm.trans h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.mulByTwoEndo_isIntegralElem
statement:
theorem mulByTwoEndo_isIntegralElem (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (z : W.FunctionField) :
    (mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).IsIntegralElem z
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).range W.FunctionField :=
    module_finite_mulByTwoRange h2
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral ↥(mulByTwoEndo (W := W) h2).range W.FunctionField :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite _ _
  exact RingHom.isIntegralElem_of_isIntegral_range _ (Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral z)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ramificationIdxTwo_pos
statement:
theorem ramificationIdxTwo_pos (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (p : ProjPoint W) :
    0 < ramificationIdxTwo h2 p
proof:
:=
  ramificationIdx_pos _ _ p

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisorProj_mulByTwoEndo_apply
statement:
theorem divisorProj_mulByTwoEndo_apply (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (p : ProjPoint W) :
    divisorProj W (mulByTwoEndo h2 f) p
      = ramificationIdxTwo h2 p * divisorProj W f (comapProjPointTwo h2 p)
proof:
:=
  divisorProj_comp_apply _ _ hf p

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.dvd_divisorProj_mulByTwoEndo
statement:
theorem dvd_divisorProj_mulByTwoEndo (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℤ} {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hn : ∀ q : ProjPoint W, n ∣ divisorProj W f q) (p : ProjPoint W) :
    n ∣ divisorProj W (mulByTwoEndo h2 f) p
proof:
:=
  dvd_divisorProj_comp (mulByTwoEndo_algebraMap_base h2) (mulByTwoEndo_isIntegralElem h2) hf hn p

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.dvd_divisorProj_mulByTwoEndo_of_torsion
statement:
theorem dvd_divisorProj_mulByTwoEndo_of_torsion [DecidableEq F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x y : F}
    (h : W.Nonsingular x y) {n : ℕ} (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisorProj W f = Finsupp.single (some (pointClosedPoint h.left)) (n : ℤ)
        - Finsupp.single none (n : ℤ) ∧
      ∀ p : ProjPoint W, (n : ℤ) ∣ divisorProj W (mulByTwoEndo h2 f) p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hdiv⟩ := divisorProj_eq_single_sub_single_of_torsion h hP
  refine ⟨f, hf, hdiv, dvd_divisorProj_mulByTwoEndo h2 hf fun q => ?_⟩
  rw [hdiv, Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  exact dvd_sub (by split <;> simp) (by split <;> simp)

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.mem_valuationSubringAtPrime_iff_count_nonneg
statement:
theorem mem_valuationSubringAtPrime_iff_count_nonneg {f : K} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    f ∈ valuationSubringAtPrime K v ↔ 0 ≤ count K v (spanSingleton R⁰ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [valuationSubringAtPrime_eq_valuationSubring, Valuation.mem_valuationSubring_iff,
    valuation_eq_exp_neg_count v hf, ← WithZero.exp_zero, WithZero.exp_le_exp, neg_nonpos]

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.count_spanSingleton_mul
statement:
theorem count_spanSingleton_mul {f g : K} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    count K v (spanSingleton R⁰ (f * g))
      = count K v (spanSingleton R⁰ f) + count K v (spanSingleton R⁰ g)
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : spanSingleton R⁰ f ≠ 0 := by rwa [ne_eq, spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff]
  have hg' : spanSingleton R⁰ g ≠ 0 := by rwa [ne_eq, spanSingleton_eq_zero_iff]
  rw [← spanSingleton_mul_spanSingleton, count_mul _ _ hf' hg']

name: IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.exists_count_spanSingleton_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_count_spanSingleton_eq_one :
    ∃ π : K, π ≠ 0 ∧ count K v (spanSingleton R⁰ π) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ⟩ := valuation_exists_uniformizer K v
  have h0 : π ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, map_zero] at hπ
    exact WithZero.exp_ne_zero hπ.symm
  exact ⟨π, h0, by rw [count_eq_neg_log_valuation v h0, hπ, WithZero.log_exp, neg_neg]⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_uniformizer_placeBelow
statement:
theorem exists_uniformizer_placeBelow (q : ProjPoint W) :
    ∃ πA : ↥(placeBelow φ q), IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q) = Ideal.span {πA} ∧
      ∃ π₀ : W.FunctionField, π₀ ≠ 0 ∧ divisorProj W π₀ q = 1 ∧
        ((πA : ↥φ.fieldRange) : W.FunctionField) = φ π₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π₀, hπ₀0, hπ₀⟩ := exists_divisorProj_eq_one (W := W) q
  have hmem : π₀ ∈ placeOf W q :=
    (mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg q hπ₀0).2 (by rw [hπ₀]; norm_num)
  refine ⟨placeBelowEquiv φ q ⟨π₀, hmem⟩, ?_, π₀, hπ₀0, hπ₀, ?_⟩
  · refine (IsDiscreteValuationRing.irreducible_iff_uniformizer _).1 ?_
    change Irreducible ((placeBelowEquiv φ q).toMulEquiv ⟨π₀, hmem⟩)
    rw [MulEquiv.irreducible_iff]
    exact (irreducible_placeOf_iff ⟨π₀, hmem⟩).2 hπ₀
  · rw [coe_placeBelowEquiv, RingHom.rangeRestrictFieldEquiv_apply_coe]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.count_eq_divisorProj
statement:
theorem count_eq_divisorProj {g : W.FunctionField} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    count W.FunctionField v
        (spanSingleton (integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)⁰ g)
      = divisorProj W g (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_nonneg_iff_of_exists_eq_one
    (φ := fun x => count W.FunctionField v
      (spanSingleton (integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)⁰ x))
    (ψ := fun x => divisorProj W x (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v))
    (fun x y hx hy => count_spanSingleton_mul v hx hy)
    (fun x y hx hy => by rw [divisorProj_mul hx hy, Finsupp.add_apply])
    (fun x hx => ?_) (exists_count_spanSingleton_eq_one v) (exists_divisorProj_eq_one _) hg
  rw [← mem_valuationSubringAtPrime_iff_count_nonneg v hx,
    ← mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg _ hx, placeOf_projPointOfHeightOne hφF v]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_maximalIdeal_le_pow_iff
statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_le_pow_iff
    (hp : comapProjPoint hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v) = q) (n : ℕ) :
    Ideal.map (algebraMap ↥(placeBelow φ q)
        ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField))
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)) ≤ v.asIdeal ^ n
      ↔ (n : ℤ) ≤ ramificationIdx hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨πA, hspan, π₀, h00, h01, hcoe⟩ := exists_uniformizer_placeBelow (φ := φ) q
  have hne : ((πA : ↥φ.fieldRange) : W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hcoe]
    exact fun h => h00 (φ.injective (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  have hord : divisorProj W ((πA : ↥φ.fieldRange) : W.FunctionField)
      (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)
      = ramificationIdx hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v) := by
    rw [hcoe, divisorProj_comp_apply hφF hφint h00 _, hp, h01, mul_one]
  rw [hspan, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem,
    ← intValuation_le_pow_iff_mem, ← valuation_of_algebraMap (K := W.FunctionField)]
  change valuation W.FunctionField v ((πA : ↥φ.fieldRange) : W.FunctionField)
    ≤ WithZero.exp (-(n : ℤ)) ↔ _
  rw [valuation_eq_exp_neg_count v hne, count_eq_divisorProj hφF v hne, hord,
    WithZero.exp_le_exp, neg_le_neg_iff]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ideal_ramificationIdx_eq_toNat
statement:
theorem ideal_ramificationIdx_eq_toNat
    [hlies : v.asIdeal.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q))] :
    v.asIdeal.ramificationIdx ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      = (ramificationIdx hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)).toNat
proof:
:= by
  have hp : comapProjPoint hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v) = q :=
    (comapProjPoint_projPointOfHeightOne_eq_iff hφF hφint v).2 hlies.over.symm
  have hpos := ramificationIdx_pos hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)
  rw [← Ideal.ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx _ _ (maximalIdeal_placeBelow_ne_bot q)]
  refine Ideal.ramificationIdx'_spec ?_ ?_
  · rw [map_maximalIdeal_le_pow_iff hφF hφint v hp]
    omega
  · rw [map_maximalIdeal_le_pow_iff hφF hφint v hp]
    push_cast
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_quotient_asIdeal_surjective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_quotient_asIdeal_surjective [IsAlgClosed F]
    [hlies : v.asIdeal.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q))] :
    Function.Surjective (algebraMap
      (↥(placeBelow φ q) ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q))
      (↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) ⧸ v.asIdeal))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : comapProjPoint hφF hφint (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v) = q :=
    (comapProjPoint_projPointOfHeightOne_eq_iff hφF hφint v).2 hlies.over.symm
  intro x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  have hb : (b : W.FunctionField) ∈ placeOf W (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v) :=
    mem_placeOf_of_mem_integralClosure hφF hφint hp b.2
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (algebraMap_residueFieldProj_bijective
    (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)).surjective
    (IsLocalRing.residue _ (⟨(b : W.FunctionField), hb⟩ :
      ↥(placeOf W (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v))))
  have hcA : (⟨algebraMap F W.FunctionField c, ⟨algebraMap F W.FunctionField c, hφF c⟩⟩ :
      ↥φ.fieldRange) ∈ placeBelow φ q :=
    mem_placeBelow_of_coe_eq_algebraMap hφF c _ rfl
  refine ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ⟨_, hcA⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_mk_of_liesOver]
  refine (Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem _ _).2 ?_
  rw [HeightOneSpectrum.mem_asIdeal_iff_mem_nonunits (K := W.FunctionField),
    ← placeOf_projPointOfHeightOne hφF v]
  have hmem : ((algebraMap F ↥(placeOf W (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)) c
        - ⟨(b : W.FunctionField), hb⟩ :
        ↥(placeOf W (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)))) ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ := by
    have h1 : algebraMap F (residueFieldProj W (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)) c
        = Ideal.Quotient.mk (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _)
          (algebraMap F ↥(placeOf W (projPointOfHeightOne φ hφF q v)) c) :=
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F _ _ c
    exact (Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk_iff_sub_mem _ _).1 (h1.symm.trans hc)
  exact ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff.2 hmem

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ideal_inertiaDeg_eq_one
statement:
theorem ideal_inertiaDeg_eq_one [IsAlgClosed F]
    [v.asIdeal.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q))] :
    v.asIdeal.inertiaDeg ↥(placeBelow φ q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : v.asIdeal.IsMaximal := v.isPrime.isMaximal v.ne_bot
  haveI : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)).IsMaximal :=
    IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _
  haveI : Nontrivial (↥(placeBelow φ q) ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.2 (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal _).ne_top
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap
      (↥(placeBelow φ q) ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q))
      (↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) ⧸ v.asIdeal)) :=
    ⟨(faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).1 inferInstance,
      algebraMap_quotient_asIdeal_surjective hφF hφint v⟩
  rw [Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq_of_isMaximal (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)) v.asIdeal,
    ← Module.finrank_self (↥(placeBelow φ q) ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q))]
  exact ((AlgEquiv.ofBijective (Algebra.ofId _ _) hbij).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq).symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.sum_ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg_placeBelow
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg_placeBelow
    [Fintype ↥((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)).primesOver
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField))] :
    ∑ P : ↥((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)).primesOver
        ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)),
        P.1.ramificationIdx ↥(placeBelow φ q) * P.1.inertiaDeg ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      = finrank ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) :=
    module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelow q
  haveI : Module.Flat ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField) :=
    module_flat_integralClosure_placeBelow q
  exact Ideal.sum_ramification_inertia_eq_finrank _ _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.sum_toNat_ramificationIdx_fibre
statement:
theorem sum_toNat_ramificationIdx_fibre [IsAlgClosed F] :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPoint_preimage_singleton hφF hφint q).toFinset,
        (ramificationIdx hφF hφint p).toNat
      = finrank ↥(placeBelow φ q) ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite ↥((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)).primesOver
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField)) :=
    finite_primesOver_maximalIdeal_placeBelow hφF hφint
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite ↥((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)).primesOver
    ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelow φ q) W.FunctionField))
  rw [← sum_ramificationIdx_mul_inertiaDeg_placeBelow (φ := φ) (q := q), ← Finset.sum_coe_sort]
  refine Eq.symm (Fintype.sum_equiv ((primesOverEquivFibre hφF hφint).trans
    (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun x => (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).symm)) _ _ fun P => ?_)
  haveI : (heightOneOfPrimesOver P).asIdeal.LiesOver
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ↥(placeBelow φ q)) := P.2.2
  change (heightOneOfPrimesOver P).asIdeal.ramificationIdx ↥(placeBelow φ q)
      * (heightOneOfPrimesOver P).asIdeal.inertiaDeg ↥(placeBelow φ q) = _
  rw [ideal_inertiaDeg_eq_one hφF hφint (heightOneOfPrimesOver P), mul_one,
    ideal_ramificationIdx_eq_toNat hφF hφint (heightOneOfPrimesOver P)]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.residueDegreeComap_none_eq_one
statement:
theorem residueDegreeComap_none_eq_one :
    residueDegreeComap hφF hφint (none : ProjPoint W) = 1
proof:
:=
  (residueDegreeComap_eq_one_of_residueDegreeProj_eq_one hφF hφint
    (residueDegreeProj_none_eq_one W)).2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.residueDegreeProj_comapProjPoint_none_eq_one
statement:
theorem residueDegreeProj_comapProjPoint_none_eq_one :
    residueDegreeProj W (comapProjPoint hφF hφint (none : ProjPoint W)) = 1
proof:
:=
  (residueDegreeComap_eq_one_of_residueDegreeProj_eq_one hφF hφint
    (residueDegreeProj_none_eq_one W)).1

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo_of_isAlgClosed :
    Module.Finite ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q) W.FunctionField)
proof:
:=
  module_finite_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo h2
    (isSeparable_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange_of_isAlgClosed h2) q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo_of_isAlgClosed

theorem finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo_of_isAlgClosed :
    finrank ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q) W.FunctionField) = 4
proof:
:=

    (isSeparable_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange_of_isAlgClosed h2) q

:=

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.finite_primesOver_maximalIdeal_placeBelowTwo_of_isAlgClosed

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.sum_ramificationIdxTwo_eq_four
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdxTwo_eq_four :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 q).toFinset,
      (ramificationIdxTwo h2 p).toNat = 4
proof:
:= by
  haveI := module_finite_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange (W := W) h2
  haveI := isSeparable_mulByTwoEndoFieldRange_of_isAlgClosed (W := W) h2
  rw [show (4 : ℕ) = finrank ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q)
      ↥(integralClosure ↥(placeBelowTwo W h2 q) W.FunctionField) from
    (finrank_integralClosure_placeBelowTwo_of_isAlgClosed h2 q).symm]
  exact sum_toNat_ramificationIdx_fibre (mulByTwoEndo_algebraMap_base h2)
    (mulByTwoEndo_isIntegralElem h2)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_residueDegreeTwo
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdxTwo_mul_residueDegreeTwo :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 q).toFinset,
      (ramificationIdxTwo h2 p).toNat * residueDegreeTwo h2 p = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_ramificationIdxTwo_eq_four h2 q]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  rw [residueDegreeTwo_eq_one_of_residueDegreeProj_eq_one h2 (residueDegreeProj_eq_one p), mul_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.card_fibre_comapProjPointTwo_le_four
statement:
theorem card_fibre_comapProjPointTwo_le_four :
    (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 q).toFinset.card ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, ← sum_ramificationIdxTwo_eq_four h2 q]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => by have := ramificationIdxTwo_pos h2 p; omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.sum_ramificationIdxTwo_erase_none_eq_three
statement:
theorem sum_ramificationIdxTwo_erase_none_eq_three :
    ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 (none : ProjPoint W)).toFinset.erase
      none, (ramificationIdxTwo h2 p).toNat = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (none : ProjPoint W)
      ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2 (none : ProjPoint W)).toFinset :=
    (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).2 (comapProjPointTwo_none h2)
  have hone : (ramificationIdxTwo h2 (none : ProjPoint W)).toNat = 1 := by
    rw [ramificationIdxTwo_none h2]
    rfl
  have hsum : 1 + ∑ p ∈ (finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton h2
      (none : ProjPoint W)).toFinset.erase none, (ramificationIdxTwo h2 p).toNat = 4 := by
    rw [← hone, Finset.add_sum_erase _ (fun p => (ramificationIdxTwo h2 p).toNat) hmem]
    exact sum_ramificationIdxTwo_eq_four h2 none
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.residueDegreeComap_congr

theorem residueDegreeComap_congr {ψ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField}
    (hψF : ∀ c : F, ψ (algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c)
    (hψint : ∀ z : W.FunctionField, ψ.IsIntegralElem z) (h : φ = ψ) (p : ProjPoint W) :
    residueDegreeComap hφF hφint p = residueDegreeComap hψF hψint p

  subst h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.residueDegreeComap_eq_one_iff_surjective
statement:
theorem residueDegreeComap_eq_one_iff_surjective (p : ProjPoint W) :
    residueDegreeComap hφF hφint p = 1 ↔ Function.Surjective
      (algebraMap (residueFieldProj W (comapProjPoint hφF hφint p)) (residueFieldProj W p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [residueDegreeComap, ← Subalgebra.bot_eq_top_iff_finrank_eq_one, eq_top_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h x => Algebra.mem_bot.1 (h Algebra.mem_top),
    fun h _ _ => Algebra.mem_bot.2 (h _)⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.residueDegreeComap_eq_one_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  refine (residueDegreeComap_eq_one_iff_surjective hφF hφint p).2 fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective x
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := h y
  exact ⟨IsLocalRing.residue _ z, rfl⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.residueDegreeComap_algEquiv
statement:
theorem residueDegreeComap_algEquiv (σ : W.FunctionField ≃ₐ[F] W.FunctionField)
    (p : ProjPoint W) :
    residueDegreeComap (φ := (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)) σ.commutes
      (isIntegralElem_algEquiv σ) p = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine residueDegreeComap_eq_one_of_surjective _ _ fun y => ?_
  have hmem : σ.symm (y : W.FunctionField) ∈ placeOf W (comapProjPoint
      (φ := (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)) σ.commutes
        (isIntegralElem_algEquiv σ) p) := by
    rw [mem_placeOf_comapProjPoint]
    change σ (σ.symm (y : W.FunctionField)) ∈ placeOf W p
    rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact y.2
  refine ⟨⟨σ.symm (y : W.FunctionField), hmem⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [coe_placeHomComap]
  change σ (σ.symm (y : W.FunctionField)) = (y : W.FunctionField)
  rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ker_residueHomSome
statement:
lemma ker_residueHomSome :
    RingHom.ker ((residueHomSome v).toRingHom : W.CoordinateRing →+* _) = v.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
  change IsLocalRing.residue _ (algebraMap W.CoordinateRing (placeOf W (some v)) a) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]
  exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.to_map_mem_maximal_iff _ v.asIdeal a

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.residueHomSome_surjective
statement: theorem residueHomSome_surjective : Function.Surjective (residueHomSome (W := W) v)
proof:
:= by
  intro ξ
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective ξ
  obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective v.asIdeal.primeCompl y
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : W.CoordinateRing, residueHomSome v s * residueHomSome v t = 1 := by
    letI : Field (W.CoordinateRing ⧸ v.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
    have hs : (Ideal.Quotient.mk v.asIdeal (s : W.CoordinateRing)) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ne, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
      exact s.2
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists_inv.1 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hs)
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective u
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    rw [← map_mul]
    have hmem : (s : W.CoordinateRing) * t - 1 ∈ v.asIdeal := by
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sub, map_mul, hu, map_one, sub_self]
    have hz : residueHomSome v ((s : W.CoordinateRing) * t - 1) = 0 :=
      (ker_residueHomSome (W := W) v).ge hmem
    rw [map_sub, map_one, sub_eq_zero] at hz
    exact hz
  refine ⟨a * t, ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (IsLocalRing.residue (placeOf W (some v)))
    (IsLocalization.mk'_spec (placeOf W (some v)) a s)
  rw [map_mul] at h1
  have key : IsLocalRing.residue (placeOf W (some v)) (IsLocalization.mk' _ a s)
      * residueHomSome v (s : W.CoordinateRing) = residueHomSome v a := h1
  rw [map_mul, ← key, mul_assoc, ht, mul_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_residueFieldProj_none_surjective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_residueFieldProj_none_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (algebraMap F (residueFieldProj W (none : ProjPoint W)))
proof:
:= by
  intro ξ
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := residue_placeOf_surjective (W := W) none ξ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_const_ordInfty_sub_pos (mem_ordInftyValuationSubring.1 x.2)
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  have hcoe : algebraMap F (residueFieldProj W (none : ProjPoint W)) c
      = IsLocalRing.residue _ (algebraMap F (placeOf W (none : ProjPoint W)) c) := rfl
  rw [hcoe]
  rcases hc with hc | hc
  · exact congrArg _ (Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_algebraMap_placeOf, ← hc]))
  · refine (sub_eq_zero.1 ?_).symm
    rw [← map_sub]
    have hval : ((x - algebraMap F (placeOf W (none : ProjPoint W)) c : placeOf W _) :
        W.FunctionField) = (x : W.FunctionField) - algebraMap F W.FunctionField c := rfl
    have hne : ((x - algebraMap F (placeOf W (none : ProjPoint W)) c : placeOf W _) :
        W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hval]
      intro h0
      rw [h0, ordInfty_zero] at hc
      exact absurd hc (lt_irrefl 0)
    rw [residue_placeOf_eq_zero_iff hne, divisorProj_apply_none, hval]
    exact hc

proof:

  | none => exact algebraMap_residueFieldProj_none_bijective W
  | some v => exact algebraMap_residueFieldProj_some_bijective v

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_maximalIdeal_placeOf_iff
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : 0 ≤ divisorProj W (x : W.FunctionField) p :=
    (mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p hx).1 x.2
  rw [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hnu
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hmem with h | h
    · exact h
    · have hinv : (x : W.FunctionField)⁻¹ ∈ placeOf W p := by
        rw [mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p (inv_ne_zero hx), divisorProj_inv,
          Finsupp.neg_apply, ← h, neg_zero]
      exact absurd (isUnit_iff_exists_inv.2
        ⟨⟨(x : W.FunctionField)⁻¹, hinv⟩, Subtype.ext (by simpa using mul_inv_cancel₀ hx)⟩) hnu
  · intro hlt hu
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := isUnit_iff_exists_inv.1 hu
    have hxy : (x : W.FunctionField) * (y : W.FunctionField) = 1 := congrArg Subtype.val hy
    have hyne : (y : W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      simp [h] at hxy
    have h0 : divisorProj W ((x : W.FunctionField) * y) p = 0 := by
      rw [hxy, divisorProj_one]
      rfl
    rw [divisorProj_mul hx hyne, Finsupp.add_apply] at h0
    have := (mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p hyne).1 y.2
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.maximalIdeal_placeOf_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  have hπ0 : (π : W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, divisorProj_zero] at hπ
    simp at hπ
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) ?_
  · rcases eq_or_ne (x : W.FunctionField) 0 with h0 | h0
    · have hx0 : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (by simpa using h0)
      simp [hx0]
    · have hpos := (mem_maximalIdeal_placeOf_iff h0).1 hx
      have hq : (x : W.FunctionField) / (π : W.FunctionField) ∈ placeOf W p := by
        rw [mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p (div_ne_zero h0 hπ0), divisorProj_div h0 hπ0,
          Finsupp.sub_apply, hπ]
        omega
      exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.2
        ⟨⟨_, hq⟩, Subtype.ext (by simpa using div_mul_cancel₀ (x : W.FunctionField) hπ0)⟩
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]
    exact (mem_maximalIdeal_placeOf_iff hπ0).2 (by rw [hπ]; norm_num)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isUnit_placeOf_iff
statement:
theorem isUnit_placeOf_iff {p : ProjPoint W} (x : placeOf W p) :
    IsUnit x ↔ (x : W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 ∧ divisorProj W (x : W.FunctionField) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (x : W.FunctionField) 0 with h | h
  · have hx : x = 0 := Subtype.ext h
    simp [hx]
  · have hmem : 0 ≤ divisorProj W (x : W.FunctionField) p :=
      (mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p h).1 x.2
    rw [← IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal, mem_maximalIdeal_placeOf_iff h]
    exact ⟨fun hh => ⟨h, by omega⟩, fun hh => by omega⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isPrincipal_maximalIdeal_placeOf
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_maximalIdeal_placeOf (p : ProjPoint W) :
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (placeOf W p)).IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ0, hπ⟩ := exists_divisorProj_eq_one p
  have hmem : π ∈ placeOf W p :=
    (mem_placeOf_iff_divisorProj_nonneg p hπ0).2 (by rw [hπ]; norm_num)
  exact ⟨⟨⟨π, hmem⟩, by
    rw [maximalIdeal_placeOf_eq_span (⟨π, hmem⟩ : placeOf W p) hπ, Ideal.submodule_span_eq]⟩⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.genY_mem_of_genX_mem
statement: lemma genY_mem_of_genX_mem : CoordinateRing.genY W ∈ O
proof:
:=
  (O.valuation_le_one_iff _).1 <|
    WeierstrassCurve.valuation_le_one_of_valuation_le_one O.valuation
      (W.map (algebraMap F W.FunctionField))
      (by simpa using valuation_algebraMap_base_le hF W.a₁)
      (by simpa using valuation_algebraMap_base_le hF W.a₂)
      (by simpa using valuation_algebraMap_base_le hF W.a₃)
      (by simpa using valuation_algebraMap_base_le hF W.a₄)
      (by simpa using valuation_algebraMap_base_le hF W.a₆)
      equation_gen ((O.valuation_le_one_iff _).2 hx)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_polynomial_mem
statement: lemma algebraMap_polynomial_mem (p : F[X]) : algebraMap F[X] W.FunctionField p ∈ O
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hp hq
  | monomial n c =>
      rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial, map_mul, map_pow, algebraMap_polynomial_X]
      refine mul_mem ?_ (pow_mem hx n)
      rw [Polynomial.C_eq_algebraMap, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
      exact hF c

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_coordinateRing_mem
statement:
theorem algebraMap_coordinateRing_mem (a : W.CoordinateRing) :
    algebraMap W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField a ∈ O
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, rfl⟩ := CoordinateRing.exists_smul_basis_eq a
  rw [map_add, algebraMap_smul_one, algebraMap_smul_Y]
  exact add_mem (algebraMap_polynomial_mem hF hx p)
    (mul_mem (algebraMap_polynomial_mem hF hx q) (genY_mem_of_genX_mem hF hx))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.comap_ringHom_id
statement:
private lemma comap_ringHom_id (A : ValuationSubring W.FunctionField) :
    A.comap (RingHom.id W.FunctionField) = A
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_mem_comap_algEquiv
statement:
lemma algebraMap_mem_comap_algEquiv (hF : ∀ c : F, algebraMap F W.FunctionField c ∈ O) (c : F) :
    algebraMap F W.FunctionField c ∈ O.comap (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ValuationSubring.mem_comap, show (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)
    (algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c from σ.commutes c]
  exact hF c

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.comap_algEquiv_ne_top
statement:
lemma comap_algEquiv_ne_top (hO : O ≠ ⊤) :
    O.comap (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= fun h => hO <| by
  refine SetLike.ext fun x => iff_of_true ?_ (ValuationSubring.mem_top x)
  have hx : σ.symm x ∈ O.comap (σ : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField) :=
    h ▸ ValuationSubring.mem_top _
  simpa using hx

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.comap_comap_of_apply_apply
statement:
private lemma comap_comap_of_apply_apply {e f : W.FunctionField ≃ₐ[F] W.FunctionField}
    (h : ∀ x, e (f x) = x) (A : ValuationSubring W.FunctionField) :
    (A.comap (e : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)).comap
      (f : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField) = A
proof:
:= by
  rw [ValuationSubring.comap_comap,
    show (e : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField).comp
      (f : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField) = RingHom.id _ from RingHom.ext h, comap_ringHom_id]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_heightOneSpectrum_of_genX_mem
statement:
theorem exists_heightOneSpectrum_of_genX_mem {O : ValuationSubring W.FunctionField}
    (hF : ∀ c : F, algebraMap F W.FunctionField c ∈ O) (hO : O ≠ ⊤)
    (hx : CoordinateRing.genX W ∈ O) :
    ∃ v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing,
      HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime W.FunctionField v = O
proof:
:=
  IsDedekindDomain.exists_valuationSubringAtPrime_eq O (algebraMap_coordinateRing_mem hF hx) hO

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOf_none
statement: @[simp] lemma placeOf_none : placeOf W none = ordInftyValuationSubring W
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOf_some
statement:
@[simp] lemma placeOf_some (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    placeOf W (some v) = HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime W.FunctionField v
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_mem_placeOf
statement:
lemma algebraMap_mem_placeOf (p : ProjPoint W) (c : F) :
    algebraMap F W.FunctionField c ∈ placeOf W p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | none => exact algebraMap_mem_ordInftyValuationSubring c
  | some v =>
      rw [placeOf_some, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField]
      exact HeightOneSpectrum.algebraMap_mem_valuationSubringAtPrime v _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOf_ne_top
statement: lemma placeOf_ne_top (p : ProjPoint W) : placeOf W p ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | none => exact fun h => genX_notMem_ordInftyValuationSubring (h ▸ ValuationSubring.mem_top _)
  | some v => exact HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_ne_top v

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOf_injective
statement: theorem placeOf_injective : Function.Injective (placeOf W)
proof:
:= by
  rintro (_ | v) (_ | w) h
  · rfl
  · exact absurd h (ordInftyValuationSubring_ne_valuationSubringAtPrime _)
  · exact absurd h.symm (ordInftyValuationSubring_ne_valuationSubringAtPrime _)
  · exact congrArg some (HeightOneSpectrum.valuationSubringAtPrime_injective h)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_placeOf_eq
statement:
theorem exists_placeOf_eq (O : ValuationSubring W.FunctionField)
    (hF : ∀ c : F, algebraMap F W.FunctionField c ∈ O) (hO : O ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ p : ProjPoint W, placeOf W p = O
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : CoordinateRing.genX W ∈ O
  · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_heightOneSpectrum_of_genX_mem hF hO hx
    exact ⟨some v, hv⟩
  · exact ⟨none, (eq_ordInftyValuationSubring hF hx).symm⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma placeEquiv_apply_coe (p : ProjPoint W) :
    ((placeEquiv W p : _) : ValuationSubring W.FunctionField) = placeOf W p
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOf_placeEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp] lemma placeOf_placeEquiv_symm
    (O : {O : ValuationSubring W.FunctionField //
      (∀ c : F, algebraMap F W.FunctionField c ∈ O) ∧ O ≠ ⊤}) :
    placeOf W ((placeEquiv W).symm O) = O
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val ((placeEquiv W).apply_symm_apply O)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_heightOneSpectrum
statement: lemma nonempty_heightOneSpectrum : Nonempty (HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing)
proof:
:= by
  set a : W.CoordinateRing := CoordinateRing.mk W (Polynomial.C (Polynomial.X : F[X])) with ha
  have hne : a ≠ 0 := mk_C_ne_zero Polynomial.X_ne_zero
  have hnu : ¬ IsUnit a := by
    rw [← deg_eq_zero_iff_isUnit hne, ha, deg_mk_C, Polynomial.natDegree_X]
    omega
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hle⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal (Ideal.span {a})
    fun h => hnu (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top.1 h)
  exact ⟨⟨m, hm.isPrime, fun h => hne (Ideal.mem_bot.1
    (h ▸ hle (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)))⟩⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOf_none_ne_placeOf_some
statement:
theorem placeOf_none_ne_placeOf_some (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    placeOf W none ≠ placeOf W (some v)
proof:
:=
  ordInftyValuationSubring_ne_valuationSubringAtPrime v

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOf_mapProjPointFun
statement:
lemma placeOf_mapProjPointFun (p : ProjPoint W) :
    placeOf W (mapProjPointFun W σ p)
      = (placeOf W p).comap (σ.symm : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)
proof:
:=
  (exists_placeOf_eq ((placeOf W p).comap (σ.symm : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField))
    (algebraMap_mem_comap_algEquiv σ.symm (algebraMap_mem_placeOf p))
    (comap_algEquiv_ne_top σ.symm (placeOf_ne_top p))).choose_spec

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.placeOf_mapProjPoint
statement:
@[simp] lemma placeOf_mapProjPoint (p : ProjPoint W) :
    placeOf W (mapProjPoint W σ p)
      = (placeOf W p).comap (σ.symm : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)
proof:
:=
  placeOf_mapProjPointFun σ p

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_placeOf_mapProjPoint
statement:
lemma mem_placeOf_mapProjPoint (p : ProjPoint W) (f : W.FunctionField) :
    f ∈ placeOf W (mapProjPoint W σ p) ↔ σ.symm f ∈ placeOf W p
proof:
:= by
  rw [placeOf_mapProjPoint]; exact Iff.rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mapProjPoint_eq_iff
statement:
theorem mapProjPoint_eq_iff {p q : ProjPoint W} :
    mapProjPoint W σ p = q ↔
      placeOf W q = (placeOf W p).comap (σ.symm : W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ placeOf_mapProjPoint σ p,
    fun h => placeOf_injective ((placeOf_mapProjPoint σ p).trans h.symm)⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mapProjPoint_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapProjPoint_one :
    mapProjPoint W (1 : W.FunctionField ≃ₐ[F] W.FunctionField) = Equiv.refl _
proof:
:=
  Equiv.ext fun p => placeOf_injective <| by
    rw [placeOf_mapProjPoint, Equiv.refl_apply,
      show ((1 : W.FunctionField ≃ₐ[F] W.FunctionField).symm :
        W.FunctionField →+* W.FunctionField) = RingHom.id _ from rfl, comap_ringHom_id]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mapProjPoint_mul
statement:
lemma mapProjPoint_mul :
    mapProjPoint W (σ * τ) = (mapProjPoint W τ).trans (mapProjPoint W σ)
proof:
:=
  Equiv.ext fun p => placeOf_injective <| by
    rw [placeOf_mapProjPoint, Equiv.trans_apply, placeOf_mapProjPoint, placeOf_mapProjPoint,
      ValuationSubring.comap_comap]
    exact congrArg _ (RingHom.ext fun x => rfl)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mapProjPointHom_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma mapProjPointHom_apply : mapProjPointHom W σ = mapProjPoint W σ
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.XYIdeal_isMaximal
statement: theorem XYIdeal_isMaximal (h : W.Equation x y) : (XYIdeal W x (C y)).IsMaximal
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField _ <|
    (quotientXYIdealEquiv (y := C y) h).toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv.isField (Field.toIsField F)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.XYIdeal_isPrime
statement: theorem XYIdeal_isPrime (h : W.Equation x y) : (XYIdeal W x (C y)).IsPrime
proof:
:=
  (XYIdeal_isMaximal h).isPrime

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.XYIdeal_ne_bot
statement: theorem XYIdeal_ne_bot : XYIdeal W x (C y) ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro hbot
  have hmem : XClass W x ∈ XYIdeal W x (C y) :=
    Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  rw [hbot, Ideal.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact XClass_ne_zero x hmem

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom_XClass
statement: lemma evalEvalHom_XClass (h : W.Equation x y) : evalEvalHom h (XClass W x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change evalEvalHom h (mk W (C (X - C x))) = 0
  rw [evalEvalHom_mk, evalEval_C]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom_YClass
statement: lemma evalEvalHom_YClass (h : W.Equation x y) : evalEvalHom h (YClass W (C y)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change evalEvalHom h (mk W (Y - C (C y))) = 0
  rw [evalEvalHom_mk]
  simp [Polynomial.evalEval]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.ker_evalEvalHom
statement:
theorem ker_evalEvalHom (h : W.Equation x y) :
    RingHom.ker (evalEvalHom h) = XYIdeal W x (C y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ((XYIdeal_isMaximal h).eq_of_le ?_ ?_).symm
  · 
    rw [Ne, Ideal.eq_top_iff_one, RingHom.mem_ker, map_one]
    exact one_ne_zero
  · 
    rw [XYIdeal, Ideal.span_le, Set.insert_subset_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact ⟨RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (evalEvalHom_XClass h),
      RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (evalEvalHom_YClass h)⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint_asIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pointClosedPoint_asIdeal (h : W.Equation x y) :
    (pointClosedPoint h).asIdeal = XYIdeal W x (C y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.toClass_nsmul_eq_zero_of_torsion
statement:
theorem toClass_nsmul_eq_zero_of_torsion {n : ℕ} {P : W.Point} (hP : P ∈ W.torsion n) :
    n • Point.toClass P = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_nsmul, mem_torsion_iff.mp hP, map_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.XYIdeal'_pow_isPrincipal_of_torsion
statement:
theorem XYIdeal'_pow_isPrincipal_of_torsion {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) {n : ℕ}
    (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n) :
    (↑(CoordinateRing.XYIdeal' (W := W) h ^ n) :
      Submodule W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField).IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ClassGroup.mk W.FunctionField (CoordinateRing.XYIdeal' (W := W) h) ^ n = 1 := by
    have h0 := toClass_nsmul_eq_zero_of_torsion hP
    rwa [Point.toClass_some] at h0
  rw [← map_pow] at hz
  exact ClassGroup.mk_eq_one_iff.mp hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_generator_XYIdeal'_pow_of_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_generator_XYIdeal'_pow_of_torsion {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) {n : ℕ}
    (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      (↑(CoordinateRing.XYIdeal' (W := W) h ^ n) :
        FractionalIdeal W.CoordinateRing⁰ W.FunctionField) =
        FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ f
proof:
:= by
  haveI := XYIdeal'_pow_isPrincipal_of_torsion h hP
  have hIne : (↑(CoordinateRing.XYIdeal' (W := W) h ^ n) :
      FractionalIdeal W.CoordinateRing⁰ W.FunctionField) ≠ 0 :=
    (CoordinateRing.XYIdeal' (W := W) h ^ n).isUnit.ne_zero
  refine ⟨Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator
      ((↑(CoordinateRing.XYIdeal' (W := W) h ^ n) :
        FractionalIdeal W.CoordinateRing⁰ W.FunctionField) :
        Submodule W.CoordinateRing W.FunctionField), ?_,
    FractionalIdeal.eq_spanSingleton_of_principal _⟩
  intro hg0
  exact hIne <| by
    rw [FractionalIdeal.eq_spanSingleton_of_principal
      (↑(CoordinateRing.XYIdeal' (W := W) h ^ n) :
        FractionalIdeal W.CoordinateRing⁰ W.FunctionField), hg0,
      FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ord_generator_eq
statement:
theorem ord_generator_eq {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) {n : ℕ}
    (f : W.FunctionField)
    (hgen : (↑(CoordinateRing.XYIdeal' (W := W) h ^ n) :
        FractionalIdeal W.CoordinateRing⁰ W.FunctionField) =
      FractionalIdeal.spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ f)
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    ord v f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ) v
proof:
:= by
  
  have hspan : spanSingleton W.CoordinateRing⁰ f =
      ((CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1).asIdeal :
        FractionalIdeal W.CoordinateRing⁰ W.FunctionField) ^ n := by
    rw [← hgen, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, CoordinateRing.XYIdeal'_eq,
      CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint_asIdeal]
  rw [ord, hspan]
  by_cases hv : v = CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1
  · rw [hv, count_pow_self, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
  · have hne : CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1 ≠ v := fun hc => hv hc.symm
    rw [count_pow, count_maximal_coprime W.FunctionField v hne, mul_zero]
    exact (Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (b := (n : ℤ)) hv).symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion [DecidableEq F] {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y)
    {n : ℕ} (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      divisor W f = Finsupp.single (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.1) (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hgen⟩ := exists_generator_XYIdeal'_pow_of_torsion h hP
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  ext v
  rw [divisor_apply, ord_generator_eq h f hgen v]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.some_injective_projPoint
statement:
lemma some_injective_projPoint :
    Function.Injective (some : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing → ProjPoint W)
proof:
:=
  Option.some_injective _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_apply_some
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisorProj_apply_some (f : W.FunctionField) (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    divisorProj W f (some v) = ord v f
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisorProj, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_apply (some_injective_projPoint W),
    Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (by simp), add_zero, divisor_apply]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_apply_none
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisorProj_apply_none (f : W.FunctionField) :
    divisorProj W f none = ordInfty W f
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisorProj, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_notin_range _ _ (by simp),
    Finsupp.single_eq_same, zero_add]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_eq_iff
statement:
lemma divisorProj_eq_iff {f g : W.FunctionField} :
    divisorProj W f = divisorProj W g ↔
      divisor W f = divisor W g ∧ ordInfty W f = ordInfty W g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, by simpa using congrArg (fun D => D none) h⟩
    ext v
    simpa using congrArg (fun D => D (some v)) h
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    ext p
    cases p with
    | none => simpa using h2
    | some v => simpa using congrArg (fun D => D v) h1

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisorProj_zero : divisorProj W (0 : W.FunctionField) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext p; cases p <;> simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisorProj_one : divisorProj W (1 : W.FunctionField) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext p; cases p <;> simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_mul
statement:
lemma divisorProj_mul {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W (f * g) = divisorProj W f + divisorProj W g
proof:
:= by
  ext p; cases p <;> simp [ord_mul _ hf hg, ordInfty_mul hf hg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisorProj_inv (f : W.FunctionField) : divisorProj W f⁻¹ = -divisorProj W f
proof:
:= by
  ext p; cases p <;> simp [ordInfty_inv]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_div
statement:
lemma divisorProj_div {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W (f / g) = divisorProj W f - divisorProj W g
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, divisorProj_mul hf (inv_ne_zero hg), divisorProj_inv, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_pow
statement:
lemma divisorProj_pow (f : W.FunctionField) (n : ℕ) :
    divisorProj W (f ^ n) = n • divisorProj W f
proof:
:= by
  ext p; cases p <;> simp [ord_pow, ordInfty_pow]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_zpow
statement:
lemma divisorProj_zpow (f : W.FunctionField) (n : ℤ) :
    divisorProj W (f ^ n) = n • divisorProj W f
proof:
:= by
  ext p; cases p <;> simp [ord_zpow, ordInfty_zpow]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_prod
statement:
lemma divisorProj_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → W.FunctionField)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, divisorProj W (f i)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  cases p with
  | none => simpa using ordInfty_prod W s f hf
  | some v => simpa using ord_prod v s f hf

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_algebraMap_base
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisorProj_algebraMap_base {c : F} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W (algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext p; cases p <;> simp [hc]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProjPt_none
statement: @[simp] lemma degProjPt_none : degProjPt W (none : ProjPoint W) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProjPt_some
statement:
@[simp] lemma degProjPt_some (v : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing) :
    degProjPt W (some v) = degPt v
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProjPt_pos
statement: lemma degProjPt_pos (p : ProjPoint W) : 0 < degProjPt W p
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | none => exact Nat.one_pos
  | some v => exact degPt_pos v

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProj_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degProj_zero : degProj W (0 : ProjPoint W →₀ ℤ) = 0
proof: := Finsupp.sum_zero_index

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProj_add
statement: lemma degProj_add (D E : ProjPoint W →₀ ℤ) : degProj W (D + E) = degProj W D + degProj W E
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ => zero_mul _) (fun _ _ _ => add_mul _ _ _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProj_sub
statement: lemma degProj_sub (D E : ProjPoint W →₀ ℤ) : degProj W (D - E) = degProj W D - degProj W E
proof:
:= by
  have h := degProj_add (W := W) (D - E) E
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProj_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma degProj_single (p : ProjPoint W) (n : ℤ) :
    degProj W (Finsupp.single p n) = n * degProjPt W p
proof:
:= by
  rw [degProj, Finsupp.sum_single_index (zero_mul _)]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProj_mapDomain_some
statement:
lemma degProj_mapDomain_some (D : HeightOneSpectrum W.CoordinateRing →₀ ℤ) :
    degProj W (D.mapDomain some) = degDiv W D
proof:
:= by
  rw [degProj, Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index_inj (some_injective_projPoint W), degDiv]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProj_divisorProj
statement:
theorem degProj_divisorProj {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    degProj W (divisorProj W f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisorProj, degProj_add, degProj_mapDomain_some, degProj_single, degProjPt_none]
  have := degDiv_divisor_add_ordInfty (W := W) hf
  push_cast
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProjPt_none_unique
statement:
theorem degProjPt_none_unique (w : ℤ)
    (hw : ∀ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 → degDiv W (divisor W f) + w * ordInfty W f = 0) :
    w = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := hw (CoordinateRing.genX W) genX_ne_zero
  rw [degDiv_divisor genX_ne_zero, ordInfty_genX] at h
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem divisorProj_eq_zero_iff {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W f = 0 ↔ ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ f = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisor_eq_zero hf ?_
    ext v
    simpa using congrArg (fun D => D (some v)) h
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact divisorProj_algebraMap_base hc

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degProj_nonneg
statement: lemma degProj_nonneg {D : ProjPoint W →₀ ℤ} (hD : ∀ p, 0 ≤ D p) : 0 ≤ degProj W D
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => mul_nonneg (hD p) (Int.natCast_nonneg _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eq_zero_of_degProj_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_degProj_eq_zero {D : ProjPoint W →₀ ℤ} (hD : ∀ p, 0 ≤ D p)
    (h : degProj W D = 0) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  by_cases hp : p ∈ D.support
  · have hterm := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun q _ => mul_nonneg (hD q) (Int.natCast_nonneg (degProjPt W q)))).mp h p hp
    have hpos : (0 : ℤ) < degProjPt W p := by exact_mod_cast degProjPt_pos p
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hterm with h0 | h0
    · simpa using h0
    · omega
  · simpa using Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_eq_zero_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem divisorProj_eq_zero_of_nonneg {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hD : ∀ p, 0 ≤ divisorProj W f p) : divisorProj W f = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_degProj_eq_zero hD (degProj_divisorProj hf)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisorProj_nonneg
statement:
theorem exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisorProj_nonneg {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hD : ∀ p, 0 ≤ divisorProj W f p) :
    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ f = algebraMap F W.FunctionField c
proof:
:=
  (divisorProj_eq_zero_iff hf).mp (divisorProj_eq_zero_of_nonneg hf hD)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_neg_of_ne_algebraMap
statement:
theorem exists_neg_of_ne_algebraMap {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hconst : ∀ c : F, f ≠ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c) :
    ∃ p : ProjPoint W, divisorProj W f p < 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ :=
    exists_eq_algebraMap_of_divisorProj_nonneg hf fun p => not_lt.mp fun hp => h ⟨p, hp⟩
  exact hconst c hc

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ordInfty_eq_of_divisor_eq
statement:
theorem ordInfty_eq_of_divisor_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : divisor W f = divisor W g) : ordInfty W f = ordInfty W g
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := degDiv_divisor_add_ordInfty (W := W) hf
  have h2 := degDiv_divisor_add_ordInfty (W := W) hg
  rw [h] at h1
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_scalar_of_divisorProj_eq
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_of_divisorProj_eq {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (h : divisorProj W f = divisorProj W g) :
    ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c * f = g
proof:
:=
  exists_scalar_of_divisor_eq hf hg (divisorProj_eq_iff.mp h).1

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_eq_iff_exists_scalar
statement:
theorem divisorProj_eq_iff_exists_scalar {f g : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W f = divisorProj W g ↔
      ∃ c : F, c ≠ 0 ∧ algebraMap F W.FunctionField c * f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exists_scalar_of_divisorProj_eq hf hg, fun h => ?_⟩
  have haff := (divisor_eq_iff_exists_scalar hf hg).mpr h
  exact divisorProj_eq_iff.mpr ⟨haff, ordInfty_eq_of_divisor_eq hf hg haff⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_eq_single_sub_single_of_torsion
statement:
theorem divisorProj_eq_single_sub_single_of_torsion [DecidableEq F] {x y : F}
    (h : W.Nonsingular x y) {n : ℕ} (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧ divisorProj W f
      = Finsupp.single (some (CoordinateRing.pointClosedPoint h.left)) (n : ℤ)
        - Finsupp.single none (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hd, hi⟩ := exists_generator_divisor_eq_of_torsion' h hP
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  ext p
  cases p with
  | none => simp [hi]
  | some v =>
      rw [divisorProj_apply_some, ← divisor_apply, hd, Finsupp.sub_apply]
      simp [Finsupp.single_apply]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_genX_apply_none
statement:
lemma divisorProj_genX_apply_none :

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_genX_ne_zero
statement: theorem divisorProj_genX_ne_zero : divisorProj W (CoordinateRing.genX W) ≠ 0
proof:

  rw [h] at this

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Elliptic.exists_neg_of_ne_algebraMap

theorem exists_neg_of_ne_algebraMap {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_comapProjPoint_preimage_singleton
statement:
theorem finite_comapProjPoint_preimage_singleton (q : ProjPoint W) :
    ((comapProjPoint hφF hφint) ⁻¹' {q}).Finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ0, hπ⟩ := exists_divisorProj_eq_one q
  have hφπ : φ π ≠ 0 := fun h => hπ0 (φ.injective (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  refine Set.Finite.subset (divisorProj W (φ π)).support.finite_toSet fun p hp => ?_
  have hpq : comapProjPoint hφF hφint p = q := hp
  have h := divisorProj_comp_apply hφF hφint hπ0 p
  rw [hpq, hπ, mul_one] at h
  refine Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 ?_
  rw [h]
  exact (ramificationIdx_pos hφF hφint p).ne'

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_comapProjPoint_preimage
statement:
theorem finite_comapProjPoint_preimage {s : Set (ProjPoint W)} (hs : s.Finite) :
    ((comapProjPoint hφF hφint) ⁻¹' s).Finite
proof:
:=
  hs.preimage' fun q _ => finite_comapProjPoint_preimage_singleton hφF hφint q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_setOf_ramificationIdx_mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finite_setOf_ramificationIdx_mul_ne_zero (D : ProjPoint W →₀ ℤ) :
    {p : ProjPoint W |
      ramificationIdx hφF hφint p * D (comapProjPoint hφF hφint p) ≠ 0}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Finite.subset
    (finite_comapProjPoint_preimage hφF hφint D.support.finite_toSet) fun p hp => ?_
  exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 fun h => hp (by rw [h, mul_zero])

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pullbackDivisor_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullbackDivisor_apply (D : ProjPoint W →₀ ℤ) (p : ProjPoint W) :
    pullbackDivisor hφF hφint D p
      = ramificationIdx hφF hφint p * D (comapProjPoint hφF hφint p)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.divisorProj_comp
statement:
theorem divisorProj_comp {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W (φ f) = pullbackDivisor hφF hφint (divisorProj W f)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [pullbackDivisor_apply, divisorProj_comp_apply hφF hφint hf p]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.pullbackDivisorTwo_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullbackDivisorTwo_apply (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (D : ProjPoint W →₀ ℤ)
    (p : ProjPoint W) :
    pullbackDivisorTwo h2 D p = ramificationIdxTwo h2 p * D (comapProjPointTwo h2 p)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.divisorProj_mulByTwoEndo
statement:
theorem divisorProj_mulByTwoEndo (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    divisorProj W (mulByTwoEndo h2 f) = pullbackDivisorTwo h2 (divisorProj W f)
proof:
:=
  divisorProj_comp _ _ hf

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton
statement:
theorem finite_comapProjPointTwo_preimage_singleton (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (q : ProjPoint W) :
    ((comapProjPointTwo (W := W) h2) ⁻¹' {q}).Finite
proof:
:=
  finite_comapProjPoint_preimage_singleton _ _ q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pullbackDivisorN_single_sub_single_eq_sum_torsion
statement:
theorem pullbackDivisorN_single_sub_single_eq_sum_torsion {n : ℕ} [Fintype (W.torsion n)]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hn : ((n : ℤ) : F) ≠ 0)
    (h : Transcendental F (n • genericPoint (W := W)).xCoord) {S P : W.Point} (hP : n • P = S) :
    pullbackDivisorN n h (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W S) (1 : ℤ)
        - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ))
      = ∑ R : W.torsion n, (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W (P + R)) (1 : ℤ)
          - Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W (R : W.Point)) (1 : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hO : (none : ProjPoint W) = projPointOfPoint W 0 := rfl
  rw [map_sub, pullbackDivisorN_single_eq_sum_torsion_of_ne_zero h2 hn h hP, hO,
    pullbackDivisorN_single_eq_sum_torsion_of_ne_zero h2 hn h (smul_zero n),
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun R _ => by rw [zero_add]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.affinePart_pullbackDivisorN_single_sub_single
statement:
theorem affinePart_pullbackDivisorN_single_sub_single {n : ℕ} [Fintype (W.torsion n)]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hn : ((n : ℤ) : F) ≠ 0)
    (h : Transcendental F (n • genericPoint (W := W)).xCoord) {S P : W.Point} (hP : n • P = S) :
    W.affinePart (pullbackDivisorN n h (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W S) (1 : ℤ)
        - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ)))
      = ∑ R : W.torsion n, (W.pointDivisorAff (P + R) - W.pointDivisorAff (R : W.Point))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackDivisorN_single_sub_single_eq_sum_torsion h2 hn h hP, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun R _ => map_sub _ _ _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.classOfDivisor_affinePart_pullbackDivisorN_eq_one
statement:
theorem classOfDivisor_affinePart_pullbackDivisorN_eq_one {n : ℕ}
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hn : ((n : ℤ) : F) ≠ 0)
    (h : Transcendental F (n • genericPoint (W := W)).xCoord) {S P : W.Point}
    (hP : n • P = S) (hS : n • S = 0) :
    classOfDivisor W.FunctionField (W.affinePart (pullbackDivisorN n h
        (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W S) (1 : ℤ)
          - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ)))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnF : (n : F) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  haveI := W.finite_torsion_of_intCast_ne_zero h2 hnF
  haveI : Fintype (W.torsion n) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hPsq : (n ^ 2) • P = 0 := by rw [sq, mul_smul, hP, hS]
  have hterm : ∀ R ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (W.torsion n)),
      classOfDivisor W.FunctionField (W.pointDivisorAff (P + R) - W.pointDivisorAff (R : W.Point))
        = Additive.toMul (Point.toClass P) := by
    intro R _
    rw [classOfDivisor_sub, classOfDivisor_pointDivisorAff, classOfDivisor_pointDivisorAff,
      map_add, toMul_add, mul_div_cancel_right]
  have hcard : Fintype.card (W.torsion n) = n ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, card_torsion_eq_sq h2 hnF]
  rw [affinePart_pullbackDivisorN_single_sub_single h2 hn h hP, classOfDivisor_sum,
    Finset.prod_congr rfl hterm, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, hcard, ← toMul_nsmul,
    ← map_nsmul, hPsq, Point.toClass_zero]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_divisor_eq_affinePart_pullbackDivisorN
statement:
theorem exists_divisor_eq_affinePart_pullbackDivisorN {n : ℕ}
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hn : ((n : ℤ) : F) ≠ 0)
    (h : Transcendental F (n • genericPoint (W := W)).xCoord) {S P : W.Point}
    (hP : n • P = S) (hS : n • S = 0) :
    ∃ g : W.FunctionField, g ≠ 0 ∧ W.divisor g = W.affinePart (pullbackDivisorN n h
      (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W S) (1 : ℤ)
        - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ)))
proof:
:=
  (exists_divisor_eq_iff_classOfDivisor_eq_one _).2
    (classOfDivisor_affinePart_pullbackDivisorN_eq_one h2 hn h hP hS)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_divisor_eq_divisor_mulByNEndo
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_divisor_eq_divisor_mulByNEndo {n : ℕ}
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hn : ((n : ℤ) : F) ≠ 0)
    (h : Transcendental F (n • genericPoint (W := W)).xCoord)
    {x y : F} (hns : W.Nonsingular x y) (hS : Point.some x y hns ∈ W.torsion n)
    {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hfdiv : W.divisor f = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint hns.left) (n : ℤ)) :
    ∃ g₀ : W.FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
      n • W.divisor g₀ = W.divisor (mulByNEndo n h f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnF : (n : F) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hnF
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := nsmul_surjective_of_two_ne_zero (W := W) h2 hn0 (Point.some x y hns)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgdiv⟩ :=
    exists_divisor_eq_affinePart_pullbackDivisorN h2 hn h hP (mem_torsion_iff.mp hS)
  refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, hproj₀⟩ := divisorProj_eq_single_sub_single_of_torsion hns hS
  have hd₀ : W.divisor f₀ = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint hns.left) (n : ℤ) := by
    ext v
    have hv := congrArg (fun D => D (some v)) hproj₀
    simpa [Finsupp.single_apply] using hv
  have hfe : W.divisor f = W.divisor f₀ := hfdiv.trans hd₀.symm
  have hprojf : W.divisorProj f = W.divisorProj f₀ :=
    divisorProj_eq_iff.2 ⟨hfe, ordInfty_eq_of_divisor_eq hf hf₀ hfe⟩
  have hkey : W.divisorProj (mulByNEndo n h f)
      = (n : ℤ) • pullbackDivisorN n h
          (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W (Point.some x y hns)) (1 : ℤ)
            - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ)) := by
    rw [divisorProj_mulByNEndo n h hf, hprojf, hproj₀, ← map_zsmul]
    congr 1
    rw [smul_sub, Finsupp.smul_single, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      projPointOfPoint_some]
  have hdivn : W.divisor (mulByNEndo n h f)
      = (n : ℤ) • W.affinePart (pullbackDivisorN n h
        (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W (Point.some x y hns)) (1 : ℤ)
          - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ))) := by
    rw [← affinePart_divisorProj, hkey, map_zsmul]
  rw [hdivn, hgdiv, ← natCast_zsmul]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_n_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem exists_gS_n_of_isAlgClosed {n : ℕ} (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hn : ((n : ℤ) : F) ≠ 0)
    (h : Transcendental F (n • genericPoint (W := W)).xCoord)
    {x y : F} (hns : W.Nonsingular x y) (hS : Point.some x y hns ∈ W.torsion n) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      W.divisor f = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint hns.left) (n : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : W.FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • gS ^ n = mulByNEndo n h f
proof:
:=
  exists_gS_n h hns hS fun _ hf hfdiv =>
    exists_nsmul_divisor_eq_divisor_mulByNEndo h2 hn h hns hS hf hfdiv

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_of_ne_zero_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem exists_gS_of_ne_zero_of_isAlgClosed {n : ℕ} (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hn : ((n : ℤ) : F) ≠ 0)
    {x y : F} (hns : W.Nonsingular x y) (hS : Point.some x y hns ∈ W.torsion n) :
    ∃ f : W.FunctionField, f ≠ 0 ∧
      W.divisor f = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint hns.left) (n : ℤ) ∧
      ∃ gS : W.FunctionField, gS ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ u : W.CoordinateRingˣ, (u : W.CoordinateRing) • gS ^ n
          = mulByNEndo n (transcendental_xCoord_nsmul_genericPoint_of_intCast_ne_zero h2 hn) f
proof:
:=
  exists_gS_n_of_isAlgClosed h2 hn _ hns hS

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nonsingular_mem_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_nonsingular_mem_torsion (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) (hn1 : n ≠ 1) :
    ∃ (x y : F) (h : W.Nonsingular x y), Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion n
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hn
  haveI := W.finite_torsion_of_intCast_ne_zero h2 hn
  have hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n ^ 2 := card_torsion_eq_sq h2 hn
  have h1n : 1 < Nat.card (W.torsion n) := by
    rw [hcard]
    have : 2 ≤ n := by omega
    calc 1 < 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ n ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left this 2
  haveI : Nontrivial (W.torsion n) := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.mp h1n
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_ne (0 : W.torsion n)
  have hT0 : (T : W.Point) ≠ 0 := fun hc => hT (Subtype.ext hc)
  match hTP : (T : W.Point), hT0 with
  | Point.some x y h, _ => exact ⟨x, y, h, hTP ▸ T.2⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.pullbackDivisorThree_single_sub_single_eq_sum_torsion
statement:
theorem pullbackDivisorThree_single_sub_single_eq_sum_torsion [Fintype (W.torsion 3)]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {S P : W.Point} (hP : (3 : ℕ) • P = S) :
    pullbackDivisorThree h2 h3 (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W S) (1 : ℤ)
        - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ))
      = ∑ R : W.torsion 3, (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W (P + R)) (1 : ℤ)
          - Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W (R : W.Point)) (1 : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hO : (none : ProjPoint W) = projPointOfPoint W 0 := rfl
  rw [map_sub, pullbackDivisorThree_single_eq_sum_torsion h2 h3 hP, hO,
    pullbackDivisorThree_single_eq_sum_torsion h2 h3 (smul_zero 3), ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun R _ => by rw [zero_add]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.affinePart_pullbackDivisorThree_single_sub_single
statement:
theorem affinePart_pullbackDivisorThree_single_sub_single [Fintype (W.torsion 3)]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {S P : W.Point} (hP : (3 : ℕ) • P = S) :
    affinePart W (pullbackDivisorThree h2 h3 (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W S) (1 : ℤ)
        - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ)))
      = ∑ R : W.torsion 3, (pointDivisorAff W (P + R) - pointDivisorAff W (R : W.Point))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pullbackDivisorThree_single_sub_single_eq_sum_torsion h2 h3 hP, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun R _ => map_sub _ _ _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.classOfDivisor_affinePart_pullbackDivisorThree_eq_one
statement:
theorem classOfDivisor_affinePart_pullbackDivisorThree_eq_one (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    {S P : W.Point} (hP : (3 : ℕ) • P = S) (hS : (3 : ℕ) • S = 0) :
    classOfDivisor W.FunctionField (affinePart W (pullbackDivisorThree h2 h3
        (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W S) (1 : ℤ)
          - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ)))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := W.finite_torsion_three h3
  haveI : Fintype (W.torsion 3) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hP9 : (9 : ℕ) • P = 0 := by
    rw [show (9 : ℕ) = 3 * 3 from rfl, mul_smul, hP, hS]
  have hterm : ∀ R ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (W.torsion 3)),
      classOfDivisor W.FunctionField (pointDivisorAff W (P + R) - pointDivisorAff W (R : W.Point))
        = Additive.toMul (Point.toClass P) := by
    intro R _
    rw [classOfDivisor_sub, classOfDivisor_pointDivisorAff, classOfDivisor_pointDivisorAff,
      map_add, toMul_add, mul_div_cancel_right]
  have hcard : Fintype.card (W.torsion 3) = 9 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, card_torsion_three h2 h3]
  rw [affinePart_pullbackDivisorThree_single_sub_single h2 h3 hP, classOfDivisor_sum,
    Finset.prod_congr rfl hterm, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, hcard, ← toMul_nsmul,
    ← map_nsmul, hP9, Point.toClass_zero]
  rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_divisor_eq_affinePart_pullbackDivisorThree
statement:
theorem exists_divisor_eq_affinePart_pullbackDivisorThree (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    {S P : W.Point} (hP : (3 : ℕ) • P = S) (hS : (3 : ℕ) • S = 0) :
    ∃ g : W.FunctionField, g ≠ 0 ∧ divisor W g = affinePart W (pullbackDivisorThree h2 h3
      (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W S) (1 : ℤ)
        - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ)))
proof:
:=
  (exists_divisor_eq_iff_classOfDivisor_eq_one _).2
    (classOfDivisor_affinePart_pullbackDivisorThree_eq_one h2 h3 hP hS)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_divisor_eq_divisor_mulByThreeEndo
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_divisor_eq_divisor_mulByThreeEndo (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (hS : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 3)
    {f : W.FunctionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hfdiv : divisor W f = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h.left) (3 : ℤ)) :
    ∃ g₀ : W.FunctionField, g₀ ≠ 0 ∧
      3 • divisor W g₀ = divisor W (mulByThreeEndo h2 h3 f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_nsmul_three_eq h2 (Point.some x y h)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgdiv⟩ :=
    exists_divisor_eq_affinePart_pullbackDivisorThree h2 h3 hP (mem_torsion_iff.mp hS)
  refine ⟨g, hg, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, hproj₀⟩ := divisorProj_eq_single_sub_single_of_torsion h hS
  have hd₀ : divisor W f₀ = Finsupp.single (pointClosedPoint h.left) (3 : ℤ) := by
    ext v
    have hv := congrArg (fun D => D (some v)) hproj₀
    simpa [Finsupp.single_apply] using hv
  have hfe : divisor W f = divisor W f₀ := hfdiv.trans hd₀.symm
  have hprojf : divisorProj W f = divisorProj W f₀ :=
    divisorProj_eq_iff.2 ⟨hfe, ordInfty_eq_of_divisor_eq hf hf₀ hfe⟩
  have hkey : divisorProj W (mulByThreeEndo h2 h3 f)
      = (3 : ℤ) • pullbackDivisorThree h2 h3
          (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W (Point.some x y h)) (1 : ℤ)
            - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ)) := by
    rw [divisorProj_mulByThreeEndo h2 h3 hf, hprojf, hproj₀, ← map_zsmul]
    congr 1
    rw [smul_sub, Finsupp.smul_single, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      projPointOfPoint_some]
    norm_num
  have hdiv3 : divisor W (mulByThreeEndo h2 h3 f)
      = (3 : ℤ) • affinePart W (pullbackDivisorThree h2 h3
        (Finsupp.single (projPointOfPoint W (Point.some x y h)) (1 : ℤ)
          - Finsupp.single (none : ProjPoint W) (1 : ℤ))) := by
    rw [← affinePart_divisorProj, hkey, map_zsmul]
  rw [hdiv3, hgdiv, ← natCast_zsmul]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_gS_three_of_isAlgClosed

:= by

  have h : finrank ↥(FixedPoints.subfield (TorsionThreeMul W) W.FunctionField) W.FunctionField

theorem fixedFieldThree_eq_mulByThreeFieldRange_of_card (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)

:= by

    finrank_mulByThreeFieldRange h2 h3
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ↥(mulByThreeEndoAlgHom (W := W) h2 h3).fieldRange W.FunctionField :=
    Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hdeg]; norm_num)
  refine IntermediateField.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq' ?_
    (by rw [hdeg, finrank_fixedFieldThree_of_card hcard])

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.isSeparable_mulByThreeFieldRange_of_card
statement:

    (Algebra.IsSeparable ↥(FixedPoints.subfield (TorsionThreeMul W) W.FunctionField)

    (p : ProjPoint W) :
