name: AddCommGroup.equiv_zmod_sq_of_two_gen
statement:
theorem equiv_zmod_sq_of_two_gen [Finite A] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hkill : ∀ a : A, n • a = 0) (hcard : Nat.card A = n ^ 2)
    {g₁ g₂ : A} (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure {g₁, g₂} = ⊤) :
    Nonempty (A ≃+ ZMod n × ZMod n)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  haveI : Module (ZMod n) A := AddCommGroup.zmodModule hkill
  
  have hspan : Submodule.span (ZMod n) {g₁, g₂} = ⊤ := by
    rw [Submodule.eq_top_iff']
    intro a
    have ha : a ∈ AddSubgroup.closure {g₁, g₂} := by rw [hgen]; exact AddSubgroup.mem_top a
    refine (AddSubgroup.closure_le
      (Submodule.span (ZMod n) {g₁, g₂}).toAddSubgroup).mpr ?_ ha
    intro x hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span hx
  
  let f : (ZMod n × ZMod n) →ₗ[ZMod n] A :=
    (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton (ZMod n) A g₁).coprod (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton (ZMod n) A g₂)
  have hrange : LinearMap.range f = ⊤ := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_coprod, ← LinearMap.span_singleton_eq_range,
      ← LinearMap.span_singleton_eq_range, ← Submodule.span_union, Set.singleton_union, hspan]
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp hrange
  
  haveI : Finite (ZMod n × ZMod n) := inferInstance
  have hcard2 : Nat.card (ZMod n × ZMod n) = n ^ 2 := by
    rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_zmod, sq]
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite A
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite (ZMod n × ZMod n)
  have hcardeq : Fintype.card (ZMod n × ZMod n) = Fintype.card A := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hcard, hcard2]
  have hbij : Function.Bijective f :=
    (Fintype.bijective_iff_surjective_and_card f).mpr ⟨hsurj, hcardeq⟩
  exact ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofBijective f hbij).symm.toAddEquiv⟩

name: AddCommGroup.zmultiples_sum_of_one_eq_top
statement:
theorem zmultiples_sum_of_one_eq_top {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] (a : κ → ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ k, a k ≠ 0) (hco : Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on a)) :
    AddSubgroup.zmultiples (∑ k, DirectSum.of (fun k => ZMod (a k)) k 1) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero (∏ k, a k) := ⟨Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun k _ => ha k⟩
  set G : (⨁ k, ZMod (a k)) := ∑ k, DirectSum.of (fun k => ZMod (a k)) k 1 with hG
  
  let Φ : (⨁ k, ZMod (a k)) ≃+ ZMod (∏ k, a k) :=
    (DirectSum.addEquivProd (fun k => ZMod (a k))).trans (ZMod.prodEquivPi a hco).symm.toAddEquiv
  
  have hprod : DirectSum.addEquivProd (fun k => ZMod (a k)) G = fun _ => 1 := by
    funext k
    have hval : DirectSum.addEquivProd (fun k => ZMod (a k)) G k = G k := rfl
    rw [hval, hG, DirectSum.sum_apply]
    simp [DirectSum.of_apply]
  have hsymm : (ZMod.prodEquivPi a hco).symm (fun _ => 1) = 1 := by
    apply (ZMod.prodEquivPi a hco).injective
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    funext k
    rw [ZMod.prodEquivPi_apply, map_one]
  have hΦG : Φ G = 1 := by
    have h1 : Φ G
        = (ZMod.prodEquivPi a hco).symm (DirectSum.addEquivProd (fun k => ZMod (a k)) G) := rfl
    rw [h1, hprod, hsymm]
  rw [AddSubgroup.eq_top_iff']
  intro d
  have hd : d = (Φ d).val • G := by
    have h2 : Φ d = (Φ d).val • Φ G := by
      rw [hΦG, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    calc d = Φ.symm (Φ d) := (Φ.symm_apply_apply d).symm
      _ = Φ.symm ((Φ d).val • Φ G) := by rw [← h2]
      _ = (Φ d).val • Φ.symm (Φ G) := by rw [map_nsmul]
      _ = (Φ d).val • G := by rw [Φ.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [hd]
  exact nsmul_mem (AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples G) _

name: AddCommGroup.exists_two_gen_of_coloring
statement:
theorem exists_two_gen_of_coloring {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (a : ι → ℕ)
    (ha : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0) (color : ι → Bool)
    (hc : ∀ i j, color i = color j → i ≠ j → (a i).Coprime (a j)) :
    ∃ g₁ g₂ : ⨁ i, ZMod (a i),
      AddSubgroup.closure ({g₁, g₂} : Set (⨁ i, ZMod (a i))) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  set G : Bool → (⨁ i, ZMod (a i)) :=
    fun b => ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => color i = b),
      DirectSum.of (fun i => ZMod (a i)) i 1 with hGdef
  refine ⟨G false, G true, ?_⟩
  
  have key : ∀ i, DirectSum.of (fun i => ZMod (a i)) i 1 ∈
      AddSubgroup.closure ({G false, G true} : Set (⨁ i, ZMod (a i))) := by
    intro i
    let κ := {i' : ι // color i' = color i}
    let incl : (⨁ j : κ, ZMod (a j.val)) →+ (⨁ i, ZMod (a i)) :=
      DirectSum.toAddMonoid (fun j => DirectSum.of (fun i => ZMod (a i)) j.val)
    have hcop : Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on fun j : κ => a j.val) := by
      intro j₁ j₂ hj
      exact hc j₁.val j₂.val (j₁.2.trans j₂.2.symm) (fun h => hj (Subtype.ext h))
    have htop := zmultiples_sum_of_one_eq_top (fun j : κ => a j.val) (fun j => ha j.val) hcop
    have hi : DirectSum.of (fun j : κ => ZMod (a j.val)) ⟨i, rfl⟩ 1 ∈
        AddSubgroup.zmultiples (∑ j, DirectSum.of (fun j : κ => ZMod (a j.val)) j 1) := by
      rw [htop]; exact AddSubgroup.mem_top _
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff] at hi
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hi
    have himg : incl (DirectSum.of (fun j : κ => ZMod (a j.val)) ⟨i, rfl⟩ 1)
        = DirectSum.of (fun i => ZMod (a i)) i 1 := by
      simp only [incl, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
    have hGb : incl (∑ j, DirectSum.of (fun j : κ => ZMod (a j.val)) j 1) = G (color i) := by
      rw [map_sum, hGdef]
      simp only [incl, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
      exact (Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.univ.filter fun i' => color i' = color i)
        (p := fun i' => color i' = color i) (fun x => by simp)
        (fun i' => DirectSum.of (fun i => ZMod (a i)) i' 1)).symm
    have heq : DirectSum.of (fun i => ZMod (a i)) i 1 = k • G (color i) := by
      rw [← himg, ← hk, map_zsmul, hGb]
    rw [heq]
    refine zsmul_mem (AddSubgroup.subset_closure ?_) k
    cases h : color i <;> simp
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro d _
  rw [← DirectSum.sum_univ_of d]
  refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ (fun i _ => ?_)
  have hdi : d i = (d i).val • (1 : ZMod (a i)) := by
    haveI : NeZero (a i) := ⟨ha i⟩
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  have hof : DirectSum.of (fun i => ZMod (a i)) i (d i)
      = (d i).val • DirectSum.of (fun i => ZMod (a i)) i 1 := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hdi]
    rw [map_nsmul]
  rw [hof]
  exact nsmul_mem (key i) _

name: AddCommGroup.card_nsmul_eq_zero_congr
statement:
theorem card_nsmul_eq_zero_congr {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] (e : A ≃+ B) (q : ℕ) :
    Nat.card {a : A // q • a = 0} = Nat.card {b : B // q • b = 0}
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.card_congr
  refine Equiv.subtypeEquiv e.toEquiv (fun a => ?_)
  change q • a = 0 ↔ q • e a = 0
  rw [← map_nsmul, EmbeddingLike.map_eq_zero_iff]

name: AddCommGroup.card_le_card_nsmul_eq_zero_zmod
statement:
theorem card_le_card_nsmul_eq_zero_zmod {q e : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (he : 0 < e) :
    q ≤ Nat.card {x : ZMod (q ^ e) // q • x = 0}
proof:
:= by
  have hqe : q ^ e ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hq.ne'
  haveI : NeZero (q ^ e) := ⟨hqe⟩
  set y : ZMod (q ^ e) := ((q ^ (e - 1) : ℕ) : ZMod (q ^ e)) with hy
  have hqy : q • y = 0 := by
    rw [hy, nsmul_eq_mul, ← Nat.cast_mul,
      show q * q ^ (e - 1) = q ^ e by rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel he]]
    exact ZMod.natCast_self _
  
  have hsub : ∀ z ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples y, q • z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp hz
    rw [smul_comm, hqy, smul_zero]
  have hcard : q ≤ Nat.card (AddSubgroup.zmultiples y) := by
    rw [Nat.card_zmultiples, hy, ZMod.addOrderOf_coe _ hqe,
      Nat.gcd_eq_right (pow_dvd_pow q (Nat.sub_le e 1)),
      Nat.pow_div (Nat.sub_le e 1) hq, Nat.sub_sub_self he, pow_one]
  refine hcard.trans (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective
    (fun z => (⟨z.1, hsub z.1 z.2⟩ : {x : ZMod (q ^ e) // q • x = 0}))
    (fun z₁ z₂ h => Subtype.ext (by simpa using h)))

name: AddCommGroup.card_nsmul_eq_zero_directSum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [card_nsmul_eq_zero_congr (DirectSum.addEquivProd B) q]
  rw [Nat.card_congr (show {f : (∀ i, B i) // q • f = 0} ≃ ∀ i, {x : B i // q • x = 0} from
    (Equiv.subtypeEquiv (Equiv.refl _) (fun f => by
      simp only [Equiv.refl_apply, funext_iff, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.zero_apply])).trans
      (Equiv.subtypePiEquivPi))]
  exact Nat.card_pi

name: AddCommGroup.equiv_zmod_sq_of_card_sq
statement:
theorem equiv_zmod_sq_of_card_sq [Finite A] {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hkill : ∀ a : A, n • a = 0) (hcard : Nat.card A = n ^ 2)
    (hrank : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → Nat.card {a : A // p • a = 0} ≤ p ^ 2) :
    Nonempty (A ≃+ ZMod n × ZMod n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, p, hp, ef, ⟨e⟩⟩ := AddCommGroup.equiv_directSum_zmod_of_finite A
  set a : ι → ℕ := fun i => p i ^ ef i with ha
  have ha0 : ∀ i, a i ≠ 0 := fun i => pow_ne_zero _ (hp i).pos.ne'
  
  have hbound : ∀ q, q.Prime →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i = q ∧ 0 < ef i)).card ≤ 2 := by
    intro q hq
    have h1 : ∀ i, 1 ≤ Nat.card {x : ZMod (a i) // q • x = 0} := by
      intro i
      haveI : NeZero (a i) := ⟨ha0 i⟩
      haveI : Nonempty {x : ZMod (a i) // q • x = 0} := ⟨⟨0, smul_zero q⟩⟩
      exact Nat.card_pos
    have hq2 : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i = q ∧ 0 < ef i),
        q ≤ Nat.card {x : ZMod (a i) // q • x = 0} := by
      intro i hi
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hi
      obtain ⟨-, hpi, hei⟩ := hi
      have hai : a i = q ^ ef i := by simp only [ha, hpi]
      rw [hai]
      exact card_le_card_nsmul_eq_zero_zmod hq.pos hei
    have hprodge : q ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i = q ∧ 0 < ef i)).card ≤
        Nat.card {x : A // q • x = 0} := by
      rw [card_nsmul_eq_zero_congr e q, card_nsmul_eq_zero_directSum]
      calc q ^ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i = q ∧ 0 < ef i)).card
          = ∏ _i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i = q ∧ 0 < ef i), q := by
            rw [Finset.prod_const]
        _ ≤ ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => p i = q ∧ 0 < ef i),
              Nat.card {x : ZMod (a i) // q • x = 0} := Finset.prod_le_prod' hq2
        _ ≤ ∏ i, Nat.card {x : ZMod (a i) // q • x = 0} :=
            Finset.prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le' (Finset.subset_univ _)
              (fun i _ _ => h1 i)
    exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right hq.one_lt).mp (hprodge.trans (hrank q hq))
  
  let fo := Fintype.equivFin ι
  let color : ι → Bool := fun i => decide (∃ j, fo j < fo i ∧ p j = p i ∧ 0 < ef j)
  have hcolor : ∀ i j, color i = color j → i ≠ j → (a i).Coprime (a j) := by
    intro i j hcc hne
    by_contra hnc
    have hei : 0 < ef i := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (ef i) with h | h
      · exact absurd (by rw [ha]; simp [h]) hnc
      · exact h
    have hej : 0 < ef j := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (ef j) with h | h
      · exact absurd (by rw [ha]; simp [h]) hnc
      · exact h
    have hpij : p i = p j := by
      by_contra hpne
      have hcopow : (p i ^ ef i).Coprime (p j ^ ef j) :=
        Nat.Coprime.pow (ef i) (ef j) ((Nat.coprime_primes (hp i) (hp j)).mpr hpne)
      exact hnc (by simpa only [ha] using hcopow)
    have hfij : fo i ≠ fo j := fun h => hne (fo.injective h)
    
    have contra : ∀ k, k ≠ i → k ≠ j → p k = p i → 0 < ef k → False := by
      intro k hki hkj hk2 hk3
      have h2lt : 2 < (Finset.univ.filter (fun i' => p i' = p i ∧ 0 < ef i')).card :=
        Finset.two_lt_card_iff.mpr ⟨k, i, j,
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hk2, hk3⟩,
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, rfl, hei⟩,
          Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hpij.symm, hej⟩, hki, hkj, hne⟩
      exact absurd (hbound (p i) (hp i)) (by omega)
    rcases lt_trichotomy (fo i) (fo j) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · have hcj : color j = true := by
        simp only [color, decide_eq_true_eq]; exact ⟨i, hlt, hpij, hei⟩
      have hci : color i = true := hcc ▸ hcj
      simp only [color, decide_eq_true_eq] at hci
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2, hk3⟩ := hci
      exact contra k (fun h => (ne_of_lt hk1) (congrArg fo h))
        (fun h => (ne_of_lt (hk1.trans hlt)) (congrArg fo h)) hk2 hk3
    · exact hfij heq
    · have hci : color i = true := by
        simp only [color, decide_eq_true_eq]; exact ⟨j, hgt, hpij.symm, hej⟩
      have hcj : color j = true := hcc ▸ hci
      simp only [color, decide_eq_true_eq] at hcj
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2, hk3⟩ := hcj
      exact contra k (fun h => (ne_of_lt (hk1.trans hgt)) (congrArg fo h))
        (fun h => (ne_of_lt hk1) (congrArg fo h)) (hk2.trans hpij.symm) hk3
  
  obtain ⟨G₀, G₁, hG⟩ := exists_two_gen_of_coloring a ha0 color hcolor
  refine equiv_zmod_sq_of_two_gen hn hkill hcard (g₁ := e.symm G₀) (g₂ := e.symm G₁) ?_
  have himg : (e.symm : (⨁ i, ZMod (a i)) →+ A) '' {G₀, G₁} = {e.symm G₀, e.symm G₁} := by
    simp [Set.image_insert_eq]
  rw [show ({e.symm G₀, e.symm G₁} : Set A) = (e.symm : (⨁ i, ZMod (a i)) →+ A) '' {G₀, G₁} from
    himg.symm, ← AddMonoidHom.map_closure, hG,
    AddSubgroup.map_top_of_surjective _ e.symm.surjective]

name: WeierstrassCurve.HasChordSum.map
statement:
theorem HasChordSum.map {W : WeierstrassCurve R} {n : ℤ} (h : W.HasChordSum n) (f : R →+* S) :
    (W.map f).HasChordSum n
proof:
:= by
  have H := congrArg (Polynomial.map f) h
  simpa only [HasChordSum, map_Φ, map_ΨSq, WeierstrassCurve.map_b₂, WeierstrassCurve.map_b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.map_b₆, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_pow,
    Polynomial.map_ofNat, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X] using H

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasChordSum_of_map
statement:
theorem hasChordSum_of_map {W : WeierstrassCurve R} {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {n : ℤ} (h : (W.map f).HasChordSum n) : W.HasChordSum n
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.map_injective f hf ?_
  simpa only [HasChordSum, map_Φ, map_ΨSq, WeierstrassCurve.map_b₂, WeierstrassCurve.map_b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.map_b₆, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_pow,
    Polynomial.map_ofNat, Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X] using h

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasChordSum_of_univ
statement:
theorem hasChordSum_of_univ {n : ℤ} (h : univ.HasChordSum n) (W : WeierstrassCurve R) :
    W.HasChordSum n
proof:
:= by
  have H := h.map W.specialize
  rwa [univ_map_specialize] at H

name: WeierstrassCurve.forall_hasChordSum_iff_univ
statement:
theorem forall_hasChordSum_iff_univ {n : ℤ} :
    (∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] (W : WeierstrassCurve R), W.HasChordSum n) ↔ univ.HasChordSum n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h _ univ, fun h _ _ W => hasChordSum_of_univ h W⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasChordSum_of_univQ
statement:
theorem hasChordSum_of_univQ {n : ℤ} (h : univQ.HasChordSum n) (W : WeierstrassCurve R) :
    W.HasChordSum n
proof:
:=
  hasChordSum_of_univ (hasChordSum_of_map (MvPolynomial.map_injective _ Int.cast_injective) h) W

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasChordSum_neg
statement:
theorem hasChordSum_neg {W : WeierstrassCurve R} {n : ℤ} (h : W.HasChordSum n) :
    W.HasChordSum (-n)
proof:
:= by
  have e₁ : -n + 1 = -(n - 1) := by ring
  have e₂ : -n - 1 = -(n + 1) := by ring
  rw [HasChordSum, e₁, e₂, Φ_neg, Φ_neg, ΨSq_neg, ΨSq_neg, Φ_neg, ΨSq_neg]
  rw [HasChordSum] at h
  linear_combination h

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasChordSum_zero
statement: theorem hasChordSum_zero (W : WeierstrassCurve R) : W.HasChordSum 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasChordSum]
  norm_num [Φ_zero, Φ_one, ΨSq_zero, ΨSq_one, show (0 : ℤ) - 1 = -1 from rfl, Φ_neg, ΨSq_neg]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasChordSum_one
statement: theorem hasChordSum_one (W : WeierstrassCurve R) : W.HasChordSum 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasChordSum]
  norm_num [Φ_zero, Φ_one, Φ_two, ΨSq_zero, ΨSq_one, ΨSq_two, Ψ₂Sq, b₈, map_ofNat]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.univ_Δ_ne_zero
statement: theorem univ_Δ_ne_zero : univ.Δ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : (univ.map (WeierstrassCurve.specialize
      (⟨0, 0, 0, 0, 1⟩ : WeierstrassCurve ℤ))).Δ = 0 := by rw [map_Δ, h, map_zero]
  rw [univ_map_specialize] at h1
  norm_num [WeierstrassCurve.Δ, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₈] at h1

name: WeierstrassCurve.univQ_Δ_ne_zero
statement: theorem univQ_Δ_ne_zero : univQ.Δ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [univQ, map_Δ]
  exact fun h => univ_Δ_ne_zero
    (MvPolynomial.map_injective _ Int.cast_injective (by rw [h, map_zero]))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_add_addX_negY
statement:
theorem addX_add_addX_negY [DecidableEq F] {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : F} (h₁ : W.Equation x₁ y₁)
    (h₂ : W.Equation x₂ y₂) (hx : x₁ ≠ x₂) :
    2 * (W.addX x₁ x₂ (W.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂)
          + W.addX x₁ x₂ (W.slope x₁ x₂ y₁ (W.negY x₂ y₂))) * (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2
      = W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₁ + W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₂ - (W.b₂ + 4 * (x₁ + x₂)) * (x₁ - x₂) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [equation_iff] at h₁ h₂
  rw [slope_of_X_ne hx, slope_of_X_ne hx]
  have hd : x₁ - x₂ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hx
  simp only [addX, negY, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X, eval_ofNat, map_ofNat]
  field_simp
  linear_combination (4 : F) * h₁ + (4 : F) * h₂

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.chordSum_eval_of_chord
statement:
private theorem chordSum_eval_of_chord {x u a b : F} (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {m p n : ℤ}
    (hm : (W.ΨSq m).eval x ≠ 0) (hp : (W.ΨSq p).eval x ≠ 0)
    (hn : (W.ΨSq n).eval x ≠ 0)
    (hu : u = (W.Φ m).eval x / (W.ΨSq m).eval x)
    (ha : a = (W.Φ p).eval x / (W.ΨSq p).eval x)
    (hb : b = (W.Φ n).eval x / (W.ΨSq n).eval x)
    (hG : (x * (W.ΨSq m).eval x - (W.Φ m).eval x) ^ 2
        = (W.ΨSq p).eval x * (W.ΨSq n).eval x)
    (hchord : 2 * (a + b) * (u - x) ^ 2
        = W.Ψ₂Sq.eval u + W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x - (W.b₂ + 4 * (u + x)) * (u - x) ^ 2) :
    (W.Φ p).eval x * (W.ΨSq n).eval x + (W.Φ n).eval x * (W.ΨSq p).eval x
      = 2 * x * (W.Φ m).eval x ^ 2
        + (2 * x ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x + W.b₄) * (W.Φ m).eval x * (W.ΨSq m).eval x
        + (W.b₄ * x + W.b₆) * (W.ΨSq m).eval x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  subst hu ha hb
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X, eval_ofNat,
    map_ofNat] at hchord
  field_simp at hchord
  rw [← hG] at hchord
  have hG2 : (x * (W.ΨSq m).eval x - (W.Φ m).eval x) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hG]; exact mul_ne_zero hp hn
  have key : (x * (W.ΨSq m).eval x - (W.Φ m).eval x) ^ 2 *
      (2 * (W.ΨSq m).eval x *
        ((W.Φ p).eval x * (W.ΨSq n).eval x + (W.Φ n).eval x * (W.ΨSq p).eval x))
      = (x * (W.ΨSq m).eval x - (W.Φ m).eval x) ^ 2 *
      (2 * (W.ΨSq m).eval x *
        (2 * x * (W.Φ m).eval x ^ 2
          + (2 * x ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x + W.b₄) * (W.Φ m).eval x * (W.ΨSq m).eval x
          + (W.b₄ * x + W.b₆) * (W.ΨSq m).eval x ^ 2)) := by
    linear_combination hchord
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero h2 hm) (mul_left_cancel₀ hG2 key)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.chordSum_eval
statement:
private theorem chordSum_eval (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) {x : F}
    (h0 : (W.ΨSq ((k : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x ≠ 0)
    (h1 : (W.ΨSq (((k + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x ≠ 0)
    (h2' : (W.ΨSq (((k + 2 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x ≠ 0) :
    (W.Φ (((k + 2 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x * (W.ΨSq ((k : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x
        + (W.Φ ((k : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x * (W.ΨSq (((k + 2 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x
      = 2 * x * (W.Φ (((k + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x ^ 2
        + (2 * x ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x + W.b₄) * (W.Φ (((k + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x
            * (W.ΨSq (((k + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x
        + (W.b₄ * x + W.b₆) * (W.ΨSq (((k + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have e0 : ((k : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((k : ℤ) + 1) - 1 := by ring
  have e2 : ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((k : ℤ) + 1) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  have e1 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast rfl
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_equation (W := W) h2 x
  have hns : W.Nonsingular x y := (equation_iff_nonsingular ..).mp hy
  obtain ⟨ym, hnsm, hQ⟩ := hasXCoordFormula_of_two_ne_zero (W := W) h2 (k + 1) hns h1
  obtain ⟨ya, hnsa, hA⟩ := hasXCoordFormula_of_two_ne_zero (W := W) h2 (k + 2) hns h2'
  obtain ⟨yb, hnsb, hB⟩ := hasXCoordFormula_of_two_ne_zero (W := W) h2 k hns h0
  set u := (W.Φ (((k + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x / (W.ΨSq (((k + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x with hu
  have hψ1 : (W.ψ (((k : ℤ) + 1) + 1)).evalEval x y ≠ 0 := fun hz =>
    h2' (by rw [e2, ← ψ_sq_evalEval hy, hz]; ring)
  have hψ2 : (W.ψ (((k : ℤ) + 1) - 1)).evalEval x y ≠ 0 := fun hz =>
    h0 (by rw [e0, ← ψ_sq_evalEval hy, hz]; ring)
  have hux : u ≠ x := by
    intro h
    rcases (Φ_div_ΨSq_eq_iff hy (p := (k : ℤ) + 1) (q := 1) (by rwa [e1] at h1)
      (by simp [ΨSq_one])).mp
      (by rw [Φ_one, ΨSq_one, eval_X, eval_one, div_one]
          rw [hu, e1] at h
          exact h.symm) with h' | h'
    · exact hψ1 h'
    · exact hψ2 h'
  have hstep : (k + 1) • Point.some x y hns + Point.some x y hns
      = (k + 2) • Point.some x y hns := by
    conv_rhs => rw [show k + 2 = (k + 1) + 1 from rfl, succ_nsmul]
  have hstep' : k • Point.some x y hns + Point.some x y hns
      = (k + 1) • Point.some x y hns := by conv_rhs => rw [succ_nsmul]
  have hsum : Point.some u ym hnsm + Point.some x y hns
      = Point.some (W.addX u x (W.slope u x ym y)) _
        (nonsingular_add hnsm hns fun hxy => hux hxy.left) := Point.add_of_X_ne hux
  have hdif : Point.some u ym hnsm + -Point.some x y hns
      = Point.some (W.addX u x (W.slope u x ym (W.negY x y))) _
        (nonsingular_add hnsm ((nonsingular_neg ..).mpr hns) fun hxy => hux hxy.left) :=
    Point.add_of_X_ne hux
  have ha : W.addX u x (W.slope u x ym y)
      = (W.Φ (((k + 2 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x / (W.ΨSq (((k + 2 : ℕ)) : ℤ)).eval x := by
    rw [hQ, hA, hsum] at hstep
    simp only [Point.some.injEq] at hstep
    exact hstep.1
  have hb : W.addX u x (W.slope u x ym (W.negY x y))
      = (W.Φ ((k : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x / (W.ΨSq ((k : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x := by
    have hk : k • Point.some x y hns = Point.some u ym hnsm + -Point.some x y hns := by
      rw [← hQ, ← hstep']; abel
    rw [hB, hdif] at hk
    simp only [Point.some.injEq] at hk
    exact hk.1.symm
  refine chordSum_eval_of_chord h2 h1 h2' h0 hu rfl rfl ?_ ?_
  · have hid := ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_evalEval hy ((k : ℤ) + 1) 1
    rw [Φ_one, ΨSq_one, eval_X, eval_one, mul_one, ← e2, ← e0, ← e1] at hid
    rw [← hid, mul_pow, ψ_sq_evalEval hy, ψ_sq_evalEval hy]
  · rw [← ha, ← hb]
    exact addX_add_addX_negY hnsm.left hy hux

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.hasChordSum_succ
statement:
private theorem hasChordSum_succ [CharZero F] (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    W.HasChordSum ((k : ℤ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0 := two_ne_zero
  have e0 : ((k : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((k : ℤ) + 1) - 1 := by ring
  have e2 : ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((k : ℤ) + 1) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  have e1 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) + 1 := by exact_mod_cast rfl
  have c0 : ((k : ℕ) : F) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hk
  have c1 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : F) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
  have c2 : ((k + 2 : ℕ) : F) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero (k + 1))
  have n0 : W.ΨSq ((k : ℕ) : ℤ) ≠ 0 := W.ΨSq_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast c0)
  have n1 : W.ΨSq ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≠ 0 := W.ΨSq_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast c1)
  have n2 : W.ΨSq ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≠ 0 := W.ΨSq_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast c2)
  rw [HasChordSum, ← e2, ← e0, ← e1]
  refine mul_left_cancel₀ (a := W.ΨSq ((k : ℕ) : ℤ) * W.ΨSq ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
    * W.ΨSq ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero n0 n1) n2) ?_
  refine Polynomial.funext fun x => ?_
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_add, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C, eval_ofNat]
  by_cases h0 : (W.ΨSq ((k : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x = 0
  · rw [h0]; ring
  by_cases h1 : (W.ΨSq ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x = 0
  · rw [h1]; ring
  by_cases h2' : (W.ΨSq ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x = 0
  · rw [h2']; ring
  rw [chordSum_eval h2 k h0 h1 h2']

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.hasChordSum_of_isAlgClosed
statement: theorem hasChordSum_of_isAlgClosed [CharZero F] (n : ℤ) : W.HasChordSum n
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ m : ℕ, W.HasChordSum (m : ℤ) by
    by_cases hn : 0 ≤ n
    · lift n to ℕ using hn; exact h n
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℕ, n = -(m : ℤ) := ⟨(-n).toNat, by omega⟩
      rw [hm]
      exact hasChordSum_neg (h m)
  intro m
  match m with
  | 0 => exact_mod_cast hasChordSum_zero W
  | 1 => exact_mod_cast hasChordSum_one W
  | (k + 2) =>
      rw [show ((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 by push_cast; ring]
      exact hasChordSum_succ (k + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasChordSum
statement: theorem hasChordSum (W : WeierstrassCurve R) (n : ℤ) : W.HasChordSum n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine hasChordSum_of_univQ ?_ W
  set B := MvPolynomial (Fin 5) ℚ with hB
  set K := AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing B) with hK
  set f : B →+* K := (algebraMap (FractionRing B) K).comp (algebraMap B (FractionRing B)) with hf
  have hfinj : Function.Injective f :=
    (algebraMap (FractionRing B) K).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective B (FractionRing B))
  refine hasChordSum_of_map (f := f) hfinj ?_
  haveI : (univQ.map f).IsElliptic := by
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [map_Δ]
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h => univQ_Δ_ne_zero ((map_eq_zero_iff f hfinj).mp h)
  exact Affine.hasChordSum_of_isAlgClosed n

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasChordSum_cleared
statement:
theorem hasChordSum_cleared (W : WeierstrassCurve R) (n : ℤ) :
    2 * W.ΨSq n ^ 2 * (W.Φ (n + 1) * W.ΨSq (n - 1) + W.Φ (n - 1) * W.ΨSq (n + 1))
      = W.ΨSq (2 * n) + W.ΨSq n ^ 4 * W.Ψ₂Sq
        - C W.b₂ * W.ΨSq n ^ 2 * (X * W.ΨSq n - W.Φ n) ^ 2
        - 4 * W.ΨSq n * (W.Φ n + X * W.ΨSq n) * (X * W.ΨSq n - W.Φ n) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h : W.Φ (n + 1) * W.ΨSq (n - 1) + W.Φ (n - 1) * W.ΨSq (n + 1) =
      2 * X * W.Φ n ^ 2 + (2 * X ^ 2 + C W.b₂ * X + C W.b₄) * W.Φ n * W.ΨSq n +
        (C W.b₄ * X + C W.b₆) * W.ΨSq n ^ 2 := W.hasChordSum n
  rw [W.hasΨSqDoubling n, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq]
  simp only [map_ofNat, map_mul]
  linear_combination (2 * W.ΨSq n ^ 2) * h

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasChordSum_two_of_b_relation
statement:
theorem hasChordSum_two_of_b_relation (W : WeierstrassCurve R) :
    W.Φ 3 * W.ΨSq 1 + W.Φ 1 * W.ΨSq 3
      = 2 * X * W.Φ 2 ^ 2 + (2 * X ^ 2 + C W.b₂ * X + C W.b₄) * W.Φ 2 * W.ΨSq 2
        + (C W.b₄ * X + C W.b₆) * W.ΨSq 2 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (4 : R[X]) * C W.b₈ = C W.b₂ * C W.b₆ - C W.b₄ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [map_mul, map_sub, map_pow, map_ofNat] using congrArg (C : R →+* R[X]) W.b_relation
  simp only [Φ_three, ΨSq_three, Φ_one, ΨSq_one, Φ_two, ΨSq_two, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃,
    WeierstrassCurve.preΨ₄, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, map_mul, map_sub, map_pow, map_ofNat]
  linear_combination (-(X ^ 2) * (4 * X ^ 3 + C W.b₂ * X ^ 2 + 2 * C W.b₄ * X + C W.b₆)) * hb

name: IsEllipticNet.mul_two_mul_eq_of_rel
statement:
theorem mul_two_mul_eq_of_rel {W : ℤ → R} (odd : Function.Odd W) {p q : ℤ}
    (h : rel W p (p + q) (p - q) q = 0) :
    W (2 * q) * W (2 * p + q) * W p * W (p + q)
      = W q * (W (2 * p) * W (p + 2 * q) * W (p + q)
        + W (2 * p + 2 * q) * W p * W (p - q))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel] at h
  rw [show p + (p + q) + q = 2 * p + 2 * q from by ring, show p - (p + q) = -q from by ring,
    show p - q + q = p from by ring, show p + (p - q) + q = 2 * p from by ring,
    show p - (p - q) = q from by ring, show p + q + q = p + 2 * q from by ring,
    show p + q + (p - q) + q = 2 * p + q from by ring,
    show p + q - (p - q) = 2 * q from by ring, odd q] at h
  linear_combination h

name: IsEllipticNet.cyclic_two_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cyclic_two_mul_eq_zero {W : ℤ → R} (odd : Function.Odd W) (h : IsEllipticNet W)
    {u v w : ℤ} (huvw : u + v + w = 0) :
    W (2 * u) * W (v - w) * W v * W w + W (2 * v) * W (w - u) * W w * W u
      + W (2 * w) * W (u - v) * W u * W v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hw : w = -u - v := by omega
  subst hw
  have key := mul_two_mul_eq_of_rel odd (h u (u + v) (u - v) v)
  rw [show v - (-u - v) = u + 2 * v from by ring, show -u - v - u = -(2 * u + v) from by ring,
    show 2 * (-u - v) = -(2 * u + 2 * v) from by ring, show -u - v = -(u + v) from by ring,
    odd (2 * u + v), odd (2 * u + 2 * v), odd (u + v)]
  linear_combination key

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_cyclic_two_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem normEDS_cyclic_two_mul_eq_zero (b c d : R) {u v w : ℤ} (huvw : u + v + w = 0) :
    normEDS b c d (2 * u) * normEDS b c d (v - w) * normEDS b c d v * normEDS b c d w
      + normEDS b c d (2 * v) * normEDS b c d (w - u) * normEDS b c d w * normEDS b c d u
      + normEDS b c d (2 * w) * normEDS b c d (u - v) * normEDS b c d u * normEDS b c d v = 0
proof:
:=
  IsEllipticNet.cyclic_two_mul_eq_zero (fun n => normEDS_neg b c d n)
    (normEDS_isEllipticNet b c d) huvw

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_one_two_three_five
