name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_cyclic_two_mul_witness
statement:
theorem normEDS_cyclic_two_mul_witness :
    normEDS (1 : ℤ) 2 3 (2 * 3) * normEDS 1 2 3 (1 - -4) * normEDS 1 2 3 1 * normEDS 1 2 3 (-4)
        = -420 ∧
      normEDS (1 : ℤ) 2 3 (2 * 1) * normEDS 1 2 3 (-4 - 3) * normEDS 1 2 3 (-4) * normEDS 1 2 3 3
        = -402 ∧
      normEDS (1 : ℤ) 2 3 (2 * -4) * normEDS 1 2 3 (3 - 1) * normEDS 1 2 3 3 * normEDS 1 2 3 1
        = 822
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    norm_num [show (2 : ℤ) * 3 = 6 by norm_num, show (1 : ℤ) - -4 = 5 by norm_num,
      show (-4 : ℤ) - 3 = -7 by norm_num, show (2 : ℤ) * -4 = -8 by norm_num,
      show (3 : ℤ) - 1 = 2 by norm_num, show (-4 : ℤ) = -(4 : ℤ) by norm_num,
      show (-7 : ℤ) = -(7 : ℤ) by norm_num, show (-8 : ℤ) = -(8 : ℤ) by norm_num, normEDS_neg,
      normEDS_one, normEDS_two, normEDS_three, normEDS_four, normEDS_one_two_three_five,
      normEDS_one_two_three_six, normEDS_one_two_three_seven, normEDS_one_two_three_eight]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_cyclic_two_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ψ_cyclic_two_mul_eq_zero {u v w : ℤ} (huvw : u + v + w = 0) :
    W.ψ (2 * u) * W.ψ (v - w) * W.ψ v * W.ψ w + W.ψ (2 * v) * W.ψ (w - u) * W.ψ w * W.ψ u
      + W.ψ (2 * w) * W.ψ (u - v) * W.ψ u * W.ψ v = 0
proof:
:=
  IsEllipticNet.cyclic_two_mul_eq_zero (fun n => W.ψ_neg n) W.ψ_isEllipticNet huvw

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_cyclic_two_mul_evalEval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ψ_cyclic_two_mul_evalEval_eq_zero {u v w : ℤ} (huvw : u + v + w = 0) :
    (W.ψ (2 * u)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (v - w)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ v).evalEval x y
        * (W.ψ w).evalEval x y
      + (W.ψ (2 * v)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (w - u)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ w).evalEval x y
        * (W.ψ u).evalEval x y
      + (W.ψ (2 * w)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (u - v)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ u).evalEval x y
        * (W.ψ v).evalEval x y = 0
proof:
:=
  IsEllipticNet.cyclic_two_mul_eq_zero (W := fun n => (W.ψ n).evalEval x y)
    (fun n => by simp only [ψ_neg, evalEval_neg]) W.ψ_isEllipticNet_evalEval huvw

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.collinear_div
statement:
theorem collinear_div (h : W.Equation x y) {u v w : ℤ} (huvw : u + v + w = 0)
    (hu : (W.ΨSq u).eval x ≠ 0) (hv : (W.ΨSq v).eval x ≠ 0) (hw : (W.ΨSq w).eval x ≠ 0) :
    (W.ψ (2 * u)).evalEval x y / (W.ΨSq u).eval x ^ 2
        * ((W.Φ v).eval x / (W.ΨSq v).eval x - (W.Φ w).eval x / (W.ΨSq w).eval x)
      + (W.ψ (2 * v)).evalEval x y / (W.ΨSq v).eval x ^ 2
        * ((W.Φ w).eval x / (W.ΨSq w).eval x - (W.Φ u).eval x / (W.ΨSq u).eval x)
      + (W.ψ (2 * w)).evalEval x y / (W.ΨSq w).eval x ^ 2
        * ((W.Φ u).eval x / (W.ΨSq u).eval x - (W.Φ v).eval x / (W.ΨSq v).eval x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (W.Φ v).eval x / (W.ΨSq v).eval x - (W.Φ w).eval x / (W.ΨSq w).eval x
      = (W.ψ u).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (v - w)).evalEval x y
          / ((W.ΨSq v).eval x * (W.ΨSq w).eval x) := by
    rw [Φ_div_ΨSq_sub_Φ_div_ΨSq h hw hv, show w + v = -u from by omega,
      show w - v = -(v - w) from by ring, ψ_neg, ψ_neg, evalEval_neg, evalEval_neg]
    ring
  have e2 : (W.Φ w).eval x / (W.ΨSq w).eval x - (W.Φ u).eval x / (W.ΨSq u).eval x
      = (W.ψ v).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (w - u)).evalEval x y
          / ((W.ΨSq w).eval x * (W.ΨSq u).eval x) := by
    rw [Φ_div_ΨSq_sub_Φ_div_ΨSq h hu hw, show u + w = -v from by omega,
      show u - w = -(w - u) from by ring, ψ_neg, ψ_neg, evalEval_neg, evalEval_neg]
    ring
  have e3 : (W.Φ u).eval x / (W.ΨSq u).eval x - (W.Φ v).eval x / (W.ΨSq v).eval x
      = (W.ψ w).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (u - v)).evalEval x y
          / ((W.ΨSq u).eval x * (W.ΨSq v).eval x) := by
    rw [Φ_div_ΨSq_sub_Φ_div_ΨSq h hv hu, show v + u = -w from by omega,
      show v - u = -(u - v) from by ring, ψ_neg, ψ_neg, evalEval_neg, evalEval_neg]
    ring
  have key := ψ_cyclic_two_mul_evalEval_eq_zero (W := W) (x := x) (y := y) huvw
  have hu' : (W.ψ u).evalEval x y ≠ 0 := fun hc => hu (by rw [← ψ_sq_evalEval h u, hc]; ring)
  have hv' : (W.ψ v).evalEval x y ≠ 0 := fun hc => hv (by rw [← ψ_sq_evalEval h v, hc]; ring)
  have hw' : (W.ψ w).evalEval x y ≠ 0 := fun hc => hw (by rw [← ψ_sq_evalEval h w, hc]; ring)
  rw [e1, e2, e3, ← ψ_sq_evalEval h u, ← ψ_sq_evalEval h v, ← ψ_sq_evalEval h w]
  set a := (W.ψ u).evalEval x y
  set b := (W.ψ v).evalEval x y
  set c := (W.ψ w).evalEval x y
  set A := (W.ψ (2 * u)).evalEval x y
  set B := (W.ψ (2 * v)).evalEval x y
  set C := (W.ψ (2 * w)).evalEval x y
  set P := (W.ψ (v - w)).evalEval x y
  set Q := (W.ψ (w - u)).evalEval x y
  set S := (W.ψ (u - v)).evalEval x y
  field_simp
  linear_combination key

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.isDedekindDomain
statement:
theorem isDedekindDomain [IsIntegrallyClosed W.CoordinateRing] :
    IsDedekindDomain W.CoordinateRing
proof:
:=
  (isDedekindDomain_iff W.CoordinateRing (FractionRing W.CoordinateRing)).mpr
    ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
      fun {_} => (isIntegrallyClosed_iff (FractionRing W.CoordinateRing)).mp inferInstance⟩

name: AddSubgroup.torsionByProdHom_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsionByProdHom_apply_coe (P : A[m] × A[n]) :
    ((torsionByProdHom A m n P : A[m * n]) : A) = (P.1 : A) + (P.2 : A)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AddSubgroup.torsionByProdHom_bijective
statement:
lemma torsionByProdHom_bijective (h : IsCoprime m n) :
    Function.Bijective (torsionByProdHom A m n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := h
  constructor
  · rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    rintro ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩⟩ hab
    rw [torsionBy.zsmul_iff] at ha hb
    have hab' : a + b = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hab
    have hb' : b = -a := (neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero_right hab').symm
    have hna : n • a = 0 := by
      have : n • b = 0 := hb
      rw [hb', smul_neg, neg_eq_zero] at this
      exact this
    have ha0 : a = 0 := by
      have h1 : (u * m + v * n) • a = a := by rw [huv, one_smul]
      rw [← h1, add_smul, mul_smul, ha, smul_zero, zero_add, mul_smul, hna, smul_zero]
    have hb0 : b = 0 := by rw [hb', ha0, neg_zero]
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext ha0) (Subtype.ext hb0)
  · intro P
    have hP : (m * n) • (P : A) = 0 := torsionBy.zsmul_iff.mp P.2
    refine ⟨(⟨v • n • (P : A), ?_⟩, ⟨u • m • (P : A), ?_⟩), ?_⟩
    · rw [torsionBy.zsmul_iff, ← mul_smul, ← mul_smul,
        show m * v * n = v * (m * n) by ring, mul_smul, hP, smul_zero]
    · rw [torsionBy.zsmul_iff, ← mul_smul, ← mul_smul,
        show n * u * m = u * (m * n) by ring, mul_smul, hP, smul_zero]
    · refine Subtype.ext ?_
      rw [torsionByProdHom_apply_coe]
      calc v • n • (P : A) + u • m • (P : A)
          = (v * n + u * m) • (P : A) := by rw [add_smul, mul_smul, mul_smul]
        _ = (P : A) := by rw [add_comm (v * n), huv, one_smul]

name: AddSubgroup.card_torsionBy_mul_of_isCoprime
statement:
theorem card_torsionBy_mul_of_isCoprime (h : IsCoprime m n) :
    Nat.card A[m * n] = Nat.card A[m] * Nat.card A[n]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (torsionByMulAddEquiv h).toEquiv, Nat.card_prod]

name: AddSubgroup.finite_torsionBy_mul_iff
statement:
theorem finite_torsionBy_mul_iff (h : IsCoprime m n) :
    Finite A[m * n] ↔ Finite A[m] ∧ Finite A[n]
proof:
:= by
  rw [(torsionByMulAddEquiv h).toEquiv.finite_iff, Prod.finite_iff]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsion_mul_eq'
statement: private lemma torsion_mul_eq' (m n : ℕ) : W.torsion (m * n) = W.Point[(m : ℤ) * (n : ℤ)]
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun k : ℤ => W.Point[k]) (Nat.cast_mul m n)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_mul
statement:
theorem card_torsion_mul (h : Nat.Coprime m n) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (m * n)) = Nat.card (W.torsion m) * Nat.card (W.torsion n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [torsion_mul_eq', AddSubgroup.card_torsionBy_mul_of_isCoprime
    (Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr h)]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_mul_iff
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_mul_iff (h : Nat.Coprime m n) :
    Finite (W.torsion (m * n)) ↔ Finite (W.torsion m) ∧ Finite (W.torsion n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [torsion_mul_eq', AddSubgroup.finite_torsionBy_mul_iff (Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr h)]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_eq_prod_factorization
statement:
theorem card_torsion_eq_prod_factorization (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n.factorization.prod fun p k => Nat.card (W.torsion (p ^ k))
proof:
:=
  Nat.multiplicative_factorization (fun k => Nat.card (W.torsion k))
    (fun _ _ h => card_torsion_mul h) (by rw [torsion_one]; simp) hn

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_mul
statement:
theorem card_torsion_two_mul [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hn : Odd n) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (2 * n)) = 4 * Nat.card (W.torsion n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_torsion_mul (Nat.coprime_two_left.mpr hn), card_torsion_two h2]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsion_two_mul_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsion_two_mul_addEquiv [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hn : Odd n) : Nonempty (W.torsion (2 * n) ≃+ (ZMod 2 × ZMod 2) × W.torsion n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv (W := W) h2
  exact ⟨(torsionMulAddEquiv (Nat.coprime_two_left.mpr hn)).trans (e.prodCongr (AddEquiv.refl _))⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent_natCast
statement:
private lemma isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent_natCast [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    IsCoprime (W.ΨSq ((n : ℤ) + 1) * W.ΨSq ((n : ℤ) - 1)) (W.ΨSq (n : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · rw [show ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0 from rfl, zero_add, zero_sub,
      WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_one, WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_neg, WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_one, one_mul]
    exact isCoprime_one_left
  refine (Polynomial.isCoprime_iff_aeval_ne_zero_of_isAlgClosed
    (K := AlgebraicClosure F) _ _ _).mpr ?_
  intro a
  by_cases hq : (aeval a) (W.ΨSq (n : ℤ)) = 0
  · left
    have h2' : (2 : AlgebraicClosure F) ≠ 0 := fun h =>
      h2 ((algebraMap F (AlgebraicClosure F)).injective (by rw [map_ofNat, map_zero]; exact h))
    have hq' : ((W.map (algebraMap F (AlgebraicClosure F))).ΨSq (n : ℤ)).eval a = 0 := by
      rw [WeierstrassCurve.map_ΨSq, eval_map, ← aeval_def]; exact hq
    have key := eval_ΨSq_adjacent_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero
      (W := W.map (algebraMap F (AlgebraicClosure F))) h2' hn hq'
    rw [map_mul]
    intro hcon
    refine key ?_
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.map_ΨSq, WeierstrassCurve.map_ΨSq, eval_map, eval_map, ← aeval_def,
      ← aeval_def]
    exact hcon
  · right
    exact hq

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent
statement:
theorem isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) :
    IsCoprime (W.ΨSq (n + 1) * W.ΨSq (n - 1)) (W.ΨSq n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq n with hn | hn
  · rw [hn]
    exact isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent_natCast h2 n.natAbs
  · rw [hn, show -(n.natAbs : ℤ) + 1 = -((n.natAbs : ℤ) - 1) by ring,
      show -(n.natAbs : ℤ) - 1 = -((n.natAbs : ℤ) + 1) by ring,
      WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_neg, WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_neg, WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_neg, mul_comm]
    exact isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent_natCast h2 n.natAbs

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isCoprime_ΨSq_succ
statement:
theorem isCoprime_ΨSq_succ [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) :
    IsCoprime (W.ΨSq (n + 1)) (W.ΨSq n)
proof:
:=
  (isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent h2 n).of_mul_left_left

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isCoprime_ΨSq_pred
statement:
theorem isCoprime_ΨSq_pred [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) :
    IsCoprime (W.ΨSq (n - 1)) (W.ΨSq n)
proof:
:=
  (isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent h2 n).of_mul_left_right

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isCoprime_Φ_ΨSq
statement:
theorem isCoprime_Φ_ΨSq [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) :
    IsCoprime (W.Φ n) (W.ΨSq n)
proof:
:=
  WeierstrassCurve.isCoprime_Φ_ΨSq_of_isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent (isCoprime_ΨSq_adjacent h2 n)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsion_addEquiv_zmod_sq_of_coprime
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsion_addEquiv_zmod_sq_of_coprime {m n : ℕ} (h : Nat.Coprime m n)
    (hm : Nonempty (W.torsion m ≃+ ZMod m × ZMod m))
    (hn : Nonempty (W.torsion n ≃+ ZMod n × ZMod n)) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion (m * n) ≃+ ZMod (m * n) × ZMod (m * n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨em⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨en⟩ := hn
  have crt : ZMod (m * n) ≃+ ZMod m × ZMod n := (ZMod.chineseRemainder h).toAddEquiv
  exact ⟨((torsionMulAddEquiv h).trans (em.prodCongr en)).trans
    ((AddEquiv.prodProdProdComm (ZMod m) (ZMod m) (ZMod n) (ZMod n)).trans
      (crt.symm.prodCongr crt.symm))⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_six
statement:
theorem card_torsion_six (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion 6) = 36
proof:
:= by
  have h : Nat.Coprime 2 3 := by decide
  have hmul := card_torsion_mul (W := W) h
  rwa [show (2 * 3 : ℕ) = 6 from rfl, card_torsion_two h2, card_torsion_three h2 h3] at hmul

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionSix_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionSix_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 6 ≃+ ZMod 6 × ZMod 6)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Nat.Coprime 2 3 := by decide
  have hsix := nonempty_torsion_addEquiv_zmod_sq_of_coprime (W := W) h
    (nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv h2) (nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv h2 h3)
  rwa [show (2 * 3 : ℕ) = 6 from rfl] at hsix

name: AddSubgroup.torsionBy.zsmul_iff
statement: lemma torsionBy.zsmul_iff {n : ℤ} {a : A} : a ∈ A[n] ↔ n • a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [torsionBy, Submodule.mem_toAddSubgroup, Submodule.mem_torsionBy_iff]

name: AddSubgroup.torsionBy_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsionBy_zero : A[(0 : ℤ)] = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp

name: AddSubgroup.torsionBy_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsionBy_one : A[(1 : ℤ)] = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [torsionBy.zsmul_iff, one_smul, AddSubgroup.mem_bot]

name: AddSubgroup.torsionBy_le_torsionBy_of_dvd
statement: lemma torsionBy_le_torsionBy_of_dvd {m n : ℤ} (h : m ∣ n) : A[m] ≤ A[n]
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  rw [torsionBy.zsmul_iff] at ha ⊢
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [mul_comm, mul_smul, ha, smul_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_torsion_iff
statement: lemma mem_torsion_iff {n : ℕ} {P : W.Point} : P ∈ W.torsion n ↔ n • P = 0
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nsmul_mem_torsion
statement: lemma nsmul_mem_torsion {n : ℕ} (P : W.torsion n) : n • P = 0
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul P

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.add_self_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_two
statement:
lemma add_self_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_two {P : W.Point} (h : P ∈ W.torsion 2) :
    P + P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn := mem_torsion_iff.mp h
  rwa [two_nsmul] at hn

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.add_add_self_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_three
statement:
lemma add_add_self_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_three {P : W.Point} (h : P ∈ W.torsion 3) :
    P + P + P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn := mem_torsion_iff.mp h
  rwa [show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 from rfl, add_smul, two_nsmul, one_nsmul] at hn

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsion_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsion_zero : W.torsion 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext P
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsion_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsion_one : W.torsion 1 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext P
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsion_mono
statement: lemma torsion_mono {m n : ℕ} (h : m ∣ n) : W.torsion m ≤ W.torsion n
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.torsionBy_le_torsionBy_of_dvd (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr h)

name: AddSubgroup.kerTorsionSmulHom_surjective
statement: theorem kerTorsionSmulHom_surjective : Function.Surjective (kerTorsionSmulHom A m n)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have han : n • (a : A) = 0 := torsionBy.zsmul_iff.mp a.2
  have hmn : (a : A) ∈ A[m * n] := by
    rw [torsionBy.zsmul_iff, mul_smul, han, smul_zero]
  refine ⟨⟨⟨(a : A), hmn⟩, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  exact AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr (Subtype.ext (by simp))

name: AddSubgroup.kerTorsionSmulHom_bijective
statement: theorem kerTorsionSmulHom_bijective : Function.Bijective (kerTorsionSmulHom A m n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨kerTorsionSmulHom_injective A m n, kerTorsionSmulHom_surjective A m n⟩

name: AddSubgroup.card_ker_torsionSmulHom
statement:
theorem card_ker_torsionSmulHom :
    Nat.card (torsionSmulHom A m n).ker = Nat.card A[n]
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_eq_of_bijective _ (kerTorsionSmulHom_bijective A m n)

name: AddSubgroup.torsionSmulHom_surjective
statement:
theorem torsionSmulHom_surjective (hn : Function.Surjective fun a : A => n • a) :
    Function.Surjective (torsionSmulHom A m n)
proof:
:= by
  intro Q
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hn (Q : A)
  have ha' : n • a = (Q : A) := ha
  have hmn : a ∈ A[m * n] := by
    rw [torsionBy.zsmul_iff, mul_smul, ha']
    exact torsionBy.zsmul_iff.mp Q.2
  exact ⟨⟨a, hmn⟩, Subtype.ext ha'⟩

name: AddSubgroup.card_torsionBy_mul_of_surjective
statement:
theorem card_torsionBy_mul_of_surjective (hn : Function.Surjective fun a : A => n • a) :
    Nat.card A[m * n] = Nat.card A[m] * Nat.card A[n]
proof:
:= by
  have hcard := (torsionSmulHom A m n).ker.card_mul_index
  rw [AddSubgroup.index_ker, card_ker_torsionSmulHom,
    AddMonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr (torsionSmulHom_surjective m hn),
    Nat.card_congr (AddSubgroup.topEquiv (G := A[m])).toEquiv] at hcard
  rw [← hcard, mul_comm]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma evalEvalHom_mk (h : W.Equation x y) (g : R[X][Y]) :
    evalEvalHom h (mk W g) = g.evalEval x y
proof:
:=
  AdjoinRoot.evalEval_mk h g

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_evalEval
statement: lemma ψ_evalEval (h : W.Equation x y) (n : ℤ) : (W.ψ n).evalEval x y = (W.Ψ n).evalEval x y
proof:
:= by
  have H := congrArg (CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom h) (CoordinateRing.mk_ψ W n)
  rwa [CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom_mk, CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom_mk] at H

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_sq_evalEval
statement:
lemma ψ_sq_evalEval (h : W.Equation x y) (n : ℤ) :
    (W.ψ n).evalEval x y ^ 2 = (W.ΨSq n).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have H := congrArg (CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom h) (CoordinateRing.mk_Ψ_sq W n)
  rw [map_pow, CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom_mk, CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom_mk, evalEval_C] at H
  rw [ψ_evalEval h, H]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ_sq_evalEval
statement:
lemma Ψ_sq_evalEval (h : W.Equation x y) (n : ℤ) :
    (W.Ψ n).evalEval x y ^ 2 = (W.ΨSq n).eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ψ_evalEval h, ψ_sq_evalEval h]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.φ_evalEval
statement: lemma φ_evalEval (h : W.Equation x y) (n : ℤ) : (W.φ n).evalEval x y = (W.Φ n).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have H := congrArg (CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom h) (CoordinateRing.mk_φ W n)
  rwa [CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom_mk, CoordinateRing.evalEvalHom_mk, evalEval_C] at H

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_zero_evalEval
statement: lemma ψ_zero_evalEval : (W.ψ 0).evalEval x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ψ_zero, evalEval_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_one_evalEval
statement: lemma ψ_one_evalEval : (W.ψ 1).evalEval x y = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ψ_one, evalEval_one]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_two_evalEval
statement: lemma ψ_two_evalEval : (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y = 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃
proof:
:= by
  rw [ψ_two]
  exact evalEval_polynomialY x y

name: WeierstrassCurve.C_b_relation
statement:
lemma C_b_relation {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (W : WeierstrassCurve R) :
    (4 : R[X]) * C W.b₈ = C W.b₂ * C W.b₆ - C W.b₄ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [map_ofNat] using congrArg C W.b_relation

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_self_eq_div
statement:
theorem addX_self_eq_div (h : W.Equation x y) (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) :
    W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y) = (W.Φ 2).eval x / W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [slope_of_Y_ne rfl hy]
  set s := 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ with hsdef
  have hden : y - W.negY x y = s := by rw [hsdef]; simp only [negY]; ring
  have hden0 : s ≠ 0 := by rw [← hden]; exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hy
  have hs : s ^ 2 = W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x := by
    have hsq := ψ_sq_evalEval (W := W) h 2
    rw [ΨSq_two, ψ_two_evalEval] at hsq
    rw [hsdef]; exact hsq
  have hΦv : (W.Φ 2).eval x =
      x ^ 4 - (2 * W.a₄ + W.a₁ * W.a₃) * x ^ 2 - 2 * (W.a₃ ^ 2 + 4 * W.a₆) * x
        - (W.a₁ ^ 2 * W.a₆ + 4 * W.a₂ * W.a₆ - W.a₁ * W.a₃ * W.a₄
            + W.a₂ * W.a₃ ^ 2 - W.a₄ ^ 2) := by
    rw [Φ_two, WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈]
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C]
  have heq : y ^ 2 + W.a₁ * x * y + W.a₃ * y
      - (x ^ 3 + W.a₂ * x ^ 2 + W.a₄ * x + W.a₆) = 0 :=
    (equation_iff' x y).mp h
  rw [hden, ← hs]
  simp only [addX]
  field_simp [hden0]
  linear_combination
    (W.a₁ * (3 * x ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y)
        - (W.a₂ + 2 * x) * (s + 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃)) * hsdef
      + (-W.a₁ ^ 2 - 4 * W.a₂ - 8 * x) * heq - hΦv

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addY_self_eq_div
statement:
theorem addY_self_eq_div (h : W.Equation x y) (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) :
    W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y)
      = (W.preΨ₄.eval x -
          (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y * (W.a₁ * (W.Φ 2).eval x + W.a₃ * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x)) /
        (2 * (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [addY, negAddY, addX_self_eq_div h hy, slope_of_Y_ne rfl hy]
  simp only [negY]
  rw [ψ_two_evalEval]
  set s := 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ with hsdef
  have hden : y - (-y - W.a₁ * x - W.a₃) = s := by rw [hsdef]; ring
  have hden0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    have hn : y - W.negY x y = s := by rw [hsdef]; simp only [negY]; ring
    rw [← hn]; exact sub_ne_zero.mpr hy
  have hs : s ^ 2 = W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x := by
    have hsq := ψ_sq_evalEval (W := W) h 2
    rw [ΨSq_two, ψ_two_evalEval] at hsq
    rw [hsdef]; exact hsq
  have hΦv : (W.Φ 2).eval x =
      x ^ 4 - (2 * W.a₄ + W.a₁ * W.a₃) * x ^ 2 - 2 * (W.a₃ ^ 2 + 4 * W.a₆) * x
        - (W.a₁ ^ 2 * W.a₆ + 4 * W.a₂ * W.a₆ - W.a₁ * W.a₃ * W.a₄
            + W.a₂ * W.a₃ ^ 2 - W.a₄ ^ 2) := by
    rw [Φ_two, WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈]
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C]
  have heq : y ^ 2 + W.a₁ * x * y + W.a₃ * y
      - (x ^ 3 + W.a₂ * x ^ 2 + W.a₄ * x + W.a₆) = 0 :=
    (equation_iff' x y).mp h
  rw [hden, ← hs, hΦv]
  simp only [preΨ₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₈, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C, eval_ofNat]
  field_simp [hden0, h2]
  linear_combination (8 * x ^ 3 - 4 * x ^ 2 * W.a₁ ^ 2 - 12 * x * W.a₁ * W.a₃
        - 8 * x * W.a₄ - 16 * W.a₆ - 8 * W.a₃ ^ 2 - 16 * x * W.a₁ * y - 16 * W.a₃ * y
        - 16 * y ^ 2) * heq
    + (5 * x ^ 4 * W.a₁ + 4 * x ^ 2 * W.a₁ * W.a₄ + 8 * x * W.a₁ * W.a₆
        + W.a₁ ^ 3 * W.a₆ + 4 * W.a₁ * W.a₂ * W.a₆ + W.a₁ * W.a₂ * W.a₃ ^ 2
        - W.a₁ ^ 2 * W.a₃ * W.a₄ - W.a₁ * W.a₄ ^ 2 + 6 * x ^ 3 * s + 6 * x ^ 3 * W.a₃
        + 4 * x ^ 2 * W.a₂ * s + 4 * x ^ 3 * W.a₁ * W.a₂ + 4 * x ^ 2 * W.a₂ * W.a₃
        + 2 * x * W.a₄ * s + 2 * x * W.a₃ * W.a₄ - W.a₃ * s ^ 2 - x * W.a₁ * W.a₃ * s
        - W.a₃ ^ 2 * s - W.a₃ ^ 3 + 12 * x ^ 3 * y + 8 * x ^ 2 * W.a₂ * y + 4 * x * W.a₄ * y
        - 4 * x * W.a₁ * s * y - 4 * x ^ 2 * W.a₁ ^ 2 * y - 10 * x * W.a₁ * W.a₃ * y
        - 4 * W.a₃ * s * y - 6 * W.a₃ ^ 2 * y - 2 * s ^ 2 * y - 12 * x * W.a₁ * y ^ 2
        - 12 * W.a₃ * y ^ 2 - 4 * s * y ^ 2 - 8 * y ^ 3) * hsdef

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₃_eval_eq_sub
statement: lemma Ψ₃_eval_eq_sub (x : F) : W.Ψ₃.eval x = x * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x - (W.Φ 2).eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ_two_eq]
  simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_X]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Φ_two_eval
statement: lemma Φ_two_eval (x : F) : (W.Φ 2).eval x = x * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x - W.Ψ₃.eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ψ₃_eval_eq_sub]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Φ_two_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq
statement:
theorem eval_Φ_two_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq [W.IsElliptic] (x : F)
    (hx : (W.ΨSq 2).eval x = 0) : (W.Φ 2).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hΨ₃ : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0 :=
    Polynomial.eval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime W.isCoprime_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq (by rwa [ΨSq_two] at hx)
  refine eval_Φ_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_ne_zero hx ?_ ?_
  · rw [show (2 : ℤ) + 1 = 3 from rfl, ΨSq_three, eval_pow]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ hΨ₃
  · rw [show (2 : ℤ) - 1 = 1 from rfl, ΨSq_one, eval_one]
    exact one_ne_zero

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_self_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eval
statement:
lemma addX_self_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eval {x y : F} (h : W.Equation x y) (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) :
    W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y) * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = (W.Φ 2).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ ≠ 0 := two_mul_add_ne_zero_of_Y_ne hy
  have key : (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y) - x) * (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) ^ 2
      = -W.Ψ₃.eval x := by
    rw [addX_self_sub h hy, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hd)]
  rw [Φ_two_eval, Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq h]
  linear_combination key

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_addX_self_eq
statement:
lemma exists_addX_self_eq [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x₀ : F) :
    ∃ x y : F, W.Nonsingular x y ∧ y ≠ W.negY x y ∧
      W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y) = x₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_eval_Φ_eq (W := W) (n := 2) (by norm_num) x₀
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat, ΨSq_two] at hx
  have hne : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
    eval_Φ_two_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq x (by rw [ΨSq_two]; exact h0) (by rw [hx, h0, mul_zero])
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_equation (W := W) h2 x
  have hns : W.Nonsingular x y := equation_iff_nonsingular.mp hy
  have hyne : y ≠ W.negY x y := by
    intro hcon
    have hd : 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ = 0 := by
      rw [negY] at hcon
      linear_combination hcon
    exact hne (by rw [Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq hy, hd]; ring)
  refine ⟨x, y, hns, hyne, ?_⟩
  have hmul := addX_self_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eval hy hyne
  rw [hx] at hmul
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hne hmul

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.hasXCoordFormula_two
statement: theorem hasXCoordFormula_two : HasXCoordFormula W 2
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h hne
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hne ⊢
  rw [ΨSq_two] at hne
  have hyeq : W.Equation x y := h.1
  have hyne : y ≠ W.negY x y := by
    intro hcon
    have hd : 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ = 0 := by
      rw [negY] at hcon
      linear_combination hcon
    exact hne (by rw [Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq hyeq, hd]; ring)
  have hX : W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y) = (W.Φ 2).eval x / (W.ΨSq 2).eval x := by
    rw [ΨSq_two, eq_div_iff hne]
    exact addX_self_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eval hyeq hyne
  have hns₂ : W.Nonsingular ((W.Φ 2).eval x / (W.ΨSq 2).eval x)
      (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y)) := by
    rw [← hX]
    exact nonsingular_add h h fun hxy => hyne hxy.right
  refine ⟨W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y), hns₂, ?_⟩
  rw [two_nsmul, Point.add_self_of_Y_ne hyne]
  simp only [Point.some.injEq, and_true]
  exact hX

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_two_eq
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_two_eq [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (Q : W.Point) :
    ∃ P : W.Point, 2 • P = Q
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_eq_of_hasXCoordFormula h2 (by norm_num)
    (by simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat]; exact eval_Φ_two_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq)
    hasXCoordFormula_two Q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nsmul_two_surjective
statement:
theorem nsmul_two_surjective [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective fun P : W.Point => (2 : ℕ) • P
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_two_eq h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_two_eq_some_of_root
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_two_eq_some_of_root [W.IsElliptic] {x₀ y₀ : F}
    (hQ : W.Nonsingular x₀ y₀) {x y : F} (hxy : W.Equation x y)
    (hx : (W.Φ 2).eval x = x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x) :
    ∃ P : W.Point, 2 • P = Point.some x₀ y₀ hQ
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_eq_some_of_hasXCoordFormula_of_root
    (by simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat]; exact eval_Φ_two_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq)
    hasXCoordFormula_two hQ hxy (by simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, ΨSq_two] using hx)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nsmul_four_eq_zero_of_nsmul_two_eq
statement:
lemma nsmul_four_eq_zero_of_nsmul_two_eq {P T : W.Point} (hP : (2 : ℕ) • P = T)
    (hT : T ∈ W.torsion 2) : (4 : ℕ) • P = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (4 : ℕ) = 2 * 2 from rfl, mul_nsmul, hP]
  exact mem_torsion_iff.mp hT

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ne_of_nsmul_two_eq
statement:
lemma ne_of_nsmul_two_eq {P T : W.Point} (hP : (2 : ℕ) • P = T) (hT : T ∈ W.torsion 2)
    (hT0 : T ≠ 0) : P ≠ T
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  exact hT0 (hP.symm.trans (mem_torsion_iff.mp hT))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nsmul_eq_of_nsmul_two_eq
statement:
lemma nsmul_eq_of_nsmul_two_eq {P T : W.Point} (hP : (2 : ℕ) • P = T) (hT : T ∈ W.torsion 2)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n % 4 = 2) : n • P = T
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.div_add_mod n 4, hn]
  rw [add_nsmul, mul_nsmul, nsmul_four_eq_zero_of_nsmul_two_eq hP hT, smul_zero, zero_add, hP]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_eq_some_of_root_of_mem_torsion_two
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_nsmul_two_eq_some_of_root hQ hxy hx
  exact ⟨P, nsmul_eq_of_nsmul_two_eq hP hT hn,
    ne_of_nsmul_two_eq hP hT (Point.some_ne_zero hQ)⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X_zero
statement: private lemma equation_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X_zero : (y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X ℚ).Equation 0 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Affine.equation_iff]; norm_num [y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X_two
statement: private lemma equation_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X_two : (y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X ℚ).Equation 2 6
proof:
:= by
  rw [Affine.equation_iff]; norm_num [y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Φ_two_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X
statement:
private lemma eval_Φ_two_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X :
    ((y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X ℚ).Φ 2).eval 2 = (0 : ℚ) * (y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X ℚ).Ψ₂Sq.eval 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ_two_eval]
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈, y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_two_eq_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_two_eq_some_of_root _ equation_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X_two
    eval_Φ_two_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X

name: IsEllipticNet.isEllipticSequence_of_mul_self_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isEllipticSequence_of_mul_self_eq_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {W : ℤ → R}
    (h : ∀ n : ℤ, W n * W n = 0) : IsEllipticSequence W
proof:
:= by
  intro p q r
  simp only [rel, add_zero]
  linear_combination (norm := ring1) (W (p + q) * W (p - q)) * h r -
    (W (p + r) * W (p - r)) * h q + (W (q + r) * W (q - r)) * h p

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroGen₀_mul_self
statement: lemma sqZeroGen₀_mul_self : sqZeroGen₀ * sqZeroGen₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqZeroGen₀, inl_mul_inl, inl_mul_inl, inl_mul_inl,
    show (2 : ZMod 4) * 2 = 0 from by decide, inl_zero, inl_zero, inl_zero]

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroGen₀_add_self
statement: lemma sqZeroGen₀_add_self : sqZeroGen₀ + sqZeroGen₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqZeroGen₀, ← inl_add, ← inl_add, ← inl_add, show (2 : ZMod 4) + 2 = 0 from by decide,
    inl_zero, inl_zero, inl_zero]

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroGen₁_mul_self
statement: lemma sqZeroGen₁_mul_self : sqZeroGen₁ * sqZeroGen₁ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqZeroGen₁, inl_mul_inl, inl_mul_inl, inr_mul_inr, inl_zero, inl_zero]

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroGen₂_mul_self
statement: lemma sqZeroGen₂_mul_self : sqZeroGen₂ * sqZeroGen₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqZeroGen₂, inl_mul_inl, inr_mul_inr, inl_zero]

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroGen₃_mul_self
statement: lemma sqZeroGen₃_mul_self : sqZeroGen₃ * sqZeroGen₃ = 0
proof: := by rw [sqZeroGen₃, inr_mul_inr]

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroGen_prod
statement:
lemma sqZeroGen_prod :
    sqZeroGen₀ * sqZeroGen₁ * sqZeroGen₂ * sqZeroGen₃ = inr (inr (inr 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqZeroGen₀, sqZeroGen₁, sqZeroGen₂, sqZeroGen₃, inl_mul_inl, inl_mul_inl, inl_mul_inr,
    inl_mul_inl, inl_mul_inr, inl_mul_inr]
  simp

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroGen_prod_ne_zero
statement: lemma sqZeroGen_prod_ne_zero : sqZeroGen₀ * sqZeroGen₁ * sqZeroGen₂ * sqZeroGen₃ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqZeroGen_prod]
  intro h
  rw [← inr_zero] at h
  replace h := inr_injective h
  rw [← inr_zero] at h
  replace h := inr_injective h
  rw [← inr_zero] at h
  exact absurd (inr_injective h) (by decide)

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroVal_mul_self
statement: lemma sqZeroVal_mul_self (n : ℤ) : sqZeroVal n * sqZeroVal n = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold sqZeroVal
  split_ifs
  · exact sqZeroGen₀_mul_self
  · exact sqZeroGen₁_mul_self
  · exact sqZeroGen₂_mul_self
  · exact sqZeroGen₃_mul_self
  · exact mul_zero 0

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroSeq_mul_self
statement: lemma sqZeroSeq_mul_self (n : ℤ) : sqZeroSeq n * sqZeroSeq n = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold sqZeroSeq
  split_ifs
  · exact sqZeroVal_mul_self n
  · rw [neg_mul_neg]; exact sqZeroVal_mul_self (-n)

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroSeq_odd
statement: lemma sqZeroSeq_odd : Function.Odd sqZeroSeq
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  rcases lt_trichotomy n 0 with h | rfl | h
  · rw [sqZeroSeq, sqZeroSeq, if_pos (by omega), if_neg (by omega), neg_neg]
  · simp only [sqZeroSeq, neg_zero, le_refl, if_pos, sqZeroVal]
    rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero]
    exact sqZeroGen₀_add_self
  · rw [sqZeroSeq, sqZeroSeq, if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega), neg_neg]

name: IsEllipticNet.isEllipticSequence_sqZeroSeq
statement: theorem isEllipticSequence_sqZeroSeq : IsEllipticSequence sqZeroSeq
proof:
:=
  isEllipticSequence_of_mul_self_eq_zero sqZeroSeq_mul_self

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroSeq_zero
statement: lemma sqZeroSeq_zero : sqZeroSeq 0 = sqZeroGen₀
proof: := by norm_num [sqZeroSeq, sqZeroVal]

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroSeq_one
statement: lemma sqZeroSeq_one : sqZeroSeq 1 = sqZeroGen₁
proof: := by norm_num [sqZeroSeq, sqZeroVal]

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroSeq_two
statement: lemma sqZeroSeq_two : sqZeroSeq 2 = sqZeroGen₂
proof: := by norm_num [sqZeroSeq, sqZeroVal]

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroSeq_three
statement: lemma sqZeroSeq_three : sqZeroSeq 3 = sqZeroGen₃
proof: := by norm_num [sqZeroSeq, sqZeroVal]

name: IsEllipticNet.rel_sqZeroSeq_one
statement:
lemma rel_sqZeroSeq_one :
    rel sqZeroSeq 1 1 1 1 = sqZeroGen₀ * sqZeroGen₁ * sqZeroGen₂ * sqZeroGen₃
proof:
:= by
  have h : rel sqZeroSeq 1 1 1 1 =
      sqZeroSeq 0 * sqZeroSeq 1 * sqZeroSeq 2 * sqZeroSeq 3 := by
    simp only [rel]
    norm_num
    ring
  rw [h, sqZeroSeq_zero, sqZeroSeq_one, sqZeroSeq_two, sqZeroSeq_three]

name: IsEllipticNet.not_isEllipticNet_sqZeroSeq
statement: theorem not_isEllipticNet_sqZeroSeq : ¬ IsEllipticNet sqZeroSeq
proof:
:= fun h =>
  sqZeroGen_prod_ne_zero (rel_sqZeroSeq_one ▸ h 1 1 1 1)

name: IsEllipticNet.sqZeroSeq_one_ne_one
statement: lemma sqZeroSeq_one_ne_one : sqZeroSeq 1 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : SqZeroRing) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h1 : ((1 : SqZeroRing).fst.fst.fst) = ((0 : SqZeroRing).fst.fst.fst) := by rw [h]
    rw [fst_one, fst_one, fst_one, fst_zero, fst_zero, fst_zero] at h1
    exact absurd h1 (by decide)
  intro h
  have h0 := sqZeroSeq_mul_self 1
  rw [h, one_mul] at h0
  exact hone h0

name: IsEllipticNet.exists_odd_isEllipticSequence_not_isEllipticNet
statement:
theorem exists_odd_isEllipticSequence_not_isEllipticNet :
    ∃ (R : Type) (_ : CommRing R) (W : ℤ → R),
      Function.Odd W ∧ IsEllipticSequence W ∧ ¬ IsEllipticNet W
proof:
:=
  ⟨SqZeroRing, inferInstance, sqZeroSeq, sqZeroSeq_odd, isEllipticSequence_sqZeroSeq,
    not_isEllipticNet_sqZeroSeq⟩

name: normEDS_rel_even
statement:
lemma normEDS_rel_even (m : ℤ) :
    IsEllipticNet.rel (normEDS b c d) (m + 1) (m - 1) 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsEllipticNet.rel_even, normEDS_one, normEDS_two]
  linear_combination normEDS_even b c d m

name: normEDS_rel_odd
statement:
lemma normEDS_rel_odd (m : ℤ) :
    IsEllipticNet.rel (normEDS b c d) (m + 1) m 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsEllipticNet.rel_odd, normEDS_one]
  linear_combination normEDS_odd b c d m

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_rel_even
statement: lemma ψ_rel_even (m : ℤ) : IsEllipticNet.rel W.ψ (m + 1) (m - 1) 1 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  normEDS_rel_even W.ψ₂ (C W.Ψ₃) (C W.preΨ₄) m

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_rel_odd
statement: lemma ψ_rel_odd (m : ℤ) : IsEllipticNet.rel W.ψ (m + 1) m 1 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  normEDS_rel_odd W.ψ₂ (C W.Ψ₃) (C W.preΨ₄) m

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_rel_even_evalEval
statement:
lemma ψ_rel_even_evalEval (m : ℤ) :
    IsEllipticNet.rel (fun n ↦ (W.ψ n).evalEval x y) (m + 1) (m - 1) 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsEllipticNet.map_rel W.ψ (evalEvalRingHom x y) (m + 1) (m - 1) 1 0
  rw [ψ_rel_even, map_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_rel_odd_evalEval
statement:
lemma ψ_rel_odd_evalEval (m : ℤ) :
    IsEllipticNet.rel (fun n ↦ (W.ψ n).evalEval x y) (m + 1) m 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsEllipticNet.map_rel W.ψ (evalEvalRingHom x y) (m + 1) m 1 0
  rw [ψ_rel_odd, map_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: IsEllipticNet.rel_reindex_sum
statement: lemma rel_reindex_sum (p q r s : ℤ) : rel W p q r s = rel W (q + r + s) q r (p - q - r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel]
  ring_nf

name: IsEllipticNet.rel_reindex_avg
statement: lemma rel_reindex_avg (p q r s : ℤ) : rel W p q r s = rel W p (p - r) (p - q) (q + r + s - p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel]
  ring_nf

name: IsEllipticNet.sub_mul_mul_rel
statement:
lemma sub_mul_mul_rel (p q r s k : ℤ) :
    W (s - k) * W k * rel W p q r s =
      W (r + s) * W r * rel W (p + k) (q + k) k (s - 2 * k)
      - W (q + s) * W q * rel W (p + k) (r + k) k (s - 2 * k)
      + W (p + s) * W p * rel W (q + k) (r + k) k (s - 2 * k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel]
  ring_nf

name: IsEllipticNet.rel_eq_zero_of_rel_sub_two_mul
statement:
lemma rel_eq_zero_of_rel_sub_two_mul {s : ℤ} (k : ℤ) (hreg : IsRegular (W (s - k) * W k))
    (h : ∀ p q r : ℤ, rel W p q r (s - 2 * k) = 0) (p q r : ℤ) : rel W p q r s = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : W (s - k) * W k * rel W p q r s = W (s - k) * W k * 0 := by
    rw [sub_mul_mul_rel W p q r s k, h, h, h]
    ring
  exact hreg.left key

name: IsEllipticNet.isEllipticNet_of_isEllipticSequence
statement:
theorem isEllipticNet_of_isEllipticSequence (hreg : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → IsRegular (W n))
    (h : IsEllipticSequence W) : IsEllipticNet W
proof:
:= by
  have heven : ∀ k p q r : ℤ, rel W p q r (2 * k) = 0 := by
    intro k p q r
    rcases eq_or_ne k 0 with rfl | hk
    · simpa using h p q r
    · refine rel_eq_zero_of_rel_sub_two_mul W k ?_ (fun a b c => ?_) p q r
      · rw [show (2 : ℤ) * k - k = k by ring]
        exact (hreg k hk).mul (hreg k hk)
      · rw [show (2 : ℤ) * k - 2 * k = 0 by ring]
        exact h a b c
  intro p q r s
  rcases Int.even_or_odd s with hs | hs
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hs
    rw [show s = 2 * m by omega]
    exact heven m p q r
  · rcases Int.even_or_odd (p + q + r) with hd | hd
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hd
      rw [rel_reindex_sum W p q r s, show p - q - r = 2 * (m - q - r) by omega]
      exact heven _ _ _ _
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hd
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hs
      rw [rel_reindex_avg W p q r s, show q + r + s - p = 2 * (m + n + 1 - p) by omega]
      exact heven _ _ _ _

name: IsEllipticNet.isEllipticNet_iff_isEllipticSequence
statement:
theorem isEllipticNet_iff_isEllipticSequence (hreg : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → IsRegular (W n)) :
    IsEllipticNet W ↔ IsEllipticSequence W
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.isEllipticSequence, isEllipticNet_of_isEllipticSequence W hreg⟩

name: IsEllipticNet.isEllipticNet_iff_rel_one
statement:
theorem isEllipticNet_iff_rel_one (odd : W.Odd) (h1 : W 1 = 1)
    (hreg : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → IsRegular (W n)) :
    IsEllipticNet W ↔ ∀ p q : ℤ, rel W p q 1 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  (isEllipticNet_iff_isEllipticSequence W hreg).trans (isEllipticSequence_iff_rel_one W odd h1)

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_isEllipticNet_univ_of_gapCore
statement:
theorem normEDS_isEllipticNet_univ_of_gapCore (hgap : WardGapCore) :
    IsEllipticNet (normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2))
proof:
:=
  IsEllipticNet.isEllipticNet_of_isEllipticSequence _
    (fun n hn => IsRegular.of_ne_zero (normEDS_univ_ne_zero n hn))
    (normEDS_isEllipticSequence_of_gapCore _ _ _ hgap)

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_isEllipticNet_of_gapCore
statement:
theorem normEDS_isEllipticNet_of_gapCore (b c d : R) (hgap : WardGapCore) :
    IsEllipticNet (normEDS b c d)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q r s
  set φ : UnivEDS →+* R := (aeval ![b, c, d] : UnivEDS →ₐ[ℤ] R).toRingHom with hφ
  have hcomp : φ ∘ normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) = normEDS b c d := by
    funext n
    rw [Function.comp_apply, map_normEDS]
    congr 1 <;> simp [hφ]
  have h := IsEllipticNet.map_rel (normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)) φ p q r s
  rw [normEDS_isEllipticNet_univ_of_gapCore hgap, map_zero, hcomp] at h
  exact h.symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_isEllipticNet_of_gapCore
statement: theorem ψ_isEllipticNet_of_gapCore (hgap : WardGapCore) : IsEllipticNet W.ψ
proof:
:=
  normEDS_isEllipticNet_of_gapCore W.ψ₂ (C W.Ψ₃) (C W.preΨ₄) hgap

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_isEllipticNet_evalEval_of_gapCore
statement:
theorem ψ_isEllipticNet_evalEval_of_gapCore (hgap : WardGapCore) :
    IsEllipticNet (fun n ↦ (W.ψ n).evalEval x y)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q r s
  have h := IsEllipticNet.map_rel W.ψ (evalEvalRingHom x y) p q r s
  rw [ψ_isEllipticNet_of_gapCore W hgap p q r s, map_zero] at h
  exact h.symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.setOf_equation_subset_pair
statement:
lemma setOf_equation_subset_pair {x y₀ : F} (h₀ : W.Equation x y₀) :
    {y : F | W.Equation x y} ⊆ {y₀, W.negY x y₀}
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rcases Y_eq_of_X_eq hy h₀ rfl with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.setOf_equation_finite
statement: lemma setOf_equation_finite (x : F) : {y : F | W.Equation x y}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty {y : F | W.Equation x y} with h | ⟨y₀, h₀⟩
  · rw [h]; exact Set.finite_empty
  · exact ((Set.finite_singleton _).insert _).subset
      (W.setOf_equation_subset_pair h₀)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.setOf_equation_ncard_le_two
statement: lemma setOf_equation_ncard_le_two (x : F) : {y : F | W.Equation x y}.ncard ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty {y : F | W.Equation x y} with h | ⟨y₀, h₀⟩
  · rw [h, Set.ncard_empty]; norm_num
  · calc {y : F | W.Equation x y}.ncard
        ≤ ({y₀, W.negY x y₀} : Set F).ncard :=
          Set.ncard_le_ncard (W.setOf_equation_subset_pair h₀) (Set.toFinite _)
      _ ≤ 2 := by
          refine (Set.ncard_insert_le _ _).trans ?_
          rw [Set.ncard_singleton]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coordTag_injective
statement: private lemma coordTag_injective : Function.Injective W.coordTag
proof:
:= by
  rintro (_ | ⟨x₁, y₁, h₁⟩) (_ | ⟨x₂, y₂, h₂⟩) h <;>
    simp only [coordTag, reduceCtorEq, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  · rfl
  · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h; rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_of_xCoords
statement:
theorem finite_of_xCoords {A : Set W.Point} {S : Set F} (hS : S.Finite)
    (hx : ∀ ⦃x y : F⦄ ⦃h : W.Nonsingular x y⦄, (.some x y h : W.Point) ∈ A → x ∈ S) :
    A.Finite
proof:
:= by
  
  set T : Set (F × F) := {p : F × F | p.1 ∈ S ∧ W.Equation p.1 p.2} with hT
  
  have hTfin : T.Finite := by
    apply Set.Finite.subset (hS.biUnion fun x _ => (W.setOf_equation_finite x).image (Prod.mk x))
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨hxS, hxy⟩
    exact Set.mem_biUnion hxS ⟨y, hxy, rfl⟩
  
  refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image (f := W.coordTag) ?_ (W.coordTag_injective.injOn)
  refine ((hTfin.image some).insert none).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨(_ | ⟨x, y, h⟩), hP, rfl⟩
  · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
  · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨(x, y), ⟨hx hP, h.left⟩, rfl⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_someY
statement: lemma equation_someY {x y : F} (h : W.Equation x y) : W.Equation x (W.someY x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [someY, dif_pos ⟨y, h⟩]
  exact Exists.choose_spec (⟨y, h⟩ : ∃ y : F, W.Equation x y)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.fibreTag_injective
statement: private lemma fibreTag_injective : Function.Injective W.fibreTag
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro (_ | ⟨x₁, y₁, h₁⟩) (_ | ⟨x₂, y₂, h₂⟩) h <;>
    simp only [fibreTag, reduceCtorEq, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, decide_eq_decide] at h
  · rfl
  · obtain ⟨rfl, hb⟩ := h
    have hy : y₁ = y₂ := by
      by_cases hy₁ : y₁ = W.someY x₁
      · exact hy₁.trans (hb.mp hy₁).symm
      · have hy₂ : y₂ ≠ W.someY x₁ := fun hc => hy₁ (hb.mpr hc)
        rcases Y_eq_of_X_eq h₁.left h₂.left rfl with h | h
        · exact h
        · exfalso
          rcases Y_eq_of_X_eq (W.equation_someY h₁.left) h₁.left rfl with h' | h'
          · exact hy₁ h'.symm
          · exact hy₂ (by rw [h', h, negY_negY])
    subst hy
    rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ncard_le_of_xCoords
statement:
theorem ncard_le_of_xCoords {A : Set W.Point} {S : Set F} (hS : S.Finite)
    (hx : ∀ ⦃x y : F⦄ ⦃h : W.Nonsingular x y⦄, (.some x y h : W.Point) ∈ A → x ∈ S) :
    A.ncard ≤ 2 * S.ncard + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hT : (S ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set Bool)).Finite := hS.prod Set.finite_univ
  have hsub : W.fibreTag '' A ⊆ insert none (some '' (S ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set Bool))) := by
    rintro _ ⟨(_ | ⟨x, y, h⟩), hP, rfl⟩
    · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
    · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨(x, _), ⟨hx hP, Set.mem_univ _⟩, rfl⟩
  calc A.ncard
      = (W.fibreTag '' A).ncard := (Set.ncard_image_of_injective A W.fibreTag_injective).symm
    _ ≤ (insert none (some '' (S ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set Bool)))).ncard :=
        Set.ncard_le_ncard hsub ((hT.image some).insert none)
    _ ≤ (some '' (S ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set Bool))).ncard + 1 := Set.ncard_insert_le _ _
    _ = 2 * S.ncard + 1 := by
        rw [Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ (Option.some_injective _), Set.ncard_prod]
        simp [mul_comm]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ncard_le_of_xCoords_of_selfNeg
statement:
theorem ncard_le_of_xCoords_of_selfNeg {A : Set W.Point} {S S₀ : Set F} (hS : S.Finite)
    (hS₀ : S₀.Finite)
    (hx : ∀ ⦃x y : F⦄ ⦃h : W.Nonsingular x y⦄, (.some x y h : W.Point) ∈ A → x ∈ S ∪ S₀)
    (hone : ∀ ⦃x y : F⦄ ⦃h : W.Nonsingular x y⦄, (.some x y h : W.Point) ∈ A → x ∈ S₀ →
      y = W.negY x y) :
    A.ncard ≤ 2 * S.ncard + S₀.ncard + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set U : Set (F × Bool) := S ×ˢ Set.univ ∪ S₀ ×ˢ {true} with hU
  have hUfin : U.Finite := (hS.prod Set.finite_univ).union (hS₀.prod (Set.finite_singleton _))
  have hsub : W.fibreTag '' A ⊆ insert none (some '' U) := by
    rintro _ ⟨(_ | ⟨x, y, h⟩), hP, rfl⟩
    · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
    · refine Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨(x, decide (y = W.someY x)), ?_, rfl⟩
      rcases hx hP with hxS | hxS₀
      · exact Or.inl ⟨hxS, Set.mem_univ _⟩
      
      · refine Or.inr ⟨hxS₀, ?_⟩
        have hy : y = W.someY x := by
          rcases Y_eq_of_X_eq (W.equation_someY h.left) h.left rfl with h' | h'
          · exact h'.symm
          · rw [h', ← hone hP hxS₀]
        simp [hy]
  calc A.ncard
      = (W.fibreTag '' A).ncard := (Set.ncard_image_of_injective A W.fibreTag_injective).symm
    _ ≤ (insert none (some '' U)).ncard :=
        Set.ncard_le_ncard hsub ((hUfin.image some).insert none)
    _ ≤ (some '' U).ncard + 1 := Set.ncard_insert_le _ _
    _ = U.ncard + 1 := by rw [Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ (Option.some_injective _)]
    _ ≤ 2 * S.ncard + S₀.ncard + 1 := by
        have h := Set.ncard_union_le (S ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set Bool)) (S₀ ×ˢ ({true} : Set Bool))
        rw [Set.ncard_prod, Set.ncard_prod] at h
        simp only [Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_bool,
          Set.ncard_singleton, mul_one] at h
        rw [hU]
        omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsion_finite_of_xCoords
statement:
theorem torsion_finite_of_xCoords {n : ℕ} {S : Set F} (hS : S.Finite)
    (hx : ∀ ⦃x y : F⦄ ⦃h : W.Nonsingular x y⦄,
      (.some x y h : W.Point) ∈ W.torsion n → x ∈ S) :
    (W.torsion n : Set W.Point).Finite
proof:
:=
  W.finite_of_xCoords hS hx

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_of_xCoords
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_of_xCoords {n : ℕ} {S : Set F} (hS : S.Finite)
    (hx : ∀ ⦃x y : F⦄ ⦃h : W.Nonsingular x y⦄,
      (.some x y h : W.Point) ∈ W.torsion n → x ∈ S) :
    Finite (W.torsion n)
proof:
:=
  Set.finite_coe_iff.mpr (W.torsion_finite_of_xCoords hS hx)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_le_of_xCoords
statement:
theorem card_torsion_le_of_xCoords {n : ℕ} {S : Set F} (hS : S.Finite)
    (hx : ∀ ⦃x y : F⦄ ⦃h : W.Nonsingular x y⦄,
      (.some x y h : W.Point) ∈ W.torsion n → x ∈ S) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) ≤ 2 * S.ncard + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.coe_sort_coe, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
  exact W.ncard_le_of_xCoords hS hx

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_le_of_xCoords_of_selfNeg
statement:
theorem card_torsion_le_of_xCoords_of_selfNeg {n : ℕ} {S S₀ : Set F} (hS : S.Finite)
    (hS₀ : S₀.Finite)
    (hx : ∀ ⦃x y : F⦄ ⦃h : W.Nonsingular x y⦄,
      (.some x y h : W.Point) ∈ W.torsion n → x ∈ S ∪ S₀)
    (hone : ∀ ⦃x y : F⦄ ⦃h : W.Nonsingular x y⦄,
      (.some x y h : W.Point) ∈ W.torsion n → x ∈ S₀ → y = W.negY x y) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) ≤ 2 * S.ncard + S₀.ncard + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.coe_sort_coe, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
  exact W.ncard_le_of_xCoords_of_selfNeg hS hS₀ hx hone

name: Polynomial.separable_quadratic
statement:
theorem separable_quadratic {K : Type*} [Field K] {b c : K} (hD : b ^ 2 - 4 * c ≠ 0) :
    (X ^ 2 + C b * X + C c : K[X]).Separable
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv : derivative (X ^ 2 + C b * X + C c : K[X]) = C 2 * X + C b := by
    simp [derivative_add, derivative_mul, derivative_pow]
  rw [Polynomial.Separable, hderiv]
  refine ⟨C (-4 * (b ^ 2 - 4 * c)⁻¹), C ((b ^ 2 - 4 * c)⁻¹) * (C 2 * X + C b), ?_⟩
  have h : (C ((b ^ 2 - 4 * c)⁻¹) * C (b ^ 2 - 4 * c) : K[X]) = 1 := by
    rw [← C_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hD, C_1]
  linear_combination (norm := (C_simp; ring1)) h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.four_ne_zero_of_two_ne_zero'
statement: private lemma four_ne_zero_of_two_ne_zero' (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : (4 : F) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (4 : F) = 2 * 2 by norm_num]; exact mul_ne_zero h2 h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.halvingX_monic
statement: theorem halvingX_monic (x₀ : F) : (W.halvingX x₀).Monic
proof:
:= by
  rw [halvingX]; monicity!

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degree_halvingX
statement: theorem degree_halvingX (x₀ : F) : (W.halvingX x₀).degree = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [halvingX]; compute_degree!

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eq_halvingX_sq
statement:
theorem Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eq_halvingX_sq (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F}
    (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) : W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq = (W.halvingX x₀) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set c : F := (4 * x₀ ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x₀ + W.b₄) / 2 with hcdef
  have hc : 2 * c = 4 * x₀ ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x₀ + W.b₄ := by rw [hcdef]; field_simp
  have hE2 : 4 * x₀ ^ 3 + W.b₂ * x₀ ^ 2 + 2 * W.b₄ * x₀ + W.b₆ = 0 := by
    simpa [Ψ₂Sq, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow] using hx₀
  have hE2' : (C (4 * x₀ ^ 3 + W.b₂ * x₀ ^ 2 + 2 * W.b₄ * x₀ + W.b₆) : F[X]) = 0 := by
    rw [hE2, map_zero]
  have hb' : (C (4 * W.b₈) : F[X]) = C (W.b₂ * W.b₆ - W.b₄ ^ 2) := by rw [W.b_relation]
  have key : C (4 : F) * (W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq) = C (4 : F) * (W.halvingX x₀) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Φ_two, Ψ₂Sq, halvingX, ← hcdef]
    linear_combination (norm := (C_simp; ring1))
      (C (-8 : F) * X + C (-(4 * x₀ + W.b₂))) * hE2' + (C (-1 : F)) * hb'
      + (C (4 : F) * X ^ 2 + C (-(8 * x₀)) * X
          + C (-(2 * c) - (4 * x₀ ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x₀ + W.b₄))) * congrArg C hc
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by simpa using four_ne_zero_of_two_ne_zero' h2) key

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.discrim_halvingX
statement:
theorem discrim_halvingX (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x₀ : F) :
    (-(2 * x₀)) ^ 2 - 4 * (-((4 * x₀ ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x₀ + W.b₄) / 2))
      = (derivative W.Ψ₂Sq).eval x₀
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, derivative_add, derivative_mul, derivative_C, derivative_X,
    derivative_pow, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add,
    mul_one]
  field_simp
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_halvingX
statement:
theorem separable_halvingX (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hsep : W.Ψ₂Sq.Separable) {x₀ : F}
    (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) : (W.halvingX x₀).Separable
proof:
:= by
  rw [halvingX]
  refine Polynomial.separable_quadratic ?_
  rw [discrim_halvingX h2]
  exact Polynomial.eval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime hsep.symm hx₀

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Φ_two_eq_of_root_halvingX
statement:
theorem eval_Φ_two_eq_of_root_halvingX (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F} (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0)
    {x : F} (hx : (W.halvingX x₀).eval x = 0) :
    (W.Φ 2).eval x = x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (eval x) (Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eq_halvingX_sq h2 hx₀)
  simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_pow, hx] at this
  linear_combination this

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_halvingX
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  refine eval_Φ_two_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq x (by rwa [ΨSq_two]) ?_
  rw [eval_Φ_two_eq_of_root_halvingX h2 hx₀ hx, h0, mul_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.halvingY_monic
statement: theorem halvingY_monic (x : F) : (W.halvingY x).Monic
proof:
:= by
  rw [halvingY]; monicity!

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degree_halvingY
statement: theorem degree_halvingY (x : F) : (W.halvingY x).degree = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [halvingY]; compute_degree!

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.discrim_halvingY
statement:
theorem discrim_halvingY (x : F) :
    (W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) ^ 2 - 4 * (-(x ^ 3 + W.a₂ * x ^ 2 + W.a₄ * x + W.a₆))
      = W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆,
    eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_halvingY
statement: theorem separable_halvingY {x : F} (hx : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ≠ 0) : (W.halvingY x).Separable
proof:
:= by
  rw [halvingY]
  exact Polynomial.separable_quadratic (by rw [discrim_halvingY]; exact hx)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_of_eval_halvingY_eq_zero
statement:
theorem equation_of_eval_halvingY_eq_zero {x y : F} (h : (W.halvingY x).eval y = 0) :
    W.Equation x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [equation_iff']
  simp only [halvingY, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X] at h
  linear_combination h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_two_eq_some_of_roots
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_two_eq_some_of_roots [DecidableEq F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    {x₀ y₀ : F} (hQ : W.Nonsingular x₀ y₀) (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) {x y : F}
    (hx : (W.halvingX x₀).eval x = 0) (hy : (W.halvingY x).eval y = 0) :
    ∃ P : W.Point, 2 • P = Point.some x₀ y₀ hQ
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_two_eq_some_of_root hQ (equation_of_eval_halvingY_eq_zero hy)
    (by simpa only [ΨSq_two] using eval_Φ_two_eq_of_root_halvingX h2 hx₀ hx)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_halvingX
statement:
theorem map_halvingX {K : Type*} [Field K] (f : F →+* K) (x₀ : F) :
    (W.map f).halvingX (f x₀) = (W.halvingX x₀).map f
proof:
:= by
  simp [halvingX, WeierstrassCurve.map_b₂, WeierstrassCurve.map_b₄, map_div₀, map_ofNat,
    Polynomial.map_neg, Polynomial.map_ofNat]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.map_halvingY
statement:
theorem map_halvingY {K : Type*} [Field K] (f : F →+* K) (x : F) :
    (W.map f).halvingY (f x) = (W.halvingY x).map f
proof:
:= by
  simp [halvingY, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₁, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₂, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₃,
    WeierstrassCurve.map_a₄, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₆, Polynomial.map_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_halvingXRoot
statement:
theorem eval_halvingXRoot {W : Affine F} (x₀ : F) :
    ((W⁄(W.halvingXField x₀)).halvingX (algebraMap F (W.halvingXField x₀) x₀)).eval
      (W.halvingXRoot x₀) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (W⁄(W.halvingXField x₀)) = W.map (algebraMap F (W.halvingXField x₀)) from rfl,
    map_halvingX]
  exact eval_rootOfSplits _ _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isGalois_halvingXField
statement:
theorem isGalois_halvingXField (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hsep : W.Ψ₂Sq.Separable)
    (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) : IsGalois F (W.halvingXField x₀)
proof:
:=
  IsGalois.of_separable_splitting_field (p := W.halvingX x₀) (separable_halvingX h2 hsep hx₀)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteDimensional_halvingXField
statement: theorem finiteDimensional_halvingXField : FiniteDimensional F (W.halvingXField x₀)
proof:
:=
  IsSplittingField.finiteDimensional _ (W.halvingX x₀)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_two_ne_zero'
statement:
private lemma algebraMap_two_ne_zero' {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    (2 : L) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_ofNat (algebraMap F L) 2, ne_eq, map_eq_zero]; exact h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Ψ₂Sq_baseChange
statement:
theorem eval_Ψ₂Sq_baseChange {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) :
    (W⁄L).Ψ₂Sq.eval (algebraMap F L x₀) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (W⁄L) = W.map (algebraMap F L) from rfl, WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₂Sq, eval_map,
    ← Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply]
  simp [hx₀]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eval_halvingXRoot_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Ψ₂Sq_eval_halvingXRoot_ne_zero [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) :
    (W⁄(W.halvingXField x₀)).Ψ₂Sq.eval (W.halvingXRoot x₀) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄(W.halvingXField x₀)).IsElliptic :=
    inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F (W.halvingXField x₀))).IsElliptic
  exact Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_halvingX (algebraMap_two_ne_zero' h2)
    (eval_Ψ₂Sq_baseChange hx₀) (eval_halvingXRoot x₀)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_halvingYRoot
statement:
theorem eval_halvingYRoot (W : Affine F) (x₀ : F) :
    ((W.halvingYPoly x₀).map
      (algebraMap (W.halvingXField x₀) (W.halvingField x₀))).eval (W.halvingYRoot x₀) = 0
proof:
:=
  eval_rootOfSplits _ _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isGalois_halvingField
statement:
theorem isGalois_halvingField [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) :
    IsGalois (W.halvingXField x₀) (W.halvingField x₀)
proof:
:=
  IsGalois.of_separable_splitting_field (p := W.halvingYPoly x₀)
    (separable_halvingY (Ψ₂Sq_eval_halvingXRoot_ne_zero h2 hx₀))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSeparable_halvingField
statement:
theorem isSeparable_halvingField [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hsep : W.Ψ₂Sq.Separable)
    (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) : Algebra.IsSeparable F (W.halvingField x₀)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isGalois_halvingXField h2 hsep hx₀
  haveI := isGalois_halvingField (W := W) h2 hx₀
  exact Algebra.IsSeparable.trans F (W.halvingXField x₀) (W.halvingField x₀)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteDimensional_halvingField
statement: theorem finiteDimensional_halvingField : FiniteDimensional F (W.halvingField x₀)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FiniteDimensional F (W.halvingXField x₀) := finiteDimensional_halvingXField
  haveI : FiniteDimensional (W.halvingXField x₀) (W.halvingField x₀) :=
    IsSplittingField.finiteDimensional _ (W.halvingYPoly x₀)
  exact FiniteDimensional.trans F (W.halvingXField x₀) (W.halvingField x₀)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isGalois_normalClosure_halvingField
statement:
theorem isGalois_normalClosure_halvingField [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hsep : W.Ψ₂Sq.Separable) (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) :
    IsGalois F (IntermediateField.normalClosure F (W.halvingField x₀)
      (AlgebraicClosure (W.halvingField x₀)))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isSeparable_halvingField h2 hsep hx₀
  exact _root_.isGalois_normalClosure_of_isSeparable F (W.halvingField x₀)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.baseChange_baseChange
statement:
private lemma baseChange_baseChange (W : Affine F) (L₁ : Type*) [Field L₁] [Algebra F L₁]
    (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra F L] [Algebra L₁ L] [IsScalarTower F L₁ L] :
    ((W⁄L₁)⁄L) = (W⁄L)
proof:
:=
  WeierstrassCurve.map_baseChange (R := F) W (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L₁ L)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_halvingX_baseChange
proof:
:= by
  rw [← baseChange_baseChange W L₁ L,
    show ((W⁄L₁)⁄L) = (W⁄L₁).map (algebraMap L₁ L) from rfl,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F L₁ L x₀, map_halvingX, eval_map, ← Polynomial.aeval_def,
    Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply, Polynomial.aeval_def, ← eval_map, ← map_halvingX]
  simp [Algebra.algebraMap_self, hr]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_halvingY_baseChange
proof:
:= by
  rw [← baseChange_baseChange W L₁ L,
    show ((W⁄L₁)⁄L) = (W⁄L₁).map (algebraMap L₁ L) from rfl, map_halvingY]
  exact hy

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_two_eq_halvingField
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_two_eq_halvingField [DecidableEq (W.halvingField x₀)] [W.IsElliptic]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {y₀ : F} (hQ : W.Nonsingular x₀ y₀) (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) :
    ∃ P : (W⁄(W.halvingField x₀)).Point,
      2 • P = Point.some (algebraMap F (W.halvingField x₀) x₀)
        (algebraMap F (W.halvingField x₀) y₀)
        ((W.map_nonsingular (algebraMap F (W.halvingField x₀)).injective x₀ y₀).mpr hQ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄(W.halvingField x₀)).IsElliptic :=
    inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F (W.halvingField x₀))).IsElliptic
  exact exists_nsmul_two_eq_some_of_roots (algebraMap_two_ne_zero' h2) _
    (eval_Ψ₂Sq_baseChange hx₀) (eval_halvingX_baseChange (eval_halvingXRoot x₀))
    (y := W.halvingYRoot x₀) (eval_halvingY_baseChange (eval_halvingYRoot W x₀))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.halvingX_y2EqX3SubX
statement: private lemma halvingX_y2EqX3SubX : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingX 0 = X ^ 2 + C 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [halvingX, y2EqX3SubX, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX_zero
statement: private lemma eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX_zero : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Ψ₂Sq.eval 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, y2EqX3SubX, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX
statement: private lemma Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Ψ₂Sq = C 4 * X ^ 3 - C 4 * X
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, y2EqX3SubX, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆]
  C_simp
  norm_num
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX
statement: private theorem separable_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX : (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Ψ₂Sq.Separable
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv : derivative ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Ψ₂Sq) = C 12 * X ^ 2 - C 4 := by
    rw [Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX]
    simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_C, derivative_X, derivative_pow,
      zero_mul, zero_add, mul_one, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    C_simp
    ring
  rw [Polynomial.Separable, hderiv, Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX]
  have key : (C (-9 : ℚ) * X) * (C 4 * X ^ 3 - C 4 * X)
      + (C 3 * X ^ 2 - C 2) * (C 12 * X ^ 2 - C 4) = C (8 : ℚ) := by
    C_simp; ring
  refine ⟨C (8 : ℚ)⁻¹ * (C (-9) * X), C (8 : ℚ)⁻¹ * (C 3 * X ^ 2 - C 2), ?_⟩
  calc C (8 : ℚ)⁻¹ * (C (-9) * X) * (C 4 * X ^ 3 - C 4 * X)
        + C (8 : ℚ)⁻¹ * (C 3 * X ^ 2 - C 2) * (C 12 * X ^ 2 - C 4)
      = C (8 : ℚ)⁻¹ * ((C (-9 : ℚ) * X) * (C 4 * X ^ 3 - C 4 * X)
        + (C 3 * X ^ 2 - C 2) * (C 12 * X ^ 2 - C 4)) := by ring
    _ = C (8 : ℚ)⁻¹ * C (8 : ℚ) := by rw [key]
    _ = 1 := by rw [← C_mul]; norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_halvingX_y2EqX3SubX_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem eval_halvingX_y2EqX3SubX_ne_zero (x : ℚ) :
    ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingX 0).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [halvingX_y2EqX3SubX]
  simp only [eval_add, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.halvingXRoot_y2EqX3SubX_not_mem_range
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have h : (((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingX 0).map
      (algebraMap ℚ ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingXField 0))).eval
      ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingXRoot 0) = 0 := eval_rootOfSplits _ _
  rw [← hq, eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_hom] at h
  exact eval_halvingX_y2EqX3SubX_ne_zero q ((map_eq_zero _).mp h)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSeparable_halvingField_y2EqX3SubX
statement:
private theorem isSeparable_halvingField_y2EqX3SubX :
    Algebra.IsSeparable ℚ ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingField 0)
proof:
:=
  isSeparable_halvingField (by norm_num) separable_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX_zero

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_two_eq_y2EqX3SubX
statement:
private theorem exists_nsmul_two_eq_y2EqX3SubX :
    ∃ P : ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ)⁄((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingField 0)).Point,
      2 • P = Point.some (algebraMap ℚ ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingField 0) 0)
        (algebraMap ℚ ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingField 0) 0)
        (((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).map_nonsingular
          (algebraMap ℚ ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).halvingField 0)).injective 0 0).mpr
            nonsingular_zero_y2EqX3SubX)
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_two_eq_halvingField (by norm_num) nonsingular_zero_y2EqX3SubX
    eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX_zero

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.baseChange_baseChange'
statement:
private lemma baseChange_baseChange' (W : Affine F) (L₁ : Type*) [Field L₁] [Algebra F L₁]
    (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra F L] [Algebra L₁ L] [IsScalarTower F L₁ L] :
    ((W⁄L₁)⁄L) = (W⁄L)
proof:
:=
  WeierstrassCurve.map_baseChange (R := F) W (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F L₁ L)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_two_ne_zero''
statement:
private lemma algebraMap_two_ne_zero'' {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    (2 : L) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_ofNat (algebraMap F L) 2, ne_eq, map_eq_zero]
  exact h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_halvingTowerXRoot
statement:
theorem eval_halvingTowerXRoot (x : F) :
    ((W⁄(W.halvingTower x)).halvingX (algebraMap F (W.halvingTower x) x)).eval
      (W.halvingTowerXRoot x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (((W⁄(W.twoTorsionField))⁄(W.halvingTower x)).halvingX
      (algebraMap (W.twoTorsionField) (W.halvingTower x)
        (algebraMap F W.twoTorsionField x))).eval (W.halvingTowerXRoot x) = 0 :=
    eval_halvingX_baseChange (eval_halvingXRoot _)
  rwa [baseChange_baseChange' W W.twoTorsionField (W.halvingTower x),
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F W.twoTorsionField (W.halvingTower x) x] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_halvingTowerYRoot
statement:
theorem eval_halvingTowerYRoot (x : F) :
    ((W⁄(W.halvingTower x)).halvingY (W.halvingTowerXRoot x)).eval
      (W.halvingTowerYRoot x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (((W⁄(W.twoTorsionField))⁄(W.halvingTower x)).halvingY
      (W.halvingTowerXRoot x)).eval (W.halvingTowerYRoot x) = 0 :=
    eval_halvingY_baseChange (eval_halvingYRoot _ _)
  rwa [baseChange_baseChange' W W.twoTorsionField (W.halvingTower x)] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSeparable_halvingTower
statement:
theorem isSeparable_halvingTower (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x : F} (hx : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0) :
    Algebra.IsSeparable F (W.halvingTower x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄(W.twoTorsionField)).IsElliptic :=
    inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F W.twoTorsionField)).IsElliptic
  haveI := isGalois_of_isSplittingField_Ψ₂Sq (W := W) (L := W.twoTorsionField) h2
  haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable W.twoTorsionField (W.halvingTower x) :=
    isSeparable_halvingField (algebraMap_two_ne_zero'' h2)
      (separable_Ψ₂Sq (algebraMap_two_ne_zero'' h2)) (eval_Ψ₂Sq_baseChange hx)
  exact Algebra.IsSeparable.trans F W.twoTorsionField (W.halvingTower x)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteDimensional_halvingTower
statement: theorem finiteDimensional_halvingTower {x : F} : FiniteDimensional F (W.halvingTower x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FiniteDimensional F W.twoTorsionField :=
    finiteDimensional_of_isSplittingField_Ψ₂Sq W W.twoTorsionField
  haveI : FiniteDimensional W.twoTorsionField (W.halvingTower x) := finiteDimensional_halvingField
  exact FiniteDimensional.trans F W.twoTorsionField (W.halvingTower x)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isGalois_halvingGaloisField
statement:
theorem isGalois_halvingGaloisField (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x : F} (hx : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0) :
    IsGalois F (W.halvingGaloisField x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isSeparable_halvingTower h2 hx
  exact _root_.isGalois_normalClosure_of_isSeparable F (W.halvingTower x)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteDimensional_halvingGaloisField
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_halvingGaloisField {x : F} :
    FiniteDimensional F (W.halvingGaloisField x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FiniteDimensional F (W.halvingTower x) := finiteDimensional_halvingTower
  infer_instance

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.splits_Ψ₂Sq_halvingGaloisField
statement: theorem splits_Ψ₂Sq_halvingGaloisField (x : F) : (W⁄(W.halvingGaloisField x)).Ψ₂Sq.Splits
proof:
:= by
  have hL₁ : Splits (W.Ψ₂Sq.map (algebraMap F W.twoTorsionField)) := by
    have h := splits_Ψ₂Sq_baseChange W W.twoTorsionField
    rwa [show (W⁄(W.twoTorsionField)) = W.map (algebraMap F W.twoTorsionField) from rfl,
      WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₂Sq] at h
  have hN := Polynomial.Splits.of_algHom hL₁ (twoTorsionFieldToGalois W x)
  rwa [show (W⁄(W.halvingGaloisField x)) = W.map (algebraMap F (W.halvingGaloisField x)) from rfl,
    WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₂Sq]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_halvingGaloisField
statement:
theorem card_torsion_two_halvingGaloisField (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x : F)
    [DecidableEq (W.halvingGaloisField x)] :
    Nat.card ((W⁄(W.halvingGaloisField x)).torsion 2) = 4
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄(W.halvingGaloisField x)).IsElliptic :=
    inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F (W.halvingGaloisField x))).IsElliptic
  exact card_torsion_two_of_splits (algebraMap_two_ne_zero'' h2) (splits_Ψ₂Sq_halvingGaloisField x)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_two_eq_of_roots_baseChange
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_two_eq_of_roots_baseChange {M L : Type*} [Field M] [Field L] [Algebra F M]
    [Algebra F L] [Algebra M L] [IsScalarTower F M L] [DecidableEq L]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x y : F} (hQ : W.Nonsingular x y) (hx : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0)
    {r s : M} (hr : ((W⁄M).halvingX (algebraMap F M x)).eval r = 0)
    (hs : ((W⁄M).halvingY r).eval s = 0) :
    ∃ P : (W⁄L).Point, 2 • P = Point.some (algebraMap F L x) (algebraMap F L y)
      ((W.map_nonsingular (algebraMap F L).injective x y).mpr hQ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄L).IsElliptic := inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F L)).IsElliptic
  have hrL : ((W⁄L).halvingX (algebraMap F L x)).eval (algebraMap M L r) = 0 :=
    eval_halvingX_baseChange hr
  have hsL : ((W⁄L).halvingY (algebraMap M L r)).eval (algebraMap M L s) = 0 := by
    refine eval_halvingY_baseChange ?_
    rw [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply, hs, map_zero]
  exact exists_nsmul_two_eq_some_of_roots (algebraMap_two_ne_zero'' h2) _
    (eval_Ψ₂Sq_baseChange hx) hrL hsL

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_two_eq_halvingGaloisField
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_two_eq_halvingGaloisField (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x y : F}
    (hQ : W.Nonsingular x y) (hx : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0)
    [DecidableEq (W.halvingGaloisField x)] :
    ∃ P : (W⁄(W.halvingGaloisField x)).Point,
      2 • P = Point.some (algebraMap F (W.halvingGaloisField x) x)
        (algebraMap F (W.halvingGaloisField x) y)
        ((W.map_nonsingular (algebraMap F (W.halvingGaloisField x)).injective x y).mpr hQ)
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_two_eq_of_roots_baseChange h2 hQ hx (eval_halvingTowerXRoot x)
    (eval_halvingTowerYRoot x)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X'
statement:
private lemma Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X' :
    (y2EqX3Add4X ℚ).Ψ₂Sq = C 4 * X * (X ^ 2 + C 4)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆, y2EqX3Add4X]
  norm_num only
  simp only [map_ofNat, Polynomial.C_0]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X_eq_zero_iff'
statement:
private lemma eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X_eq_zero_iff' {x : ℚ} :
    (y2EqX3Add4X ℚ).Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X']
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_add, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h' | h'
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h' with h'' | h''
      · norm_num at h''
      · exact h''
    · nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
  · rintro rfl
    ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X_zero
statement: private lemma eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X_zero : (y2EqX3Add4X ℚ).Ψ₂Sq.eval 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X_eq_zero_iff'.mpr rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_roots_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X'
statement:
private lemma card_roots_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X' :
    Nat.card {x : ℚ // (y2EqX3Add4X ℚ).Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0} = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique]
  exact ⟨⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext ((eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X_eq_zero_iff'.mp a.2).trans
    (eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X_eq_zero_iff'.mp b.2).symm)⟩,
    ⟨⟨0, eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add4X_eq_zero_iff'.mpr rfl⟩⟩⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_y2EqX3Add4X_base

name: AddSubgroup.torsionSmulHom_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsionSmulHom_apply_coe (P : A[m * n]) :

proof:

  rfl

name: AddSubgroup.kerTorsionSmulHom_injective
statement: lemma kerTorsionSmulHom_injective : Function.Injective (kerTorsionSmulHom A m n)
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  have h' := Subtype.ext_iff.mp h
  exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h')

name: AddSubgroup.finite_torsionBy_mul
statement: theorem finite_torsionBy_mul [Finite A[m]] [Finite A[n]] : Finite A[m * n]
proof:
:= by
  rw [(torsionSmulHom A m n).finite_iff_finite_ker_range]
  exact ⟨Finite.of_injective _ (kerTorsionSmulHom_injective A m n),
    Finite.of_injective _ (rangeTorsionSmulHom_injective A m n)⟩

name: AddSubgroup.card_torsionBy_mul_le
statement:
theorem card_torsionBy_mul_le [Finite A[m]] [Finite A[n]] :
    Nat.card A[m * n] ≤ Nat.card A[m] * Nat.card A[n]
proof:
:= by
  have h := (torsionSmulHom A m n).ker.card_mul_index
  rw [AddSubgroup.index_ker] at h
  calc Nat.card A[m * n]
      = Nat.card (torsionSmulHom A m n).ker * Nat.card (torsionSmulHom A m n).range := h.symm
    _ ≤ Nat.card A[n] * Nat.card A[m] :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ (kerTorsionSmulHom_injective A m n))
          (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ (rangeTorsionSmulHom_injective A m n))
    _ = Nat.card A[m] * Nat.card A[n] := mul_comm _ _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.primeFactors_two_pow_mul_three_pow
statement:
private lemma primeFactors_two_pow_mul_three_pow (a b : ℕ) :
    ∀ p ∈ (2 ^ a * 3 ^ b).primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨hpp, hdvd, -⟩ := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hpp).mp hdvd with h | h
  · exact Or.inl ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpp Nat.prime_two).mp (hpp.dvd_of_dvd_pow h))
  · exact Or.inr ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpp Nat.prime_three).mp (hpp.dvd_of_dvd_pow h))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_and_card_torsion_le_sq_of_eq_two_or_three
statement:
private lemma finite_and_card_torsion_le_sq_of_eq_two_or_three {p : ℕ} (hp : p = 2 ∨ p = 3) :
    Finite (W.torsion p) ∧ Nat.card (W.torsion p) ≤ p ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp with rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨W.finite_torsion_two h2, by simpa using W.card_torsion_two_le h2⟩
  · exact ⟨W.finite_torsion_three h3, by simpa using W.card_torsion_three_le h3⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_and_card_torsion_le_sq_of_smooth
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hn hfac
    by_cases h1 : n = 1
    · subst h1
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [torsion_one]
        infer_instance
      · rw [torsion_one]
        simp
    · have hprime : n.minFac.Prime := Nat.minFac_prime h1
      have hdvd : n.minFac ∣ n := Nat.minFac_dvd n
      have hmem : n.minFac ∈ n.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hprime, hdvd, hn⟩
      have hsplit : n.minFac * (n / n.minFac) = n := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
      have hklt : n / n.minFac < n := Nat.div_lt_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) hprime.one_lt
      have hk0 : n / n.minFac ≠ 0 := fun h => hn (by rw [← hsplit, h, mul_zero])
      have hkfac : ∀ q ∈ (n / n.minFac).primeFactors, q = 2 ∨ q = 3 := fun q hq =>
        hfac q (Nat.primeFactors_mono (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hdvd) hn hq)
      obtain ⟨hkfin, hkcard⟩ := ih _ hklt hk0 hkfac
      obtain ⟨hpfin, hpcard⟩ :=
        finite_and_card_torsion_le_sq_of_eq_two_or_three (W := W) h2 h3 (hfac _ hmem)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hsplit]
        exact finite_torsion_mul hpfin hkfin
      · calc Nat.card (W.torsion n)
            = Nat.card (W.torsion (n.minFac * (n / n.minFac))) := by rw [hsplit]
          _ ≤ Nat.card (W.torsion n.minFac) * Nat.card (W.torsion (n / n.minFac)) :=
              card_torsion_mul_le hpfin hkfin
          _ ≤ n.minFac ^ 2 * (n / n.minFac) ^ 2 := Nat.mul_le_mul hpcard hkcard
          _ = (n.minFac * (n / n.minFac)) ^ 2 := (mul_pow _ _ 2).symm
          _ = n ^ 2 := by rw [hsplit]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_of_smooth
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_of_smooth {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hfac : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3) : Finite (W.torsion n)
proof:
:=
  (finite_and_card_torsion_le_sq_of_smooth h2 h3 n hn hfac).1

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_le_sq_of_smooth
statement:
theorem card_torsion_le_sq_of_smooth {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hfac : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3) : Nat.card (W.torsion n) ≤ n ^ 2
proof:
:=
  (finite_and_card_torsion_le_sq_of_smooth h2 h3 n hn hfac).2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_two_pow_mul_three_pow
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_two_pow_mul_three_pow (a b : ℕ) :
    Finite (W.torsion (2 ^ a * 3 ^ b))
proof:
:=

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_pow_mul_three_pow_le
statement:

proof:
:=
  card_torsion_le_sq_of_smooth h2 h3 (by positivity)
    (primeFactors_two_pow_mul_three_pow a b)

statement: theorem card_torsion_four_le : Nat.card (W.torsion 4) ≤ 16

name: IsEllipticNet.netX_neg
statement: lemma netX_neg (hodd : Function.Odd a) (x : F) (n : ℤ) : netX a x (-n) = netX a x n
proof:
:= by
  rw [netX, netX, show -n + 1 = -(n - 1) from by ring, show -n - 1 = -(n + 1) from by ring,
    hodd, hodd, hodd, neg_mul_neg, neg_pow, mul_comm (a (n - 1))]

statement: lemma netS_neg (hodd : Function.Odd a) (n : ℤ) : netS a (-n) = -netS a n

name: IsEllipticNet.netDefect_neg

name: IsEllipticNet.netX_sub_netX
proof:
:= by
  have key := mul_sub_eq_of_rel_one h1 (hnet p q 1 0)

  field_simp
