:=
  mem_torsion_iff.mp (by rw [← hgen]; exact mem_closure_snd P Q)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_eq_of_mem_torsion
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hℓ y
  have hx' : ℓ • x = y := hx
  refine ⟨x, ?_, hx'⟩
  rw [mem_torsion_iff, pow_succ, mul_smul, hx']
  exact hy

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.closure_pair_eq_torsion_succ
statement:
theorem closure_pair_eq_torsion_succ {ℓ k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) {P Q P' Q' : W.Point}
    (hP' : P' ∈ W.torsion (ℓ ^ (k + 1))) (hQ' : Q' ∈ W.torsion (ℓ ^ (k + 1)))
    (hP : ℓ • P' = P) (hQ : ℓ • Q' = Q)
    (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (ℓ ^ k)) :
    AddSubgroup.closure ({P', Q'} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (ℓ ^ (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  set H := AddSubgroup.closure ({P', Q'} : Set W.Point) with hH
  have hP'H : P' ∈ H := AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hQ'H : Q' ∈ H := AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  
  have hle : W.torsion (ℓ ^ k) ≤ H := by
    rw [← hgen, AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hP ▸ AddSubgroup.nsmul_mem _ hP'H ℓ
    · exact hQ ▸ AddSubgroup.nsmul_mem _ hQ'H ℓ
  refine le_antisymm ?_ fun x hx => ?_
  · rw [AddSubgroup.closure_le]
    rintro x (rfl | rfl) <;> assumption
  · 
    have hlx : ℓ • x ∈ W.torsion (ℓ ^ k) := by
      rw [mem_torsion_iff, ← mul_smul, ← pow_succ]
      exact hx
    rw [← hgen] at hlx
    obtain ⟨m, l, hml⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_closure_pair.mp hlx
    have hhH : m • P' + l • Q' ∈ H :=
      AddSubgroup.add_mem _ (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hP'H m) (AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ hQ'H l)
    
    have hdiff : x - (m • P' + l • Q') ∈ W.torsion ℓ := by
      rw [mem_torsion_iff, smul_sub, sub_eq_zero, smul_add, smul_comm ℓ m, smul_comm ℓ l, hP, hQ,
        hml]
    have : x - (m • P' + l • Q') ∈ H :=
      hle (torsion_mono (dvd_pow_self ℓ (by omega)) hdiff)
    simpa using AddSubgroup.add_mem _ this hhH

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_of_addEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_of_addEquiv {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (e : W.torsion n ≃+ ZMod n × ZMod n) :
    ∃ P Q : W.Point, P ∈ W.torsion n ∧ Q ∈ W.torsion n ∧
      AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(e.symm (1, 0) : W.Point), (e.symm (0, 1) : W.Point),
    (e.symm (1, 0)).2, (e.symm (0, 1)).2, ?_⟩
  have htop : AddSubgroup.closure ({e.symm (1, 0), e.symm (0, 1)} : Set (W.torsion n)) = ⊤ := by
    have himg : (e.symm.toAddMonoidHom) ''
        ({((1 : ZMod n), (0 : ZMod n)), ((0 : ZMod n), (1 : ZMod n))} : Set (ZMod n × ZMod n))
        = ({e.symm (1, 0), e.symm (0, 1)} : Set (W.torsion n)) := by
      rw [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
      rfl
    rw [← himg, ← AddMonoidHom.map_closure, closure_pair_zmod_prod n,
      AddSubgroup.map_top_of_surjective _ e.symm.surjective]
  have hsub : AddSubgroup.map (W.torsion n).subtype
      (AddSubgroup.closure ({e.symm (1, 0), e.symm (0, 1)} : Set (W.torsion n)))
      = AddSubgroup.closure ({(e.symm (1, 0) : W.Point), (e.symm (0, 1) : W.Point)} :
        Set W.Point) := by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.map_closure, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
    rfl
  rw [← hsub, htop, ← AddMonoidHom.range_eq_map, AddSubgroup.range_subtype]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_compatible_basis_of_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_compatible_basis_of_surjective {ℓ : ℕ}
    (hℓ : Function.Surjective fun P : W.Point => ℓ • P)
    (hbase : ∃ P Q : W.Point, P ∈ W.torsion ℓ ∧ Q ∈ W.torsion ℓ ∧
      AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion ℓ) :
    ∃ P Q : ℕ → W.Point,
      (∀ k, AddSubgroup.closure ({P k, Q k} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (ℓ ^ k)) ∧
      (∀ k, ℓ • P (k + 1) = P k) ∧ (∀ k, ℓ • Q (k + 1) = Q k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g₁, g₂, hg₁, hg₂, hg⟩ := hbase
  
  have key : ∀ (k : ℕ) (pq : W.Point × W.Point), ∃ pq' : W.Point × W.Point,
      AddSubgroup.closure ({pq.1, pq.2} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (ℓ ^ k) →
        AddSubgroup.closure ({pq'.1, pq'.2} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (ℓ ^ (k + 1)) ∧
          ℓ • pq'.1 = pq.1 ∧ ℓ • pq'.2 = pq.2 := by
    intro k pq
    by_cases hpq : AddSubgroup.closure ({pq.1, pq.2} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (ℓ ^ k)
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
      · 
        have hmem₁ : pq.1 ∈ AddSubgroup.closure ({pq.1, pq.2} : Set W.Point) :=
          AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert _ _)
        have hmem₂ : pq.2 ∈ AddSubgroup.closure ({pq.1, pq.2} : Set W.Point) :=
          AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
        rw [hpq, pow_zero, torsion_one, AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hmem₁ hmem₂
        refine ⟨(g₁, g₂), fun _ => ⟨by simpa using hg, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
        · rw [hmem₁]; exact mem_torsion_iff.mp hg₁
        · rw [hmem₂]; exact mem_torsion_iff.mp hg₂
      · 
        have hp : pq.1 ∈ W.torsion (ℓ ^ k) :=
          hpq ▸ AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert _ _)
        have hq : pq.2 ∈ W.torsion (ℓ ^ k) :=
          hpq ▸ AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
        obtain ⟨p', hp'mem, hp'⟩ := exists_nsmul_eq_of_mem_torsion hℓ hp
        obtain ⟨q', hq'mem, hq'⟩ := exists_nsmul_eq_of_mem_torsion hℓ hq
        exact ⟨(p', q'), fun _ =>
          ⟨closure_pair_eq_torsion_succ hk hp'mem hq'mem hp' hq' hpq, hp', hq'⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨(0, 0), fun h => absurd h hpq⟩
  choose nxt hnxt using key
  obtain ⟨b, hb0, hbs⟩ : ∃ b : ℕ → W.Point × W.Point,
      b 0 = (0, 0) ∧ ∀ k, b (k + 1) = nxt k (b k) :=
    ⟨fun k => Nat.rec ((0 : W.Point), (0 : W.Point)) nxt k, rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  have hgen : ∀ k, AddSubgroup.closure ({(b k).1, (b k).2} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (ℓ ^ k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      rw [hb0, pow_zero, torsion_one]
      simp
    | succ k ih => rw [hbs]; exact (hnxt k (b k) ih).1
  refine ⟨fun k => (b k).1, fun k => (b k).2, hgen, fun k => ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · change ℓ • (b (k + 1)).1 = (b k).1
    rw [hbs]
    exact (hnxt k (b k) (hgen k)).2.1
  · change ℓ • (b (k + 1)).2 = (b k).2
    rw [hbs]
    exact (hnxt k (b k) (hgen k)).2.2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionPairHom_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsionPairHom_apply_coe {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P Q : W.Point}
    (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion n)
    (ab : ZMod n × ZMod n) :
    ((torsionPairHom hgen ab : W.torsion n) : W.Point) = ab.1.val • P + ab.2.val • Q
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_zmod_pair_eq
statement:
theorem exists_zmod_pair_eq {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P Q : W.Point}
    (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion n)
    {x : W.Point} (hx : x ∈ W.torsion n) :
    ∃ a b : ZMod n, a.val • P + b.val • Q = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ab, hab⟩ := zmodPairHom_surjOn (nsmul_fst_of_closure hgen) (nsmul_snd_of_closure hgen)
    (by rw [hgen]; exact hx)
  exact ⟨ab.1, ab.2, hab⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionPairHom_bijective_of_card
statement:
theorem torsionPairHom_bijective_of_card {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n * n) {P Q : W.Point}
    (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion n) :
    Function.Bijective (torsionPairHom hgen)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Nat.bijective_iff_surjective_and_card _).mpr ⟨fun x => ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := exists_zmod_pair_eq hgen x.2
    exact ⟨(a, b), Subtype.ext hab⟩
  · rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_zmod, hcard]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionPairEquivOfCard_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsionPairEquivOfCard_apply_coe {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n * n) {P Q : W.Point}
    (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion n)
    (ab : ZMod n × ZMod n) :
    ((torsionPairEquivOfCard hcard hgen ab : W.torsion n) : W.Point)
      = ab.1.val • P + ab.2.val • Q
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.zmod_pair_eq_zero_iff_of_card
statement:
theorem zmod_pair_eq_zero_iff_of_card {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n * n) {P Q : W.Point}
    (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion n)
    {a b : ZMod n} : a.val • P + b.val • Q = 0 ↔ a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : torsionPairHom hgen (a, b) = torsionPairHom hgen (0, 0) := by
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      rw [torsionPairHom_apply_coe, torsionPairHom_apply_coe, h]
      simp
    exact Prod.mk.injEq .. ▸ (Prod.ext_iff.mp
      ((torsionPairHom_bijective_of_card hcard hgen).1 this))
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ne_zero_and_ne_of_closure_pair_of_card
statement:
theorem ne_zero_and_ne_of_closure_pair_of_card {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n * n) (hn : 1 < n) {P Q : W.Point}
    (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion n) :
    P ≠ 0 ∧ Q ≠ 0 ∧ P ≠ Q
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact (1 < n) := ⟨hn⟩
  have hval1 : ((1 : ZMod n)).val = 1 := ZMod.val_one _
  have hval0 : ((0 : ZMod n)).val = 0 := ZMod.val_zero
  have hne10 : (1 : ZMod n) ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero
  refine ⟨fun h => hne10 ?_, fun h => hne10 ?_, fun h => hne10 ?_⟩
  · exact ((zmod_pair_eq_zero_iff_of_card hcard hgen (a := 1) (b := 0)).mp
      (by rw [hval1, hval0, h]; simp)).1
  · exact ((zmod_pair_eq_zero_iff_of_card hcard hgen (a := 0) (b := 1)).mp
      (by rw [hval1, hval0, h]; simp)).2
  · have himg : torsionPairHom hgen (1, 0) = torsionPairHom hgen (0, 1) := by
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      rw [torsionPairHom_apply_coe, torsionPairHom_apply_coe, hval1, hval0, h]
      simp
    exact congrArg Prod.fst ((torsionPairHom_bijective_of_card hcard hgen).1 himg)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.zsmul_surjective_of_nsmul
proof:
:= by
  intro Q
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hsurj Q
  exact ⟨P, by change ((p : ℕ) : ℤ) • P = Q; rw [natCast_zsmul]; exact hP⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_mul_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : W.torsion (n * p) = W.Point[(n : ℤ) * (p : ℤ)] :=
    congrArg (fun k : ℤ => W.Point[k]) (by push_cast; ring)
  rw [hcast,
    AddSubgroup.card_torsionBy_mul_of_surjective (n : ℤ) (zsmul_surjective_of_nsmul hsurj),
    show W.Point[(p : ℤ)] = W.torsion p from rfl, mul_comm]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_pow_of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [torsion_one]
  | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ, card_torsion_mul_of_surjective hsurj, ih, pow_succ, mul_comm]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_pow
statement:
theorem card_torsion_pow {p : ℕ}
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun P : W.Point => p • P)
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion p) = p ^ 2) (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (p ^ k)) = (p ^ k) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_torsion_pow_of_surjective hsurj, hcard, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_pow
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_pow {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun P : W.Point => p • P)
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion p) = p ^ 2) (k : ℕ) : Finite (W.torsion (p ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  have h : Nat.card (W.torsion (p ^ k)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [card_torsion_pow hsurj hcard]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (pow_ne_zero k hp)
  exact (Nat.card_ne_zero.mp h).2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_pow_mul_self
statement:
theorem card_torsion_pow_mul_self {p : ℕ}
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun P : W.Point => p • P)
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion p) = p ^ 2) (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (p ^ k)) = p ^ k * p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_torsion_pow hsurj hcard, sq]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun P : W.Point => p • P)
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion p) = p ^ 2) (k : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion (p ^ k) ≃+ ZMod (p ^ k) × ZMod (p ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := finite_torsion_pow hp.pos.ne' hsurj hcard k
  haveI : Finite (W.torsion p) := by
    have h : Nat.card (W.torsion p) ≠ 0 := by rw [hcard]; exact pow_ne_zero 2 hp.pos.ne'
    exact (Nat.card_ne_zero.mp h).2
  refine AddCommGroup.equiv_zmod_sq_of_card_sq (pow_pos hp.pos k)
    (fun a => nsmul_mem_torsion a) (card_torsion_pow hsurj hcard k) ?_
  intro q hq
  rcases eq_or_ne q p with rfl | hqp
  · 
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        fun a : {a : W.torsion (q ^ k) // (q : ℕ) • a = 0} => (⟨(a.1 : W.Point), by
          rw [mem_torsion_iff]
          exact congrArg Subtype.val a.2⟩ : W.torsion q) := by
      intro a b hab
      simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq] at hab
      exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hab)
    calc Nat.card {a : W.torsion (q ^ k) // (q : ℕ) • a = 0}
        ≤ Nat.card (W.torsion q) := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ hinj
      _ = q ^ 2 := hcard
  · 
    have hcop : IsCoprime (q : ℤ) ((p : ℤ) ^ k) := by
      have hnat : Nat.Coprime q (p ^ k) :=
        Nat.Coprime.pow_right k ((Nat.coprime_primes hq hp).mpr hqp)
      simpa using Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr hnat
    obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hcop
    have hzero : ∀ a : W.torsion (p ^ k), (q : ℕ) • a = 0 → a = 0 := by
      intro a ha
      have hqa : (q : ℤ) • a = 0 := by
        rw [show (q : ℤ) = ((q : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl, natCast_zsmul, ha]
      have hka : ((p : ℤ) ^ k) • a = 0 := by
        rw [show ((p : ℤ) ^ k) = (((p ^ k : ℕ)) : ℤ) by push_cast; ring, natCast_zsmul]
        exact nsmul_mem_torsion a
      have h1 : ((1 : ℤ)) • a = 0 := by
        rw [← huv, add_smul, mul_smul, mul_smul, hqa, hka, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
      simpa using h1
    have hcard1 : Nat.card {a : W.torsion (p ^ k) // (q : ℕ) • a = 0} = 1 := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique]
      exact ⟨⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext ((hzero a.1 a.2).trans (hzero b.1 b.2).symm)⟩, ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩⟩⟩
    rw [hcard1]
    exact Nat.one_le_pow 2 q hq.pos

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_pow_of_card
statement:
theorem card_torsion_pow_of_card (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion p) = p ^ 2) (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (p ^ k)) = (p ^ k) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_pow (nsmul_surjective_of_two_ne_zero h2 hp) hcard k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_pow_of_card
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_pow_of_card (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion p) = p ^ 2) (k : ℕ) : Finite (W.torsion (p ^ k))
proof:
:=
  finite_torsion_pow hp (nsmul_surjective_of_two_ne_zero h2 hp) hcard k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_pow_mul_self_of_card
statement:
theorem card_torsion_pow_mul_self_of_card (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 0)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv_of_card
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv_of_card (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion p) = p ^ 2) (k : ℕ) :

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_pow_of_odd
statement:
theorem card_torsion_pow_of_odd (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hodd : Odd p) (hp : (p : F) ≠ 0)
    (k : ℕ) : Nat.card (W.torsion (p ^ k)) = (p ^ k) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_pow_of_card h2 (fun h => hp (by rw [h, Nat.cast_zero]))
    (card_torsion_eq_sq_of_odd h2 hodd hp) k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_pow_of_odd
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_pow_of_odd (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hodd : Odd p) (hp : (p : F) ≠ 0)
    (k : ℕ) : Finite (W.torsion (p ^ k))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_pow_mul_self_of_odd
statement:
theorem card_torsion_pow_mul_self_of_odd (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hodd : Odd p)
    (hp : (p : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) : Nat.card (W.torsion (p ^ k)) = p ^ k * p ^ k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv_of_odd
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv_of_odd (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hodd : Odd p) (hpF : (p : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion (p ^ k) ≃+ ZMod (p ^ k) × ZMod (p ^ k))
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv_of_card h2 hp (card_torsion_eq_sq_of_odd h2 hodd hpF) k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_nsmul_eq_zero_torsion_le_of_odd
statement:
theorem card_nsmul_eq_zero_torsion_le_of_odd (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n)
    (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) :
    Nat.card {a : W.torsion n // q • a = 0} ≤ q ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hdvd : q ∣ n
  · have hqodd : Odd q := by
      rcases Nat.even_or_odd q with he | ho
      · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hdvd
        exact absurd (he.mul_right k) (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hodd)
      · exact ho
    have hqF : (q : F) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hdvd
      exact hn (by push_cast; rw [h, zero_mul])
    haveI : Finite (W.torsion q) := finite_torsion_of_intCast_ne_zero h2 hqF
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        fun a : {a : W.torsion n // q • a = 0} => (⟨(a.1 : W.Point), by
          rw [mem_torsion_iff]
          exact congrArg Subtype.val a.2⟩ : W.torsion q) := by
      intro a b hab
      simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq] at hab
      exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hab)
    calc Nat.card {a : W.torsion n // q • a = 0}
        ≤ Nat.card (W.torsion q) := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ hinj
      _ = q ^ 2 := card_torsion_eq_sq_of_odd h2 hqodd hqF
  · have hcop : IsCoprime (q : ℤ) (n : ℤ) := by
      have hnat : Nat.Coprime q n := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hq).mpr hdvd
      simpa using Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr hnat
    obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hcop
    have hzero : ∀ a : W.torsion n, q • a = 0 → a = 0 := by
      intro a ha
      have hqa : (q : ℤ) • a = 0 := by
        rw [show (q : ℤ) = ((q : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl, natCast_zsmul, ha]
      have hna : (n : ℤ) • a = 0 := by
        rw [show (n : ℤ) = ((n : ℕ) : ℤ) from rfl, natCast_zsmul]
        exact nsmul_mem_torsion a
      have h1 : (1 : ℤ) • a = 0 := by
        rw [← huv, add_smul, mul_smul, mul_smul, hqa, hna, smul_zero, smul_zero, add_zero]
      simpa using h1
    have hcard1 : Nat.card {a : W.torsion n // q • a = 0} = 1 := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique]
      exact ⟨⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext ((hzero a.1 a.2).trans (hzero b.1 b.2).symm)⟩, ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩⟩⟩
    rw [hcard1]
    exact Nat.one_le_pow 2 q hq.pos

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsion_addEquiv_of_odd
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsion_addEquiv_of_odd (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n)
    (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) : Nonempty (W.torsion n ≃+ ZMod n × ZMod n)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite (W.torsion n) := finite_torsion_of_intCast_ne_zero h2 hn
  have hn0 : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; exact hn (by norm_num))
  exact AddCommGroup.equiv_zmod_sq_of_card_sq hn0 (fun a => nsmul_mem_torsion a)
    (card_torsion_eq_sq_of_odd h2 hodd hn)
    (fun q hq => card_nsmul_eq_zero_torsion_le_of_odd h2 hodd hn hq)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleTwoOdd
statement: private lemma exampleTwoOdd : (2 : AlgClosedQ) ≠ 0
proof: := two_ne_zero

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_eq_sq
statement:
theorem card_torsion_eq_sq (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hn
  set a := n.factorization 2 with ha
  set m := n / 2 ^ a with hm
  have hsplit : 2 ^ a * m = n := Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self n 2
  have hdvd : ¬ (2 ∣ m) := Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl Nat.prime_two hn0
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime (2 ^ a) m :=
    Nat.Coprime.pow_left _ ((Nat.prime_two.coprime_iff_not_dvd).mpr hdvd)
  have hmF : (m : F) ≠ 0 := fun hz => hn (by rw [← hsplit]; push_cast; rw [hz, mul_zero])
  have hodd : Odd m := Nat.odd_iff.mpr (Nat.two_dvd_ne_zero.mp hdvd)
  have hmul := card_torsion_mul (W := W) hcop
  rw [hsplit] at hmul
  rw [hmul, card_torsion_two_pow h2 a, card_torsion_eq_sq_of_odd h2 hodd hmF, ← hsplit,
    show (4 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, ← pow_mul, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_comm a 2]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionPrimePow_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionPrimePow_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hpF : (p : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion (p ^ k) ≃+ ZMod (p ^ k) × ZMod (p ^ k))
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv hp (nsmul_surjective_of_two_ne_zero h2 hp.pos.ne')
    (card_torsion_eq_sq h2 hpF) k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsion_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsion_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion n ≃+ ZMod n × ZMod n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.recOnPosPrimePosCoprime with
  | prime_pow p k hp hk =>
      refine nonempty_torsionPrimePow_addEquiv h2 hp ?_ k
      intro hz
      exact hn (by push_cast; rw [hz]; exact zero_pow hk.ne')
  | zero => exact absurd (by push_cast; ring) hn
  | one => simpa using nonempty_torsionTwoPow_addEquiv (W := W) h2 0
  | coprime a b _ _ hcop Pa Pb =>
      have haF : (a : F) ≠ 0 := fun hz => hn (by push_cast; rw [hz, zero_mul])
      have hbF : (b : F) ≠ 0 := fun hz => hn (by push_cast; rw [hz, mul_zero])
      exact nonempty_torsion_addEquiv_zmod_sq_of_coprime hcop (Pa haF) (Pb hbF)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_five
statement:
theorem card_torsion_five (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h5 : (5 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion 5) = 25
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_torsion_eq_sq (W := W) h2 (n := 5) (by exact_mod_cast h5)
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionFive_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionFive_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h5 : (5 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 5 ≃+ ZMod 5 × ZMod 5)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsion_addEquiv h2 (by exact_mod_cast h5)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_ten
statement:
theorem card_torsion_ten (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h5 : (5 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion 10) = 100
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_torsion_eq_sq (W := W) h2 (n := 10)
    (by rw [show ((10 : ℕ) : F) = 2 * 5 by push_cast; ring]; exact mul_ne_zero h2 h5)
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionTen_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionTen_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h5 : (5 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 10 ≃+ ZMod 10 × ZMod 10)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsion_addEquiv h2
    (by rw [show ((10 : ℕ) : F) = 2 * 5 by push_cast; ring]; exact mul_ne_zero h2 h5)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo]
    (h : (OfNat.ofNat n : F) ≠ 0) : (OfNat.ofNat n : L) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_ofNat (algebraMap F L) n, ne_eq, map_eq_zero]
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Ψ₃
statement: theorem separable_Ψ₃ [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) : W.Ψ₃.Separable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsplits : (W.Ψ₃.map (algebraMap F W.Ψ₃.SplittingField)).Splits :=
    IsSplittingField.splits W.Ψ₃.SplittingField W.Ψ₃
  refine (Polynomial.nodup_aroots_iff_of_splits (K := W.Ψ₃.SplittingField)
    (W.Ψ₃_ne_zero h3) hsplits).mp ?_
  haveI : (W⁄W.Ψ₃.SplittingField).IsElliptic :=
    inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F W.Ψ₃.SplittingField)).IsElliptic
  have hnodup := nodup_roots_Ψ₃ (W := W⁄W.Ψ₃.SplittingField)
    (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 2 h2) (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3)
  rw [show (W⁄W.Ψ₃.SplittingField).Ψ₃ = W.Ψ₃.map (algebraMap F W.Ψ₃.SplittingField) from
    WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₃ ..] at hnodup
  simpa [Polynomial.aroots] using hnodup

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.splits_Ψ₃_baseChange
statement: theorem splits_Ψ₃_baseChange : (W⁄L₁).Ψ₃.Splits
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (W⁄L₁).Ψ₃ = W.Ψ₃.map (algebraMap F L₁) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₃ ..]
  exact IsSplittingField.splits L₁ W.Ψ₃

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isGalois_of_isSplittingField_Ψ₃
statement:
theorem isGalois_of_isSplittingField_Ψ₃ [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    IsGalois F L₁
proof:
:=
  IsGalois.of_separable_splitting_field (p := W.Ψ₃) (separable_Ψ₃ h2 h3)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteDimensional_of_isSplittingField_Ψ₃
statement: theorem finiteDimensional_of_isSplittingField_Ψ₃ : FiniteDimensional F L₁
proof:
:=
  IsSplittingField.finiteDimensional L₁ W.Ψ₃

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂SqRootPoly_ne_zero
statement: lemma Ψ₂SqRootPoly_ne_zero : Ψ₂SqRootPoly W L₁ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Ψ₂SqRootPoly]
  refine Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun c _ => ?_
  exact X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero (by norm_num) c

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.dvd_Ψ₂SqRootPoly
statement:
lemma dvd_Ψ₂SqRootPoly {x : L₁} (hx : (W⁄L₁).Ψ₃.eval x = 0) (h3 : (3 : L₁) ≠ 0) :
    (X ^ 2 - C ((W⁄L₁).Ψ₂Sq.eval x)) ∣ Ψ₂SqRootPoly W L₁
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ?_)
  rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, mem_roots ((W⁄L₁).Ψ₃_ne_zero h3)]
  exact hx

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Ψ₂SqRootPoly
statement:
lemma separable_Ψ₂SqRootPoly [(W⁄L₁).IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : L₁) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : L₁) ≠ 0) :
    (Ψ₂SqRootPoly W L₁).Separable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Ψ₂SqRootPoly]
  refine separable_prod' ?_ ?_
  · intro c hc d hd hcd
    have hne : d - c ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero_of_ne (Ne.symm hcd)
    refine ⟨C (d - c)⁻¹, -C (d - c)⁻¹, ?_⟩
    have hrw : C (d - c)⁻¹ * (X ^ 2 - C c) + -C (d - c)⁻¹ * (X ^ 2 - C d)
        = C ((d - c)⁻¹ * (d - c)) := by rw [map_mul, map_sub]; ring
    rw [hrw, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, map_one]
  · intro c hc
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hc
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hc
    rw [mem_roots ((W⁄L₁).Ψ₃_ne_zero h3)] at hx
    exact separable_X_pow_sub_C _ (by simpa using h2)
      (Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_Ψ₃ h2 hx)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₃_eq_map
statement: private lemma Ψ₃_eq_map : (W⁄L₂).Ψ₃ = ((W⁄L₁).Ψ₃).map (algebraMap L₁ L₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (W⁄L₂).Ψ₃ = W.Ψ₃.map (algebraMap F L₂) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₃ ..,
    show (W⁄L₁).Ψ₃ = W.Ψ₃.map (algebraMap F L₁) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₃ ..,
    Polynomial.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eq_map
statement: private lemma Ψ₂Sq_eq_map : (W⁄L₂).Ψ₂Sq = ((W⁄L₁).Ψ₂Sq).map (algebraMap L₁ L₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (W⁄L₂).Ψ₂Sq = W.Ψ₂Sq.map (algebraMap F L₂) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₂Sq ..,
    show (W⁄L₁).Ψ₂Sq = W.Ψ₂Sq.map (algebraMap F L₁) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₂Sq ..,
    Polynomial.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.splits_Ψ₃_tower
statement: theorem splits_Ψ₃_tower : (W⁄L₂).Ψ₃.Splits
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ψ₃_eq_map L₁]
  exact (splits_Ψ₃_baseChange W L₁).map _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_tower
statement:
theorem isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_tower (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {z : L₂} (hz : (W⁄L₂).Ψ₃.eval z = 0) :
    IsSquare ((W⁄L₂).Ψ₂Sq.eval z)
proof:
:= by
  have h3₁ : (3 : L₁) ≠ 0 := algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3
  have h3₂ : (3 : L₂) ≠ 0 := algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3
  have hmem : z ∈ (W⁄L₂).Ψ₃.roots := (mem_roots ((W⁄L₂).Ψ₃_ne_zero h3₂)).mpr hz
  rw [Ψ₃_eq_map L₁, (splits_Ψ₃_baseChange W L₁).roots_map] at hmem
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hmem
  rw [mem_roots ((W⁄L₁).Ψ₃_ne_zero h3₁)] at hx
  set c : L₁ := (W⁄L₁).Ψ₂Sq.eval x with hc
  have hdvd : (X ^ 2 - C c) ∣ Ψ₂SqRootPoly W L₁ := dvd_Ψ₂SqRootPoly hx h3₁
  have hsplits : (((X : L₁[X]) ^ 2 - C c).map (algebraMap L₁ L₂)).Splits :=
    ((IsSplittingField.splits L₂ (Ψ₂SqRootPoly W L₁)).of_dvd
      (Polynomial.map_ne_zero Ψ₂SqRootPoly_ne_zero) (Polynomial.map_dvd _ hdvd))
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hsplits.exists_eval_eq_zero (by
    rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C]
    rw [degree_X_pow_sub_C (by norm_num)]
    exact by decide)
  rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C, eval_sub,
    eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C, sub_eq_zero] at hs
  rw [Ψ₂Sq_eq_map L₁, eval_map, eval₂_hom, ← hc, ← hs]
  exact ⟨s, (sq s).symm ▸ rfl⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_tower
statement:
theorem card_torsion_three_tower [W.IsElliptic] [DecidableEq L₂] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) : Nat.card ((W⁄L₂).torsion 3) = 9
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄L₂).IsElliptic := inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F L₂)).IsElliptic
  exact card_torsion_three_of_splits (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 2 h2)
    (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3) (splits_Ψ₃_tower L₁)
    fun _ hz => isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_tower L₁ h3 hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_tower
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_tower [W.IsElliptic] [DecidableEq L₂] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) : Nonempty ((W⁄L₂).torsion 3 ≃+ ZMod 3 × ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄L₂).IsElliptic := inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F L₂)).IsElliptic
  exact nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_of_splits (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 2 h2)
    (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3) (splits_Ψ₃_tower L₁)
    fun _ hz => isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_tower L₁ h3 hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteDimensional_tower
statement: theorem finiteDimensional_tower : FiniteDimensional F L₂
proof:
:= by
  haveI : FiniteDimensional F L₁ := finiteDimensional_of_isSplittingField_Ψ₃ W L₁
  haveI : FiniteDimensional L₁ L₂ := IsSplittingField.finiteDimensional L₂ (Ψ₂SqRootPoly W L₁)
  exact FiniteDimensional.trans F L₁ L₂

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isGalois_tower_top
statement:
theorem isGalois_tower_top [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    IsGalois L₁ L₂
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄L₁).IsElliptic := inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F L₁)).IsElliptic
  exact IsGalois.of_separable_splitting_field (p := Ψ₂SqRootPoly W L₁)
    (separable_Ψ₂SqRootPoly (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 2 h2) (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSeparable_tower
statement:
theorem isSeparable_tower [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Algebra.IsSeparable F L₂
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isGalois_of_isSplittingField_Ψ₃ W L₁ h2 h3
  haveI := isGalois_tower_top (W := W) L₁ (L₂ := L₂) h2 h3
  exact Algebra.IsSeparable.trans F L₁ L₂

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₃_eq_map_algHom
statement: private lemma Ψ₃_eq_map_algHom (φ : L →ₐ[F] M) : (W⁄M).Ψ₃ = ((W⁄L).Ψ₃).map φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (W⁄M).Ψ₃ = W.Ψ₃.map (algebraMap F M) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₃ ..,
    show (W⁄L).Ψ₃ = W.Ψ₃.map (algebraMap F L) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₃ ..,
    Polynomial.map_map, ← φ.comp_algebraMap]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eq_map_algHom
statement: private lemma Ψ₂Sq_eq_map_algHom (φ : L →ₐ[F] M) : (W⁄M).Ψ₂Sq = ((W⁄L).Ψ₂Sq).map φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (W⁄M).Ψ₂Sq = W.Ψ₂Sq.map (algebraMap F M) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₂Sq ..,
    show (W⁄L).Ψ₂Sq = W.Ψ₂Sq.map (algebraMap F L) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Ψ₂Sq ..,
    Polynomial.map_map, ← φ.comp_algebraMap]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.splits_Ψ₃_of_algHom
statement: theorem splits_Ψ₃_of_algHom (φ : L →ₐ[F] M) (h : (W⁄L).Ψ₃.Splits) : (W⁄M).Ψ₃.Splits
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ψ₃_eq_map_algHom φ]
  exact h.map _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_of_algHom
statement:
theorem isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_of_algHom (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (φ : L →ₐ[F] M)
    (hsplits : (W⁄L).Ψ₃.Splits)
    (hsq : ∀ x : L, (W⁄L).Ψ₃.eval x = 0 → IsSquare ((W⁄L).Ψ₂Sq.eval x))
    {z : M} (hz : (W⁄M).Ψ₃.eval z = 0) : IsSquare ((W⁄M).Ψ₂Sq.eval z)
proof:
:= by
  have h3L : (3 : L) ≠ 0 := algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3
  have h3M : (3 : M) ≠ 0 := algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3
  have hmem : z ∈ (W⁄M).Ψ₃.roots := (mem_roots ((W⁄M).Ψ₃_ne_zero h3M)).mpr hz
  rw [Ψ₃_eq_map_algHom φ, hsplits.roots_map] at hmem
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hmem
  rw [mem_roots ((W⁄L).Ψ₃_ne_zero h3L)] at hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hsq x hx
  rw [Ψ₂Sq_eq_map_algHom φ, eval_map, eval₂_hom, hs, map_mul]
  exact ⟨φ s, rfl⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_of_algHom
statement:
theorem card_torsion_three_of_algHom [W.IsElliptic] [DecidableEq M] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (φ : L →ₐ[F] M) (hsplits : (W⁄L).Ψ₃.Splits)
    (hsq : ∀ x : L, (W⁄L).Ψ₃.eval x = 0 → IsSquare ((W⁄L).Ψ₂Sq.eval x)) :
    Nat.card ((W⁄M).torsion 3) = 9
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄M).IsElliptic := inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F M)).IsElliptic
  exact card_torsion_three_of_splits (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 2 h2)
    (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3) (splits_Ψ₃_of_algHom φ hsplits)
    fun _ hz => isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_of_algHom h3 φ hsplits hsq hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_of_algHom
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_of_algHom [W.IsElliptic] [DecidableEq M] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (φ : L →ₐ[F] M) (hsplits : (W⁄L).Ψ₃.Splits)
    (hsq : ∀ x : L, (W⁄L).Ψ₃.eval x = 0 → IsSquare ((W⁄L).Ψ₂Sq.eval x)) :
    Nonempty ((W⁄M).torsion 3 ≃+ ZMod 3 × ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄M).IsElliptic := inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F M)).IsElliptic
  exact nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_of_splits (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 2 h2)
    (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero 3 h3) (splits_Ψ₃_of_algHom φ hsplits)
    fun _ hz => isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_of_algHom h3 φ hsplits hsq hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_threeDivisionField
statement:
theorem card_torsion_three_threeDivisionField [W.IsElliptic] [DecidableEq (threeDivisionField W)]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card ((W⁄(threeDivisionField W)).torsion 3) = 9
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_three_tower (W := W) W.Ψ₃.SplittingField h2 h3

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_threeDivisionField
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_threeDivisionField [W.IsElliptic]
    [DecidableEq (threeDivisionField W)] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty ((W⁄(threeDivisionField W)).torsion 3 ≃+ ZMod 3 × ZMod 3)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_tower (W := W) W.Ψ₃.SplittingField h2 h3

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteDimensional_threeDivisionField
statement: theorem finiteDimensional_threeDivisionField : FiniteDimensional F (threeDivisionField W)
proof:
:=
  finiteDimensional_tower (W := W) W.Ψ₃.SplittingField

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSeparable_threeDivisionField
statement:
theorem isSeparable_threeDivisionField [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Algebra.IsSeparable F (threeDivisionField W)

:=

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isGalois_threeDivisionGaloisField
statement:
theorem isGalois_threeDivisionGaloisField [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    IsGalois F (threeDivisionGaloisField W)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isSeparable_threeDivisionField W h2 h3
  exact _root_.isGalois_normalClosure_of_isSeparable F (threeDivisionField W)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteDimensional_threeDivisionGaloisField
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_threeDivisionGaloisField :
    FiniteDimensional F (threeDivisionGaloisField W)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := finiteDimensional_threeDivisionField W
  infer_instance

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_threeDivisionGaloisField
statement:
theorem card_torsion_three_threeDivisionGaloisField [W.IsElliptic]
    [DecidableEq (threeDivisionGaloisField W)] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card ((W⁄(threeDivisionGaloisField W)).torsion 3) = 9
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_three_of_algHom h2 h3
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F (threeDivisionField W) (threeDivisionGaloisField W))
    (splits_Ψ₃_tower (W := W) W.Ψ₃.SplittingField)
    fun _ hz => isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_tower (W := W) W.Ψ₃.SplittingField h3 hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_threeDivisionGaloisField
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_threeDivisionGaloisField [W.IsElliptic]
    [DecidableEq (threeDivisionGaloisField W)] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty ((W⁄(threeDivisionGaloisField W)).torsion 3 ≃+ ZMod 3 × ZMod 3)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_of_algHom h2 h3
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F (threeDivisionField W) (threeDivisionGaloisField W))
    (splits_Ψ₃_tower (W := W) W.Ψ₃.SplittingField)
    fun _ hz => isSquare_Ψ₂Sq_eval_tower (W := W) W.Ψ₃.SplittingField h3 hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3
statement:
private lemma Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3 :
    (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Ψ₃ = C 3 * X * ((X + 1) * (X ^ 2 - X + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₈, y2AddYEqX3]
  norm_num only
  simp only [map_ofNat, Polynomial.C_0, Polynomial.C_1]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private lemma eval_Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3_eq_zero_iff {x : ℚ} :
    (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Ψ₃.eval x = 0 ↔ x = 0 ∨ x = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3]
  simp only [eval_mul, eval_add, eval_sub, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X, eval_one]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h' | h'
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h' with h'' | hx
      · norm_num at h''
      · exact Or.inl hx
    · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h' with hx | hq
      · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
      · nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * x - 1)]
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_roots_Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3
statement:
private lemma card_roots_Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3 :
    Nat.card {x : ℚ // (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Ψ₃.eval x = 0} = 2
proof:
:= by
  have e : {x : ℚ // (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Ψ₃.eval x = 0} ≃ (({0, -1} : Set ℚ) : Type) :=
    Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun x => by
      rw [eval_Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3_eq_zero_iff]
      simp
  rw [Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Set.ncard_pair (by norm_num)]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.not_splits_Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3
statement: private theorem not_splits_Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3 : ¬ (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Ψ₃.Splits
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h4 := card_roots_Ψ₃_of_splits (W := y2AddYEqX3 ℚ) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h
  rw [card_roots_Ψ₃_y2AddYEqX3] at h4
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_threeDivisionField_y2AddYEqX3
statement:
private theorem card_torsion_three_threeDivisionField_y2AddYEqX3 :
    Nat.card (((y2AddYEqX3 ℚ)⁄(threeDivisionField (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ))).torsion 3) = 9
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_three_threeDivisionField _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isGalois_threeDivisionGaloisField_y2AddYEqX3
statement:
private theorem isGalois_threeDivisionGaloisField_y2AddYEqX3 :
    IsGalois ℚ (threeDivisionGaloisField (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ))
proof:
:=
  isGalois_threeDivisionGaloisField _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_threeDivisionGaloisField_y2AddYEqX3
statement:
private theorem card_torsion_three_threeDivisionGaloisField_y2AddYEqX3 :
    Nat.card (((y2AddYEqX3 ℚ)⁄(threeDivisionGaloisField (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ))).torsion 3) = 9
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_three_threeDivisionGaloisField _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_three_pow
statement:
theorem Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_three_pow :
    ∀ n : ℕ, n ≠ 0 → (∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3) → ∃ a b : ℕ, n = 2 ^ a * 3 ^ b
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro hn hfac
    rcases eq_or_ne n 1 with rfl | h1
    · exact ⟨0, 0, by norm_num⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd h1
    have hmem : p ∈ n.primeFactors := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨hp, hpd, hn⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hpd
    have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp [hm] at hn
    have hmlt : m < n := by
      rw [hm]
      exact lt_mul_iff_one_lt_left (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm0) |>.mpr hp.one_lt
    have hmfac : ∀ q ∈ m.primeFactors, q = 2 ∨ q = 3 := by
      intro q hq
      refine hfac q (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨(Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hq).1, ?_, hn⟩)
      exact hm ▸ (Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hq).2.1.mul_left p
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := ih m hmlt hm0 hmfac
    rcases hfac p hmem with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨a + 1, b, by rw [hm, hab]; ring⟩
    · exact ⟨a, b + 1, by rw [hm, hab]; ring⟩

name: Nat.intCast_ne_zero_of_smooth
statement:
theorem Nat.intCast_ne_zero_of_smooth {K : Type*} [Field K] (h2 : (2 : K) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : K) ≠ 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hfac : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3) : ((n : ℤ) : K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_three_pow n hn hfac
  push_cast
  exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ h2) (pow_ne_zero _ h3)

name: Nat.natCast_ne_zero_of_smooth
statement:
theorem Nat.natCast_ne_zero_of_smooth {K : Type*} [Field K] (h2 : (2 : K) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : K) ≠ 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hfac : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3) : (n : K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using Nat.intCast_ne_zero_of_smooth h2 h3 hn hfac

name: Nat.ten_not_smooth
statement: theorem Nat.ten_not_smooth : ¬ (∀ p ∈ (10 : ℕ).primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3)
proof:
:= by
  intro hfac
  have h5 : (5 : ℕ) ∈ (10 : ℕ).primeFactors :=
    Nat.mem_primeFactors.mpr ⟨Nat.prime_five, ⟨2, by norm_num⟩, by norm_num⟩
  rcases hfac 5 h5 with h | h <;> omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_mul_three
statement:
theorem card_torsion_mul_three (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (n * 3)) = 9 * Nat.card (W.torsion n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_torsion_mul_of_surjective (nsmul_three_surjective h2) n, card_torsion_three h2 h3]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_pow
statement:
theorem card_torsion_three_pow (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (3 ^ k)) = 9 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_torsion_pow_of_surjective (nsmul_three_surjective h2) k, card_torsion_three h2 h3]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_three_pow
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_three_pow (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Finite (W.torsion (3 ^ k))
proof:
:=
  finite_torsion_pow three_ne_zero (nsmul_three_surjective h2)
    (by rw [card_torsion_three h2 h3]; norm_num) k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_pow_mul_self
statement:
theorem card_torsion_three_pow_mul_self (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (3 ^ k)) = 3 ^ k * 3 ^ k
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_pow_mul_self (nsmul_three_surjective h2)
    (by rw [card_torsion_three h2 h3]; norm_num) k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionThreePow_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionThreePow_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion (3 ^ k) ≃+ ZMod (3 ^ k) × ZMod (3 ^ k))
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv Nat.prime_three (nsmul_three_surjective h2)
    (by rw [card_torsion_three h2 h3]; norm_num) k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_nine
statement:
theorem card_torsion_nine (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion 9) = 81
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_torsion_three_pow (W := W) h2 h3 2
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionNine_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionNine_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 9 ≃+ ZMod 9 × ZMod 9)
proof:
:= by
  have h := nonempty_torsionThreePow_addEquiv (W := W) h2 h3 2
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_pow_mul_three_pow
statement:
theorem card_torsion_two_pow_mul_three_pow (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (a b : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (2 ^ a * 3 ^ b)) = (2 ^ a * 3 ^ b) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_torsion_mul (Nat.Coprime.pow _ _ (by decide)), card_torsion_two_pow h2,
    card_torsion_three_pow h2 h3, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, mul_comm a 2, mul_comm b 2,
    pow_mul, pow_mul]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionTwoPowMulThreePow_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionTwoPowMulThreePow_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    (a b : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion (2 ^ a * 3 ^ b) ≃+ ZMod (2 ^ a * 3 ^ b) × ZMod (2 ^ a * 3 ^ b))
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsion_addEquiv_zmod_sq_of_coprime (Nat.Coprime.pow _ _ (by decide))
    (nonempty_torsionTwoPow_addEquiv h2 a) (nonempty_torsionThreePow_addEquiv h2 h3 b)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_eq_sq_of_smooth
statement:
theorem card_torsion_eq_sq_of_smooth (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hfac : ∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3) : Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_three_pow n hn hfac
  exact card_torsion_two_pow_mul_three_pow h2 h3 a b

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsion_addEquiv_zmod_sq_of_smooth
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_two_pow_mul_three_pow n hn hfac
  exact nonempty_torsionTwoPowMulThreePow_addEquiv h2 h3 a b

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_thirtysix
statement:
theorem card_torsion_thirtysix (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion 36) = 1296
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_torsion_two_pow_mul_three_pow (W := W) h2 h3 2 2
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionThirtySix_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionThirtySix_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 36 ≃+ ZMod 36 × ZMod 36)
proof:
:= by
  have h := nonempty_torsionTwoPowMulThreePow_addEquiv (W := W) h2 h3 2 2
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.primeFactors_seventytwo
statement: private lemma primeFactors_seventytwo : ∀ p ∈ (72 : ℕ).primeFactors, p = 2 ∨ p = 3
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨hpp, hdvd, -⟩ := Nat.mem_primeFactors.mp hp
  rw [show (72 : ℕ) = 2 ^ 3 * 3 ^ 2 from rfl] at hdvd
  rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hpp).mp hdvd with h | h
  · exact Or.inl ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpp Nat.prime_two).mp (hpp.dvd_of_dvd_pow h))
  · exact Or.inr ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hpp Nat.prime_three).mp (hpp.dvd_of_dvd_pow h))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_three_nsmul_eq_of_mem_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_three_nsmul_eq_of_mem_torsion (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {k : ℕ} {y : W.Point}
    (hy : y ∈ W.torsion (3 ^ k)) : ∃ x ∈ W.torsion (3 ^ (k + 1)), 3 • x = y
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_eq_of_mem_torsion (nsmul_three_surjective h2) hy

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_three
statement:
theorem exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_three (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P Q : W.Point, P ∈ W.torsion 3 ∧ Q ∈ W.torsion 3 ∧
      AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion 3
proof:
:=
  (nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv (W := W) h2 h3).elim exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_of_addEquiv

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_compatible_basis_three
statement:
theorem exists_compatible_basis_three (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P Q : ℕ → W.Point,
      (∀ k, AddSubgroup.closure ({P k, Q k} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (3 ^ k)) ∧
      (∀ k, 3 • P (k + 1) = P k) ∧ (∀ k, 3 • Q (k + 1) = Q k)
proof:
:=
  exists_compatible_basis_of_surjective (nsmul_three_surjective h2)
    (exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_three h2 h3)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionPairHom_bijective_three
proof:
:=
  haveI := finite_torsion_three_pow (W := W) h2 h3 k
  torsionPairHom_bijective_of_card (card_torsion_three_pow_mul_self h2 h3 k) hgen

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionPairEquivThree_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsionPairEquivThree_apply_coe (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {k : ℕ}
    {P Q : W.Point}
    (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (3 ^ k))
    (ab : ZMod (3 ^ k) × ZMod (3 ^ k)) :
    ((torsionPairEquivThree h2 h3 hgen ab : W.torsion (3 ^ k)) : W.Point)
      = ab.1.val • P + ab.2.val • Q
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.zmod_pair_eq_zero_iff_three
proof:
:=
  haveI := finite_torsion_three_pow (W := W) h2 h3 k
  zmod_pair_eq_zero_iff_of_card (card_torsion_three_pow_mul_self h2 h3 k) hgen

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ne_zero_and_ne_of_closure_pair_three
proof:
:=
  haveI := finite_torsion_three_pow (W := W) h2 h3 k
  ne_zero_and_ne_of_closure_pair_of_card (card_torsion_three_pow_mul_self h2 h3 k)
    (by calc 1 < 3 := by norm_num
      _ = 3 ^ 1 := (pow_one 3).symm
      _ ≤ 3 ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hk) hgen

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₃_eval_eq_neg
statement:
lemma Ψ₃_eval_eq_neg {x y : F} (h : W.Equation x y) :
    (3 * x ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y) ^ 2
        + W.a₁ * (3 * x ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y) * (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃)
        - (W.a₂ + 3 * x) * (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) ^ 2
      = -W.Ψ₃.eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [equation_iff'] at h
  simp only [Ψ₃, b₂, b₄, b₆, b₈, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X, eval_ofNat]
  linear_combination (-(W.a₁ ^ 2 + 4 * W.a₂) - 12 * x) * h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.two_mul_add_ne_zero_of_Y_ne
statement:
lemma two_mul_add_ne_zero_of_Y_ne {x y : F} (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) :
    2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [negY] at hy
  intro hd
  exact hy (by linear_combination hd)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_setOf_Ψ₃_root
statement: lemma finite_setOf_Ψ₃_root (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) : {x : F | W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0}.Finite
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.finite_setOf_isRoot (W.Ψ₃_ne_zero h3)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ncard_setOf_Ψ₃_root_le
statement: lemma ncard_setOf_Ψ₃_root_le (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) : {x : F | W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0}.ncard ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : W.Ψ₃ ≠ 0 := W.Ψ₃_ne_zero h3
  have hset : {x : F | W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0} = ↑W.Ψ₃.roots.toFinset := by
    ext x
    simp [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hne, IsRoot]
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  exact (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _).trans
    ((Polynomial.card_roots' _).trans W.natDegree_Ψ₃_le)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.slope_self_mul
statement:
lemma slope_self_mul {x y : F} (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) :
    W.slope x x y y * (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) = 3 * x ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [slope_of_Y_ne rfl hy, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_eq_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr hy), negY]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_self_sub
statement:
lemma addX_self_sub {x y : F} (h : W.Equation x y) (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) :
    W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y) - x = -W.Ψ₃.eval x / (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero 2 (two_mul_add_ne_zero_of_Y_ne hy)), addX]
  linear_combination Ψ₃_eval_eq_neg h + (W.slope x x y y * (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃)
    + (3 * x ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y)
    + W.a₁ * (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃)) * slope_self_mul hy

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_self_eq_iff
statement:
lemma addX_self_eq_iff {x y : F} (h : W.Equation x y) (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) :
    W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y) = x ↔ W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, addX_self_sub h hy, div_eq_zero_iff, neg_eq_zero]
  simp [pow_eq_zero_iff, two_mul_add_ne_zero_of_Y_ne hy]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_torsion_three_iff_add_self_eq_neg
statement: lemma mem_torsion_three_iff_add_self_eq_neg {P : W.Point} : P ∈ W.torsion 3 ↔ P + P = -P
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_torsion_iff, show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 from rfl, succ_nsmul, two_nsmul,
    add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ne_negY_of_mem_torsion_three
statement:
lemma ne_negY_of_mem_torsion_three {x y : F} {h : W.Nonsingular x y}
    (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 3) : y ≠ W.negY x y
proof:
:= by
  intro hy
  refine Point.some_ne_zero h ?_
  have h3 := mem_torsion_three_iff_add_self_eq_neg.mp hP
  rw [Point.add_self_of_Y_eq hy] at h3
  rw [← neg_eq_zero, ← h3]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_torsion_three_some_iff
statement:
lemma mem_torsion_three_some_iff {x y : F} {h : W.Nonsingular x y} (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) :
    Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 3 ↔ W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_torsion_three_iff_add_self_eq_neg, Point.add_self_of_Y_ne hy, Point.neg_some]
  constructor
  · intro hc
    rw [Point.some.injEq] at hc
    exact (addX_self_eq_iff h.left hy).mp hc.left
  · intro hx
    rcases Point.X_eq_iff.mp ((addX_self_eq_iff h.left hy).mpr hx) with hc | hc
    · refine absurd ?_ (Point.some_ne_zero h)
      have hPP : (Point.some x y h : W.Point) + Point.some x y h = Point.some x y h := by
        rw [Point.add_self_of_Y_ne hy]; exact hc
      exact add_right_cancel (hPP.trans (zero_add _).symm)
    · rw [hc, Point.neg_some]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_three
statement:
lemma Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_three {x y : F} {h : W.Nonsingular x y}
    (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 3) : W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0
proof:
:=
  (mem_torsion_three_some_iff (ne_negY_of_mem_torsion_three hP)).mp hP

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_three
statement: lemma finite_torsion_three (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) : Finite (W.torsion 3)
proof:
:=
  W.finite_torsion_of_xCoords (W.finite_setOf_Ψ₃_root h3)
    fun _ _ _ hP => Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_three hP

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_le
statement: theorem card_torsion_three_le (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) : Nat.card (W.torsion 3) ≤ 9
proof:
:=
  (W.card_torsion_le_of_xCoords (W.finite_setOf_Ψ₃_root h3)
      fun _ _ _ hP => Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_three hP).trans <| by
    have := W.ncard_setOf_Ψ₃_root_le h3
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eval
statement:
lemma Ψ₂Sq_eval (x : F) :
    W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 4 * x ^ 3 + W.b₂ * x ^ 2 + 2 * W.b₄ * x + W.b₆
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ψ₂Sq, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Y_ne_negY_of_Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero
statement:
lemma Y_ne_negY_of_Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) (hx : W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0) :
    y ≠ W.negY x y
proof:
:= by
  intro hy
  have hd : 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ = 0 := by
    rw [negY] at hy
    linear_combination hy
  have key := Ψ₃_eval_eq_neg h.1
  rw [hx, hd, neg_zero] at key
  have hn : 3 * x ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y = 0 :=
    pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (by linear_combination key)
  rcases h.2 with hX | hY
  · exact hX (by rw [evalEval_polynomialX]; linear_combination -hn)
  · exact hY (by rw [evalEval_polynomialY]; exact hd)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero
statement:
lemma Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y)
    (hx : W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0) : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq h.1]
  exact pow_ne_zero 2 (two_mul_add_ne_zero_of_Y_ne (Y_ne_negY_of_Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero h hx))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_torsion_three_some_iff'
statement:
lemma mem_torsion_three_some_iff' [DecidableEq F] {x y : F} {h : W.Nonsingular x y} :
    Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 3 ↔ W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_three,
    fun hx => (mem_torsion_three_some_iff (Y_ne_negY_of_Ψ₃_eval_eq_zero h hx)).mpr hx⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff_sq
statement:
lemma equation_iff_sq (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x y : F) :
    W.Equation x y ↔ (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) ^ 2 = W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => (Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq h).symm, fun h => ?_⟩
  have h4 : (4 : F) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show (4 : F) = 2 * 2 by norm_num]
    exact mul_ne_zero h2 h2
  rw [equation_iff']
  refine mul_left_cancel₀ h4 ?_
  rw [mul_zero, Ψ₂Sq_eval] at *
  simp only [b₂, b₄, b₆] at h
  linear_combination h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_setOf_equation_eq_two_of_isSquare
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs'⟩ := hsq
  have hs : s ^ 2 = W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x := by rw [hs']; ring
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (by rw [← hs, h]; ring)
  have hmem : ∀ y : F, W.Equation x y ↔
      y = (s - W.a₁ * x - W.a₃) / 2 ∨ y = (-s - W.a₁ * x - W.a₃) / 2 := by
    intro y
    rw [equation_iff_sq h2, ← hs]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ - s) * (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ + s) = 0 := by
        linear_combination h
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h' with h'' | h''
      · exact Or.inl (by rw [eq_div_iff h2]; linear_combination h'')
      · exact Or.inr (by rw [eq_div_iff h2]; linear_combination h'')
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> field_simp <;> ring
  have h4 : (4 : F) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show (4 : F) = 2 * 2 by norm_num]
    exact mul_ne_zero h2 h2
  have hne : (s - W.a₁ * x - W.a₃) / 2 ≠ (-s - W.a₁ * x - W.a₃) / 2 := by
    intro h
    rw [div_eq_div_iff h2 h2] at h
    exact hs0 ((mul_eq_zero.mp (show (4 : F) * s = 0 by linear_combination h)).resolve_left h4)
  have hset : {y : F | W.Equation x y}
      = {(s - W.a₁ * x - W.a₃) / 2, (-s - W.a₁ * x - W.a₃) / 2} := by
    ext y
    simpa using hmem y
  have hcard : Nat.card {y : F // W.Equation x y} = ({y : F | W.Equation x y}).ncard :=
    Nat.card_coe_set_eq _
  rw [hcard, hset, Set.ncard_pair hne]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSquare_eval_Ψ₂Sq
statement: private lemma isSquare_eval_Ψ₂Sq [IsAlgClosed F] (x : F) : IsSquare (W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x) (n := 2) two_pos

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_setOf_equation_eq_two
statement:
lemma card_setOf_equation_eq_two [IsAlgClosed F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x : F}

proof:

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_equation_of_isSquare
statement:
lemma exists_equation_of_isSquare (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x : F}
    (hsq : IsSquare (W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x)) : ∃ y : F, W.Equation x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hsq
  refine ⟨(s - W.a₁ * x - W.a₃) / 2, ?_⟩
  rw [equation_iff_sq h2, hs]
  field_simp

statement: lemma exists_equation [IsAlgClosed F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x : F) : ∃ y : F, W.Equation x y

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_Ψ₃
statement:
lemma Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_Ψ₃ [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x : F}

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.derivative_Ψ₃
statement: lemma derivative_Ψ₃ : derivative W.Ψ₃ = 3 * W.Ψ₂Sq
proof:
:= by

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nodup_roots_Ψ₃
statement:
lemma nodup_roots_Ψ₃ [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    W.Ψ₃.roots.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one]
  intro r
  rw [count_roots]
  by_contra hcount
  rw [not_le] at hcount
  have hroot : W.Ψ₃.eval r = 0 := by
    have hpos : 0 < W.Ψ₃.rootMultiplicity r := lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hcount.le
    exact (rootMultiplicity_pos (W.Ψ₃_ne_zero h3)).mp hpos
  have hder : (derivative W.Ψ₃).IsRoot r := by
    simpa using isRoot_iterate_derivative_of_lt_rootMultiplicity (n := 1) hcount
  rw [derivative_Ψ₃, IsRoot, eval_mul, eval_ofNat, mul_eq_zero] at hder
  exact Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_Ψ₃ h2 hroot (hder.resolve_left h3)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_roots_Ψ₃_of_splits
statement:
lemma card_roots_Ψ₃_of_splits [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hsplits : W.Ψ₃.Splits) : Nat.card {x : F // W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0} = 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_congr (W.rootsEquivΨ₃ h3), Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe,
    Multiset.toFinset_card_of_nodup (nodup_roots_Ψ₃ h2 h3),
    ← hsplits.natDegree_eq_card_roots, W.natDegree_Ψ₃ h3]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_roots_Ψ₃
statement:
lemma card_roots_Ψ₃ [W.IsElliptic] [IsAlgClosed F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card {x : F // W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0} = 4
proof:
:=
  card_roots_Ψ₃_of_splits h2 h3 (IsAlgClosed.splits _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionThreeOfPair_bijective
statement:
lemma torsionThreeOfPair_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (torsionThreeOfPair (W := W))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (_ | ⟨⟨x₁, hx₁⟩, ⟨y₁, hy₁⟩⟩) (_ | ⟨⟨x₂, hx₂⟩, ⟨y₂, hy₂⟩⟩) hab
    · rfl
    · exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val hab).symm (Point.some_ne_zero _)
    · exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val hab) (Point.some_ne_zero _)
    · have hxy := congrArg Subtype.val hab
      rw [torsionThreeOfPair, torsionThreeOfPair, Point.some.injEq] at hxy
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hxy
      rfl
  · rintro ⟨(_ | ⟨x, y, h⟩), hP⟩
    · exact ⟨none, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨some ⟨⟨x, mem_torsion_three_some_iff'.mp hP⟩, ⟨y, h.1⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three_of_splits
statement:
theorem card_torsion_three_of_splits (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hsplits : W.Ψ₃.Splits) (hsq : ∀ x : F, W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0 → IsSquare (W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x)) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion 3) = 9
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite {x : F // W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0} :=
    (W.finite_setOf_Ψ₃_root h3).to_subtype
  haveI : Fintype {x : F // W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  haveI : ∀ x : {x : F // W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0}, Finite {y : F // W.Equation x.1 y} :=
    fun x => (W.setOf_equation_finite x.1).to_subtype
  have hfib : ∀ x : {x : F // W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0}, Nat.card {y : F // W.Equation x.1 y} = 2 :=
    fun x => card_setOf_equation_eq_two_of_isSquare h2
      (Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_Ψ₃ h2 x.2) (hsq x.1 x.2)
  have hroots : Fintype.card {x : F // W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0} = 4 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, card_roots_Ψ₃_of_splits h2 h3 hsplits]
  rw [Nat.card_congr torsionThreeEquiv, Finite.card_option, Nat.card_sigma,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => hfib x, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, hroots]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_three
statement:
theorem card_torsion_three [IsAlgClosed F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion 3) = 9
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_three_of_splits h2 h3 (IsAlgClosed.splits _) fun x _ => isSquare_eval_Ψ₂Sq x

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_of_splits
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_of_splits (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hsplits : W.Ψ₃.Splits) (hsq : ∀ x : F, W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0 → IsSquare (W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x)) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 3 ≃+ ZMod 3 × ZMod 3)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := W.finite_torsion_three h3
  have hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion 3) = 3 ^ 2 := by
    rw [card_torsion_three_of_splits h2 h3 hsplits hsq]
    norm_num
  refine AddCommGroup.equiv_zmod_sq_of_card_sq three_pos (fun a => nsmul_mem_torsion a) hcard ?_
  intro p hp
  rcases eq_or_ne p 2 with rfl | hp2
  · 
    have hone : ∀ a : W.torsion 3, (2 : ℕ) • a = 0 → a = 0 := by
      intro a ha
      have h3a : (3 : ℕ) • a = 0 := nsmul_mem_torsion a
      have key : (2 : ℕ) • a + a = (3 : ℕ) • a := by rw [← succ_nsmul]
      rw [ha, zero_add, h3a] at key
      exact key
    have hcard1 : Nat.card {a : W.torsion 3 // (2 : ℕ) • a = 0} = 1 := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique]
      exact ⟨⟨fun a b => Subtype.ext ((hone a.1 a.2).trans (hone b.1 b.2).symm)⟩,
        ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩⟩⟩
    rw [hcard1]
    norm_num
  · have hp3 : 3 ≤ p := by
      have := hp.two_le
      omega
    calc Nat.card {a : W.torsion 3 // p • a = 0}
        ≤ Nat.card (W.torsion 3) := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective
      _ = 3 ^ 2 := hcard
      _ ≤ p ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hp3 2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv [IsAlgClosed F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 3 ≃+ ZMod 3 × ZMod 3)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv_of_splits h2 h3 (IsAlgClosed.splits _)
    fun x _ => isSquare_eval_Ψ₂Sq x

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_add_self_eq_div
statement:
theorem addX_add_self_eq_div (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h : W.Equation x y) (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y)
    (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0) :
    W.addX (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x
        (W.slope (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y)) y)
      = (W.Φ 3).eval x / (W.ΨSq 3).eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff (by rw [ΨSq_three_eval]; exact pow_ne_zero 2 hT)]
  exact addX_add_self_mul_ΨSq_three_eval h2 h hy hT

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addY_add_eq_div_aux
statement:
private theorem addY_add_eq_div_aux (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h : W.Equation x y)
    (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0) {X₂ Y₂ : F}
    (hX₂ : X₂ = (W.Φ 2).eval x / W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x)
    (hY₂ : Y₂ = (W.preΨ₄.eval x -
        (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y * (W.a₁ * (W.Φ 2).eval x + W.a₃ * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x)) /
      (2 * (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y ^ 3)) (hne : X₂ ≠ x)
    (hX : W.addX X₂ x (W.slope X₂ x Y₂ y) = (W.Φ 3).eval x / (W.ΨSq 3).eval x) :
    W.addY X₂ x Y₂ (W.slope X₂ x Y₂ y)
      = ((2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) * ((W.preΨ 5).eval x - W.preΨ₄.eval x ^ 2) -
          W.a₁ * (W.Φ 3).eval x * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y -
          W.a₃ * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3) / (2 * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3)
proof:
:= by
  set p := W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x with hpdef
  set T := W.Ψ₃.eval x with hTdef
  set Q := W.preΨ₄.eval x with hQdef
  set s := 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ with hsdef
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := two_mul_add_ne_zero_of_Y_ne hy
  have hs : s ^ 2 = p := (Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq h).symm
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := by rw [← hs]; exact pow_ne_zero 2 hsne
  set Φ2 := (W.Φ 2).eval x with hΦ2def
  have hΦ2 : Φ2 = x * p - T := by rw [hΦ2def, hpdef, hTdef, Φ_two_eval]
  set Φ3v := (W.Φ 3).eval x with hΦ3def
  have hΦ3 : Φ3v = x * T ^ 2 - Q * p := by
    rw [hΦ3def, Φ_three_eval, ← hTdef, ← hQdef, ← hpdef]
  set Kv := (W.preΨ 5).eval x - Q ^ 2 with hKdef
  have hK : Kv = Q * p ^ 2 - T ^ 3 - Q ^ 2 := by
    rw [hKdef, preΨ_five]
    simp only [eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_pow]
    rw [← hpdef, ← hTdef, ← hQdef]
  
  have hslope : W.slope X₂ x Y₂ y = -(W.a₁) / 2 + (p ^ 2 - Q) * s / (2 * p * T) := by
    have hXsub : X₂ - x = -T / p := by
      rw [hX₂, hΦ2]; field_simp; ring
    have hYsub : Y₂ - y = (Q - p ^ 2 + W.a₁ * T * s) / (2 * p * s) := by
      rw [hY₂, ψ_two_evalEval, ← hsdef, hΦ2,
        show y = (s - W.a₁ * x - W.a₃) / 2 from by rw [eq_div_iff h2, hsdef]; ring]
      field_simp
      linear_combination (p * x * W.a₁ * s - T * W.a₁ * s - p * s ^ 2 + p * W.a₃ * s - Q) * hs
    rw [slope_of_X_ne hne, hYsub, hXsub]
    field_simp
    linear_combination (-(p ^ 2 - Q)) * hs
  
  have hY2 : Y₂ = -(W.a₁ * Φ2 + W.a₃ * p) / (2 * p) + Q / (2 * p ^ 2) * s := by
    rw [hY₂, ψ_two_evalEval, ← hsdef]
    field_simp
    linear_combination (p * s * Φ2 * W.a₁ + p ^ 2 * s * W.a₃ - Q * s ^ 2 - p * Q) * hs
  rw [addY, negAddY, hX, negY, ΨSq_three]
  simp only [eval_pow]
  rw [hslope, hX₂, ← hTdef, hY2, ψ_evalEval h 3, Ψ_three, evalEval_C, ← hTdef, hΦ2, hΦ3, hK]
  field_simp
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addY_add_self_eq_div
statement:
theorem addY_add_self_eq_div (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h : W.Equation x y) (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y)
    (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0) :
    W.addY (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y))
        (W.slope (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y)) y)
      = ((2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) * ((W.preΨ 5).eval x - W.preΨ₄.eval x ^ 2) -
          W.a₁ * (W.Φ 3).eval x * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y -
          W.a₃ * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3) / (2 * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3)
proof:
:=
  addY_add_eq_div_aux h2 h hy hT (addX_self_eq_div h hy) (addY_self_eq_div h h2 hy)
    (fun hc => hT ((addX_self_eq_iff h hy).mp hc)) (addX_add_self_eq_div h2 h hy hT)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.psiThree_evalEval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem psiThree_evalEval_ne_zero (h : W.Equation x y) (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0) :
    (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rwa [ψ_evalEval h 3, Ψ_three, evalEval_C]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonsingular_tripling
statement:
theorem nonsingular_tripling (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h : W.Equation x y) (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0) :
    W.Nonsingular ((W.Φ 3).eval x / (W.ΨSq 3).eval x)
      (((2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) * ((W.preΨ 5).eval x - W.preΨ₄.eval x ^ 2) -
          W.a₁ * (W.Φ 3).eval x * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y -
          W.a₃ * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3) / (2 * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3))
proof:
:=
  equation_iff_nonsingular.mp (tripling_equation h h2 (psiThree_evalEval_ne_zero h hT))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.add_add_self_eq_some
statement:
theorem add_add_self_eq_some (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {h : W.Nonsingular x y}
    (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0) :
    Point.some x y h + Point.some x y h + Point.some x y h
      = Point.some ((W.Φ 3).eval x / (W.ΨSq 3).eval x)
          (((2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) * ((W.preΨ 5).eval x - W.preΨ₄.eval x ^ 2) -
              W.a₁ * (W.Φ 3).eval x * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y -
              W.a₃ * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3) / (2 * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3))
          (nonsingular_tripling h2 h.left hT)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Point.add_self_of_Y_ne hy,
    Point.add_of_X_ne (fun hc => hT ((addX_self_eq_iff h.left hy).mp hc)), Point.some.injEq]
  exact ⟨addX_add_self_eq_div h2 h.left hy hT, addY_add_self_eq_div h2 h.left hy hT⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nsmul_three_eq_some
statement:
theorem nsmul_three_eq_some (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {h : W.Nonsingular x y}
    (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0) :
    (3 : ℕ) • Point.some x y h
      = Point.some ((W.Φ 3).eval x / (W.ΨSq 3).eval x)
          (((2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) * ((W.preΨ 5).eval x - W.preΨ₄.eval x ^ 2) -
              W.a₁ * (W.Φ 3).eval x * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y -
              W.a₃ * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3) / (2 * (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ^ 3))
          (nonsingular_tripling h2 h.left hT)
proof:
:= by
  rw [three'_nsmul]; exact add_add_self_eq_some h2 hy hT

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.triplingX_ne_zero
statement: theorem triplingX_ne_zero (x₀ : F) : W.triplingX x₀ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h9 := natDegree_triplingX (W := W) x₀
  rw [h, natDegree_zero] at h9
  exact absurd h9 (by norm_num)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_triplingX

:= by

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_triplingX

theorem separable_triplingX [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F}

:=
  separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq h2 h3 hx₀

proof:
:= by

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₃_eval_ne_zero_of_root_triplingX
statement:
theorem Ψ₃_eval_ne_zero_of_root_triplingX [W.IsElliptic] {x₀ r : F}
    (hr : (W.triplingX x₀).eval r = 0) : W.Ψ₃.eval r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hT
  refine eval_Φ_three_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq r (by rw [ΨSq_three_eval, hT]; ring) ?_
  rw [eval_triplingX, hT] at hr
  linear_combination hr

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_triplingX
statement:
theorem Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_triplingX [W.IsElliptic] {x₀ : F} (hx₀ : W.Ψ₃.eval x₀ = 0)
    {r : F} (hr : (W.triplingX x₀).eval r = 0) : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  have hT : W.Ψ₃.eval r ≠ 0 := Ψ₃_eval_ne_zero_of_root_triplingX hr
  rw [eval_triplingX] at hr
  have hsplit : (r - x₀) * W.Ψ₃.eval r ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [Φ_three_eval, hp] at hr
    linear_combination hr
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hsplit with h1 | h2
  · exact hT (sub_eq_zero.mp h1 ▸ hx₀)
  · exact hT (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp h2)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero'

private lemma algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero' {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra F L] (n : ℕ)

proof:

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_three_eq_triplingField
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_three_eq_triplingField [DecidableEq (W.triplingField x₀)] [W.IsElliptic]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {y₀ : F} (hQ : W.Nonsingular x₀ y₀) :
    ∃ P : (W⁄(W.triplingField x₀)).Point,
      (3 : ℕ) • P = Point.some (algebraMap F (W.triplingField x₀) x₀)
        (algebraMap F (W.triplingField x₀) y₀)
        ((W.map_nonsingular (algebraMap F (W.triplingField x₀)).injective x₀ y₀).mpr hQ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄(W.triplingField x₀)).IsElliptic :=
    inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F (W.triplingField x₀))).IsElliptic
  have hr : ((W⁄(W.triplingField x₀)).triplingX
      (algebraMap F (W.triplingField x₀) x₀)).eval
      (algebraMap (W.triplingXField x₀) (W.triplingField x₀) (W.triplingXRoot x₀)) = 0 :=
    eval_triplingX_baseChange (eval_triplingXRoot x₀)
  have hy : ((W⁄(W.triplingField x₀)).halvingY
      (algebraMap (W.triplingXField x₀) (W.triplingField x₀) (W.triplingXRoot x₀))).eval
      (W.triplingYRoot x₀) = 0 :=
    eval_halvingY_baseChange (eval_triplingYRoot W x₀)
  refine exists_nsmul_three_eq_some_of_root (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero' 2 h2) _
    (equation_of_eval_halvingY_eq_zero hy) ?_
  rw [eval_triplingX] at hr
  linear_combination hr

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_triplingTowerXRoot
statement:
theorem eval_triplingTowerXRoot (x₀ : F) :
    ((W⁄(W.triplingTower x₀)).triplingX (algebraMap F (W.triplingTower x₀) x₀)).eval
      (W.triplingTowerXRoot x₀) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (((W⁄(threeDivisionField W))⁄(W.triplingTower x₀)).triplingX
      (algebraMap (threeDivisionField W) (W.triplingTower x₀)
        (algebraMap F (threeDivisionField W) x₀))).eval (W.triplingTowerXRoot x₀) = 0 :=
    eval_triplingX_baseChange (eval_triplingXRoot _)
  rwa [baseChange_baseChange'' W (threeDivisionField W) (W.triplingTower x₀),
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F (threeDivisionField W) (W.triplingTower x₀) x₀] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_triplingTowerYRoot

:= by
  have h : (((W⁄(threeDivisionField W))⁄(W.triplingTower x₀)).halvingY
      (W.triplingTowerXRoot x₀)).eval (W.triplingTowerYRoot x₀) = 0 :=
    eval_halvingY_baseChange (eval_triplingYRoot _ _)
  rwa [baseChange_baseChange'' W (threeDivisionField W) (W.triplingTower x₀)] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSeparable_triplingTower
statement:
theorem isSeparable_triplingTower (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F}
    (hx₀ : W.Ψ₃.eval x₀ = 0) : Algebra.IsSeparable F (W.triplingTower x₀)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄(threeDivisionField W)).IsElliptic :=
    inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F (threeDivisionField W))).IsElliptic
  haveI := isSeparable_threeDivisionField W h2 h3
  haveI : Algebra.IsSeparable (threeDivisionField W) (W.triplingTower x₀) :=
    isSeparable_triplingField (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero' 2 h2) (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero' 3 h3)
      (eval_Ψ₃_baseChange hx₀)
  exact Algebra.IsSeparable.trans F (threeDivisionField W) (W.triplingTower x₀)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finiteDimensional_triplingTower
statement: theorem finiteDimensional_triplingTower {x₀ : F} : FiniteDimensional F (W.triplingTower x₀)

  haveI : FiniteDimensional (threeDivisionField W) (W.triplingTower x₀) :=

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_three_eq_of_roots_baseChange
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_three_eq_of_roots_baseChange {M L : Type*} [Field M] [Field L] [Algebra F M]
    [Algebra F L] [Algebra M L] [IsScalarTower F M L] [DecidableEq L]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ y₀ : F} (hQ : W.Nonsingular x₀ y₀)
    {r s : M} (hr : ((W⁄M).triplingX (algebraMap F M x₀)).eval r = 0)
    (hs : ((W⁄M).halvingY r).eval s = 0) :
    ∃ P : (W⁄L).Point, (3 : ℕ) • P = Point.some (algebraMap F L x₀) (algebraMap F L y₀)
      ((W.map_nonsingular (algebraMap F L).injective x₀ y₀).mpr hQ)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (W⁄L).IsElliptic := inferInstanceAs (W.map (algebraMap F L)).IsElliptic
  have hrL : ((W⁄L).triplingX (algebraMap F L x₀)).eval (algebraMap M L r) = 0 :=
    eval_triplingX_baseChange hr
  have hsL : ((W⁄L).halvingY (algebraMap M L r)).eval (algebraMap M L s) = 0 := by
    refine eval_halvingY_baseChange ?_
    rw [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply, hs, map_zero]
  refine exists_nsmul_three_eq_some_of_root (algebraMap_ofNat_ne_zero' 2 h2) _
    (equation_of_eval_halvingY_eq_zero hsL) ?_
  rw [eval_triplingX] at hrL
  linear_combination hrL

    ∃ P : (W⁄(W.triplingGaloisField x₀)).Point,

        (algebraMap F (W.triplingGaloisField x₀) y₀)
        ((W.map_nonsingular (algebraMap F (W.triplingGaloisField x₀)).injective x₀ y₀).mpr hQ)

    (eval_triplingTowerYRoot x₀)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_root_triplingX_of_nsmul_three_eq
proof:
:= by
  match P with
  | .zero =>
    rw [show (Point.zero : W.Point) = 0 from rfl, smul_zero] at hP
    exact absurd hP (by simp)
  | .some r s h =>
    by_cases hΨ : W.Ψ₃.eval r = 0
    · have hzero : (3 : ℕ) • Point.some r s h = 0 :=
        (nsmul_eq_zero_iff_eval_preΨ_eq_zero h2 (by decide) h).mpr
          (by rw [show ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (3 : ℤ) by norm_num, preΨ_three]; exact hΨ)
      rw [hzero] at hP
      simp at hP
    · have hΨSq : (W.ΨSq (3 : ℕ)).eval r ≠ 0 := by
        rw [show ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (3 : ℤ) by norm_num, ΨSq_three_eval]
        exact pow_ne_zero 2 hΨ
      obtain ⟨y', h', hform⟩ := hasXCoordFormula_three h2 h hΨSq
      rw [hform, Point.some.injEq] at hP
      refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
      rw [eval_triplingX, ← hP.1, show ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (3 : ℤ) by norm_num, ΨSq_three_eval]
      field_simp
      ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_triplingX_zero_y2AddYEqX3
statement:
private lemma eval_triplingX_zero_y2AddYEqX3 (x : ℚ) :
    ((y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).triplingX 0).eval x = x ^ 9 - 24 * x ^ 6 + 3 * x ^ 3 + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_triplingX, Φ_three_eval]
  simp only [preΨ₄_eval, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, WeierstrassCurve.b₂,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈, y2AddYEqX3]
  simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C, eval_ofNat]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_triplingX_zero_y2AddYEqX3_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem eval_triplingX_zero_y2AddYEqX3_ne_zero (x : ℚ) :
    ((y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).triplingX 0).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_triplingX_zero_y2AddYEqX3]
  intro h
  have hmonic : (X ^ 9 - 24 * X ^ 6 + 3 * X ^ 3 + 1 : ℤ[X]).Monic := by monicity!
  have hint : IsIntegral ℤ x := by
    refine ⟨X ^ 9 - 24 * X ^ 6 + 3 * X ^ 3 + 1, hmonic, ?_⟩
    simp only [eval₂_add, eval₂_sub, eval₂_mul, eval₂_pow, eval₂_X, eval₂_ofNat, eval₂_one]
    linear_combination h
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp hint
  subst hd
  have hdz : d ^ 9 - 24 * d ^ 6 + 3 * d ^ 3 + 1 = 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (by simpa using h : (d : ℚ) ^ 9 - 24 * (d : ℚ) ^ 6 + 3 * (d : ℚ) ^ 3 + 1 = 0)
  have hdvd : d ∣ 1 := ⟨-(d ^ 8 - 24 * d ^ 5 + 3 * d ^ 2), by linarith [hdz]⟩
  rcases Int.isUnit_iff.mp (isUnit_of_dvd_one hdvd) with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num at hdz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.not_exists_nsmul_three_eq_y2AddYEqX3
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨P, hP⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_root_triplingX_of_nsmul_three_eq (by norm_num)
    nonsingular_zero_y2AddYEqX3 hP
  exact eval_triplingX_zero_y2AddYEqX3_ne_zero r hr

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.xCoordOf_some
statement:
private lemma xCoordOf_some {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) :
