proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_isAlgClosed_of_odd
statement:
theorem separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_isAlgClosed_of_odd (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n)
    (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F} (hx₀ : (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)).eval x₀ = 0) :
    (W.Φ n - C x₀ * W.ΨSq n).Separable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hn
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := exists_equation (W := W) h2 x₀
  have hS : W.Nonsingular x₀ y₀ := equation_iff_nonsingular.mp hy₀
  set S : W.Point := Point.some x₀ y₀ hS with hSdef
  have hSne : S ≠ 0 := Point.some_ne_zero hS
  have hSn : n • S = 0 :=
    (nsmul_eq_zero_iff_eval_preΨ_eq_zero h2 hodd hS).mpr hx₀
  set g : F[X] := W.Φ n - C x₀ * W.ΨSq n with hgdef
  have hdeg : g.natDegree = n ^ 2 := natDegree_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq (W := W) hn0 x₀
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := fun h => by
    rw [h] at hdeg; exact (pow_ne_zero 2 hn0) (by simpa using hdeg.symm)
  have hsplits : g.Splits := IsAlgClosed.splits g
  have hrc : Multiset.card g.roots = n ^ 2 := by rw [splits_iff_card_roots.mp hsplits, hdeg]
  have hgeval : ∀ x : F, g.eval x = (W.Φ n).eval x - x₀ * (W.ΨSq n).eval x := by
    intro x; rw [hgdef, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C]
  
  have hne_of_root : ∀ x : F, g.eval x = 0 → (W.ΨSq n).eval x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx h0
    refine eval_Φ_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero (W := W) h2 hn0 x h0 ?_
    rw [hgeval, h0, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hx
    exact hx
  
  have hfwd : ∀ P : W.Point, n • P = S → g.eval (xCoordOf P) = 0 := by
    rintro (_ | ⟨x, y, hns⟩) hP
    · exact absurd (by rw [← hP, show (Point.zero : W.Point) = 0 from rfl, smul_zero]) hSne.symm
    · have hpre : (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)).eval x ≠ 0 := fun h0 =>
        hSne (by rw [← hP, (nsmul_eq_zero_iff_eval_preΨ_eq_zero h2 hodd hns).mpr h0])
      have hΨ : (W.ΨSq n).eval x ≠ 0 := by
        intro h0
        refine hpre ?_
        rw [ΨSq_natCast_eq_sq_of_odd (W := W) hodd, eval_pow] at h0
        exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp h0
      obtain ⟨y', h', hxy⟩ := hasXCoordFormula_of_two_ne_zero (W := W) h2 n hns hΨ
      rw [hP, hSdef] at hxy
      have hx0 : (W.Φ n).eval x / (W.ΨSq n).eval x = x₀ :=
        (((Point.some.injEq _ _ _ _ _ _).mp hxy).1).symm
      rw [xCoordOf_some, hgeval, ← hx0, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hΨ, sub_self]
  
  have hinj : ∀ P Q : W.Point, n • P = S → n • Q = S →
      xCoordOf P = xCoordOf Q → P = Q := by
    rintro (_ | ⟨x, y, hns⟩) Q hP hQ hxx
    · exact absurd (by rw [← hP, show (Point.zero : W.Point) = 0 from rfl, smul_zero]) hSne.symm
    rcases Q with _ | ⟨x', y', hns'⟩
    · exact absurd (by rw [← hQ, show (Point.zero : W.Point) = 0 from rfl, smul_zero]) hSne.symm
    rw [xCoordOf_some, xCoordOf_some] at hxx
    rcases (Point.X_eq_iff (h₁ := hns) (h₂ := hns')).mp hxx with hc | hc
    · exact hc
    · exfalso
      have hSS : S = -S := by
        nth_rewrite 1 [← hP]
        rw [hc, smul_neg, hQ]
      have h2S : (2 : ℕ) • S = 0 := by
        rw [two_nsmul]
        nth_rewrite 1 [hSS]
        exact neg_add_cancel S
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hodd
      refine hSne ?_
      have hsplit : n • S = k • ((2 : ℕ) • S) + S := by
        rw [hk, add_nsmul, one_nsmul, mul_nsmul]
      rw [h2S, smul_zero, zero_add] at hsplit
      rw [← hsplit, hSn]
  
  have hsurj : ∀ x : F, g.eval x = 0 → ∃ P : W.Point, n • P = S ∧ xCoordOf P = x := by
    intro x hx
    have hΨ := hne_of_root x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_equation (W := W) h2 x
    have hns : W.Nonsingular x y := equation_iff_nonsingular.mp hy
    obtain ⟨y', h', hxy⟩ := hasXCoordFormula_of_two_ne_zero (W := W) h2 n hns hΨ
    have hx0 : (W.Φ n).eval x / (W.ΨSq n).eval x = x₀ := by
      rw [hgeval] at hx
      rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hx, mul_div_assoc, div_self hΨ, mul_one]
    rcases (Point.X_eq_iff (h₁ := h') (h₂ := hS)).mp hx0 with hc | hc
    · exact ⟨Point.some x y hns, by rw [hxy, hc, hSdef], xCoordOf_some hns⟩
    · refine ⟨-Point.some x y hns, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [smul_neg, hxy, hc, hSdef, neg_neg]
      · rw [Point.neg_some]; rfl
  
  obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ := nsmul_surjective_of_two_ne_zero (W := W) h2 hn0 S
  have hfib : Nat.card {P : W.Point // n • P = S} = n ^ 2 := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr (fibreEquivTorsion hP₀), card_torsion_eq_sq h2 hn]
  have hbij : Function.Bijective
      (fun P : {P : W.Point // n • P = S} => (⟨xCoordOf P.1, hfwd P.1 P.2⟩ :
        {x : F // g.eval x = 0})) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨P, hP⟩ ⟨Q, hQ⟩ hPQ
      exact Subtype.ext (hinj P Q hP hQ (congrArg Subtype.val hPQ))
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨P, hP, hxP⟩ := hsurj x hx
      exact ⟨⟨P, hP⟩, Subtype.ext hxP⟩
  have hrootsn : g.roots.toFinset.card = n ^ 2 := by
    rw [← card_root_subtype hg0, ← Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective _ hbij), hfib]
  exact (nodup_roots_iff_of_splits hg0 hsplits).mp
    (Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup.mp (by rw [hrootsn, hrc]))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_isAlgClosed (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0)
    {x₀ : F} (hx₀ : W.Ψ₃.eval x₀ = 0) : (W.Φ 3 - C x₀ * W.ΨSq 3).Separable
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : (W.preΨ ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x₀ = 0 := by
    rw [show ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (3 : ℤ) by norm_num, preΨ_three]; exact hx₀
  simpa using separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_isAlgClosed_of_odd (W := W) h2 (n := 3) (by decide)
    (by exact_mod_cast h3) hpre

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_odd
statement:
theorem separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_odd (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n)
    (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F} (hx₀ : (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)).eval x₀ = 0) :
    (W.Φ n - C x₀ * W.ΨSq n).Separable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set K := AlgebraicClosure F with hK
  have h2' : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := fun hzero =>
    h2 ((algebraMap F K).injective (by rw [map_ofNat, map_zero]; exact hzero))
  have hn' : ((n : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 := fun hzero =>
    hn ((algebraMap F K).injective (by rw [map_natCast, map_zero]; exact hzero))
  have hx0' : ((W⁄K).preΨ (n : ℤ)).eval (algebraMap F K x₀) = 0 := by
    rw [show (W⁄K).preΨ (n : ℤ) = (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)).map (algebraMap F K) from
      WeierstrassCurve.map_preΨ .., eval_map, eval₂_at_apply, hx₀, map_zero]
  rw [← Polynomial.separable_map (algebraMap F K),
    show (W.Φ n - C x₀ * W.ΨSq n).map (algebraMap F K)
      = (W⁄K).Φ n - C (algebraMap F K x₀) * (W⁄K).ΨSq n by
      rw [show (W⁄K).Φ (n : ℤ) = (W.Φ (n : ℤ)).map (algebraMap F K) from WeierstrassCurve.map_Φ ..,
        show (W⁄K).ΨSq (n : ℤ) = (W.ΨSq (n : ℤ)).map (algebraMap F K) from
          WeierstrassCurve.map_ΨSq .., Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C]]
  exact separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_isAlgClosed_of_odd h2' hodd hn' hx0'

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq
statement:
theorem separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F}
    (hx₀ : W.Ψ₃.eval x₀ = 0) : (W.Φ 3 - C x₀ * W.ΨSq 3).Separable
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : (W.preΨ ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ)).eval x₀ = 0 := by
    rw [show ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (3 : ℤ) by norm_num, preΨ_three]; exact hx₀
  simpa using separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_odd (W := W) h2 (n := 3) (by decide)
    (by exact_mod_cast h3) hpre

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_preΨ_sq_of_odd
statement:
theorem separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_preΨ_sq_of_odd (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n)
    (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F} (hx₀ : (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)).eval x₀ = 0) :
    (W.Φ n - C x₀ * W.preΨ (n : ℤ) ^ 2).Separable
proof:
:= by
  have h := separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_odd (W := W) h2 hodd hn hx₀
  rwa [ΨSq_natCast_eq_sq_of_odd (W := W) hodd] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_mem_torsion_of_odd
statement:
theorem separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_mem_torsion_of_odd [DecidableEq F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n) (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ y₀ : F} (hS : W.Nonsingular x₀ y₀)
    (hSn : Point.some x₀ y₀ hS ∈ W.torsion n) : (W.Φ n - C x₀ * W.ΨSq n).Separable
proof:
:=
  separable_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_odd h2 hodd hn
    ((nsmul_eq_zero_iff_eval_preΨ_eq_zero h2 hodd hS).mp (mem_torsion_iff.mp hSn))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_Ψ₃_sq
statement:
theorem separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_Ψ₃_sq (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F}
    (hx₀ : W.Ψ₃.eval x₀ = 0) : (W.Φ 3 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₃ ^ 2).Separable
proof:
:= by
  have h := separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq h2 h3 hx₀
  rwa [WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_three] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_mem_torsion
statement:
theorem separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_mem_torsion [DecidableEq F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ y₀ : F} (hS : W.Nonsingular x₀ y₀)

proof:

    (by exact_mod_cast h3) hS (by simpa using hS3)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Ψ₃_zero_y2AddYEqX3

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_triplingPoly_zero_y2AddYEqX3
statement:
private lemma eval_triplingPoly_zero_y2AddYEqX3 :
    ((y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Φ 3 - C (0 : ℚ) * (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).ΨSq 3).eval 0 = 1
proof:
:= by

  simp only [preΨ₄_eval, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, WeierstrassCurve.b₂,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈, y2AddYEqX3]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleSeparableTriplingPoly
statement:
private theorem exampleSeparableTriplingPoly :
    ((y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Φ 3 - C (0 : ℚ) * (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).ΨSq 3).Separable
proof:
:=
  separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq (by norm_num) (by norm_num) eval_Ψ₃_zero_y2AddYEqX3

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleSeparableTriplingPolyΨ₃Sq
statement:
private theorem exampleSeparableTriplingPolyΨ₃Sq :
    ((y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Φ 3 - C (0 : ℚ) * (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Ψ₃ ^ 2).Separable
proof:
:=
  separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_Ψ₃_sq (by norm_num) (by norm_num) eval_Ψ₃_zero_y2AddYEqX3

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_y2AddYEqX3_zero
statement: private lemma equation_y2AddYEqX3_zero : (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Equation 0 0

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.memTorsionThree_y2AddYEqX3
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_torsion_iff]
  refine (nsmul_eq_zero_iff_eval_preΨ_eq_zero (by norm_num) (n := 3) (by decide)
    (equation_iff_nonsingular.mp equation_y2AddYEqX3_zero)).mpr ?_
  rw [show ((3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (3 : ℤ) by norm_num, preΨ_three]
  exact eval_Ψ₃_zero_y2AddYEqX3

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exampleSeparableTriplingPolyOfMemTorsion
statement:
private theorem exampleSeparableTriplingPolyOfMemTorsion :
    ((y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).Φ 3 - C (0 : ℚ) * (y2AddYEqX3 ℚ).ΨSq 3).Separable
proof:
:=
  separable_Φ_three_sub_C_mul_ΨSq_of_mem_torsion (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (equation_iff_nonsingular.mp equation_y2AddYEqX3_zero) memTorsionThree_y2AddYEqX3

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.preΨ₄_eq
statement:
lemma preΨ₄_eq :
    W.preΨ₄ = W.Ψ₃ * (6 * X ^ 2 + C W.b₂ * X + C W.b₄) - W.Ψ₂Sq ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.preΨ₄, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq]
  simp only [map_ofNat, C_sub, C_mul, C_pow]
  linear_combination (norm := ring1) (X : F[X]) ^ 2 * W.C_b_relation

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.preΨ₄_eval
statement:
lemma preΨ₄_eval (x : F) :
    W.preΨ₄.eval x = W.Ψ₃.eval x * (6 * x ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x + W.b₄) - W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [preΨ₄_eq]; simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Φ_three_eval
statement:
lemma Φ_three_eval (x : F) :
    (W.Φ 3).eval x = x * W.Ψ₃.eval x ^ 2 - W.preΨ₄.eval x * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.Φ_three]; simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ΨSq_three_eval
statement: lemma ΨSq_three_eval (x : F) : (W.ΨSq 3).eval x = W.Ψ₃.eval x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_three]; simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.tripling_core
statement:
lemma tripling_core (x : F) :
    (W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ^ 2 - W.preΨ₄.eval x) ^ 2 + 4 * W.Ψ₃.eval x ^ 3
        - (W.b₂ + 12 * x) * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x * W.Ψ₃.eval x ^ 2
        + 4 * W.preΨ₄.eval x * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ^ 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃, WeierstrassCurve.preΨ₄]
  simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, eval_C, eval_ofNat]
  linear_combination (W.b₈ ^ 2 + 6 * x * W.b₆ * W.b₈ + 9 * x ^ 2 * W.b₆ ^ 2 +
      8 * x ^ 2 * W.b₄ * W.b₈ + 24 * x ^ 3 * W.b₄ * W.b₆ + 4 * x ^ 3 * W.b₂ * W.b₈ +
      22 * x ^ 4 * W.b₈ + 16 * x ^ 4 * W.b₄ ^ 2 + 11 * x ^ 4 * W.b₂ * W.b₆ +
      54 * x ^ 5 * W.b₆ + 14 * x ^ 5 * W.b₂ * W.b₄ + 60 * x ^ 6 * W.b₄ +
      3 * x ^ 6 * W.b₂ ^ 2 + 24 * x ^ 7 * W.b₂ + 45 * x ^ 8) * W.b_relation

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.preΨ₄_eval_of_Ψ₃
statement:
lemma preΨ₄_eval_of_Ψ₃ {x : F} (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0) :
    W.preΨ₄.eval x = -W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcore := tripling_core (W := W) x
  rw [hT] at hcore
  have hsq : (W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ^ 2 + W.preΨ₄.eval x) ^ 2 = 0 := by linear_combination hcore
  have h0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp hsq
  linear_combination h0

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Φ_three_eval_of_Ψ₃
statement:
lemma Φ_three_eval_of_Ψ₃ {x : F} (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0) :
    (W.Φ 3).eval x = W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ_three_eval, hT, preΨ₄_eval_of_Ψ₃ hT]; ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Φ_three_eval_ne_zero_of_Ψ₃
statement:
lemma Φ_three_eval_ne_zero_of_Ψ₃ [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x : F}
    (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0) : (W.Φ 3).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ_three_eval_of_Ψ₃ hT]
  exact pow_ne_zero 3 (Ψ₂Sq_eval_ne_zero_of_root_Ψ₃ h2 hT)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Φ_three_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq
statement:
theorem eval_Φ_three_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq [W.IsElliptic] (x : F)
    (hx : (W.ΨSq 3).eval x = 0) : (W.Φ 3).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : W.Ψ₃.eval x = 0 := by
    refine pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp ?_
    rw [← eval_pow, ← ΨSq_three]
    exact hx
  refine eval_Φ_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_ne_zero hx ?_ ?_
  · rw [show (3 : ℤ) + 1 = 4 from rfl, ΨSq_four, eval_mul, eval_pow]
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (pow_ne_zero _ (Polynomial.eval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime W.isCoprime_preΨ₄_Ψ₃ h3))
      (Polynomial.eval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime W.isCoprime_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq.symm h3)
  · rw [show (3 : ℤ) - 1 = 2 from rfl, ΨSq_two]
    exact Polynomial.eval_ne_zero_of_isCoprime W.isCoprime_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq.symm h3

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX_add_self_mul_ΨSq_three_eval
statement:
theorem addX_add_self_mul_ΨSq_three_eval (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x y : F} (h : W.Equation x y)
    (hy : y ≠ W.negY x y) (hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0) :
    W.addX (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x
        (W.slope (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y)) y)
        * (W.ΨSq 3).eval x = (W.Φ 3).eval x
proof:
:= by
  set ℓ := W.slope x x y y with hℓ
  set x₂ := W.addX x x ℓ with hx₂
  set y₂ := W.addY x x y ℓ with hy₂def
  set s := 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ with hsdef
  set T := W.Ψ₃.eval x with hTdef
  set Q := W.preΨ₄.eval x with hQdef
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := two_mul_add_ne_zero_of_Y_ne hy
  have hs : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = s ^ 2 := Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq h
  have hXsub : (x₂ - x) * s ^ 2 = -T := by
    rw [hx₂, hℓ, addX_self_sub h hy, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hsne)]
  have hx₂ne : x₂ - x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hcon
    rw [hcon, zero_mul, eq_comm, neg_eq_zero] at hXsub
    exact hT hXsub
  have hslope_self : ℓ * s = 3 * x ^ 2 + 2 * W.a₂ * x + W.a₄ - W.a₁ * y := slope_self_mul hy
  have hQeq : Q = T * (6 * x ^ 2 + (W.a₁ ^ 2 + 4 * W.a₂) * x + (2 * W.a₄ + W.a₁ * W.a₃))
      - (s ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hQdef, hTdef, preΨ₄_eval, hs, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄]
  have hcore : ((s ^ 2) ^ 2 - Q) ^ 2 + 4 * T ^ 3
      - ((W.a₁ ^ 2 + 4 * W.a₂) + 12 * x) * s ^ 2 * T ^ 2 + 4 * Q * (s ^ 2) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    have := tripling_core (W := W) x
    rw [hs, ← hTdef, ← hQdef, WeierstrassCurve.b₂] at this
    exact this
  have hYkey : (y₂ - y) * (2 * s ^ 2 * s) = Q - (s ^ 2) ^ 2 + W.a₁ * T * s := by
    rw [hy₂def, WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addY, WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY,
      WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negAddY, ← hx₂]
    linear_combination (-2 * s * (ℓ + W.a₁)) * hXsub + (2 * T) * hslope_self
      + (-1 : F) * hQeq
  set L := W.slope x₂ x y₂ y with hLdef
  have hsl : L * (x₂ - x) = y₂ - y := by
    rw [hLdef, slope_of_X_ne (fun hcon => hx₂ne (by rw [hcon, sub_self])), div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx₂ne]
  have hslope2 : L * (2 * s * T) = (s ^ 2) ^ 2 - Q - W.a₁ * T * s := by
    linear_combination (-2 * s ^ 2 * s) * hsl + (-1 : F) * hYkey + (2 * s * L) * hXsub
  have h4 : (4 : F) * s ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    refine mul_ne_zero ?_ (pow_ne_zero 2 hsne)
    rw [show (4 : F) = 2 * 2 by norm_num]
    exact mul_ne_zero h2 h2
  have main : (W.addX x₂ x L * T ^ 2 - (x * T ^ 2 - Q * s ^ 2)) * (4 * s ^ 2) = 0 := by
    simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX]
    linear_combination (2 * s * T * L + s ^ 4 - Q + W.a₁ * T * s) * hslope2
      + (-4 * T ^ 2) * hXsub + hcore
  rw [ΨSq_three_eval, Φ_three_eval, ← hTdef, ← hQdef, hs]
  have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp main).resolve_right h4
  linear_combination hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.hasXCoordFormula_three
statement: theorem hasXCoordFormula_three (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : HasXCoordFormula W 3
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h hne
  simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hne ⊢
  have hyeq : W.Equation x y := h.1
  have hT : W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hne (by rw [ΨSq_three_eval, h0]; ring)
  have h3P : (3 : ℕ) • Point.some x y h
      = Point.some x y h + Point.some x y h + Point.some x y h := by
    rw [show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 from rfl, add_smul, two_nsmul, one_nsmul]
  by_cases hyeqn : y = W.negY x y
  · 
    have hs0 : 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ = 0 := by
      have h' := hyeqn
      rw [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY] at h'
      linear_combination h'
    have hp : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0 := by rw [Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq hyeq, hs0]; ring
    have hxx : (W.Φ 3).eval x / (W.ΨSq 3).eval x = x := by
      rw [Φ_three_eval, hp, mul_zero, sub_zero, ΨSq_three_eval, mul_div_assoc,
        div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 hT), mul_one]
    have hns₃ : W.Nonsingular ((W.Φ 3).eval x / (W.ΨSq 3).eval x) y := by rw [hxx]; exact h
    refine ⟨y, hns₃, ?_⟩
    rw [h3P, Point.add_self_of_Y_eq hyeqn, zero_add]
    simp only [Point.some.injEq, and_true]
    exact hxx.symm
  · 
    have hx₂ne : W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y) ≠ x := by
      rw [Ne, addX_self_eq_iff hyeq hyeqn]
      exact hT
    have hX : W.addX (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x
        (W.slope (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y)) y)
        = (W.Φ 3).eval x / (W.ΨSq 3).eval x := by
      rw [eq_div_iff hne]
      exact addX_add_self_mul_ΨSq_three_eval h2 hyeq hyeqn hT
    have hns₃ : W.Nonsingular ((W.Φ 3).eval x / (W.ΨSq 3).eval x)
        (W.addY (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y))
          (W.slope (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y)) y)) := by
      rw [← hX]
      exact nonsingular_add (nonsingular_add h h fun hxy => hyeqn hxy.right) h
        fun hxy => hx₂ne hxy.left
    refine ⟨W.addY (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y))
        (W.slope (W.addX x x (W.slope x x y y)) x (W.addY x x y (W.slope x x y y)) y),
      hns₃, ?_⟩
    rw [h3P, Point.add_self_of_Y_ne hyeqn, Point.add_of_X_ne hx₂ne]
    simp only [Point.some.injEq, and_true]
    exact hX

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_three_some
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_three_some [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x₀ : F) :
    ∃ (P : W.Point) (y' : F) (h' : W.Nonsingular x₀ y'), (3 : ℕ) • P = Point.some x₀ y' h'
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_some_of_hasXCoordFormula h2 (by norm_num)
    (by simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat]; exact eval_Φ_three_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq)
    (hasXCoordFormula_three h2) x₀

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_three_eq
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_three_eq [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (Q : W.Point) :
    ∃ P : W.Point, (3 : ℕ) • P = Q
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_eq_of_hasXCoordFormula h2 (by norm_num)
    (by simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat]; exact eval_Φ_three_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq)
    (hasXCoordFormula_three h2) Q

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nsmul_three_surjective
statement:
theorem nsmul_three_surjective [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective fun P : W.Point => (3 : ℕ) • P
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_three_eq h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_three_eq_some_of_root
statement:
theorem exists_nsmul_three_eq_some_of_root [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ y₀ : F}
    (hQ : W.Nonsingular x₀ y₀) {x y : F} (hxy : W.Equation x y)
    (hx : (W.Φ 3).eval x = x₀ * W.Ψ₃.eval x ^ 2) :
    ∃ P : W.Point, (3 : ℕ) • P = Point.some x₀ y₀ hQ
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_eq_some_of_hasXCoordFormula_of_root
    (by simp only [Nat.cast_ofNat]; exact eval_Φ_three_ne_zero_of_root_ΨSq)
    (hasXCoordFormula_three h2) hQ hxy
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat, ΨSq_three_eval] using hx)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_y2EqX3AddOne_two
statement: private lemma equation_y2EqX3AddOne_two : (y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).Equation 2 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Affine.equation_iff]; norm_num [y2EqX3AddOne]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_y2EqX3AddOne_neg_one
statement: private lemma equation_y2EqX3AddOne_neg_one : (y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).Equation (-1) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Affine.equation_iff]; norm_num [y2EqX3AddOne]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Φ_three_y2EqX3AddOne
statement:
private lemma eval_Φ_three_y2EqX3AddOne :
    ((y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).Φ 3).eval 2 = (-1 : ℚ) * (y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).Ψ₃.eval 2 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ_three_eval]
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.preΨ₄, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈,
    y2EqX3AddOne]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_nsmul_three_eq_y2EqX3AddOne
statement:
private theorem exists_nsmul_three_eq_y2EqX3AddOne :
    ∃ P : (y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).Point,
      (3 : ℕ) • P =
        Point.some (-1) 0 (equation_iff_nonsingular.mp equation_y2EqX3AddOne_neg_one)
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_three_eq_some_of_root (by norm_num) _ equation_y2EqX3AddOne_two
    eval_Φ_three_y2EqX3AddOne

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_mul_two
statement:
theorem card_torsion_mul_two (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (n * 2)) = 4 * Nat.card (W.torsion n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_torsion_mul_of_surjective (nsmul_two_surjective h2) n, card_torsion_two h2]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_pow
statement:
theorem card_torsion_two_pow (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (2 ^ k)) = 4 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_torsion_pow_of_surjective (nsmul_two_surjective h2) k, card_torsion_two h2]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_two_pow
statement: theorem finite_torsion_two_pow (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) : Finite (W.torsion (2 ^ k))
proof:
:=
  finite_torsion_pow two_ne_zero (nsmul_two_surjective h2)
    (by rw [card_torsion_two h2]; norm_num) k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_pow_mul_self
statement:
theorem card_torsion_two_pow_mul_self (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion (2 ^ k)) = 2 ^ k * 2 ^ k
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_pow_mul_self (nsmul_two_surjective h2) (by rw [card_torsion_two h2]; norm_num) k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionTwoPow_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionTwoPow_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion (2 ^ k) ≃+ ZMod (2 ^ k) × ZMod (2 ^ k))
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsionPow_addEquiv Nat.prime_two (nsmul_two_surjective h2)
    (by rw [card_torsion_two h2]; norm_num) k

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_four
statement: theorem card_torsion_four (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : Nat.card (W.torsion 4) = 16
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_torsion_two_pow (W := W) h2 2
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionFour_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionFour_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 4 ≃+ ZMod 4 × ZMod 4)
proof:
:= by
  have h := nonempty_torsionTwoPow_addEquiv (W := W) h2 2
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionTwoPowMulThree_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionTwoPowMulThree_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) (k : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion (2 ^ k * 3) ≃+ ZMod (2 ^ k * 3) × ZMod (2 ^ k * 3))
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsion_addEquiv_zmod_sq_of_coprime
    (Nat.Coprime.pow_left k (by decide)) (nonempty_torsionTwoPow_addEquiv h2 k)
    (nonempty_torsionThree_addEquiv h2 h3)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_twelve
statement:
theorem card_torsion_twelve (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion 12) = 144
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_torsion_mul (W := W) (m := 4) (n := 3) (by decide)
  rw [card_torsion_four h2, card_torsion_three h2 h3] at h
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionTwelve_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionTwelve_addEquiv (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h3 : (3 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 12 ≃+ ZMod 12 × ZMod 12)
proof:
:= by
  have h := nonempty_torsionTwoPowMulThree_addEquiv (W := W) h2 h3 2
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_two_nsmul_eq_of_mem_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_two_nsmul_eq_of_mem_torsion (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {k : ℕ} {y : W.Point}
    (hy : y ∈ W.torsion (2 ^ k)) : ∃ x ∈ W.torsion (2 ^ (k + 1)), 2 • x = y
proof:
:=
  exists_nsmul_eq_of_mem_torsion (nsmul_two_surjective h2) hy

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_two
statement:
theorem exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_two (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P Q : W.Point, P ∈ W.torsion 2 ∧ Q ∈ W.torsion 2 ∧
      AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion 2
proof:
:=
  (nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv (W := W) h2).elim exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_of_addEquiv

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.exists_compatible_basis
statement:
theorem exists_compatible_basis (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ P Q : ℕ → W.Point,
      (∀ k, AddSubgroup.closure ({P k, Q k} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (2 ^ k)) ∧
      (∀ k, 2 • P (k + 1) = P k) ∧ (∀ k, 2 • Q (k + 1) = Q k)
proof:
:=
  exists_compatible_basis_of_surjective (nsmul_two_surjective h2)
    (exists_closure_pair_eq_torsion_two h2)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionPairHom_bijective
proof:
:=
  haveI := finite_torsion_two_pow (W := W) h2 k
  torsionPairHom_bijective_of_card (card_torsion_two_pow_mul_self h2 k) hgen

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionPairEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma torsionPairEquiv_apply_coe (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {k : ℕ} {P Q : W.Point}
    (hgen : AddSubgroup.closure ({P, Q} : Set W.Point) = W.torsion (2 ^ k))
    (ab : ZMod (2 ^ k) × ZMod (2 ^ k)) :
    ((torsionPairEquiv h2 hgen ab : W.torsion (2 ^ k)) : W.Point)
      = ab.1.val • P + ab.2.val • Q
proof: := rfl

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.zmod_pair_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:=
  haveI := finite_torsion_two_pow (W := W) h2 k
  zmod_pair_eq_zero_iff_of_card (card_torsion_two_pow_mul_self h2 k) hgen

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ne_zero_and_ne_of_closure_pair
proof:
:=
  haveI := finite_torsion_two_pow (W := W) h2 k
  ne_zero_and_ne_of_closure_pair_of_card (card_torsion_two_pow_mul_self h2 k)
    (by calc 1 < 2 := one_lt_two
      _ = 2 ^ 1 := (pow_one 2).symm
      _ ≤ 2 ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hk) hgen

name: WeierstrassCurve.eval_Ψ₃_ne_zero_of_eval_Ψ₂Sq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_Ψ₃_ne_zero_of_eval_Ψ₂Sq_eq_zero {x : R} (h : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0) :
    W.Ψ₃.eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h₃ =>
  not_isUnit_X_sub_C x <|
    W.isCoprime_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq.isUnit_of_dvd' (dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr h₃) (dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr h)

name: WeierstrassCurve.eval_ΨSq_three_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_two_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_ΨSq_three_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_two_eq_zero {x : R} (h : (W.ΨSq 2).eval x = 0) :
    (W.ΨSq 3).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ΨSq_two] at h
  rw [ΨSq_three]
  exact fun h₃ =>
    not_isUnit_X_sub_C x <|
      (W.isCoprime_Ψ₃_Ψ₂Sq.pow_left (m := 2)).isUnit_of_dvd'
        (dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr h₃) (dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr h)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_three_evalEval_ne_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ψ_three_evalEval_ne_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero (h : W.Equation x y)
    (h₂ : (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y = 0) : (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h₃
  refine eval_ΨSq_three_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_two_eq_zero (W := W) (x := x) ?_ ?_
  · rw [← ψ_sq_evalEval h, h₂]
    ring
  · rw [← ψ_sq_evalEval h, h₃]
    ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_three_ne_zero_two_torsion_y2EqX3AddOne
statement:
theorem ψ_three_ne_zero_two_torsion_y2EqX3AddOne :
    ((y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).ψ 2).evalEval (-1) 0 = 0 ∧
      ((y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).ψ 3).evalEval (-1) 0 = -9
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [ψ_two_evalEval]; norm_num [y2EqX3AddOne]
  · rw [ψ_three, evalEval_C]
    norm_num [y2EqX3AddOne, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
      WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.four_ne_zero_of_two_ne_zero
statement:
private lemma four_ne_zero_of_two_ne_zero {F : Type*} [Field F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    (4 : F) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (4 : F) = 2 * 2 by norm_num]
  exact mul_ne_zero h2 h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq
statement:
lemma Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq {x y : F} (h : W.Equation x y) :
    W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ΨSq_two, ← ψ_sq_evalEval h 2, ψ_two_evalEval]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_of_Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_zero
statement:
lemma equation_of_Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_zero (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x y : F}
    (hy : 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ = 0) (hx : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0) : W.Equation x y
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : (4 : F) ≠ 0 := four_ne_zero_of_two_ne_zero h2
  rw [equation_iff']
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ h4
  rw [mul_zero]
  simp only [Ψ₂Sq, b₂, b₄, b₆, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_C, eval_X] at hx
  linear_combination (2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃) * hy - hx

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.two_mul_twoTorsionY_add
statement:
lemma two_mul_twoTorsionY_add (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x : F) :
    2 * W.twoTorsionY x + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [twoTorsionY]
  field_simp
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_twoTorsionY
statement:
lemma equation_twoTorsionY (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x : F} (hx : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0) :
    W.Equation x (W.twoTorsionY x)
proof:
:=
  equation_of_Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_zero h2 (two_mul_twoTorsionY_add h2 x) hx

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonsingular_twoTorsionY
statement:
lemma nonsingular_twoTorsionY [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x : F}
    (hx : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0) : W.Nonsingular x (W.twoTorsionY x)
proof:
:=
  equation_iff_nonsingular.mp (equation_twoTorsionY h2 hx)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.twoTorsionPolynomial_a_ne_zero
statement: lemma twoTorsionPolynomial_a_ne_zero (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : W.twoTorsionPolynomial.a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [twoTorsionPolynomial, show (4 : F) = 2 * 2 by norm_num]
  exact mul_ne_zero h2 h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_roots_Ψ₂Sq
statement: lemma finite_roots_Ψ₂Sq (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : Finite {x : F // W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finite.of_equiv _ (W.rootsEquiv h2).symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_roots_Ψ₂Sq_le
statement:
lemma card_roots_Ψ₂Sq_le (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card {x : F // W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0} ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := W.finite_roots_Ψ₂Sq h2
  rw [Nat.card_congr (W.rootsEquiv h2), Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe]
  exact (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _).trans
    ((Polynomial.card_roots' _).trans W.natDegree_Ψ₂Sq_le)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_roots_Ψ₂Sq_of_splits
statement:
lemma card_roots_Ψ₂Sq_of_splits [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hsplits : W.Ψ₂Sq.Splits) :
    Nat.card {x : F // W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0} = 3
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ha : W.twoTorsionPolynomial.a ≠ 0 := W.twoTorsionPolynomial_a_ne_zero h2
  have hd : W.twoTorsionPolynomial.discr ≠ 0 :=
    W.twoTorsionPolynomial_discr_ne_zero_of_isElliptic h2.isUnit
  have hsplits' : (W.twoTorsionPolynomial.toPoly.map (RingHom.id F)).Splits := by
    rw [Polynomial.map_id, ← Ψ₂Sq_eq]
    exact hsplits
  have hcard := Cubic.card_roots_of_discr_ne_zero (φ := RingHom.id F) ha hsplits' hd
  have hmap : Cubic.map (RingHom.id F) W.twoTorsionPolynomial = W.twoTorsionPolynomial := rfl
  rw [hmap, Cubic.roots, ← Ψ₂Sq_eq] at hcard
  rw [Nat.card_congr (W.rootsEquiv h2), Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe]
  exact hcard

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_roots_Ψ₂Sq
statement:
lemma card_roots_Ψ₂Sq [W.IsElliptic] [IsAlgClosed F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card {x : F // W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0} = 3
proof:
:=
  card_roots_Ψ₂Sq_of_splits h2 (IsAlgClosed.splits _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_torsion_two_iff_eq_neg
statement: lemma mem_torsion_two_iff_eq_neg {P : W.Point} : P ∈ W.torsion 2 ↔ P = -P
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_torsion_iff, two_nsmul, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_torsion_two_some_iff
statement:
lemma mem_torsion_two_some_iff {x y : F} (h : W.Nonsingular x y) :
    Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 2 ↔ 2 * y + W.a₁ * x + W.a₃ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_torsion_two_iff_eq_neg, Point.neg_some, Point.some.injEq]
  simp only [negY, true_and]
  constructor <;> intro hy <;> linear_combination hy

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eq_twoTorsionY_of_mem_torsion_two
statement:
lemma eq_twoTorsionY_of_mem_torsion_two (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x y : F} {h : W.Nonsingular x y}
    (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 2) : y = W.twoTorsionY x
proof:
:= by
  have hy := (mem_torsion_two_some_iff h).mp hP
  rw [twoTorsionY, eq_div_iff h2]
  linear_combination hy

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_two
statement:
lemma Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_two {x y : F} {h : W.Nonsingular x y}
    (hP : Point.some x y h ∈ W.torsion 2) : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_sq h.1, (mem_torsion_two_some_iff h).mp hP]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionTwoOfRoot_bijective
statement:
lemma torsionTwoOfRoot_bijective (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Function.Bijective (torsionTwoOfRoot (W := W) h2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (_ | ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩) (_ | ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩) hab
    · rfl
    · exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val hab).symm (Point.some_ne_zero _)
    · exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val hab) (Point.some_ne_zero _)
    · have hx := congrArg Subtype.val hab
      rw [torsionTwoOfRoot, torsionTwoOfRoot, Point.some.injEq] at hx
      exact congrArg _ (Subtype.ext hx.1)
  · rintro ⟨(_ | ⟨x, y, h⟩), hP⟩
    · exact ⟨none, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨some ⟨x, Ψ₂Sq_eval_eq_zero_of_mem_torsion_two hP⟩,
        Subtype.ext (by
          rw [torsionTwoOfRoot]
          simp only [Point.some.injEq]
          exact ⟨trivial, (eq_twoTorsionY_of_mem_torsion_two h2 hP).symm⟩)⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_two
statement: lemma finite_torsion_two (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : Finite (W.torsion 2)
proof:
:=
  haveI := W.finite_roots_Ψ₂Sq h2
  Finite.of_equiv _ (torsionTwoEquiv h2).symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_le
statement: theorem card_torsion_two_le (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : Nat.card (W.torsion 2) ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  haveI := W.finite_roots_Ψ₂Sq h2
  rw [Nat.card_congr (torsionTwoEquiv h2), Finite.card_option]
  have := W.card_roots_Ψ₂Sq_le h2
  omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_of_splits
statement:
theorem card_torsion_two_of_splits (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hsplits : W.Ψ₂Sq.Splits) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion 2) = 4
proof:
:= by
  haveI := W.finite_roots_Ψ₂Sq h2
  rw [Nat.card_congr (torsionTwoEquiv h2), Finite.card_option,
    card_roots_Ψ₂Sq_of_splits h2 hsplits]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two
statement: theorem card_torsion_two [IsAlgClosed F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : Nat.card (W.torsion 2) = 4
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_two_of_splits h2 (IsAlgClosed.splits _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv_of_splits
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv_of_splits (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (hsplits : W.Ψ₂Sq.Splits) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 2 ≃+ ZMod 2 × ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := W.finite_torsion_two h2
  have hcard : Nat.card (W.torsion 2) = 2 ^ 2 := by
    rw [card_torsion_two_of_splits h2 hsplits]
    norm_num
  refine AddCommGroup.equiv_zmod_sq_of_card_sq two_pos (fun a => nsmul_mem_torsion a) hcard ?_
  intro p hp
  calc Nat.card {a : W.torsion 2 // p • a = 0}
      ≤ Nat.card (W.torsion 2) := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective
    _ = 2 ^ 2 := hcard
    _ ≤ p ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hp.two_le 2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv [IsAlgClosed F] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (W.torsion 2 ≃+ ZMod 2 × ZMod 2)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv_of_splits h2 (IsAlgClosed.splits _)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X
statement:
private lemma Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X :
    (y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X ℚ).Ψ₂Sq = C 4 * X * (X + C 1) * (X + C 4)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆, y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X]
  norm_num only
  simp only [map_ofNat, map_one, Polynomial.C_0]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.splits_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X
statement: private lemma splits_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X : (y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X ℚ).Ψ₂Sq.Splits
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X]
  exact (((Splits.C 4).mul Splits.X).mul (Splits.X_add_C 1)).mul (Splits.X_add_C 4)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_two_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X
statement:
private theorem card_torsion_two_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X :
    Nat.card ((y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X ℚ).torsion 2) = 4
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_two_of_splits (by norm_num) splits_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X
statement:
private theorem nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X :
    Nonempty ((y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X ℚ).torsion 2 ≃+ ZMod 2 × ZMod 2)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_torsionTwo_addEquiv_of_splits (by norm_num) splits_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3Add5X2Add4X

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.halvingX_sq_sub_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq
statement:
theorem halvingX_sq_sub_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x₀ : F) :
    (W.halvingX x₀) ^ 2 - (W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq)
      = C (2 * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀) * X
        + C (((4 * x₀ ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x₀ + W.b₄) / 2) ^ 2 + W.b₈ + W.b₆ * x₀)
proof:
:= by
  set c : F := (4 * x₀ ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x₀ + W.b₄) / 2 with hcdef
  have hc : 2 * c = 4 * x₀ ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x₀ + W.b₄ := by rw [hcdef]; field_simp
  have hev : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 4 * x₀ ^ 3 + W.b₂ * x₀ ^ 2 + 2 * W.b₄ * x₀ + W.b₆ := by
    simp [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq]
  rw [hev, Φ_two, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, halvingX, ← hcdef]
  linear_combination (norm := (C_simp; ring1))
    (C (-1 : F) * X ^ 2 + C (2 * x₀) * X) * congrArg C hc

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.degree_halvingX_sq_sub_le
statement:
theorem degree_halvingX_sq_sub_le (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x₀ : F) :
    ((W.halvingX x₀) ^ 2 - (W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq)).degree ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [halvingX_sq_sub_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq h2]
  compute_degree

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.coeff_one_halvingX_sq_sub
statement:
theorem coeff_one_halvingX_sq_sub (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x₀ : F) :
    ((W.halvingX x₀) ^ 2 - (W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq)).coeff 1 = 2 * W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [halvingX_sq_sub_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq h2, coeff_add, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_one, coeff_C,
    mul_one, if_neg one_ne_zero, add_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Ψ₂Sq_eq_zero_of_isSquare
statement:
theorem eval_Ψ₂Sq_eq_zero_of_isSquare (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F}
    (hsq : IsSquare (W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq)) : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hsq
  set D : F[X] := (W.halvingX x₀) ^ 2 - (W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq) with hDdef
  have hfac : (W.halvingX x₀ - Q) * (W.halvingX x₀ + Q) = D := by rw [hDdef, hQ]; ring
  have hdegD : D.degree ≤ 1 := degree_halvingX_sq_sub_le h2 x₀
  have hsum : (W.halvingX x₀ - Q) + (W.halvingX x₀ + Q) = C 2 * W.halvingX x₀ := by
    rw [map_ofNat]; ring
  have hD0 : D = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hne₁ : W.halvingX x₀ - Q ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (by rw [← hfac, h, zero_mul])
    have hne₂ : W.halvingX x₀ + Q ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (by rw [← hfac, h, mul_zero])
    have hdegsum :
        (2 : WithBot ℕ) ≤ max (W.halvingX x₀ - Q).degree (W.halvingX x₀ + Q).degree := by
      have hCH : (C (2 : F) * W.halvingX x₀).degree = 2 := by
        rw [degree_C_mul (by simpa using h2), degree_halvingX]
      calc (2 : WithBot ℕ) = (C (2 : F) * W.halvingX x₀).degree := hCH.symm
        _ = ((W.halvingX x₀ - Q) + (W.halvingX x₀ + Q)).degree := by rw [hsum]
        _ ≤ _ := degree_add_le _ _
    have hmul : D.degree = (W.halvingX x₀ - Q).degree + (W.halvingX x₀ + Q).degree := by
      rw [← hfac, degree_mul]
    have hge₁ : (0 : WithBot ℕ) ≤ (W.halvingX x₀ - Q).degree := zero_le_degree_iff.mpr hne₁
    have hge₂ : (0 : WithBot ℕ) ≤ (W.halvingX x₀ + Q).degree := zero_le_degree_iff.mpr hne₂
    rcases max_cases (W.halvingX x₀ - Q).degree (W.halvingX x₀ + Q).degree with
      ⟨he, _⟩ | ⟨he, _⟩
    · rw [he] at hdegsum
      have : (2 : WithBot ℕ) ≤ D.degree := hmul ▸ le_add_of_le_of_nonneg hdegsum hge₂
      exact absurd (this.trans hdegD) (by decide)
    · rw [he] at hdegsum
      have : (2 : WithBot ℕ) ≤ D.degree := hmul ▸ le_add_of_nonneg_of_le hge₁ hdegsum
      exact absurd (this.trans hdegD) (by decide)
  have hcoeff := coeff_one_halvingX_sq_sub (W := W) h2 x₀
  rw [← hDdef, hD0, coeff_zero] at hcoeff
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hcoeff.symm).resolve_left h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSquare_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_iff
statement:
theorem isSquare_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_iff (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x₀ : F) :
    IsSquare (W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq) ↔ W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨eval_Ψ₂Sq_eq_zero_of_isSquare h2, fun hx₀ => ⟨W.halvingX x₀, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eq_halvingX_sq h2 hx₀, sq]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eq_halvingX_sq_iff
statement:
theorem Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eq_halvingX_sq_iff (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (x₀ : F) :
    W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq = (W.halvingX x₀) ^ 2 ↔ W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => eval_Ψ₂Sq_eq_zero_of_isSquare h2 ⟨W.halvingX x₀, by rw [h, sq]⟩,
    Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eq_halvingX_sq h2⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.not_isSquare_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq
statement:
theorem not_isSquare_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F}
    (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ ≠ 0) : ¬ IsSquare (W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq)
proof:
:=
  fun hsq => hx₀ (eval_Ψ₂Sq_eq_zero_of_isSquare h2 hsq)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.sq_halvingX_const_of_root
statement:
theorem sq_halvingX_const_of_root (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {x₀ : F} (hx₀ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x₀ = 0) :
    ((4 * x₀ ^ 2 + W.b₂ * x₀ + W.b₄) / 2) ^ 2 + W.b₈ + W.b₆ * x₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (W.halvingX x₀) ^ 2 - (W.Φ 2 - C x₀ * W.Ψ₂Sq) = 0 := by
    rw [Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_eq_halvingX_sq h2 hx₀, sub_self]
  have := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.eval 0 p)
    (hD.symm.trans (halvingX_sq_sub_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq h2 x₀))
  simpa using this.symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX
statement:
private lemma eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX (x : ℚ) :
    (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Ψ₂Sq.eval x = 4 * x ^ 3 - 4 * x
proof:
:= by
  simp [WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, y2EqX3SubX, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isSquare_y2EqX3SubX_zero
statement:
private theorem isSquare_y2EqX3SubX_zero :
    IsSquare ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Φ 2 - C 0 * (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Ψ₂Sq)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSquare_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq_iff (by norm_num), eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.not_isSquare_y2EqX3SubX_two
statement:
private theorem not_isSquare_y2EqX3SubX_two :
    ¬ IsSquare ((y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Φ 2 - C 2 * (y2EqX3SubX ℚ).Ψ₂Sq)
proof:
:= by
  refine not_isSquare_Φ_two_sub_C_mul_Ψ₂Sq (by norm_num) ?_
  rw [eval_Ψ₂Sq_y2EqX3SubX]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_odd_evalEval_ne_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ψ_odd_evalEval_ne_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero (ht : (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y = 0)
    (hψ₃ : (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    (W.ψ (2 * (m : ℤ) + 1)).evalEval x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ k : ℕ, (W.ψ (2 * (k : ℤ) + 1)).evalEval x y ≠ 0 ∧
      (W.ψ (2 * (k : ℤ) + 3)).evalEval x y ≠ 0 from (h m).1
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨?_, by simpa using hψ₃⟩
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, zero_add, ψ_one_evalEval]
    exact one_ne_zero
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, hB⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨by push_cast; rwa [show 2 * ((k : ℤ) + 1) + 1 = 2 * (k : ℤ) + 3 by ring], ?_⟩
    have hstar := ψ_mul_ψ_sub_of_ψ_eq_zero (W := W) (x := x) (y := y) ht (2 * (k : ℤ) + 3)
    rw [show 2 * (k : ℤ) + 3 + 2 = 2 * (k : ℤ) + 5 by ring,
      show 2 * (k : ℤ) + 3 - 2 = 2 * (k : ℤ) + 1 by ring,
      show (2 : ℤ) + 1 = 3 by ring, show (2 : ℤ) - 1 = 1 by ring, ψ_one_evalEval] at hstar
    intro hcon
    push_cast at hcon
    rw [show 2 * ((k : ℤ) + 1) + 3 = 2 * (k : ℤ) + 5 by ring] at hcon
    rw [hcon, zero_mul] at hstar
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hψ₃ one_ne_zero) (pow_ne_zero 2 hB) (by linear_combination hstar)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_iff_two_dvd_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_iff_two_dvd_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero (ht : (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y = 0)
    (hψ₃ : (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    (W.ψ (n : ℤ)).evalEval x y = 0 ↔ 2 ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with ⟨m, hm⟩ | ⟨m, hm⟩
  · subst hm
    refine ⟨fun _ => ⟨m, by ring⟩, fun _ => ?_⟩
    rw [show ((m + m : ℕ) : ℤ) = 2 * (m : ℤ) by push_cast; ring]
    exact ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero ht m
  · subst hm
    refine ⟨fun hz => absurd ?_ (ψ_odd_evalEval_ne_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero ht hψ₃ m),
      fun hdvd => absurd hdvd (by omega)⟩
    rwa [show ((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 2 * (m : ℤ) + 1 by push_cast; ring] at hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.two_nsmul_eq_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem two_nsmul_eq_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero (hns : W.Nonsingular x y)
    (ht : (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y = 0) : ((2 : ℕ) • Point.some x y hns : W.Point) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ψ_two_evalEval] at ht
  have hy : W.negY x y = y := by rw [negY]; linear_combination -ht
  have hneg : -(Point.some x y hns : W.Point) = Point.some x y hns := by
    rw [Point.neg_some, Point.some.injEq]
    exact ⟨rfl, hy⟩
  rw [two_nsmul]
  nth_rewrite 2 [← hneg]
  exact add_neg_cancel _

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nsmul_eq_zero_iff_two_dvd_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nsmul_eq_zero_iff_two_dvd_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero (hns : W.Nonsingular x y)
    (ht : (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y = 0) (hψ₃ : (W.ψ 3).evalEval x y ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ((n • Point.some x y hns : W.Point) = 0 ↔ 2 ∣ n) ∧
      ((W.ψ (n : ℤ)).evalEval x y = 0 ↔ 2 ∣ n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨fun hz => ?_, fun ⟨m, hm⟩ => ?_⟩,
    ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_iff_two_dvd_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero ht hψ₃ n⟩
  · by_contra hc
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = 2 * m + 1 := ⟨n / 2, by omega⟩
    rw [mul_comm, add_nsmul, ← smul_smul, two_nsmul_eq_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero hns ht,
      smul_zero, one_nsmul, zero_add] at hz
    exact Point.some_ne_zero hns hz
  · rw [hm, mul_comm, ← smul_smul, two_nsmul_eq_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero hns ht, smul_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.nsmul_eq_zero_iff_ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_of_isElliptic
statement:
theorem nsmul_eq_zero_iff_ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_of_isElliptic [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hns : W.Nonsingular x y) (n : ℕ) :
    ((n • Point.some x y hns : W.Point) = 0) ↔ (W.ψ (n : ℤ)).evalEval x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y = 0
  · have h := nsmul_eq_zero_iff_two_dvd_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero hns ht
      (ψ_three_evalEval_ne_zero_of_ψ_two_evalEval_eq_zero hns.left ht) n
    exact h.1.trans h.2.symm
  · exact nsmul_eq_zero_iff_ψ_evalEval_eq_zero h2 hns ht n

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_add_one_evalEval_ne_zero_of_nsmul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ψ_add_one_evalEval_ne_zero_of_nsmul_eq_zero [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hns : W.Nonsingular x y) {n : ℕ} (hz : (n • Point.some x y hns : W.Point) = 0) :
    (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) + 1)).evalEval x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hcon
  have hsucc : ((n + 1 : ℕ) • Point.some x y hns : W.Point) = 0 := by
    refine (nsmul_eq_zero_iff_ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_of_isElliptic h2 hns (n + 1)).mpr ?_
    rwa [show (((n + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) + 1 by push_cast; ring]
  rw [succ_nsmul, hz, zero_add] at hsucc
  exact Point.some_ne_zero hns hsucc

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_sub_one_evalEval_ne_zero_of_nsmul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem ψ_sub_one_evalEval_ne_zero_of_nsmul_eq_zero [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hns : W.Nonsingular x y) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hz : (n • Point.some x y hns : W.Point) = 0) :
    (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).evalEval x y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k : ℕ, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  intro hcon
  have hpred : ((k : ℕ) • Point.some x y hns : W.Point) = 0 := by
    refine (nsmul_eq_zero_iff_ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_of_isElliptic h2 hns k).mpr ?_
    rwa [show ((k : ℕ) : ℤ) = (((k + 1 : ℕ)) : ℤ) - 1 by push_cast; ring]
  rw [succ_nsmul, hpred, zero_add] at hz
  exact Point.some_ne_zero hns hz

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_ΨSq_adjacent_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_ΨSq_adjacent_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {x : F} (hΨ : (W.ΨSq (n : ℤ)).eval x = 0) :
    (W.ΨSq ((n : ℤ) + 1)).eval x * (W.ΨSq ((n : ℤ) - 1)).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := exists_equation (W := W) h2 x
  have hns : W.Nonsingular x y := equation_iff_nonsingular.mp hxy
  have hψn : (W.ψ (n : ℤ)).evalEval x y = 0 :=
    pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp (by rw [ψ_sq_evalEval hxy, hΨ])
  have hz : ((n : ℕ) • Point.some x y hns : W.Point) = 0 :=
    (nsmul_eq_zero_iff_ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_of_isElliptic h2 hns n).mpr hψn
  refine mul_ne_zero ?_ ?_
  · rw [← ψ_sq_evalEval hxy]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (ψ_add_one_evalEval_ne_zero_of_nsmul_eq_zero h2 hns hz)
  · rw [← ψ_sq_evalEval hxy]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (ψ_sub_one_evalEval_ne_zero_of_nsmul_eq_zero h2 hns hn hz)

statement:

statement:

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_Ψ₂Sq
statement: theorem separable_Ψ₂Sq [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : W.Ψ₂Sq.Separable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ha : W.twoTorsionPolynomial.a ≠ 0 := W.twoTorsionPolynomial_a_ne_zero h2
  have hd : W.twoTorsionPolynomial.discr ≠ 0 :=
    W.twoTorsionPolynomial_discr_ne_zero_of_isElliptic h2.isUnit
  have hsplits : (W.Ψ₂Sq.map (algebraMap F W.Ψ₂Sq.SplittingField)).Splits :=
    IsSplittingField.splits W.Ψ₂Sq.SplittingField W.Ψ₂Sq
  refine (Polynomial.nodup_aroots_iff_of_splits (K := W.Ψ₂Sq.SplittingField)
    (W.Ψ₂Sq_ne_zero (four_ne_zero_of_two_ne_zero h2)) hsplits).mp ?_
  have hnodup := (Cubic.discr_ne_zero_iff_roots_nodup
    (φ := algebraMap F W.Ψ₂Sq.SplittingField) ha (by rw [← Ψ₂Sq_eq]; exact hsplits)).mp hd
  simpa [Polynomial.aroots, Cubic.roots, Cubic.map_toPoly, Ψ₂Sq_eq] using hnodup

name: IsEllipticNet.rel_one_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have habs : rel W P Q 1 0 = rel W (P.natAbs : ℤ) (Q.natAbs : ℤ) 1 0 := by
    rcases Int.natAbs_eq P with hP | hP <;> rcases Int.natAbs_eq Q with hQ | hQ
    · rw [← hP, ← hQ]
    · rw [← hP]; nth_rewrite 1 [hQ]; rw [rel_one_neg_right W hodd]
    · nth_rewrite 1 [hP]; rw [← hQ, rel_one_neg_left W hodd]
    · nth_rewrite 1 [hP]; nth_rewrite 1 [hQ]
      rw [rel_one_neg_left W hodd, rel_one_neg_right W hodd]
  rw [habs]
  rcases le_total (Q.natAbs : ℤ) (P.natAbs : ℤ) with hle | hle
  · exact h _ _ (by positivity) hle (by simp [Int.natAbs_abs]; omega)
  · rw [rel_one_swap W hodd, h _ _ (by positivity) hle (by simp [Int.natAbs_abs]; omega), neg_zero]

name: IsEllipticNet.rel_one_of_rec
statement:
theorem rel_one_of_rec [IsDomain R] {W : ℤ → R}
    (hodd : W.Odd) (hzero : W 0 = 0) (h1 : W 1 = 1) (h2 : W 2 ≠ 0)
    (hrec1 : ∀ m : ℤ, rel W (m + 1) m 1 0 = 0)
    (hrec2 : ∀ m : ℤ, rel W (m + 1) (m - 1) 1 0 = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ x : ℤ, rel W x x 1 0 = 0)
    (p q : ℤ) : rel W p q 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm1 : W (-1) = -1 := by rw [hodd 1, h1]
  have hq0 : ∀ x : ℤ, rel W x 0 1 0 = 0 := by
    intro x
    simp only [rel, add_zero, sub_zero, zero_add, zero_sub, hzero, h1, hm1]
    ring
  have hq1 : ∀ x : ℤ, rel W x 1 1 0 = 0 := by
    intro x
    simp only [rel, add_zero]
    rw [show (1 : ℤ) - 1 = 0 by ring, hzero]
    ring
  suffices key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ a b : ℤ, 0 ≤ b → b ≤ a → a.natAbs + b.natAbs ≤ N →
      rel W a b 1 0 = 0 by
    exact rel_one_of_le hodd _ (key (p.natAbs + q.natAbs)) p q le_rfl
  intro N
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ N ihN =>
  intro a b hb0 hba hN
  have ihAll : ∀ P Q : ℤ, P.natAbs + Q.natAbs < a.natAbs + b.natAbs → rel W P Q 1 0 = 0 := by
    intro P Q hPQ
    refine rel_one_of_le hodd (P.natAbs + Q.natAbs) ?_ P Q le_rfl
    exact fun x y hx hxy hle => ihN (P.natAbs + Q.natAbs) (by omega) x y hx hxy hle
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hb0 with hb | hb
  · rw [← hb]; exact hq0 a
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (show (1 : ℤ) ≤ b by omega) with hb1 | hb1
  · rw [← hb1]; exact hq1 a
  have hb2 : 2 ≤ b := by omega
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hba with hab | hab
  · rw [← hab]; exact hdiag b
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (show b + 1 ≤ a by omega) with hg1 | hg1
  · rw [← hg1]; exact hrec1 b
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (show b + 2 ≤ a by omega) with hg2 | hg2
  · rw [← hg2]
    have hh := hrec2 (b + 1)
    rw [show b + 1 + 1 = b + 2 by ring, show b + 1 - 1 = b by ring] at hh
    exact hh
  have hgap : b + 3 ≤ a := by omega
  obtain ⟨m, hm | hm⟩ := Int.even_or_odd' a
  · obtain ⟨n, hn | hn⟩ := Int.even_or_odd' b
    · subst hm; subst hn
      have hc := cert_ee (W := W) h1 m n
      have g1 : rel W (m - 1) (n - 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g2 : rel W (m - 1) n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g3 : rel W (m - 1) (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g4 : rel W m (n - 2) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g5 : rel W m (n - 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g6 : rel W m (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g7 : rel W (m + 1) (n - 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g8 : rel W (m + 1) n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g9 : rel W (m + 1) (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      simp only [hrec1, hrec2, g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, g7, g8, g9, mul_zero, sub_zero,
        add_zero] at hc
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ h2)
    · subst hm; subst hn
      have hc := cert_eo (W := W) h1 m n
      have g1 : rel W (m - 1) n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g2 : rel W (m - 1) (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g3 : rel W m (n - 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g4 : rel W m n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g5 : rel W m (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g6 : rel W (m + 1) n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g7 : rel W (m + 1) (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g8 : rel W (m + n) (m - n) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g9 : rel W (m + n + 1) (m - n - 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      simp only [hrec1, hrec2, g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, g7, g8, g9, mul_zero, sub_zero,
        add_zero] at hc
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_left h2
  · obtain ⟨n, hn | hn⟩ := Int.even_or_odd' b
    · subst hm; subst hn
      have hc := cert_oe (W := W) h1 m n
      have g1 : rel W m (n - 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g2 : rel W m n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g3 : rel W m (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g4 : rel W (m + 1) (n - 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g5 : rel W (m + 1) n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g6 : rel W (m + 1) (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g7 : rel W (m + n) (m - n) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g8 : rel W (m + n + 1) (m - n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      simp only [hrec1, g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, g7, g8, mul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero] at hc
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_left h2
    · subst hm; subst hn
      have hc := cert_oo (W := W) h1 m n
      have g1 : rel W (m - 1) n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g2 : rel W (m - 1) (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g3 : rel W m (n - 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g4 : rel W m n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g5 : rel W m (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g6 : rel W m (n + 2) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g7 : rel W (m + 1) (n - 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g8 : rel W (m + 1) n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g9 : rel W (m + 1) (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g10 : rel W (m + 1) (n + 2) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g11 : rel W (m + 2) n 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      have g12 : rel W (m + 2) (n + 1) 1 0 = 0 := ihAll _ _ (by omega)
      simp only [hrec1, hrec2, g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6, g7, g8, g9, g10, g11, g12, mul_zero,
        sub_zero, add_zero] at hc
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ h2)

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_rel_one_univ
statement:
theorem normEDS_rel_one_univ (p q : ℤ) :
    IsEllipticNet.rel (normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)) p q 1 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  IsEllipticNet.rel_one_of_rec (normEDS_odd_fun (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2))
    (normEDS_zero (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)) (normEDS_one (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2))
    normEDS_univ_two_ne_zero (normEDS_rel_odd (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2))
    (normEDS_rel_even (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)) normEDS_rel_one_univ_diag p q

name: IsEllipticNet.rel_one_neg_left
statement: lemma rel_one_neg_left (odd : W.Odd) (p q : ℤ) : rel W (-p) q 1 0 = rel W p q 1 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel, add_zero]
  rw [show -p + q = -(p - q) by ring, show -p - q = -(p + q) by ring,
    show -p + 1 = -(p - 1) by ring, show -p - 1 = -(p + 1) by ring,
    odd (p - q), odd (p + q), odd (p - 1), odd (p + 1), odd p]
  ring

name: IsEllipticNet.rel_one_neg_right
statement: lemma rel_one_neg_right (odd : W.Odd) (p q : ℤ) : rel W p (-q) 1 0 = rel W p q 1 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel, add_zero]
  rw [show p + -q = p - q by ring, show p - -q = p + q by ring, show -q + 1 = -(q - 1) by ring,
    show -q - 1 = -(q + 1) by ring, odd (q - 1), odd (q + 1), odd q]
  ring

name: IsEllipticNet.rel_one_swap
statement: lemma rel_one_swap (odd : W.Odd) (p q : ℤ) : rel W q p 1 0 = -rel W p q 1 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel, add_zero]
  rw [show q + p = p + q by ring, show q - p = -(p - q) by ring, odd (p - q)]
  ring

name: IsEllipticNet.one_sq_mul_rel_zero
statement:
lemma one_sq_mul_rel_zero (odd : W.Odd) (p q r : ℤ) :
    W 1 ^ 2 * rel W p q r 0 =
      W r ^ 2 * rel W p q 1 0 + W p ^ 2 * rel W q r 1 0 + W q ^ 2 * rel W r p 1 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel, add_zero]
  rw [show r + p = p + r by ring, show r - p = -(p - r) by ring, odd (p - r)]
  ring

name: IsEllipticNet.isEllipticSequence_of_rel_one
statement:
lemma isEllipticSequence_of_rel_one (odd : W.Odd) (h1 : W 1 = 1)
    (h : ∀ p q : ℤ, rel W p q 1 0 = 0) : IsEllipticSequence W
proof:
:= by
  intro p q r
  have hrel := one_sq_mul_rel_zero W odd p q r
  rw [h p q, h q r, h r p, h1] at hrel
  simpa using hrel

name: IsEllipticNet.isEllipticSequence_iff_rel_one

lemma isEllipticSequence_iff_rel_one (odd : W.Odd) (h1 : W 1 = 1) :
    IsEllipticSequence W ↔ ∀ p q : ℤ, rel W p q 1 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h p q => h p q 1, isEllipticSequence_of_rel_one W odd h1⟩

name: IsEllipticNet.signMultiplesOfThree_odd
statement: lemma signMultiplesOfThree_odd : Function.Odd signMultiplesOfThree
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  simp only [signMultiplesOfThree, Int.sign_neg, dvd_neg]
  split <;> simp

name: IsEllipticNet.signMultiplesOfThree_one
statement: lemma signMultiplesOfThree_one : signMultiplesOfThree 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [signMultiplesOfThree]

name: IsEllipticNet.signMultiplesOfThree_add_one_mul_sub_one
statement:
lemma signMultiplesOfThree_add_one_mul_sub_one (n : ℤ) :
    signMultiplesOfThree (n + 1) * signMultiplesOfThree (n - 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (3 : ℤ) ∣ n + 1
  · have h' : ¬ (3 : ℤ) ∣ n - 1 := by
      intro h2
      have : (3 : ℤ) ∣ 2 := by simpa using dvd_sub h h2
      omega
    simp [signMultiplesOfThree, h']
  · simp [signMultiplesOfThree, h]

name: IsEllipticNet.signMultiplesOfThree_rel_one
statement: lemma signMultiplesOfThree_rel_one (p q : ℤ) : rel signMultiplesOfThree p q 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp := signMultiplesOfThree_add_one_mul_sub_one p
  have hq := signMultiplesOfThree_add_one_mul_sub_one q
  simp only [rel, add_zero, signMultiplesOfThree_one]
  linear_combination (norm := ring1)
    (-(signMultiplesOfThree q * signMultiplesOfThree q)) * hp +
      (signMultiplesOfThree p * signMultiplesOfThree p) * hq

name: IsEllipticNet.not_isEllipticSequence_signMultiplesOfThree
statement:
lemma not_isEllipticSequence_signMultiplesOfThree :
    ¬ IsEllipticSequence signMultiplesOfThree
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h369 := h 3 6 9
  simp only [rel, signMultiplesOfThree] at h369
  revert h369
  decide

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_two_three_two
statement: lemma normEDS_two_three_two (n : ℤ) : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 n = n
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : ∀ m : ℕ, normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 (m : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) := by
    intro m
    induction m using normEDSRec' with
    | zero => simp
    | one => simp
    | two => simp
    | three => simp
    | four => simp
    | even m ih =>
      have i1 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 3 - 1) = (m : ℤ) + 3 - 1 := by
        have := ih (m + 2) (by omega)
        rwa [show ((m + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 3 - 1 by push_cast; ring] at this
      have i2 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 3) = (m : ℤ) + 3 := by
        have := ih (m + 3) (by omega)
        rwa [show ((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 3 by push_cast; ring] at this
      have i3 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 3 + 2) = (m : ℤ) + 3 + 2 := by
        have := ih (m + 5) (by omega)
        rwa [show ((m + 5 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 3 + 2 by push_cast; ring] at this
      have i4 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 3 - 2) = (m : ℤ) + 3 - 2 := by
        have := ih (m + 1) (by omega)
        rwa [show ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 3 - 2 by push_cast; ring] at this
      have i5 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 3 + 1) = (m : ℤ) + 3 + 1 := by
        have := ih (m + 4) (by omega)
        rwa [show ((m + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 3 + 1 by push_cast; ring] at this
      have h := normEDS_even (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 3)
      rw [i1, i2, i3, i4, i5] at h
      rw [show ((2 * (m + 3) : ℕ) : ℤ) = 2 * ((m : ℤ) + 3) by push_cast; ring]
      have h2 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 (2 * ((m : ℤ) + 3)) * 2 = 2 * ((m : ℤ) + 3) * 2 := by
        rw [h]; ring
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ two_ne_zero h2
    | odd m ih =>
      have i1 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 2 + 2) = (m : ℤ) + 2 + 2 := by
        have := ih (m + 4) (by omega)
        rwa [show ((m + 4 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 2 + 2 by push_cast; ring] at this
      have i2 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 2) = (m : ℤ) + 2 := by
        have := ih (m + 2) (by omega)
        rwa [show ((m + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 2 by push_cast; ring] at this
      have i3 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 2 - 1) = (m : ℤ) + 2 - 1 := by
        have := ih (m + 1) (by omega)
        rwa [show ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 2 - 1 by push_cast; ring] at this
      have i4 : normEDS (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 2 + 1) = (m : ℤ) + 2 + 1 := by
        have := ih (m + 3) (by omega)
        rwa [show ((m + 3 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) + 2 + 1 by push_cast; ring] at this
      have h := normEDS_odd (2 : ℤ) 3 2 ((m : ℤ) + 2)
      rw [i1, i2, i3, i4] at h
      rw [show ((2 * (m + 2) + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 2 * ((m : ℤ) + 2) + 1 by push_cast; ring, h]; ring
  induction n using Int.negInduction with
  | nat n => exact hnat n
  | neg ih m => rw [normEDS_neg, ih]

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_univ_ne_zero
statement:
lemma normEDS_univ_ne_zero (n : ℤ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hφ := map_normEDS (aeval ![(2 : ℤ), 3, 2] : UnivEDS →ₐ[ℤ] ℤ) (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) n
  rw [h, map_zero] at hφ
  norm_num [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons] at hφ
  rw [show (![(2 : ℤ), 3, 2] 2) = 2 from rfl, normEDS_two_three_two] at hφ
  exact hn hφ.symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_rel_one_univ_diag
statement:
theorem normEDS_rel_one_univ_diag (x : ℤ) :
    IsEllipticNet.rel (normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)) x x 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  set W : ℤ → UnivEDS := normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) with hW
  have hodd : W.Odd := normEDS_odd_fun (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)
  have hs := IsEllipticNet.rel_one_swap W hodd x x
  have h2 : (2 : UnivEDS) * IsEllipticNet.rel W x x 1 0 = 0 := by
    linear_combination hs
  have htwo : (2 : UnivEDS) ≠ 0 := by
    have h := (MvPolynomial.C_injective (Fin 3) ℤ).ne (by norm_num : (2 : ℤ) ≠ 0)
    simpa using h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left htwo

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_rel_one_univ_of_gapCore
statement:
theorem normEDS_rel_one_univ_of_gapCore (hgap : WardGapCore) (p q : ℤ) :
    IsEllipticNet.rel (normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)) p q 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  set W : ℤ → UnivEDS := normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) with hW
  have hodd : W.Odd := normEDS_odd_fun (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)
  
  
  suffices h : ∀ a b : ℕ, IsEllipticNet.rel W (a : ℤ) (b : ℤ) 1 0 = 0 by
    obtain ⟨a, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg p
    · obtain ⟨b, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg q
      · exact h a b
      · rw [IsEllipticNet.rel_one_neg_right W hodd]
        exact h a b
    · obtain ⟨b, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg q
      · rw [IsEllipticNet.rel_one_neg_left W hodd]
        exact h a b
      · rw [IsEllipticNet.rel_one_neg_left W hodd, IsEllipticNet.rel_one_neg_right W hodd]
        exact h a b
  
  have hdiag : ∀ x : ℤ, IsEllipticNet.rel W x x 1 0 = 0 := by
    intro x
    rw [hW]
    exact normEDS_rel_one_univ_diag x
  
  
  have hcore : ∀ a b : ℕ, b ≤ a → IsEllipticNet.rel W (a : ℤ) (b : ℤ) 1 0 = 0 := by
    intro a b hba
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, a = b + t := ⟨a - b, by omega⟩
    rcases b with _ | _ | b
    · 
      have h0 := normEDS_rel_one_zero (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) ((0 + t : ℕ) : ℤ)
      rw [← hW] at h0
      simpa using h0
    · 
      have h1 := normEDS_rel_one_one (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) ((1 + t : ℕ) : ℤ)
      rw [← hW] at h1
      simpa using h1
    · 
      rcases t with _ | _ | _ | t
      · 
        convert hdiag ((b : ℤ) + 2) using 2 <;> push_cast <;> ring
      · 
        have hb1 := normEDS_rel_odd (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) ((b : ℤ) + 2)
        rw [← hW] at hb1
        convert hb1 using 2 <;> push_cast <;> ring
      · 
        have hb2 := normEDS_rel_even (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) ((b : ℤ) + 3)
        rw [← hW] at hb2
        convert hb2 using 2 <;> push_cast <;> ring
      · 
        have hg := hgap (b + 2 + (t + 3)) (b + 2) (by omega) (by omega)
        rw [← hW] at hg
        convert hg using 2
  
  intro a b
  rcases le_total b a with hba | hab
  · exact hcore a b hba
  · have hthis := hcore b a hab
    rw [IsEllipticNet.rel_one_swap W hodd (b : ℤ) (a : ℤ), hthis, neg_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_rel_one_diag
statement: theorem normEDS_rel_one_diag (p : ℤ) : IsEllipticNet.rel (normEDS b c d) p p 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  set φ : UnivEDS →+* R := (aeval ![b, c, d] : UnivEDS →ₐ[ℤ] R).toRingHom with hφ
  have hcomp : φ ∘ normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2) = normEDS b c d := by
    funext n
    rw [Function.comp_apply, map_normEDS]
    congr 1 <;> simp [hφ]
  have h := IsEllipticNet.map_rel (normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)) φ p p 1 0
  rw [normEDS_rel_one_univ_diag, map_zero, hcomp] at h
  exact h.symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.normEDS_rel_one_of_gapCore
statement:
theorem normEDS_rel_one_of_gapCore (hgap : WardGapCore) (p q : ℤ) :

proof:
:= by
  set φ : UnivEDS →+* R := (aeval ![b, c, d] : UnivEDS →ₐ[ℤ] R).toRingHom with hφ

    funext n
    rw [Function.comp_apply, map_normEDS]
    congr 1 <;> simp [hφ]
  have h := IsEllipticNet.map_rel (normEDS (X 0 : UnivEDS) (X 1) (X 2)) φ p q 1 0
  rw [normEDS_rel_one_univ_of_gapCore hgap, map_zero, hcomp] at h
  exact h.symm
