name: WeierstrassCurve.WronskianRec.omegaSum_zero
statement: theorem omegaSum_zero : OmegaSum W 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [OmegaSum, show 2 * ((0 : ℤ) + 1) = 2 by norm_num, show 2 * ((0 : ℤ) - 1) = -2 by norm_num,
    show 2 * (0 : ℤ) = 0 by norm_num, show (0 : ℤ) - 1 = -1 by norm_num,
    show (0 : ℤ) + 1 = 1 by norm_num, preΨ_zero, preΨ_two, preΨ_neg, preΨ_two, ΨSq_neg, ΨSq_one]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.WronskianRec.omegaDiff_zero
statement: theorem omegaDiff_zero : OmegaDiff W 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [OmegaDiff, G, Rem, show 2 * ((0 : ℤ) + 1) = 2 by norm_num,
    show 2 * ((0 : ℤ) - 1) = -2 by norm_num, show (0 : ℤ) - 1 = -1 by norm_num,
    show (0 : ℤ) + 1 = 1 by norm_num, preΨ_two, preΨ_neg, preΨ_two, ΨSq_neg, ΨSq_one, Φ_zero,
    ΨSq_zero]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.wronskian_recurrence
statement:
theorem wronskian_recurrence (m : ℤ) :
    (derivative (W.Φ (m + 1)) * W.ΨSq (m + 1) - W.Φ (m + 1) * derivative (W.ΨSq (m + 1))) *
        W.ΨSq (m - 1) ^ 2 +
      (derivative (W.Φ (m - 1)) * W.ΨSq (m - 1) - W.Φ (m - 1) * derivative (W.ΨSq (m - 1))) *
        W.ΨSq (m + 1) ^ 2 =
    WronskianRec.G W m *
      (WronskianRec.L W m * (derivative (W.Φ m) * W.ΨSq m - W.Φ m * derivative (W.ΨSq m)) -
        WronskianRec.Rem W m)
proof:
:= by
  have hS1 := W.hasChordSum m
  rw [HasChordSum] at hS1
  have hS0 : W.ΨSq (m + 1) * W.ΨSq (m - 1) = (X * W.ΨSq m - W.Φ m) ^ 2 := by
    rw [ΨSq_succ_mul_ΨSq_pred, Φ_eq_neg_adjacent_add]
    ring
  have hd1 := congrArg derivative hS1
  have hd0 := congrArg derivative hS0
  simp only [derivative_add, derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_pow, derivative_X,
    derivative_C, derivative_ofNat, Nat.cast_ofNat, map_ofNat] at hd1 hd0
  rw [WronskianRec.G, WronskianRec.L, WronskianRec.Rem]
  linear_combination (W.ΨSq (m + 1) * W.ΨSq (m - 1)) * hd1 -
      (2 * X * W.Φ m ^ 2 + (2 * X ^ 2 + C W.b₂ * X + C W.b₄) * W.Φ m * W.ΨSq m +
        (C W.b₄ * X + C W.b₆) * W.ΨSq m ^ 2) * hd0 -
      (derivative (W.ΨSq (m + 1)) * W.ΨSq (m - 1) +
        W.ΨSq (m + 1) * derivative (W.ΨSq (m - 1))) * hS1 +
      (2 * W.Φ m ^ 2 + 4 * X * W.Φ m * derivative (W.Φ m) +
        (4 * X + C W.b₂) * W.Φ m * W.ΨSq m +
        (2 * X ^ 2 + C W.b₂ * X + C W.b₄) *
          (derivative (W.Φ m) * W.ΨSq m + W.Φ m * derivative (W.ΨSq m)) +
        C W.b₄ * W.ΨSq m ^ 2 +
        2 * (C W.b₄ * X + C W.b₆) * W.ΨSq m * derivative (W.ΨSq m)) * hS0

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_add_one
statement:
theorem hasWronskianId_add_one [NoZeroDivisors R] {m : ℤ}
    (hC1 : WronskianRec.OmegaSum W m) (hC2 : WronskianRec.OmegaDiff W m)
    (hprev : W.HasWronskianId (m - 1)) (hcur : W.HasWronskianId m) (hne : W.ΨSq (m - 1) ≠ 0) :
    W.HasWronskianId (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have key := W.wronskian_recurrence m
  rw [WronskianRec.OmegaSum] at hC1
  rw [WronskianRec.OmegaDiff] at hC2
  rw [HasWronskianId] at hprev hcur ⊢
  have e1 := W.preΨ_two_mul (m + 1)
  have e2 := W.preΨ_two_mul (m - 1)
  have e3 := W.preΨ_two_mul m
  push_cast at hprev hcur ⊢
  have hcancel :
      (derivative (W.Φ (m + 1)) * W.ΨSq (m + 1) - W.Φ (m + 1) * derivative (W.ΨSq (m + 1)) -
        ((m : R[X]) + 1) * W.preΨ (m + 1) * W.preΩ (m + 1)) * W.ΨSq (m - 1) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    linear_combination key - W.ΨSq (m + 1) ^ 2 * hprev +
      (WronskianRec.G W m * WronskianRec.L W m) * hcur + ((m : R[X]) - 1) * W.ΨSq (m + 1) ^ 2 * e2 -
      (m : R[X]) * WronskianRec.G W m * WronskianRec.L W m * e3 - (m : R[X]) * hC1 - hC2 +
      ((m : R[X]) + 1) * W.ΨSq (m - 1) ^ 2 * e1
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hcancel).resolve_right (pow_ne_zero _ hne))

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_of_recurrence
statement:
theorem hasWronskianId_of_recurrence [IsDomain R] [CharZero R]
    (hC1 : ∀ m : ℤ, WronskianRec.OmegaSum W m)
    (hC2 : ∀ m : ℤ, WronskianRec.OmegaDiff W m) (n : ℤ) :
    W.HasWronskianId n
proof:
:= by
  have step : ∀ k : ℕ, W.HasWronskianId ((k : ℤ) + 1) ∧ W.HasWronskianId ((k : ℤ) + 2) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [show ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = 1 by norm_num]
        exact W.hasWronskianId_one
      · rw [show ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 2 = 2 by norm_num]
        exact W.hasWronskianId_two
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih
      have e : ((k : ℤ) + 2) - 1 = (k : ℤ) + 1 := by ring
      have hne : W.ΨSq (((k : ℤ) + 2) - 1) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [e]
        exact W.ΨSq_ne_zero (Int.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))
      have hstep := W.hasWronskianId_add_one (m := (k : ℤ) + 2) (hC1 _) (hC2 _)
        (by rw [e]; exact h1) h2 hne
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [show ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1 = (k : ℤ) + 2 by push_cast; ring]
        exact h2
      · rw [show ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 2 = (k : ℤ) + 2 + 1 by push_cast; ring]
        exact hstep
  have pos : ∀ k : ℕ, W.HasWronskianId (k : ℤ) := by
    intro k
    match k with
    | 0 =>
      rw [show ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 0 by norm_num]
      exact W.hasWronskianId_zero
    | (k + 1) =>
      rw [show ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (k : ℤ) + 1 by push_cast; ring]
      exact (step k).left
  induction n using Int.negInduction with
  | nat k => exact pos k
  | neg ih k => exact hasWronskianId_neg.mpr (ih k)

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_of_univQ_recurrence
statement:
theorem hasWronskianId_of_univQ_recurrence (hC1 : ∀ m : ℤ, WronskianRec.OmegaSum univQ m)
    (hC2 : ∀ m : ℤ, WronskianRec.OmegaDiff univQ m) (n : ℤ) :
    W.HasWronskianId n
proof:
:=
  hasWronskianId_of_univQ (univQ.hasWronskianId_of_recurrence hC1 hC2 n) W

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_eq_sq_of_recurrence
statement:
theorem card_torsion_eq_sq_of_recurrence [DecidableEq F] [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n) (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0)
    (hC1 : ∀ m : ℤ, WronskianRec.OmegaSum univQ m)
    (hC2 : ∀ m : ℤ, WronskianRec.OmegaDiff univQ m) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n ^ 2
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_eq_sq_of_wronskian_identity h2 hodd hn
    (by
      have H := W.hasWronskianId_of_univQ_recurrence hC1 hC2 (n : ℤ)
      rw [HasWronskianId] at H
      rw [H]; push_cast; ring)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_preΨ_of_wronskian
statement:
theorem separable_preΨ_of_wronskian {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n) (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0)
    (hid : derivative (W.Φ (n : ℤ)) * W.ΨSq (n : ℤ) -
        W.Φ (n : ℤ) * derivative (W.ΨSq (n : ℤ)) =
      (n : F[X]) * W.preΨ (n : ℤ) * W.preΩ (n : ℤ))
    (hcop : IsCoprime (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)) (W.preΩ (n : ℤ))) :
    (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)).Separable
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : (((n : ℤ)) : F) ≠ 0 := by push_cast; exact hn
  have hp0 : W.preΨ (n : ℤ) ≠ 0 := W.preΨ_ne_zero (R := F) hcast
  
  have hoddZ : Odd ((n : ℤ)) := by exact_mod_cast hodd
  have hsq : W.ΨSq (n : ℤ) = W.preΨ (n : ℤ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq, if_neg (Int.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hoddZ), mul_one]
  
  have hdiv : derivative (W.Φ (n : ℤ)) * W.preΨ (n : ℤ) -
      2 * W.Φ (n : ℤ) * derivative (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)) = (n : F[X]) * W.preΩ (n : ℤ) := by
    refine mul_left_cancel₀ hp0 ?_
    rw [hsq] at hid
    simp only [derivative_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, map_ofNat] at hid ⊢
    linear_combination hid
  
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hcop
  refine (separable_def' _).2 ⟨u + v * C ((n : F)⁻¹) * derivative (W.Φ (n : ℤ)),
    -(2 * v * C ((n : F)⁻¹) * W.Φ (n : ℤ)), ?_⟩
  have hC : C ((n : F)⁻¹) * (n : F[X]) = 1 := by
    rw [← C_eq_natCast, ← C_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, C_1]
  linear_combination huv + v * C ((n : F)⁻¹) * hdiv + v * W.preΩ (n : ℤ) * hC

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_eq_sq_of_wronskian
statement:
theorem card_torsion_eq_sq_of_wronskian [DecidableEq F] [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hodd : Odd n) (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0)
    (hid : derivative (W.Φ (n : ℤ)) * W.ΨSq (n : ℤ) -
        W.Φ (n : ℤ) * derivative (W.ΨSq (n : ℤ)) =
      (n : F[X]) * W.preΨ (n : ℤ) * W.preΩ (n : ℤ))
    (hcop : IsCoprime (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)) (W.preΩ (n : ℤ))) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n ^ 2
proof:
:=
  (card_torsion_eq_sq_iff_separable_preΨ h2 hodd hn).2
    (separable_preΨ_of_wronskian hodd hn hid hcop)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_eq_neg_Φ_mul_ΨSq
statement:
theorem ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_eq_neg_Φ_mul_ΨSq (h : W.Equation x y) {n : ℤ}
    (hz : (W.ψ n).evalEval x y = 0) (q : ℤ) :
    (W.ψ (n + q)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (n - q)).evalEval x y =
      -((W.Φ n).eval x * (W.ΨSq q).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (W.ΨSq n).eval x = 0 := by rw [← ψ_sq_evalEval h n, hz]; ring
  rw [ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_evalEval h n q, hsq]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_preΩ_ne_zero_of_eval_preΨ_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_preΩ_ne_zero_of_eval_preΨ_eq_zero [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hpair : ∀ x y : F, W.Equation x y → (W.ψ (n : ℤ)).evalEval x y = 0 →
      (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) + 2)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).evalEval x y ^ 2 =
        -((W.ψ ((n : ℤ) - 2)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) + 1)).evalEval x y ^ 2))
    {x : F} (hx : (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)).eval x = 0) :
    (W.preΩ (n : ℤ)).eval x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := exists_equation (W := W) h2 x
  have hΨSq : (W.ΨSq (n : ℤ)).eval x = 0 := by
    rw [ΨSq_natCast_eq_sq_of_odd hodd, eval_pow, hx, zero_pow (two_ne_zero (α := ℕ))]
  have hψn : (W.ψ (n : ℤ)).evalEval x y = 0 :=
    pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp (by rw [ψ_sq_evalEval hxy, hΨSq])
  have hΦ : (W.Φ (n : ℤ)).eval x ≠ 0 := eval_Φ_ne_zero_of_eval_ΨSq_eq_zero h2 hn x hΨSq
  have hΨ₂ : W.Ψ₂Sq.eval x ≠ 0 := eval_Ψ₂Sq_ne_zero_of_eval_preΨ_eq_zero h2 hodd hx
  
  have h1 := ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_eq_neg_Φ_mul_ΨSq hxy hψn 1
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_one, eval_one, mul_one] at h1
  have hm1 : (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).evalEval x y ≠ 0 := fun hc => hΦ (by
    rw [hc, mul_zero] at h1; simpa using h1.symm)
  have h2' := ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_eq_neg_Φ_mul_ΨSq hxy hψn 2
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_two] at h2'
  have hp2 : (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) + 2)).evalEval x y ≠ 0 := fun hc => (mul_ne_zero hΦ hΨ₂) (by
    rw [hc, zero_mul] at h2'; simpa using h2'.symm)
  
  have hfac := congrArg (Polynomial.evalEval x y) (W.Ω_factor (n : ℤ))
  rw [if_neg (Int.not_even_iff_odd.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hodd : Odd ((n : ℤ))))] at hfac
  simp only [evalEval_mul, evalEval_sub, evalEval_pow, evalEval_C, ← ψ_evalEval hxy] at hfac
  intro hΩ
  rw [hΩ, mul_zero] at hfac
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero h2 hp2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hm1) (by
    linear_combination hfac + hpair x y hxy hψn)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.isCoprime_preΨ_preΩ
statement:
theorem isCoprime_preΨ_preΩ [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic] (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ}
    (hodd : Odd n) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hpair : ∀ x y : F, W.Equation x y → (W.ψ (n : ℤ)).evalEval x y = 0 →
      (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) + 2)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).evalEval x y ^ 2 =
        -((W.ψ ((n : ℤ) - 2)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) + 1)).evalEval x y ^ 2)) :
    IsCoprime (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)) (W.preΩ (n : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  refine (Polynomial.isCoprime_iff_aeval_ne_zero_of_isAlgClosed (K := F) _ _ _).mpr fun a => ?_
  simp only [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map, Algebra.algebraMap_self, Polynomial.map_id]
  by_cases hp : (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)).eval a = 0
  · exact Or.inr (eval_preΩ_ne_zero_of_eval_preΨ_eq_zero h2 hodd hn hpair hp)
  · exact Or.inl hp

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_eq_sq_of_wronskian_of_pair
statement:
theorem card_torsion_eq_sq_of_wronskian_of_pair [DecidableEq F] [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n) (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) (hn0 : n ≠ 0)
    (hid : derivative (W.Φ (n : ℤ)) * W.ΨSq (n : ℤ) -
        W.Φ (n : ℤ) * derivative (W.ΨSq (n : ℤ)) =
      (n : F[X]) * W.preΨ (n : ℤ) * W.preΩ (n : ℤ))
    (hpair : ∀ x y : F, W.Equation x y → (W.ψ (n : ℤ)).evalEval x y = 0 →
      (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) + 2)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) - 1)).evalEval x y ^ 2 =
        -((W.ψ ((n : ℤ) - 2)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ ((n : ℤ) + 1)).evalEval x y ^ 2)) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n ^ 2
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_eq_sq_of_wronskian h2 hodd hn hid (isCoprime_preΨ_preΩ h2 hodd hn0 hpair)

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_iff_wronskian
statement:
theorem hasWronskianId_iff_wronskian {W : WeierstrassCurve R} {n : ℤ} :
    W.HasWronskianId n ↔
      wronskian (W.ΨSq n) (W.Φ n) = (n : R[X]) * W.preΨ n * W.preΩ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasWronskianId Polynomial.wronskian
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linear_combination h

name: WeierstrassCurve.HasWronskianId.map
statement:
theorem HasWronskianId.map {W : WeierstrassCurve R} {n : ℤ} (h : W.HasWronskianId n) (f : R →+* S) :
    (W.map f).HasWronskianId n
proof:
:= by
  have H := congrArg (Polynomial.map f) h
  simpa only [HasWronskianId, map_Φ, map_ΨSq, map_preΨ, map_preΩ, derivative_map,
    Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_intCast] using H

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_of_map
statement:
theorem hasWronskianId_of_map {W : WeierstrassCurve R} {f : R →+* S} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    {n : ℤ} (h : (W.map f).HasWronskianId n) : W.HasWronskianId n
proof:
:= by
  refine Polynomial.map_injective f hf ?_
  simpa only [HasWronskianId, map_Φ, map_ΨSq, map_preΨ, map_preΩ, derivative_map,
    Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_intCast] using h

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_of_univ
statement:
theorem hasWronskianId_of_univ {n : ℤ} (h : univ.HasWronskianId n) (W : WeierstrassCurve R) :
    W.HasWronskianId n
proof:
:= by
  have H := h.map W.specialize
  rwa [univ_map_specialize] at H

name: WeierstrassCurve.forall_hasWronskianId_iff_univ
statement:
theorem forall_hasWronskianId_iff_univ {n : ℤ} :
    (∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] (W : WeierstrassCurve R), W.HasWronskianId n) ↔
      univ.HasWronskianId n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h _ univ, fun h _ _ W => hasWronskianId_of_univ h W⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_of_univQ
statement:
theorem hasWronskianId_of_univQ {n : ℤ} (h : univQ.HasWronskianId n) (W : WeierstrassCurve R) :
    W.HasWronskianId n
proof:
:=
  hasWronskianId_of_univ (hasWronskianId_of_map (MvPolynomial.map_injective _ Int.cast_injective) h)
    W

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_neg
statement:
theorem hasWronskianId_neg {W : WeierstrassCurve R} {n : ℤ} :
    W.HasWronskianId (-n) ↔ W.HasWronskianId n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HasWronskianId, Φ_neg, ΨSq_neg, preΨ_neg, preΩ_neg, Int.cast_neg, neg_mul, mul_neg,
    neg_neg]

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_zero
statement: theorem hasWronskianId_zero : W.HasWronskianId 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [HasWronskianId, ΨSq_zero, preΨ_zero]

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_one
statement: theorem hasWronskianId_one : W.HasWronskianId 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : W.preΩ 1 = 1 := by
    rw [preΩ, show (1 : ℤ) + 2 = 3 by norm_num, show (1 : ℤ) - 1 = 0 by norm_num,
      show (1 : ℤ) - 2 = -1 by norm_num, show (1 : ℤ) + 1 = 2 by norm_num, preΨ_zero, preΨ_two,
      preΨ_neg, preΨ_one]
    ring
  rw [HasWronskianId, Φ_one, ΨSq_one, preΨ_one, h]
  simp

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_two
statement: theorem hasWronskianId_two : W.HasWronskianId 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [HasWronskianId, Φ_two, ΨSq_two, preΨ_two, preΩ_two, Ψ₂Sq, preΨ₄, b₂, b₄, b₆, b₈]
  simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_add, derivative_mul, derivative_pow, derivative_X,
    derivative_C, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  simp only [map_ofNat, C_add, C_sub, C_mul, C_pow]
  push_cast
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.hasWronskianId_two_of_univQ
statement: theorem hasWronskianId_two_of_univQ : W.HasWronskianId 2
proof:
:=
  hasWronskianId_of_univQ (univQ.hasWronskianId_two) W

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.separable_preΨ_of_univQ
statement:
theorem separable_preΨ_of_univQ {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n) (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0)
    (h : univQ.HasWronskianId (n : ℤ))
    (hcop : IsCoprime (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)) (W.preΩ (n : ℤ))) :
    (W.preΨ (n : ℤ)).Separable
proof:
:= by
  refine separable_preΨ_of_wronskian hodd hn ?_ hcop
  have H := hasWronskianId_of_univQ h W
  rw [HasWronskianId] at H
  rw [H]
  push_cast
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_eq_sq_of_univQ
statement:
theorem card_torsion_eq_sq_of_univQ [DecidableEq F] [IsAlgClosed F] [W.IsElliptic]
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hodd : Odd n) (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0)
    (h : univQ.HasWronskianId (n : ℤ)) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) = n ^ 2
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_eq_sq_of_wronskian_identity h2 hodd hn
    (by
      have H := hasWronskianId_of_univQ h W
      rw [HasWronskianId] at H
      rw [H]; push_cast; ring)

name: IsEllipticNet.mul_sub_eq_of_rel_one
statement:
theorem mul_sub_eq_of_rel_one {W : ℤ → R} (h1 : W 1 = 1) {p q : ℤ} (h : rel W p q 1 0 = 0) :
    W (p + q) * W (p - q)
      = W (p + 1) * W (p - 1) * W q ^ 2 - W (q + 1) * W (q - 1) * W p ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel, add_zero, h1, mul_one] at h
  linear_combination h

name: IsEllipticNet.mul_sub_eq_of_isEllipticSequence
statement:
theorem mul_sub_eq_of_isEllipticSequence {W : ℤ → R} (h1 : W 1 = 1) (h : IsEllipticSequence W)
    (p q : ℤ) :
    W (p + q) * W (p - q)
      = W (p + 1) * W (p - 1) * W q ^ 2 - W (q + 1) * W (q - 1) * W p ^ 2
proof:
:=
  mul_sub_eq_of_rel_one h1 (h p q 1)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub
statement:
theorem ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub (p q : ℤ) :
    W.ψ (p + q) * W.ψ (p - q) = W.φ q * W.ψ p ^ 2 - W.φ p * W.ψ q ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsEllipticNet.mul_sub_eq_of_rel_one (W := W.ψ) (by simp) (W.ψ_rel_one p q),
    WeierstrassCurve.φ, WeierstrassCurve.φ]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_two_mul_add_one
statement:
theorem ψ_two_mul_add_one (n : ℤ) :
    W.ψ (2 * n + 1) = W.φ n * W.ψ (n + 1) ^ 2 - W.φ (n + 1) * W.ψ n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := W.ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub (n + 1) n
  rw [show n + 1 + n = 2 * n + 1 by ring, show n + 1 - n = 1 by ring, ψ_one, mul_one] at h
  exact h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_two_mul_mul_ψ_two
statement:
theorem ψ_two_mul_mul_ψ_two (n : ℤ) :
    W.ψ (2 * n) * W.ψ 2 = W.φ (n - 1) * W.ψ (n + 1) ^ 2 - W.φ (n + 1) * W.ψ (n - 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := W.ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub (n + 1) (n - 1)
  rwa [show n + 1 + (n - 1) = 2 * n by ring, show n + 1 - (n - 1) = 2 by ring] at h

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_evalEval
statement:
theorem ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_evalEval (h : W.Equation x y) (p q : ℤ) :
    (W.ψ (p + q)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (p - q)).evalEval x y
      = (W.Φ q).eval x * (W.ΨSq p).eval x - (W.Φ p).eval x * (W.ΨSq q).eval x
proof:
:= by
  have H := congrArg (fun g : R[X][Y] => g.evalEval x y) (W.ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub p q)
  simp only [evalEval_mul, evalEval_sub, evalEval_pow] at H
  rw [H, φ_evalEval h, φ_evalEval h, ψ_sq_evalEval h, ψ_sq_evalEval h]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Φ_div_ΨSq_sub_Φ_div_ΨSq
statement:
theorem Φ_div_ΨSq_sub_Φ_div_ΨSq (h : W.Equation x y) {p q : ℤ}
    (hp : (W.ΨSq p).eval x ≠ 0) (hq : (W.ΨSq q).eval x ≠ 0) :
    (W.Φ q).eval x / (W.ΨSq q).eval x - (W.Φ p).eval x / (W.ΨSq p).eval x
      = (W.ψ (p + q)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (p - q)).evalEval x y
          / ((W.ΨSq p).eval x * (W.ΨSq q).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_evalEval h, div_sub_div _ _ hq hp, div_eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero hq hp)
    (mul_ne_zero hp hq)]
  ring

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Φ_div_ΨSq_eq_iff
statement:
theorem Φ_div_ΨSq_eq_iff (h : W.Equation x y) {p q : ℤ}
    (hp : (W.ΨSq p).eval x ≠ 0) (hq : (W.ΨSq q).eval x ≠ 0) :
    (W.Φ q).eval x / (W.ΨSq q).eval x = (W.Φ p).eval x / (W.ΨSq p).eval x
      ↔ (W.ψ (p + q)).evalEval x y = 0 ∨ (W.ψ (p - q)).evalEval x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, Φ_div_ΨSq_sub_Φ_div_ΨSq h hp hq,
    div_eq_zero_iff, mul_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero]
  simp [hp, hq]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.xCoord_sub_xCoord_of_hasXCoordFormula
statement:
theorem xCoord_sub_xCoord_of_hasXCoordFormula {p q : ℕ}
    (hp : HasXCoordFormula W p) (hq : HasXCoordFormula W q) (h : W.Nonsingular x y)
    (hp0 : (W.ΨSq p).eval x ≠ 0) (hq0 : (W.ΨSq q).eval x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (xp yp xq yq : F) (hP : W.Nonsingular xp yp) (hQ : W.Nonsingular xq yq),
      p • Point.some x y h = Point.some xp yp hP ∧ q • Point.some x y h = Point.some xq yq hQ ∧
        xq - xp = (W.ψ (p + q : ℤ)).evalEval x y * (W.ψ (p - q : ℤ)).evalEval x y
          / ((W.ΨSq (p : ℤ)).eval x * (W.ΨSq (q : ℤ)).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨yp, hP, hPeq⟩ := hp h hp0
  obtain ⟨yq, hQ, hQeq⟩ := hq h hq0
  exact ⟨_, yp, _, yq, hP, hQ, hPeq, hQeq, Φ_div_ΨSq_sub_Φ_div_ΨSq h.1 hp0 hq0⟩

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.xCoord_two_sub_xCoord_three
statement:
theorem xCoord_two_sub_xCoord_three (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (h : W.Nonsingular x y)
    (h3 : (W.ΨSq 3).eval x ≠ 0) (h2' : (W.ΨSq 2).eval x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (x₃ y₃ x₂ y₂ : F) (h₃ : W.Nonsingular x₃ y₃) (h₂ : W.Nonsingular x₂ y₂),
      (3 : ℕ) • Point.some x y h = Point.some x₃ y₃ h₃ ∧
        (2 : ℕ) • Point.some x y h = Point.some x₂ y₂ h₂ ∧
          x₂ - x₃ = (W.ψ 5).evalEval x y / ((W.ΨSq 3).eval x * (W.ΨSq 2).eval x)
proof:
:= by
  have H := xCoord_sub_xCoord_of_hasXCoordFormula (p := 3) (q := 2) (hasXCoordFormula_three h2)
    hasXCoordFormula_two h (by simpa using h3) (by simpa using h2')
  obtain ⟨x₃, y₃, x₂, y₂, h₃, h₂, e₃, e₂, hx⟩ := H
  refine ⟨x₃, y₃, x₂, y₂, h₃, h₂, e₃, e₂, ?_⟩
  rw [hx]
  norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_y2EqX3AddOne_two_three
statement: private lemma equation_y2EqX3AddOne_two_three : (y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).Equation 2 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Affine.equation_iff]; norm_num [y2EqX3AddOne]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_ΨSq_two_y2EqX3AddOne
statement: private lemma eval_ΨSq_two_y2EqX3AddOne : ((y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).ΨSq 2).eval 2 = 36
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_two]
  norm_num [y2EqX3AddOne, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₂Sq, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_ΨSq_three_y2EqX3AddOne
statement: private lemma eval_ΨSq_three_y2EqX3AddOne : ((y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).ΨSq 3).eval 2 = 5184
proof:
:= by
  rw [ΨSq_three_eval]
  norm_num [y2EqX3AddOne, WeierstrassCurve.Ψ₃, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
    WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.eval_Φ_two_y2EqX3AddOne
statement: private lemma eval_Φ_two_y2EqX3AddOne : ((y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).Φ 2).eval 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.Φ_two]
  norm_num [y2EqX3AddOne, WeierstrassCurve.b₄, WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.evalEval_ψ_five_y2EqX3AddOne
statement:
theorem evalEval_ψ_five_y2EqX3AddOne :
    ((y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).ψ 5).evalEval 2 3 = 186624
proof:
:= by
  have h := ψ_add_mul_ψ_sub_evalEval equation_y2EqX3AddOne_two_three 3 2
  rw [show (3 : ℤ) + 2 = 5 from rfl, show (3 : ℤ) - 2 = 1 from rfl, WeierstrassCurve.ψ_one,
    Polynomial.evalEval_one, mul_one, eval_Φ_two_y2EqX3AddOne, eval_Φ_three_y2EqX3AddOne,
    eval_ΨSq_two_y2EqX3AddOne, eval_ΨSq_three_y2EqX3AddOne] at h
  rw [h]; norm_num

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ncard_setOf_isRoot_le
statement:
private theorem ncard_setOf_isRoot_le {p : F[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    {x : F | p.IsRoot x}.ncard ≤ p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hset : {x : F | p.IsRoot x} = (p.roots.toFinset : Set F) := by
    ext x; simp [mem_roots hp]
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  exact (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _).trans p.card_roots'

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.four_ne_zero
statement: private theorem four_ne_zero (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) : (4 : F) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have : (4 : F) = 2 * 2 := by norm_num
  rw [this]
  exact mul_ne_zero h2 h2

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsionXSupport
statement: theorem finite_torsionXSupport {n : ℤ} (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) : (W.torsionXSupport n).Finite
proof:
:=
  finite_setOf_isRoot (W.ΨSq_ne_zero hn)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.ncard_torsionXSupport_le
statement:
theorem ncard_torsionXSupport_le {n : ℤ} (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) :
    (W.torsionXSupport n).ncard ≤ n.natAbs ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:=
  (ncard_setOf_isRoot_le (W.ΨSq_ne_zero hn)).trans (W.natDegree_ΨSq_le n)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.torsionXSupport_of_odd
statement:
theorem torsionXSupport_of_odd {n : ℤ} (hodd : Odd n) :
    W.torsionXSupport n = {x : F | (W.preΨ n).IsRoot x}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [torsionXSupport, ΨSq, Int.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hodd, IsRoot, pow_eq_zero_iff]

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.selfNeg_of_isRoot_Ψ₂Sq
statement:
theorem selfNeg_of_isRoot_Ψ₂Sq {x y : F} (h : W.Equation x y) (hx : W.Ψ₂Sq.IsRoot x) :
    y = W.negY x y
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := ψ_sq_evalEval h 2
  rw [WeierstrassCurve.ΨSq_two, hx] at hsq
  have h0 : (W.ψ 2).evalEval x y = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp hsq
  rw [ψ_two_evalEval] at h0
  rw [negY]
  linear_combination h0

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_torsionXSupport_of_mem_torsion
proof:
:= by
  have hψ := ψ_evalEval_eq_zero_of_nsmul_eq_zero h2 h (mem_torsion_iff.mp hP)
  have hsq := ψ_sq_evalEval h.left (n : ℤ)
  rw [hψ] at hsq
  simpa [torsionXSupport, IsRoot] using hsq.symm

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.mem_preΨ_union_Ψ₂Sq_of_mem_torsion
proof:
:= by
  have hx := mem_torsionXSupport_of_mem_torsion h2 hP
  rw [torsionXSupport, Set.mem_setOf_eq, IsRoot, ΨSq, eval_mul, eval_pow] at hx
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hp | hq
  · exact Or.inl (pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp hp)
  · by_cases he : Even (n : ℤ)
    · rw [if_pos he] at hq
      exact Or.inr hq
    · rw [if_neg he] at hq
      simp at hq

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_of_intCast_ne_zero
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_of_intCast_ne_zero (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) :
    Finite (W.torsion n)
proof:
:=
  W.finite_torsion_of_xCoords (finite_torsionXSupport (by exact_mod_cast hn))
    (mem_torsionXSupport_of_mem_torsion h2)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_le_sq
statement:
theorem card_torsion_le_sq (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : F) ≠ 0) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) ≤ n ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : ((n : ℤ) : F) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hn
  have hdeg := (ncard_setOf_isRoot_le (W.preΨ_ne_zero hn')).trans (W.natDegree_preΨ_le (n : ℤ))
  rw [Int.natAbs_natCast] at hdeg
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with he | ho
  
  
  · rw [if_pos (by exact_mod_cast he : Even ((n : ℤ)))] at hdeg
    have h₀ := (ncard_setOf_isRoot_le (W.Ψ₂Sq_ne_zero (four_ne_zero h2))).trans W.natDegree_Ψ₂Sq_le
    have hcard := W.card_torsion_le_of_xCoords_of_selfNeg (n := n)
      (finite_setOf_isRoot (W.preΨ_ne_zero hn'))
      (finite_setOf_isRoot (W.Ψ₂Sq_ne_zero (four_ne_zero h2)))
      (mem_preΨ_union_Ψ₂Sq_of_mem_torsion h2)
      (fun _ _ hns _ hx => selfNeg_of_isRoot_Ψ₂Sq hns.left hx)
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := he
    have hsq : (m + m) ^ 2 = 4 * m ^ 2 := by ring
    have hm : 1 ≤ m := by omega
    rw [hsq] at hdeg ⊢
    have : 1 ≤ m ^ 2 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    omega
  
  · have hoZ : Odd ((n : ℤ)) := by exact_mod_cast ho
    rw [if_neg (Int.not_even_iff_odd.mpr hoZ)] at hdeg
    have hcard := W.card_torsion_le_of_xCoords (finite_setOf_isRoot (W.preΨ_ne_zero hn'))
      (fun _ _ _ hP => by
        have := mem_torsionXSupport_of_mem_torsion h2 hP
        rwa [torsionXSupport_of_odd hoZ] at this)
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := ho
    have hsq : (2 * m + 1) ^ 2 = 4 * m ^ 2 + 4 * m + 1 := by ring
    rw [hsq] at hdeg ⊢
    omega

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_of_charZero
statement: theorem finite_torsion_of_charZero [CharZero F] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Finite (W.torsion n)
proof:
:=
  finite_torsion_of_intCast_ne_zero two_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_le_sq_of_charZero
statement:
theorem card_torsion_le_sq_of_charZero [CharZero F] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Nat.card (W.torsion n) ≤ n ^ 2
proof:
:=
  card_torsion_le_sq two_ne_zero (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_of_not_dvd_charP
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_of_not_dvd_charP (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) {p : ℕ} [CharP F p] {n : ℕ}
    (hn : ¬ p ∣ n) : Finite (W.torsion n)
proof:
:=
  finite_torsion_of_intCast_ne_zero h2 fun h => hn ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff F p n).mp h)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_of_lt_charP
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_of_lt_charP {p : ℕ} [CharP F p] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hp : n < p) :
    Finite (W.torsion n)
proof:
:= by
  have hdvd : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m < p → ¬ p ∣ m := fun m hm hmp hd =>
    absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd) (by omega)
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hn with h1 | hlt
  · rw [← h1, torsion_one]
    infer_instance
  · exact finite_torsion_of_not_dvd_charP
      (fun h => hdvd 2 (by omega) (by omega) ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff F p 2).mp h))
      (hdvd n hn hp)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_five_y2EqX3AddOne
statement: theorem finite_torsion_five_y2EqX3AddOne : Finite ((y2EqX3AddOne ℚ).torsion 5)
proof:
:=
  finite_torsion_of_charZero (by norm_num)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.finite_torsion_five_algClosure
statement:
theorem finite_torsion_five_algClosure :
    Finite ((y2EqX3AddOne (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)).torsion 5)
proof:
:=
  finite_torsion_of_charZero (by norm_num)

name: WeierstrassCurve.Affine.card_torsion_five_le_algClosure
statement:
theorem card_torsion_five_le_algClosure :
    Nat.card ((y2EqX3AddOne (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)).torsion 5) ≤ 25
proof:
:= by
  simpa using card_torsion_le_sq_of_charZero
    (W := y2EqX3AddOne (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (n := 5) (by norm_num)

name: WeierstrassCurve.univ_map_specialize
statement: theorem univ_map_specialize (W : WeierstrassCurve R) : univ.map W.specialize = W
proof:
:= by
  ext <;>
    simp only [WeierstrassCurve.map_a₁, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₂, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₃,
      WeierstrassCurve.map_a₄, WeierstrassCurve.map_a₆, univ, specialize,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val]
